tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i bskyed rim snang ba'i nyin byed bzhugs/ /
༄༅/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i bskyed rim snang ba'i nyin byed bzhugs/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i bskyed rim snang ba'i nyin byed bzhugs/ /

dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rim pa dang po'i lam gyi rnam par bzhag pa bskyed rim snang ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang bcas pa rnams la rnam pa kun tu gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ / rab dkar dge legs dpag yas las bsgrubs pa'i/ /rmad byung yon tan bye ba'i cha tsam zhig /dran par byas na'ang rgyal ba sras bcas kun/ /yun ring mchod pa'i bsod nams phung po yis/ /brgya phrag bye ba'i char yang mi phod pa'i| |dge legs stsol mdzad phun tshogs kun gyi gzhi/ /gang gi drin gyis thub pa'i lam gyi gnad/ /ston mdzad rje btsun bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /dpag yas rnam gsum tshogs kyi chu klung yan lag brgyad ldan ma lus bsdus/ /mkha' zung dus zla mig srog rnyog pa phra rab gzugs dang lhan cig dengs/ /'gyur med bde chen dbang gi rgyal po phun tshogs 'dod dgu'i bang mdzod gter/ /rnam kun mchog ldan stong gzugs mdangs gsal dang po'i sangs rgyas rnam par rgyal/ /rnyog med dang ba'i yid mtshor gang gi sku| |cung zad shar ba'i mod la'ang rmongs pa'i mun/ /drungs 'byin gsung rab gnad la nges ster ba/ /lha mchog 'jam pa'i dbyangs la snying nas 'dud/ /dri med lha yi lam la 'ja' tshon ltar/ /rnam rol sku yis gsang ba'i mdzod kun 'dzin/ /gsang bdag mgon la gus 'dud bdud rnams kyang*/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i zhabs dran bag yod gyis/ /ma lus rgyal ba'i thugs rje chen po ni| |byang phyogs sa skyong rigs ldan skur shar te/ /'grel mdzad padma dkar po'i zhabs rdul la/ /phyag 'tshal slar yang bdag blau rgyas par mdzod/ khyab bdag mchog dang de gsung dam chos dang*/ /de 'dzin bgyid pa'i skal bzang de dag gis/ /zhabs 'bring nyid du rang gis bro bor ba'i/ /bstan bsrung spyi dang mthu ldan rnal 'byor ma/ /so bdun sde drug bsrungs mar bcas rnams la'ang*/

/gus pas phyag bgyid dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /rim pa dang po'i lam la 'khrul ba'i tshogs/ /kun nas bsal te rgyud 'grel dgongs pa'i don/ /ji bzhin 'byed pa'i 'bad pa 'bras mchis shing*/ /phyi nang nyer 'tshe'i dgra las rnam rgyal nas/ /yid la bsam pa chos ldan 'grub bzhin du/ /spyi dgos thub bstan ches cher rgyas par mdzod/ /dpal ldan mdo rgyud lam gyi pad tshal snying po'i ge sar bzhad pa'i dpal/ /log bshad 'byung po'i smra ba nyams byed legs bshad gzi 'od stong 'bar ba/ /gsung rab gling bzhi'i mun pa kun sel sngon med nyi ma deng 'dir 'char/ /skal bzang rgyal ba'i lam la 'jug 'dod phyogs lhung dor la spro bar gyis/ de yang bdag cag rnams kyi ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das snyan pa'i ba dan dkar po sa gsum na g.yo ba de nyid kyis/ mtha' yas pa'i sems can srid pa dang zhi ba'i g.yang du lhung ste sdug bsngal gsum gyi mun pas lhag par bsgribs pa mtha' dag sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa'i thugs rje chen po'i rlung shugs kyis legs par bskyod cing*/ de rnams sdug bsngal mtha' dag dang bral ba de yang rang nyid kyis mdzad par bzhed pa'i lhag bsam las grub pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi shing rtas drangs pa'i tshogs gnyis kyi nyin byed dge legs kyi dkyil 'khor mtha' dag yongs su rdzogs shing*/ phrin las kyi tsha zer bye ba 'bum phrag skal bzang gi yul la gcig car du 'bab pa'i gzugs kyi sku rmad du byung bas/ theg pa gsum la ltos pa'i rigs can mtha' dag rang rang gi bag la nyal dang mthun pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad pa'i lam zab mo/ blo gros dman pa rnams kyis rjes su yi rang ba yang bya bar dka' ba ji snyed cig bka' stsal ba rnams kyi nang nas rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar zla med par gyur pa ni/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo yin la/

de'i lam gyi rnam par bzhag pa thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa mtha' yas pa zhig yod kyang bden gnyis la ltos nas bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gnyis kyi yan lag tu 'dus pa las/ re shig bskyed rim yan lag dang bcas pa'i rnam par bzhag pa bshad par bya'o/ /de la yang skyes bu mchog dman gyi lam gyi rim pa la rmongs pa byis pa'i blau can 'ga' zhig rgyud 'di nyid gsung rab spyi dang khyad par rgyud sde kun gyi yang mchog yin pa ltar/ 'di'i lam yang skyes bu mchog dbang po shin tu rnon pos bslab par bya ba yin pas 'di la slob pa'i gang zag des ni/ gang zag dman pa rnams kyis bslab par bya ba dge ba bcu la sogs pa'i las 'bras kyi blang dor dang*/ sbyin pa dang tshul khrims dang*/ byams pa dang snying rje dang byang chub kyi sems dang phar phyin drug la bslab mi dgos shing*/ der ma zad bla med kyi rgyud sde rnams las bshad pa'i bskyed pa'i rim pa la yang bslab mi dgos kyi| zab lam du sogs kyi rnal 'byor rkyang pa bsgoms pas nyi ma gcig la sogs pas chos sku mngon sum du mthong bar 'gyur ro zhes dang*/ de las blo gros cung zad mtho bar byas pa dag lam thun mong ba sngon du ma song na 'di lta bu'i rgyud thos pa dang lam nyan pa sogs kyi skal ba 'byung mi srid pas 'di la slob pa dang thos pa'i skal ba cig byung phyin chad lam gzhan rnams tshe snga ma rnams su bsgrubs zin cig yin nges pa'i phyir/ tshe 'dir dge sdig gi blang dor mi dgos par rdzogs rim rkyang pa bsgoms pas chog go zhes zer ro| |des na de lta bu la sogs pa'i log par rtog pa bsal ba'i phyir du 'di ltar bshad par bya ste/ lam spyi'i rnam par bzhag pa dang*/ khyad par rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rnam gzhag go /dang po la yang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i skyes bu gsum gyi blang bya dang dor bya'i lam rnams kyi so so'i mtshan nyid dang*/

rgyu tshogs dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ byed las dang*/ 'bras bu sogs kyi sgo nas rgyas par shes dgos mod kyi/ 'dir ni gtan la dbab bya'i gtso bo 'chad pa'i gegs su 'gyur du dwogs pa'i 'jigs pas snying po mdor bsdus tsam re brjod par bya'o/ /de la gnyis/ zag bcas 'khor ba'i lam dang*/ zag med myang 'das kyi lam mo/ /dang po la spang bya ngan song gi lam dang*/ blang bya mtho ris kyi lam mo| |dang po ni/ rten gyi gang zag grub mthas blauo kha ma bsgyur ba'i 'jig rten tha mal pa rnams dang*/ bsgyur ba'i 'jig rten rgyang 'phen lta bu 'jig rten phyi ma phan chad kyi gong ma'i khyad par cung zad kyang don du mi gnyer bar rgyab kyis phyogs nas 'jig rten 'di'i phun tshogs dang bde ba 'ba' zhig la lhag par chags pas ngo tsha dang khrel yod sogs kyi dge ba'i bsam pa spangs nas rang gi pha gsod cing bu mo la log par spyod pa sogs kyi bya ba ma yin pa 'ba' zhig byed pa rnams ni/ lam 'di'i rten gyi gang zag gi gtso bo yin la/ ya mtha'i sa mtshams ni bye brag smra ba ltar na rgyun zhugs dbang brtul man chad dang*/ mdo sde pa yan chad ltar na 'phags lam ma thob kyi bar du yod do/ /lam gyi rang bzhin ni/ rtsa ba'i rgyu las 'bras la rmongs pa'i ma rig pas bskyed cing*/ dngos kyi kun slong dug gsum gang rung gis bskyed pa/ rnam smin ngan song gi phung po sgrub par byed pa/ ngo bo yid shes 'khor gyi sems byung la lus ngag gi rig byed dang rig byed ma yin pa'i 'khor dang bcas pas bsdus pa ste/ gtso bo'i rigs bsdu na mi dge ba bcu'o/ /'di dag ni spang bya'i lam gyi gtso bo yin pas rang bzhan mdor bsdus pa tsam zhig bshad na/ mi dge ba bcu'i rgyu dang ngo bo dang*/ 'bras bu'o/ /dang po la sbyor ba kun nas slong ba'i rgyu dang*/ mjug mthar phyin par byed pa'i rgyu'o/ /dang po ni/ chos mngon pa mdzod las/

sbyor ba rtsa ba gsum las skyes// zhes bcu car la yang mi dge ba'i rtsa ba dug gsum gang rung re re las skyes pa gsum gsum yod do/ /'o na yid kyi gsum po dug gsum re re'i ngo bo ma yin nam zhe na/ skyon med de/ de'i mjug thogs las byung phyir/ brnab sems sogs rtsa gsum las skyes/ zhes dug gsum gyi rjes su skyes pa de gsum las skyes par bshad do/ / gnyis pa ni/ gsod dang gnod sems tshig rtsub bo/ /zhe sdang gis ni mthar phyin byed/ /log g.yem brnab sems ma byin len/ chags pa yis ni rdzogs par byed/ /log par lta ba gti mug gis/ /lhag ma gsum gyis rdzogs par 'dod/ /ces bshad de go sla'o/ /mi dge ba de rnams gang las 'byung ba'i gzhi yang ji skad du/ gzhi ni sems can longs spyod dang*/ /ming dang gzugs dang ming yin no/ /zhes bshad ma thag pa'i srog gcod sogs tshan pa bzhi po'i gzhi rim pa bzhin du/ sems can dang longs spyod dang*/ ming gzugs dang/ ming yin no/ /ngo bo ni/ srog gcod pa ni bsams bzhin du/ /ma nor bar ni gzhan bsad pa'o/ /ma byin len pa gzhan gyi nor| |mthu dang 'jab bus bdag gir byed/ /bgrod min 'gro par 'dod pa yis/ /log par g.yem pa rnam pa bzhi/ /rdzun tshig 'du shes gzhan bsgyur ba'i| |tshig don mngon par go ba'o/ /phra ma pha rol dbye ba'i phyir/ /nyon mongs can gyi sems kyi tshig /tshig rtsub po ni mi snyan pa/ /nyon mongs can kun kyal pa nyid/ /gzhan ni de las gzhan nyon mongs/ kha bsag glu dang zlos gar gzhan| |bstan bcos ngan zhen brnab sems ni/ /log pas gzhan gyi nor la chags| |gnod sems sems can la sdang ba/ dge dang mi dge med lta ba| |log par lta ba yin 'di la/ /gsum mam bdun ni las kyang yin/ /zhes bshad de/ gzhan ni go sla la/ log g.yem bzhi ni/ bgrod bya ma yin pa rang la mi dbang ba'i bud med dang*/ yan lag ma yin pa kha dang bshang lam/

yul ma yin pa dkon mchog gi drung lta bu/ dus ma yin pa gso sbyong gi tshe dang*/ sbrum pa dang na ba dang nyin mo'i dus lta bu'o/ /ngag 'khyal la/ bye smra ni/ nyon mongs can gyi tshig mtha' dag der 'dod la/ sde pa gzhan dag ni/ rdzun phra ma tshig rtsub gsum las gzhan pa'i nyon mongs can gyi tshig rnams ngag 'khyal yin pa'i dper brjod kha bsag sogs so/ /bcu po'i nang nas yid ky-i gsum la lus ngag gi las med pas lam kho na yin la/ bdun ni las dang lam gnyis ka yin no/ /de bzhin du 'di dag rig byed yin min gang gis bsdus pa dang*/ rang rgyud kyi dge ba la gnod pa ji ltar byed pa dang*/ khams dang 'gro ba gang na yod pa dang*/ ngo bo la yang dwogs pa dpyad pa sogs ni chos mngon pa las rgyas par shes dgos so/ /'bras bu ni/ thams cad bdag po rgyu mthun dang*/ /rnam smin 'bras bu 'byin par byed/ /ces re res kyang 'bras bu gsum gsum 'byin pa'i nang nas| rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ni/ mi dge ba bcu po chung ngus dud 'gro dang 'bring gis yi dwags dang*/ chen pos dmyal bar 'phen pa'am/ yang na/ gti mug dang 'dod chags dang zhe sdang gis kun nas bslangs pa'i las rnams kyis rim pa bzhin du 'gro ba gsum po de'i rnam smin gyi phung po mi bzad pa sgrub par byed la/ de yang las kyi khyad par 'di dang 'dir 'gro ba 'dis dang 'di lta bur sdug bsngal gyi khyad par 'di dang 'di myong ngo zhes sogs ni rtog ge'i blaus bsam gyis mi khyab cing bsam bya ma yin par gsungs pas mdo sde las brgya pa sogs las rtogs par bya'o/ /rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu ni/ dbu ma rin chen phreng ba las/ gsod pa yis ni che thung ste/ /rku ba yis ni longs spyod phongs/ /byi bo byed pas dgra dang bcas| |rdzun du smra bas skur pa ste/ phra ma yis ni bshes dang 'byed/ /tshig rtsub pos ni mi snyan thos/ /ma 'brel smra bas tshig mi btsun/

/brnab sems yid la re ba 'joms/ /gnod sems 'jigs pa sbyin par byed/ log par lta bas lta ngan nyid/ /ces gsungs pa ltar mir skyes kyang tshe thung ba la sogs pa rnams te| 'di dag kyang myong ba rgyu mthun yin gyi/ byed pa rgyu mthun ni/ gar skyes kyang srog gcod sogs la ngang gis 'jug pa'o/ /bdag po'i 'bras bu ni/ mdzod 'grel sogs las rgyas par 'byung ba rnams sdom du bsdu na/ gsod pas gzi chung rku ba yis/ /ser ba rtsa char 'dod log gis/ /rdul 'khrigs can 'gyur rdzun gyis ni/ /dri nga phra mas mtho dman can| |tshig rtsub tsha sgo can dang ni/ /dgon gdung tha chad sdig pa can/ /kyal pas dus log brnab sems kyis/ /'bras bu ngan zhing gnod sems kyis| |'bras bu phra dang log ltas ni/ 'bras bu chung ba'am 'bras bu med| |ces pa ltar phyi rol snod kyi 'byor ba nyams par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar 'bras bu gsum gsum bskyed pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ srog gcod la mtshon na/ sdug bsngal phyir dang bsad phyir dang*/ /gzi byin med phyir 'bras bu gsum| |zhes pa ste/ bsad bya sdug bsngal bar byas pa dang*/ bsad nas tshe thung bar byas pa dang*/ gzi brjid nyams par byas pa'i phyir 'bras bu gsum rim pa bzhin te/ mi dge ba gzhan la'ang rigs bsgres nas sbyor ro/ /bcu po 'di yang spang bya mi dge ba che long bsdus pa yin gyi/ 'dir ma bsdus pa'i sgo gsum gyi nyes par spyad pa mtha' dag kyang 'bras bu gsum la sogs pa'i nyes dmigs shes nas shin tu skrag pa'i tshul gyis spang ba la 'bad par bya'o/ / gnyis pa la/ rten gyi gang zag ni/ snga ma las bzlog ste/ tshe 'di'i phun tshogs dang che thabs kyi 'bras bu mtha' dag chu shing ltar snying po cung zad kyang med par mthong zhing de'i ched du 'bad pa thams cad shing rta 'dren pa'i phyugs kyis rtswa zos pa ltar shin tu gnog chung zhing nyes dmigs che bar shes nas zhen pa log ste/

phyi ma ngan song du skyes kyi dwogs nas nag can btson dong du 'dzud du nye ba ltar/ shin tu ya nga ba'i sems kyis 'jig rten phyi ma lha dang mi'i go 'phang la don gnyer mchog tu skyes pa'i gang zag ni gtso bo yin cing*/ 'di la ni skyes bu chung ngu zhes kyang bya'o/ /der ma zad/ 'di phyi'i don 'dres mar byed pa'i dge ba'i blau can rnams kyang 'dir bsdu'o/ /lam gyi rang bzhin yang*/ rtsa ba'i rgyu de kho na nyid la rmongs pa'i ma rig pas bskyed kyang*/ dug gsum med pa'i dge rtsas kun nas bslangs shing*/ rnam smin lha dang mi'i phung po sgrub par byed pa/ rgyu mthun ngan song du skyes kyang longs spyod che ba sogs kyi 'bras bu can/ ngo bo snga ma dang 'dra la/ dbye ba sgo gsum gyi legs spyad mtha' yas kyang gtso bo'i rigs bsdu na/ srog gcod pa spong ba sogs bcu ste/ so so'i rang bzhin dang 'bras bu la sogs pa ni mi dge ba bcu las ldog pa yin no zhes/ 'phags mchog klu sgrub zhabs kyis rin chen phreng bar/ mi dge'i las ni 'di dag gi /rnam smin bshad pa gang yin pa| |dge ba'i las ni de dag la/ /'bras bu de dag bzlog ste 'byung*/ /zhes pas gsal bar gsungs so/ /de ltar na tshe 'di'i che thabs dang bde skyid tshol ba la ni/ mi las kyang dud 'gro mkhas shing brtson pa yang che ba tsam du snang na dud 'gro'i bsam sbyor dang khyad par cung zad kyang med pa'i sgo nas dal 'byor chud bson pa rnams ni shin tu'ang tha chad cing snying rul bar shes te/ phyi ma'i don la ched cher byed pa cig ma byung na skyed bu chung ngu'i lam yang skye mi srid cing*/ thos bsam sgom gsum sogs kyi dka' spyad tshe ril por byas kyang lam du cung zad kyang mi 'gro bar phal cher nyon mongs kyi gsos 'ba' zhig tu 'gro bar myong ba dang mngon sum gyis grub mod kyi/ ding sang theg pa chen po'i chen po la nyams len byed par rlom pa phal cher yang tshe 'di'i che thabs cung zad kyang blos mi thongs par snang ba ni/

rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che lhag par nyams pa nyid du gsal bar byed pa'o/ /de ltar na blang bya mtho ris kyi bde 'bras tsam sgrub pa la yang gtso bo dge ba bcu dang*/ der ma 'dus pa'i dkon mchog dang pha ma la sogs pa'i rgan rabs mchod pa dang*/ sbyin pa dang snyan par smra ba la sogs pa 'jig rten ya rabs kyi chos lugs la shin tu brtson par bya dgos la| de ltar byas na lha dang mi'i nang du skyes te dge ba'i las kyi byed pa rgyu mthun la goms nas thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i bsam sbyor la yang ngang gis zhugs te gong ma gong ma'i khyad par la myur du reg par 'gyur bas re shig lam 'di dag la shin tu brtson par bya ste/ shes rab brgya pa las/ mi yi chos lugs legs spyad na/ /lha yul bgrod pa thag mi ring*/ /lha dang mi yi them skas la| |'dzegs na thar pa gam na 'dug /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ gnyis pa la/ rang don lhur len thar pa'i lam dang*/ gzhan don lhur len thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam mo/ /dang po la/ rten gyi gang zag ni/ ngan song gsum na sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal shin tu bzod par dka' zhing rgyun ring bas mnar ba lta ci smos/ mtho ris lha dang mi yang sdug bsngal gyis rang bzhin kho na yin te/ 'dod pa'i lha mi la ni lus dang sems la sdug bsngal gy-i sdug bsngal ngan song dang mtshungs pa tsam yod la/ bsod nams kyi las mthu dang ldan pa 'ga' zhig la 'dod yon khyad par can la longs spyod pa'i bde ba dang*/ khams gong gi bsam gtan gsum pa man chad na ting nge 'dzin gyis drangs pa'i bde ba khyad par can/ bzhi pa yan chad na ting nge 'dzin dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i tshor ba btang snyoms 'ba' zhig la yun ring du gnas pa sogs kyi sgo nas/ re shig sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal mngon gyur ba med kyang*/ 'khor ba'i rtsa ba ma chod cing bde ba la chags pa'i nyon mongs kyis las ngan mang du bsags pas las bzang po'i nus pa zad ma thag tu gnas 'og ma'i sdug bsngal myong dgos par shes pa'i sgo nas/

khams gsum mtha' dag la sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du yid ches pa'i nges pa brtan pos bskyed pa'i nges 'byung gi bsam pa brtan pos/ 'khor ba la mi gtsang ba'i sbubs ltar zhen pa log cing*/ de spangs pa'i thar pa mya ngan las 'das pa la padma'i tshal yid du 'ong ba ltar/ don gnyer lhag par skyes pa ste/ 'di la skyes bu 'bring zhes bya'o/ /gang zag 'di la ni rigs kyi sgo nas nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi rigs can gnyis so/ /lam gyi rang bzhin ni/ 'khor 'das kyi rang bzhin shes pa'i shes rab dang*/ sdug bsngal la skyo shas kyi nges 'byung*/ kun 'byung spong 'dod kyi 'dun pa/ 'gog pa la don gnyer gyi dad pa rnams kyi rgyu las byung ba/ grogs bdag med par rtogs pa'i lta ba rnam dag gis zin pa ste/ de yang dbu ma rang rgyud pa ltar na/ phyi rol mu stegs byed kyi brtags pa'i rtag gcig rang dbang can gyi mtshan nyid can| phung po las don gzhan rang skya thub pa'i byed pa po med par rtogs pa'i gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa nyid kyi chog par bzhed la/ dpal mgon klu sgrub dang de'i rjes 'brang mchog tu gyur pa gnas brtan sangs rgyas bskyangs dang*/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa rjes 'jug dang bcas pa rnams ni/ lta ba de tsam gyis 'khor ba las mi grol te/ gang zag la bden 'dzin mi bzlog pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gang zag rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i lta ba ni nyan rang gnyis kyi lam gyi gtso bo yin la/ de'i phyir de dag la chos rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i lta ba yang gdon mi za bar yod do zhes bzhed do/ /lta ba des zin pa'i lam gyi ngo bo yang sgo gsum gyis legs par spyad pa mtha' yas pa zhig yod mod kyi/ rigs sdu na/ so sor thar pa dang bsam gtan dang*/ zag med kyi sdom pa gsum mam dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi la sogs pa'i byang phyogs so bdun du 'dus pa rnams ni nyan rang gnyis kyi thun mong ba yin la/

khyad par/ rang rgyal la ni rten 'brel lugs 'byung lugs ldog tu bsgom pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang mkhas par bya ba'i dngos po drug la mkhas pa'i shes rab kyang yod la/ de gnyis kyi lam mthar phyin pa'i dngos kyi rkyen gyi bden bzhi mi rtag la sogs bcu drug gi don legs par bsgoms pa'i shes rab ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa ste/ lam gyi dbye ba tshogs sbyor mthong sgom mi slob lam rnams so/ / gnyis pa la rten gyi gang zag ni/ 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du shes pas sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por rang nyid bying ba'i nyams la dpags nas 'gro ba mtha' dag bzod par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal gyis gtses par shes shing*/ sdug bsngal can gyi 'gro ba thams cad kyang thog ma med pa nas phan btags pa'i drin can gyi pha ma yin par nges nas/ de dag sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa'i sems kyis dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba yang gzhan don kho nar byed pa'i snying stobs mchog dang ldan pa ste/ 'di la skyes bu chen po zhes bya'o/ /lam gy-i rang bzhin ni/ sems can thams cad la bu gcig pa ltar lhag par brtse ba'i snying rjes kun nas slangs te gzhan don du rang nyid rdzaugs pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pa'i theg chen gyi kun rdzaub sems bskyed ni lam gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu nyid du shing rta chen po mtha' dag bzhed la/ snying rje de skye ba'i rgyu ni/ gangs can gyi dpal mgon zhi ba 'tsho dpon slob kyi bzhed pas sems can dang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin stong par rang gis rtogs nas de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje phul du byung ba skye bar bzhed la| 'phags pa thogs med sku mched dang rgyal sras mar me mdzad la sogs pa ni sems can rnams mar shes nas drin dran pa la sogs pa'i rgyu 'bras bdun mar grags pa lta bu'i sgom rim las snying rje skye bar bzhed de/

mdor na byang chub kyi sems kyang snying rje la rag las pa kho na ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ de yi rtsa ba snying rjer 'dod/ /ces gsungs so/ /lam gyi ngo bo ni/ sbyin sogs pha rol tu phyin pa drug gis rgyud legs par sbyong zhing*/ sbyin pa dang*/ snyan par smra ba dang*/ don spyod pa dang*/ don mthun pa ste/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis gzhan don mthar phyin par byed de/ 'di dag ni mdo sde nas gsungs pa'i lam yin la/ rdo rje theg pa las ni/ mtshan ma dang bcas pa dang mtshan ma med pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ bskyed rim dang rdzaugs rim gyi lam thun mong ma yin pa rnams gsungs te/ de lta bu'i mdo rgyud kyi theg pa chen po'i lam thams cad kyang bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis sam/ tshogs lam la sogs pa'i slob mi slob kyi lam lnga la sogs par 'du la/ slob mi slob kyi lam thams cad kyang mdo rgyud rnams las sa bcu gsum dang bcu gnyis dang bcu gcig dang*/ khyad par du slob pa 'phags pa'i lam la sa bcu'i sgo nas nyams su len tshul la sogs pa rgyas par gsungs te/ rgyud sde'i lam gyi rnam gzhag 'og tu 'chad la/ mdo sde nas gsungs pa rnams ni/ theg pa chen po mdo sde rgyan dang*/ byang sa dang*/ bslab btus dang*/ spyod 'jug dang*/ sgom rim rnams dang*/ de dag gi don bsdus pa byang chub lam gyi sgron ma sogs las rgya cher shes par bya'o/ /lam 'di'i 'bras bu ni/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa zad par spangs shing don gnyis mthar phyin pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku gsum mam bzhi'i bdag nyid can no/ /de lta bu'i mtho ris dang thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam gyi rnam par bzhag pa 'thad pa dang ldan zhing nyams su blangs pas ngal ba 'bras bu dang bcas par 'gyur ba ni ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa kho na'i khyad par gyi chos yin te/ bstan pa 'di las phyi rol du gyur pa tshangs pa dang khyab 'jug dang*/

drang srong ser skya dang gzegs bzan sogs kyi lugs la ni/ mtho ris dang thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa la sogs pa rnams 'ga' zhig gis khas mi len cing*/ khas len pa rnams kyang de dag gi rgyu dang*/ ngo bo dang 'bras bu sogs la rmongs nas/ mtho ris kyi don du phyugs kyi mchod sbyin byed pa dang*/ rtag pa 'khor ba'i byed pa por smras nas 'khor ba ldog pa'i thar pa thob par 'dod pa dang*/ bdag 'dzin bsgoms pas 'khor ba las grol ba dang*/ chags sogs chos min gyi rtsa bar 'dod bzhin du khrus kyis chos min 'dag par 'dod pa la sogs pa smra ba thams cad nang 'gal zhing*| dngos po'i rang bzhin las phyin ci log tu zhugs pa'i phyir ro/ /der ma zad chos 'di par rlom yang mdo rgyud gang dang yang mi mthun zhing*/ shing rta chen po gang gi yang bzhed pa ma yin pa'i lam zab zab mor byas pa'i chos lugs blun po bdud kyi byin gyis brlabs pa rnams kyi rang dgar mu cor smras pa'i gdams ngag rnams kyang mkhas pa bdag legs su 'dod pa rnams kyis bslab par bya ba ma yin no/ /de bzhin du nyan thos bye brag tu smra ba dang*/ mdo sde pa dang*/ sems tsam pa dang*/ dbu ma rang rgyud pa rnams kyi'ang lta ba'i cha 'ga' zhig dngos po'i gnas lugs las phyin ci log tu gyur pa yod pas de dag kyang thos bsam gyis gtan la phab ste yang dag pa dang yang dag pa ma yin pa'i lam rnams la blang dor tshul bzhin du bya ba rigs so/ /de lta mod kyi bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab kyi dgongs pa 'grel ba'i grub mtha' smra ba chen po rnams lta ci smos/ gangs ri'i khrod kyi log pa'i chos lugs spyod pa rnams dang*/ der ma zad phyi rol mu stegs byed rnams la'ang*/ dad pa dang*/ nges 'byung dang*/ byams pa dang snying rje dang shes rab dang tshul khrims la sogs pa 'ga' zhig gsung rab rin po che dang mthun pa'i nyams len dang*/ de dag gi 'bras bu bde 'bras la longs spyod pa sogs cung zad yod pa rnams kyang 'jig rten thams cad kyi'adren pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi rnam par dkar ba'i phrin las kyi 'od zer las byung ba kho na yin te/

sems can gyi khams na bde dge ci yod thams cad rgyal ba'i phrin las kho na yin pa'i phyir ro| |de bas na rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' smra ba dang log pa'i chos la spyod pa rnams la'ang*/ rang gzhan la snying brtse zhing bstan pa rin po che nyams su dwogs pa'i bsam pas chos de skyon dang ldan mi ldan brtag shing dpyad nas log pa'i chos rnams kho na dgag par bya'i/ gang zag la sdang ba'i sems kyi dmod cing gshe ba ni/ theg pa chen po lta ci smos/ theg dman gyi tshul lugs dang yang 'gal zhing*/ sngags kyi rtsa ltung drug pa la sogs pas reg par 'gyur ba'i phyir spang bar bya'o/ /mdor na dge sdig gi blang dor mtha' dag dri ma med pa'i gsung rab rin po che rnams dpang por byas nas nyams su blang dgos la| de yang sngar bshad pa'i lam rnams la spang blang byed pa'i rim pa nyams len du 'dril ba'i tshe/ thog mar mdo rgyud rang ranganas bshad pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen legs par btsal zhing bsten tshul phyin ci ma log pas mnyes par byas nas dal 'byor rnyed dka' zhing don che ba'i tshul la yid ches pa'i nges pa bskyed cing*/ de lta bu'i dal 'byor de yang nges pa 'jig la/ der ma zad 'chi rkyen mang zhing gson rkyen nyung ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis myur du 'jig pa'i ngang tshul shes nas tshe 'di'i 'dun ma thod la bor nas pang du dug sbrul lhung ba ltar rings pa rings par dge ba sgrub pa'i blo bskyed/ shi nas kyang ngan song du skyes na dmyal ba sogs kyi sdug bsngal bzod par dka' ba'i yid 'byung dang*/ bde sdug mtha' dag dge sdig las 'byung bar nges pa'i las 'bras la yid ched bskyed nas dge sdig phra zhib la yang blang dor byas nas skyes bu chung ngu'i lam nyams su blangs*/ de la lobs nas 'khor ba mtha' dag skyon can du shes pa'i nges 'byung gi bsam pas kun nas bslangs te/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa rdzogs par nos nas nyes ltung phra mos kyang ma gos pa'i tshul khrims rnam dag gis gzhi bzung nas byang phyogs so bdun sogs skyes bu 'bring gi lam la bslabs/

de nas sngar bshad pa'i tshul gyis theg pa chen po'i bsam sbyor rnams la legs par bslabs te/ srid zhi gnyis ka las 'das pa'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bsgrub pa la nan tan du bya ste/ 'di dag dmigs rnam gyis skyong tshul rgyas par dpal ldan a ti sha'i rjes 'jug mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i byang chub lam gyi rim pa las shes par bya zhing bslab par bya'o/ /'o na lam gyi rnam gzhag ji skad bshad pa las gzhan du mi 'thad pa'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ 'di ltar nyams su blangs pas mtho ris dang thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa 'thob pa'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ spang bya mi dge bas bskyed pa'i dmyal ba sogs dang*/ blang bya dge bas bskyed pa'i mtho ris la sogs pa rnams yod par nges pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhig yod/ gal te sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab las 'di ltar bshad la/ bcom ldan 'das de nyes zad kyi skyes bu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes zer na ni/ phyi rol mu stegs byed rnams la'ang rang rang gi ston pa de lta bu'i yid ches re yod cing*/ sgrub byed de 'dra ba re 'god shes pas rnam gzhag thams cad 'gal ba la ma 'khrul ba'i tshad ma can du 'gyur ro zhe na/ 'di ni rtogs ldan gyi dogs pa yin pas/ rigs pa'i lam nas drangs pa'i lan gyis gsal bar bya ste/ sngar bshad pa lta bu'i lam gyi rnam gzhag dang de'i 'bras bu rnams grub cing 'thad pa yin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab las de ltar bshad pa de yang dgos pa sogs la ltos pa'i drang don ma yin pa'i phyir dang*/ ston pa de yang nyes zad kyi skyes bu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes bkod pa la/ mu stegs kyi mtshungs pa 'jug pa ma yin te/ der ni dpyad gsum gyis dag pa'i lung yin min mi mtshungs la/ ston pa gnyis kyang nyes zad kyi skyes bur dngos stobs kyi rigs pas sgrub nus mi nus kyi khyad par yod pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang 'di ltar/

bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab rnams ni dpyad pa gsum gyi shin tu dag pa yin te/ gzhal bya'i gnas gsum las/ gzugs sogs mngon gyur ston pa rnams ni/ mig sogs mngon sum gyi tshad mas ji ltar gzhal ba dang mthun par bstan pas mngon gyur la mngon sum gyis mi gnod cing*/ mi rtag sdug bsngal stong bdag med la sogs pa lkog gyur ston pa rnams ni/ ltos med dang gnod pa can gyi tshad ma la rten pa'i byas yod kyi rtags la sogs pa dngos po stobs shugs kyi gtan tshig yang dag la rten pa'i rjes dpag tshad ma rnams ni 'dzin stangs dang shin tu mthun par gsungs pas lkog gyur la dngos stobs rjes dpag gis mi gnod la/ mtho ris dang dmyal ba la sogs shin tu lkog gyur ston pa rnams ni ngag snga phyi dang dngos shugs la sogs pa 'gal ba med pas lung rnam dag de nyid kyis mi gnod pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang gtso bo'i don bden bzhi'i gnas lugs lta bu bstan pa rnams dngos stobs kyi tshad mas gnod med du grub pa'i sgo nas bstan don gyi gtso bo la mi slu bas shin lkog bstan pa rnams kyang bstan don la mi slu bar 'grub pa yin te/ rnam 'grel mdzad pos/ blang dang dor bya'i de nyid ni/ /thabs bcas rab tu nges pa yis/ /gtso bo'i don la mi slu'i phyir/ /gzhan la rjes su dpag pa yin/ /zhes bshad la/ 'phags pa lhas kyang*/ sangs rgyas kyis gsungs lkog gyur la/ /gang zhig the tshom skyes gyur pa/ /de yis stong pa nyid ston te| |'di nyid kho nar yid ches bya/ /zhes bshad pa'i phy-ir ro/ /mu stegs byed kyi gzhung ni/ tshad ma gsum ka dang 'gal ba'i sgo nas dpyad pa gsum gyis shin tu ma dag la/ khyad par rang tshig snga phyi dang dngos shugs sogs 'gal bas rang smra ba po skyon can du nges pa yin te/ khyad par 'phags bstod las/ rgyas pa dran pa'i mthu chung bas/ /mang po bgyis pa'i tshig dag la/

/phal cher ltag 'og 'ga' ba lags/ /thub pa khyod kyi kun kyang min/ /zhes sogs rang gzhan gyi bstan pa dang ston pa'i skyon yon rgyas par bshad pa bzhin no/ /de nas dpyad gsum gyis dag pa'i gsung rab mngon sum du gyur pa 'di nyid kyis| de gsung ba po yang nyes zad yid ches kyi skyes bur dngos stobs kyi tshad mas grub ste/ gsung rab 'di las gnas lugs kyi don bstan pas de kho na nyid bshad pa dang*/ snga phyi mi 'gal bar bshad pa bstan pa dang*/ grol ba don gnyer gyi blang dor tshang bas ma lus pa bshad pa ste/ bshad pa khyad par gsum ldan du tshad mas grub la/ de'i rtags kyis de gsung ba po la de kho na nyid rtogs pa dang rtogs pa brtan pa dang*/ ma lus pa rtogs pa ste rtogs pa khyad par gsum ldan du dpog nus shing*/ rtogs pa khyad par can de lta bu ni/ de dang de la sgrib pa'i spang bya rnams ma spangs par 'byung mi srid pas na/ rtogs pa de gsum gyi rtags las/ legs par spangs pa dang*/ slar mi ldog par spangs pa dang*/ ma lus par spangs pa gsum dpog nus la/ spang rtogs de gsum dang ldan pa ni rim pa ltar phyi rol pa'i chags bral dang*/ nyan rang slob pa dang*/ mi slob pa rnams las khyad par du 'phags par grub la/ spang rtogs de lta bus ni mkhyen pa phul du byung ba 'grub cing*/ spang rtogs de dag kyang bskal pa brgya la sogs par bsgoms pa'i nyan rang la'ang mi 'byung bas yun ring du'ang tshegs chen po sgrub dgos la/ de lta bur sgrub pa'ang gzhan don lhur len gyi snying rje la sogs pa'i thabs khyad par can la ltos par dngos stobs kyis grub pas ni brtse ba thugs rje chen po la sogs pa yon tan phul du byung ba dang ldan par grub bo/ /yang na/ stong pa dang bdag med pa la sogs pa rnams rtogs pa'i blau rnams yul gyi gnas lugs la zhugs par dngos stobs tshad mas grub cing*| de yun ring du goms na gsal snang rab kyi mthar thug pa 'byung bar rten brtan cing lus kyi 'bad rtsol la mi ltos pa'i sems kyi chos yin pa'i rtags kyis sgrub pa'i mthun dper/

'dod pa dang 'jigs goms pa sogs bzhag cing*/ der ma zad shes bya'i gnas la lo dang zla ba sogs su bslabs pas snga ma snga ma las phyi ma phyi ma gsal du 'gro bar myong bas 'grub la/ rig pa phyi ma mtha' dag thug med du sgrubs pa'i rigs pas rten rig pa rgyun mi 'chad par sgrub pa ni/ rnam 'grel mdzad pa'i lugs 'byung gi rim pas thub pa tshad mar sgrub pa'i snying po bsdus pa ste/ yi ge mang kyi dwogs pa'i 'jigs pas rgya cher ma bris so/

/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis ston pa dang*/ de'i bstan pa dang*/ de sgrub pa'i dge 'dun la yid ches pa'i dad pa brtan po rkyen gang gis kyang mi phyed pa ni| bstan pa dang ston pa skyon med du sgrub pa'i gzhung la rag las pas na/ rigs pa'i gzhung lugs rnams blo ma khugs pa'i gang zag gi bslab bya yin par 'dzin pa ni shin tu tha chad la/ slob pa rnams kyis kyang*/ nang du lta ba khyad par can skye ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo dang*/ khyad par bstan ston la yid ches bskyed pa'i thabs su mi 'gro bar gzhan dang shags 'gyed pa'i bsam pas kha phyir ltas kho nar shor na ngal ba 'bras med dang*/ don ma yin pa bskyed par 'gyur bas snying po blang ba la 'bad par bya'o/ /de ltar rang gzhan gyi dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan dang skyon gyi khyad par la tshad mas drangs pa'i nges pa gting tshugs pa rnyed nas/ rang gi skyabs gsum po gtan gyi skyabs gnas slu med du shes par bya'i/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs pa shin tu lkog gyur yin pas lung tsam kho nas sgrub dgos la/ lung yang 'gal zla la gegs byed kyi phyaugs nyid rigs pa mkhyen pa'i lugs yin no zhes smra ba rnams la ni/ skyabs 'gro'i lam la yun ring du 'bad kyang 'bras bu 'byin mi 'byin the tshom za ba nyid du khas len dgos shing*/ skyabs yul la the tshom za bas blau gting tshugs pa'i skyabs 'gro mi byed do zhes smra dgos par 'gyur ro/ /'dir smras pa/ phyi nang rig gnas kun la blo gros rgyas/ /phyi ltas tshig la mi rton gdams par shar/ /ston dang bstan pa'i gnad la yid ches skyes// sdom gsum bcas mtshams shes nas srog ltar bsrung*/ /'khor 'das rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i mthus/ /'gro la snying rje'i gdung shugs cher rgyas te| |phan bde skyed phyir bstan pa'i khur 'khyer ba/ /de yis rgyal ba'i bstan pa rdzogs par 'dzin/ ces bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad do/

/dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rim pa dang po'i lam gyi rnam par bzhag pa bskyed rim snang ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba las/ lam spyi'i rnam par bzhag pa ste le'u dang po'o// // gnyis pa khyad par rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rnam gzhag la bzhi/ mdo rgyud gnyis su 'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan/ de gnyis kyi khyad par/ rgyud sde so so'i rang bzhin| khyad par dus kyi 'khor lo'i rnam gzhag go/ / dang po ni/ spyir bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab kyi brjod bya'i lus ris kyi sgo nas bsdus na theg pa mchog dman gnyis sam/ nyan rang byams sems kyi theg pa gsum du bsdus te gsungs pa'ang yod la/ spyod bsdus sgron me las/ dman pa la mos pa la chags bral gyi spyod pa/ rgya chen po la mos pa la sa dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa/ zab mo la lhag par mos pa la 'dod chags kyi spyod pa bstan to/ /zhes spyod pa gsum du bsdus shing*/ slob dpon kṛ pi ta ka ma la'i tshul gsum sgron mer/ bden pa'i de nyid tshul ston dang*/ /pha rol phy-in pa'i tshul ston gang*/ /gsang sngags chen po'i tshul staun yang*/ /bsdus nas 'dir ni bstan pa yin/ /zhes bden bzhi'i tshul dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul dang*/ gsang sngags chen po'i tshul gsum du bsdus mod kyi/ 'dir ni mdo sde dang rgyud sde gnyis su dbye ba'i tha snyad bya la| de la rgyu'i theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu'i theg pa zhes kyang bshad de/ slob dpon dzñā na shrī'i mtha' gnyis sel bar gsang ba lung bstan pa'i mdo drangs pa las/ rgyu la mos pa rgyu chos kyi/ /'khor lo rab tu bskor zin nas| |rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam zhig /ma 'ongs dus na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ slob dpon des rgyu dang 'bras bu'i theg par tha snyad mdzad la/ slob dpon shrangngha ka ra warmas ni/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud don la 'jug pa las| byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la yang gnyis te/

sa dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang*/ gsang sngags 'bras bu rdo rje'i theg pa'o/ /zhes theg chen la gnyis su 'byed par mdzad do/ /slob dpon 'dis ni gsang sngags la rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod ces sde snod gsum du ma gtogs pa'i sde snod bzhi par yang bzhed la/ kha cig gsang sngags mdo sde'i sde snod du 'dod cing*/ yang kha cig sde snod gsum kas bsdus par 'dod do/ /de ltar na/ gang du 'dong ba 'bras bu theg pa la sngags dang pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis kyis bsgrubs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyan med dang*/ rgyan bcas sogs kyi khyad par 'dod pa ni ches mi rigs te/ lam gnyis ka'i thob bya yang rang lam gyi skyon kun zad dang yon tan kun rdzogs kyi sangs rgyas su mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gang gis 'dong ba rgyu'i theg pa la khyad par gtan med na so sor bshad pa dgos med du 'gyur la/ yod na yang brjod dgos zhe na/ 'di la yang mi mthun par smra ba mang mod kyi/ 'thad pa'i phyogs ni/ spyir nyan rang byang sems kyi theg pa gsum du 'jog pa yang*/ gang zag gi rigs mi 'dra ba la ltos nas bzhag pa yin la/ de bzhin du 'dir yang*/ gang zag 'dod yon la chags pa lam du bsgyur ba dang mi bsgyur ba la ltos nas sngags dang pha rol tu phyin pa'am mdo sde dang rgyud sde gnyis gzhag ste/ gang zag de gnyis theg pa de gnyis kyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya'i gtso bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di la phyis kyi mkhas pa kha cig de lta bu mi rigs te/ phar phyin gyi byang sems 'dod yon la chags pa dang bcas pa yang yod la/ sngags kyi byang sems de med pa yang yod pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsung ba ni gtan tshig ma grub cing khyab pa ma nges te/ sngags kyi byang sems la spyir 'dod yon lam du mi byed pa yod pa'i phyir zhes pa ni shin tu ma grub ste/ sngags kyi byang sems yin na 'dod yon la chags pa lam gyi gtso bor byed pa yin dgos pa'i phyir ro|

|'khrig pa'am dbang po gnyis sbyor dngos kyi chags pa lam du mi byed pa yod pa'i phyir zhes zer na ni des phyogs snga ma dgag par mi nus te/ de lta bu gsang sngags phar phyin las theg pa log par 'jog pa'i 'jog byed du khas ma blangs pa'i phyir ro/ khyab pa ma nges pa ni/ 'o na nyan rang gnyis theg pa so sor 'jog pa la 'jog byed ci yod/ rnam par thar pa cung zad tsam zhig gis lhag pa zhes bzung rtog spangs ma spangs kyis 'jog go zhe na/ khyed rang ltar na nyan thos bzung rtog spangs pa yang shin tu mang la rang rgyal slob pa bzung rtog ma spangs pa yod pas 'jog byed skyon can du thal lo/ /de bzhin du rten 'brel lugs 'byung lugs ldog bsgom pa dang mkhas par bya ba'i dngos po drug la mkhas par byed pa dang tshogs bsog pa yun ring thung sogs la'ang mtshungs so/ khyad chos de dag nyan rang gi gang zag re re nas mi ldan pa dang ldan pa mi dgos kyi/ gtso che ba'i khyad chos su ldan pas chog go snyam na ni| 'dir dbang po gnyis sbyor dngos kyi chags pa lam byed yod med la byas na yang nyes pa ci zhig yod/ des na theg pa so sor 'byed pa ni ris dang mos pa tha dad pa'i gang zag gi khyad chos kyi gtso bo re re lam gyi gtso bar byas nas nyams su len pa cig yod na de tsam gyis bzhag par nus so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngags dang pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis kyi khyad par/ /gang zag rno brtul dang lam bgrod pa myur bul/ rgyu theg chen sems bskyed/ grogs lta ba rnam dag 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la bzang ngan sogs kyi sgo nas dbye bar mi nus te/ /gang zag gi khyad par phar phyin theg pa nyid la'ang yod pa'i phyir dang sems bskyed sogs la khyad par cung zad kyang med pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ 'di'i lan la bod snga ma 'ga' zhig chags pa lam byed yod med dang lam bde bas brgyan pa yod med dang*/ lus la gnad du bsnun pa yod med sogs la byed do/

mkhas pa phyi ma dag 'dod pa snga ma rnams nang gses re re nas dpyad pa'i tshe khyab ches pa dang chung ba sogs kyi skyon can du byas nas/ rang gi lugs la gzugs sku dang rnam pa dngos su mthun par lam dus su sgom pa'i rnal 'byor yod med la sngags dang mdo'i khyad par du bzhed mod/ 'di la yang rnal 'byor de lta bu sngags kyi lam gyi gtso bo yin zhing sngags kyi gdul bya'i gtso bos de ltar nyams su len pas gtso che ba'i khyad chos su bzhed na ni 'gal ba med mod kyi/ gsal ba'i dbye ba re re nas khyad chos de ldan pa dgos shing*/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis gsang sngags kyi lha sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor yin na rang lhar sgom pa nges par dgos par 'dod pa ni/ dang por rang gis khas blangs pa dang 'gal ba yin te/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus las| 'jigs par dmigs shing shin tu gtsang bar byed pa dang*/ ye shes sems dpa'i bde ba dam pa med pa dang*/ /bdag nyid lha yi bsnyems pa med pa dang*/ /rmad du byung ba'i spyod yul med pa dang*/ skyon gyi rgyu'i rtog pas rab tu spyod pa sgrub par byed pa ni bya ba'i rgyud la gnas pa yin no/ /zhes bdag bskyed sogs med par gsungs pa'i dgongs pa len pa'i tshe/ de lta bu ni/ bya rgyud kyi gdul bya lha'i rnal 'byor rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas 'jigs shing skrag pa dang*/ rmad du byung ba ste 'jig rten dang 'gal ba'i 'dod chags kun spyod lam du byed pa ni snod du ma gyur pa dang*/ skye rga la sogs pa'i skyon gyi rgyu'i rnam rtog bden 'dzin dang bcas pa'i spyod lam sgrub pa'i bye brag pa 'ga' zhig la rang lhar bskyed pa dang*/ ye shes pa 'jug pa med par gsungs kyi bya rgyud kyi gdul bya gang yin thams cad la ma yin no zhes bya rgyud kyi lam nyams su len pa'i gang zag 'ga' zhig gis rang lhar mi sgom par gsal bar dam bcas pa'i phyir ro/

/gal te gang zag de'i rnal 'byor de bya rgyud kyi rnal 'byor ma yin no zhe na/ 'o na gang zag de bya rgyud kyi gdul byar ji ltar 'gyur bsam par bya'o| |des na sngar bshad pa ltar lam dang gang zag gi gtso bo la khyad chos ldan mi ldan tsam gyis bzhag par rigs la/ de ltar na gong du bshad pa'i 'dod yon la chags pa lam gyi gtso bo byed mi byed dang 'bras bu dang rnam pa mthun par sgom pa yod med dang*/ 'dod yon gyi bde bas lam brgyan ma brgyan dang*/ rtsa rlung thig le'i rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas lus la gnad du bsnun pa yod med rnams thams cad kyis sngags dang*/ phar phyin gyi khyad par phye ba ma yin no zhes shes par bya'o/ /gzhan yang tshul gsum sgron mer/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang*/ /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang*/ /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes pa yang gzhung gi tshig don ma bcos par bshad na ni/ khyad chos su rung la/ 'grel pa byed pa dag gis bshad pa'i rnam gzhag rnams ni rtswa bal ba dza ltar 'dzings pa nyid du kho bos rtogs so/ /gsum pa la rgyud kyi dbye ba/ 'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan/ phye ba so so'i rang bzhin no/ / dang po ni/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde rnams rigs la sogs pa'i sgo nas gsum du bshad pa dang*/ lngar bshad pa dang*/ bdun du bshad pa la sogs pa 'byung mod kyi/ rgya bod gnyis kar du grags che ba ni bzhir 'byed pa 'di yin te/ rdo rje gur gyi le'u bcu gsum pa las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya med rnal 'byor de ltag la'o/ /rnal 'byor mchog ni sems can mchog|rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la'o/ /zhes gdul bya dman pa dang*/ de'i ltag 'bring po dang*/ mchog dang*/ de'i ltag ches mchog tu gyur pa ste/ gang zag bzhi la ltos nas bya ba dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ rnal 'byor dang*/ rnal 'byor bla med bzhir gsungs pa ltar/

shraddha ka ras kyang*/ gsang sngags 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa la ni 'jug pa'i sgo rnam pa bzhi ste/ bya ba'i rgyud dang*/ spyod pa'i rgyud dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang*/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud ces spyir grags pa yin no/ /zhes bshad la/ de bzhin du mkhas pa du mas bshad cing*/ gangs can pa rnams ni rnam gzhag 'di kho na 'dod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyud sde bzhir 'byed pa 'di/ sems bskyed dang shes rab dang thabs la sogs pa lam gyi gtso bo mi 'dra bas kyang 'byed par mi rigs te/ lam gyi gtso bo'i lus rnams ni rgyud sde bzhi ka'ang mtshungs pa'i phyir ro| |thob bya mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas kyang ma yin te/ mdo sngags gnyis kyi thob bya'i sangs rgyas la'ang khyad par mi 'thad na rgyud sde bzhi la lta ci smos pa'i phyir ro| |gal te lam gyi khyad par mi 'dra ba dang gang zag mchog dman sogs kyis 'jog na/ rgyud sde re re la'ang dbye ba mang du dgos par thal bas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i 'jog byed khyad par med do zhe na/ 'di la bod snga ma dag man ngag snye ma'i nyer gsum pa las/ rgod pas rgyud 'di 'phrul dga' ba rnams kyi lta bu'o/ /zhes sogs la rten nas/ mngon pa nas/ gnyis gnyis 'khyud dang lag bcangs dang*/ /rgod dang ltas pas 'khrig pa yin/ /zhes bshad pa'i 'khyud pa dang lag bcangs gcig tu byas nas 'khrig pa byed tshul mi 'dra ba bzhi la ltos nas rim pa ltar bla med la sogs pa'i rgyud sde bzhir bzhag go zhes dang*/ kha cig ni/ slob dpon kun snying gi bzhed par byas nas/ 'dod chags can dbang phyug gi dang*/ zhe sdang can khyab 'jug gi dang*/ gti mug can tshangs pa'i rjes su 'brang ba dang*/ de gsum gang du'ang ma nges pa gang rung dang phrad na de'i rjes su 'jug pa ste/ mu stegs rigs bzhi po de rjais su bzung ba'i phyir du/ rim pa ltar/ bla med dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ bya ba dang*/ rnal 'byor rnams bstan to zhes dang*/

rgya gar ba 'ga' zhig dang bod la la dag ni/ mi rigs bzhi las/ bram ze'i rigs la bya rgyud/ rgyal rigs la rnal 'byor rgyud/ rje'u rigs la chags sdang gnyis chung zhing gti mug shas che ba la spyod rgyud/ de las ldog pa la gsang 'dus sogs kyi pha rgyud/ chags sdang gnyis chen po'i chen po gti mug chung ngu'i chung ngu*/ rigs gdol pa'i rigs la bde mchog la sogs pa'i ma rgyud bstan to zhes zer ro/ /de la 'dod pa snga ma ni/ 'khrig pa byed tshul bzhi po/ de rgyud sde bzhi'i chags lam du byed tshul gyi dpe ru 'dzin pa yin na ni 'thad la/ gal te de ltar byed pa'i 'dod khams kyi lha mi rigs bzhi po de rgyud sde bzhi'i so so'i gdul bya'am/ sgrub pa por 'dod na ni mi rigs te/ mi lta bu'i gang zag re res kyang rgyud sde bzhi la rim can du bslabs nas rgyud sbyong dgos par brtag gnyis las gsungs pa'i phyir te/ /dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya/ /zhes sogs kyi mthar/ sngags kyi rim pa kun shes nas| de rjes kyai yi rdo rje bstan/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin du/ mu stegs bzhi po rgyud sde bzhi'i gdul bya'i gtso bor 'dod pa'ang mi rigs te/ sngags kyi gdul bya ni gang zag dbang po yang rab dang por sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa la legs par bslabs pa zhig dgos kyi lta ba ngan pa'i mu stegs dang po nas rgyud la 'jug pa mi 'thad pa'i phyir ro/ /lugs de kun snying gi bzhed pa'ang ma yin te| des mdzad pa'i yo ga'i skor mtha' yas pa zhig yod kyang*/ de rnams su ni bla med kyi chos skad mi 'don la/

gsang 'dus kyi 'grel par ni/ khyab 'jug gi rgyud la dga' ba la bla med kyi 'dod chags kyi kun spyod rnams bstan par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ des na rgyud sde bzhi'i kun spyod khyad par ba rnams kyis mu stegs rnams kyang dga' zhing 'dun par byed pa'i zhar byung gi dgos pa yod do zhes pa yin no/ /'dir mkhas pa phyi ma dag bla med kyi rgyud kyi gdul bya'i gtso bo la zhe sdang shas che ba sogs dgos par bla ma rnams 'dod pa shin tu mi 'thad de/ spyir theg chen dang*/ khyad par sngags kyi gdul bya'i gtso bo yin na snying rje lhag par du che ba dgos pa'i phyir zhes gsung ba'ang rigs par ma mthong ste/ de ltar na gdul bya de la nges 'byung dang skyo shas kyang mchog tu gyur pa dgos pas 'dod chags kyang shas chung bar thal la| de 'dod na/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa chags can gyi lam du gsungs par rang gis kyang khas blangs pa dang 'gal la/ lam thun mong ba rnam kyis rgyud sbyangs nas nyon mongs mngon gyur ba spangs pa dgos na/ gsang sngags la nyon mongs lam du byed pa'i thabs yod par 'dod pa'ang tshig tsam du 'gyur zhing*| nyon mongs ji ltar che ba tsam gyis lam bgrod bul che bar bshad pa sogs kyang don dang mi ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du mi rigs bzhi dang sbyang ba'ang mi rigs bzhi'i kun spyod dang*/ rgyud sdai bzhi'i kun spyod cha 'dra bar 'jog na 'thad kyang*/ mi rigs bzhi po rgyud sde de dang de'i gdul bya'i gtso bor 'dod pa mi rigs te/ ind+ra bo dhi dang sa ra ha la sogs pa'i rgyal rigs dang bram ze rnams bla med kyi gdul bya'i gtso bor byung 'dug pa'i phyir ro| |des na bla med kyi gdul bya'i gtso bo ni 'dzam bu gling pa'i khams drug ldan gyi mi kho na yin la/ rgyud gzhan la der ma nges mod kyi/ lha mi'am mi'i yang rigs bzhi gang yin kyang rung ste/ rgod pa'i dga' ba tsam lam du byed nus shing*/

phyi'i bya ba khrus dang gtsang sbra sogs la gtso bor byed pa'i gdul bya la ltos nas bya rgyud dang*/ chags sems kyis bltas pa'i dga' ba tsam lam du byed nus shing*| phyi'i bya ba dang nang gi rnal 'byor gnyis ka cha mnyam par spyod pa la spyod rgyud| lag bcangs dang 'khyud pa'i dga' ba tsam lam du byed nus shing*/ nang gi rnal 'byor bzhi la gtso bor byed pa la rnal 'byor rgyud dang*/ dbang po gnyis sbyor gyi bde ba khyad par can la lam du byed nus pa'i thabs mkhas khyad par can la lhag par mos shing*/ phy-i'i bya ba gtsang sbra sogs lus ngag gi spyod pa la mi ltos par/ lha'i rnal 'byor khyad par can gyi sgo nas lhan skyes kyi bde bas de kho na nyid rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas sangs rgyas myur du sgrub pa'i gdul bya la ltos nas bla med kyi rgyud gzhag go /de yang spyi rigs nas lam thun mong ba dang rgyud sde 'og ma rnams sngon du song yang tshe 'dir bla med kyi snod rung khyad par can du dang po nas gyur pa'i rigs can yang yod do/ /gsum pa la gnyis las/ bya ba'i rgyud la dogs pa dpyad pa dang*/ lam gyi rnam gzhag dngos so/ /dang po ni/ bya ba'i rgyud la bdag bskyed ye shes pa 'jug pa sogs yod dam med ce na/ 'di la dgra nag gi 'grel pa lhan cig skyes pa'i snang ba dang*/ rgyal bas byin gyis gsang 'dus 'grel pa dang*/ ind+ra bo dhis mdzad par grags pa'i bde mchog gi 'grel pa rnams las bya spyod gnyis ka la rang lhar bskyed pa tsam yang med par bshad pa ni 'thad pa ma yin te/ spyod rgyud kyi gtso bo rnam snang mngon byang dang phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud gnyis ka las bdag bskyed gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /bya spyod gnyis ka'i 'grel byed mkhas pa sangs rgyas gsang ba dang byang chub mchog gnyis kyis ni/ rgyud sde de gnyis ka la yang bdag bskyed dang ye shes pa gzhug pa dang*/

lha drug gi rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas bsam gtan gyi yan lag bzhi dang*/ de nyid gsum gyi rnal 'byor thun mong du byed par bzhed de/ legs grub kyi mngon rtogs 'chad pa na yang*/ rnam snang mngon byang sogs spyod rgyud phal cher shes byed du mdzad pa sogs kyi rgyu mtshan mang du snang ste/ rgyas par rgyud dang 'grel pa de rnams las rtogs par bya'o/ /bod kyi mkhas pa phyi rabs pa dgabya spyod gnyis ka la lam gyi rnam gzhag so so ba dang rgyud sde gong 'og gi khyad par yang chen po yod par 'dod bzhin du/ rnam gzhag byed pa'i tshe na/ rang lhar sgom pa gsang sngags yin tshad kyi khyad chos su 'dod pa'i grub mtha' bsrang ba'i phyir du/ bya rgyud la yang bdag bskyed yod par nan gyi sgrub cing*/ sgrub byed kyi gtso bor/ bsam gtan phyi ma'i rgyud las/ sgra dang sems dang gzhi la gzhol/ /zhes spyod rgyud rnam snang mngon byang nas bshad pa'i yan lag bzhi'i bsam gtan gyi ming tsam bshad cing*/ de'i 'grel par sangs rgyas gsang bas rnam gzhag spyod rgyud ji lta ba bzhin du rnam snang mngon byang dang sbyar nas bshad pa de nyid khungs su drangs nas/ lam gyi rnam gzhag ming tsam tha dad kyang don gcig tu bzhag la/ yang sangs rgyas gsang ba dang*/ byang chub mchog gnyis kyis bshad pa thams cad bya spyod thun mong gi rnam gzhag yin par yang bden zhen gyi 'dod do/ /tshul de ni rgyu mtshan de nyid kyi rigs pa dang 'gal bar rtogs la/ yang slob dpon byang chub mchog gi legs grub kyi mngon rtogs las/ bya ba'i rgyud las lha sgrub pa'i rim pa ma bstan to snyam du bsam par mi bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis phal cher du ma bstan kyang phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud dang de kho na nyid bcu pa las bstan pa'i phyir ro zhes dang*/ gcig tu dngos grub thams cad gsang sngags kyi lha dang de kho na nyid la rag las te/

de gnyis med par dngos grub mi 'grub pa'i phyir ro zhes bshad pa'ang khungs su mi rung ste/ lung snga mas sgrub mi nus pa bshad zin la phyi ma'ang ma nges te/ gsang sngags kyi lha la bdag bskyed kyis ma khyab pa'i phyir ro/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas bsam gtan phyi ma las bsam gtan gyi yan lag rgyas par ma bstan pa rdo rje gtsug tor gyi rgyud la kha 'phangs pas kyang mi 'grub te/ rdo rje gtsug tor bya rgyud rtsod med yin mod kyi| de la lha'i rnal 'byor kha ma 'phangs par srog rtsol sogs kyi bsam gtan kha 'phangs pa tsam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na tshul 'di ni/ gal che zhing dpyad dka' bar snang bas da dung rgyud la legs par gtugs nas dpyad par bya zhing*/ re shig ni/ bya spyod gnyis su dbye ba'i bya rgyud rkyang pa la bdag bskyed med par rtogs te/ bya rgyud kyi gtso bo gsang ba spyi rgyu dang dpung bzang dang legs grub sogs las/ dam tshig gi rnam gzhag dang dkyil 'khor gyi rnam gzhag phra mo dang*/ lam la slob tshul la yang khrus dang gtsang sbra mdun bskyed kyi lha spyan drangs mchod bstod byed lugs bzlas brjod byed tshul gyi rim pa sogs kyi skabs su phyag rgya phran tshegs dang*/ bsam gtan phran tshegs kyang zhib tu bshad mod kyi/ rang lhar bsgom tshul cung zad tsam yang med pa'i phyir dang*/ sngar bshad pa'i ye shes rdo rje kun las btus kyi lung yang shin tu gsal ba'i phyir dang*/ kun mkhyen bu ston gyis kyang bya rgyud la bdag bskyed dang ye shes pa 'jug pa med par gsungs pa ltar don la gnas mod/ rgya gar ba mang pos gdugs dkar dang gra lnga sogs la bdag bskyed sogs kyi rnam gzhag mdzad pa ni bya spyod bsres pa'i lugs sam/ yang na de nyid 'dus pa las bya spyod kyi cho ga la'ang rnal 'byor rgyudakyi rigs pa sbyar du rung bar bshad pa la dgongs pa 'am/ yang na lha gcig nyid rgyud sde bzhi ka'i sgo nas sgrub tu rung ba la dgongs pa 'dra'o/

/zhes gsungs pa ltar/ chos rje sa paṇa gyi sdom gsum rab dbye las kyang*/ bya ba'i rgyud la bdag bskyed med/ /bris sku mchod nas gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag bskyed sgrub thabs mdzad pa ni/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /de yis lugs bzhin mdzad par nges/ /de ltar byed na smyung gnas med/ /bdag nyid lha ru bskyed pa la/ /mchod na bsod nams brnyas na sdig zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phy-ir dang*/ rang lha'i nga rgyal brtan po dang ma bral bar dgos pa 'dod gzhin du mchod pa 'bul ba'i dod du zla ba phyed phyed na zas gcod pa'i smyung gnas dgos par khas len pa la'ang rigs pa snga mas gnod pa'i phyir dang*/ bsam gtan phyi ma'i don yang*/ sangs rgyas gsang bas bshad pa ltar don la gnas na rnam snang mngon byang gi rgyud phyi ma yin par nges la/ bya rgyud rkyang par byed na rtsa ba'i tshig tsam gyi bdag bskyed bshad par mi 'grub pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyud legs grub sogs las/ gnas khang nang du rigs gsum gyi phyag rgya 'ching zhing phyag 'tshal dang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ phyi ru phy-in nas khrus kyi rim pa/ nang du 'ongs nas chas 'jug dang mchod pa byin rlabs bdag dang gnas khang bsrung ba sogs sngaun du btang nas/ mdun bskyed kyi gnas khang dang sa gzhi byin gyis rlob tshul/ lha spyan drangs nas mchod bstod sdig bshags sogs sgom tshul/ de nas bzlas rjod byed tshul/ bzlas pa ma dag na skyor tshul/ mjug dge ba bsngau tshul rgyas par bshad pa ltar bya ste/ zhib par lam du bsgrigs pa ni gzhan du bshad par bya'o/ /slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas rnam 'joms kyi 'grel par rnam 'joms kyi rgyud rgyas pa'i lung drangs pa las/ stong pa yi ge sgra gzugs dang*/ /phyag rgya mtshan ma lha drug ste/ zhes lha drug gi sgom tshul gsungs pa rnams bya rgyud kyi rnal 'byor du deng sang gi mkhas pa dag bzhed de/

de'i tshul mdor bsdu na/ sngaun du stong nyid sgom pa don dam pa'i stong pa'i lha/ sngags gang bzlas brjod bya rgyu de gzhan gyis ston pa rna ba'i yul du gsal bar thos pa lta bur sgom pa sgra'i lha'o| |sngags de yig 'bru bris pa ltar nam mkha' la rang gi sems zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dri ma med par gyur pa'i steng du sgom pa yi ge'i lha/ zla ba yig 'bru dang bcas pa las 'od zer sna tshogs byung ba'i rtse mo la sgom bya lha'i gzugs nam mkha' gang ba byung nas rgyal ba rnams mchod pa dang dmyal sogs kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzad pa gzugs kyi lha/ bya rgyud rang nas bshad pa'i rang gi gtsug tor sogs kyi lus kyi gnas byin gyis rlob pa'i phyag rgya rnams sam/ ma grub na rigs gsum skabs su gang bab kyi phyag rgya 'ching pa phyag rgya'i lha/ mdun du spyan gang drangs kyi lha de nyid gsal bar bsgom pa mtshan ma'i lha'o/ bsam gtan phyi ma'i bsam gtan gyi yan lag bzhi dang*/ de nyid gsum la sogs pa ni spyod rgyud kyi lam du byas nas bya rgyud kyi rnal 'byor du ma byas na bde ste/ de rnams ni nang gi rnal 'byor khyad par ba 'ba' zhig tu snang la/ bya rgyud ni phyi'i bya ba dang nang gi rnal 'byor cha mnyam tsam yang ma yin par phyi'i bya ba 'ba' zhig gtso bor byed par kun gyis khas blangs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa spyod rgyud ni/ lha'i rnal 'byor gyi yan lag gzhan rnams phal cher bya rgyud dang mthun pa'i steng du nang gi rnal 'byor khyad par ba/ rnam snang mngon byang dang bsam gtan phyi ma nas bshad pa'i bsam gtan gyi yan lag bzhi dang*/ de nyid gsum la sogs pa ste/ yan lag bzhi ni/ sgra dang sems dang gzhi la gzhol/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di la yang phyi'i bzlas brjod yan lag bzhi dang*/ nang gi bzlas brjod yan lag bzhi'o/ /dang po la/ gzhi dang po rang rnam snang du bskyed nas bsgom pa/ gnyis pa mdun du de bzhin gshegs pa gsal bar dmigs pa/

gsum pa de'i thugs kar sems zla bar bsgom pa/ bzhi pa zla ba'i steng du sgra yig 'bru sgom pa rnams so/ /nang gi ni/ rang shākya thub tu bskyed pa gzhi dang po/ de'i snying gar zla ba'i phug tu rnam snang bsgom pa gnyis pa/ de'i thugs kar zla ba dang yig 'bru sgom pa tha ma gnyis te 'di dag gi tshul rgyas par bsam gtan phyi ma'i 'grel pa dang*/ rnam snang mngon byang rtsa 'grel sogs las shes par bya'o/ /de nyid gsum ni/ bsam gtan phyi ma las bshad pa'i/ mar me gnas kyi dang*/ sgrar gnas kyi dang*/ sgra mthar thar pa ster ba'i de nyid gsum ste dang po ni/ rang lhar gsal ba'i snying khar mar me'i me lce lta bu'i me shin tu gsal zhing rno ba'i nang du bzlas bya'i sngags kyi phreng ba gzhan gyis bar ma chad du 'don pa thos pa lta bu'i shin tu phra ba bsgoms pas bru tsha ba mi 'byung ba sogs dang*/ lus la bde drod 'bar ba sogs 'byung ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor phra ba la sems shing*/ zla ba'i nang du sngags kyi me lce sgra dang bcas pa yang dmigs nas shin tu gsal ba na gzhan thams cad btang te sgra 'ba' zhig la dmigs pa'i bsam gtan byed pa ste/ phyi nang gi bzlas brjod dang de nyid gnyis po de'i gnas skabs su srog rtsol 'gog pa'i rlung sbyor yang gsungs so/ /gsum pa ni/ bsam gtan snga ma rnams kyis lha'i thugs rgyud bskul ba dang*/ bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye ba dang*/ rlung las su rung ba sogs 'byung yang 'khor ba'i rtsa ba mi chod pas/ sgra'i gnas skabs snga ma rnams gtong ba'i rim pa rnams btang ste/ mthar thar pa ster byed stong pa nyid kyi bsam gtan bdag med pa'i don la zhi gnas khyad par can gyis drangs pa'i lhag mthong gi rtsal sbyong ba'o/ /'di dag kyang bsam gtan phyi ma rtsa 'grel las rgyas par shes dgos so/ /rnam snang mngon byang las ni bsam gtan dang po rnams la mtshan bcas dang*/

zhi lhag sgom pa la mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lam ni/ de nyid 'dus pa rtsa bshad 'grel pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi gsungs pa'i don rnams mtshan bcas dang mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor gnyis su 'du la/ dang po la yang rags pa lha la dmigs pa dang*/ phra ba phyag mtshan la dmigs pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis su 'du zhing*/ dang po la slob ma'i dbang tsam las ma thob pa'i gang zag gi lam dang*/ slob dpon gyi dbang yang thob pa'i gang zag gi lam gnyis su mdzad do/ /dang po la/ slob dpon chen po kun snying gi de nyid snang chen las ni/ khrus byas nas khro bo'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pa'i bsrung 'khor gyis bdag dang gnas bsrung*/ sbyor ba tshogs bsog bya/ rdo rje thal mo sogs kyi phyag rgya khyad par can gyis rdo rje dbab pa brtan par byas/ bskyed chog gis lhar bskyed pa'i phyag chen bcings pa la ye shes pa bcug phyag rgya bzhis rgyas btab/ dbang bskur/ mchod bstod byas/ rang gi sngags zla ba lo gcig gi bar du byed pa'i rnal 'byor gcig ldan ma gtogs pa rnal 'byor chen po ma bshad cing*/ gzhal yas khang ni 'grel pa las ma bshad cing sems dpa' 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs che chung gnyis las gzhal yas khang sgom pa dang*/ sprul pa spro ba dang*/ rgyas 'debs kyi mthar mnyam rnam gsum bsgoms nas bzlas pa byed par bshad do/ /gnyis pa la/ rdo rje 'byung ba nas rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum mdzad pa ni gsum ka la bdag rdzogs rnal 'byor chen po dang bcas pa'i mthar lha re re'i bzlas brjod 'bum phrag gi bsnyain pa byed par mtshungs la/

khyad par ni| 'bring la snga ma'i steng du dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog bsdus pa tsam bsnon la/ rgyas pa la/ dang po sbyor ba dang dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang las rgyal mchog ste ting nge 'dzin gsum ka rgyas par byed pa'o/ /de yang lha sgrub pas ni lo gcig gam phyed dam zla ba gcig gi bar ram dkyil 'khor mngon sum gyi mthong gi bar du sgrub la/ gzhan la dbang bskur bas ni lhas gnang ba'i mtshan ma thob kyi bar du sgom par gsungs so/ /phra mo sgoms pa'i dgos pa ni/ zhi gnas kyi dgos pa dang phal cher mtshungs la/ sgom tshul ni/ rang gang sgom gyi lha'i mdog can gyi rdo rje rtse lnga phra shos skra rtse dang sbom shos til 'bru'i tshad can lte ba'am sny-ing khar bsams nas sngags kyis rlung dang lhan cig drangs te sna rtser bzhag la/ de la dmigs nas glang chen smyon pa 'dul ba ltar/ dran shes kyis bcings nas sems shin tu brtan par byas te/ brtan pa legs par thob nas khams gsum gyi bar du spro bsdu byed tshul sogs rgyas par gsungs te/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lam gyi snying po mdor bsdus pa tsam zhig bstan gyi/ rgyas par ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /mtshan med ni/ de nyid 'dus pa las/ snying po dang phyag rgya dang gsang sngags dang rigs sngags te bzhi'i dbang du byas pa'i de kho na nyid kyi don la rtse gcig 'jog pa'i zhi lhag gnyis ka bshad la/ bshad rgyud rtse mo nas de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/ padma'i rigs kyi bdag mdun so sor bsgom pa'i thugs kar yi ge bsams te gnyis ka'i gzugs sogs bden stong du dpyad nas yun ring du bsgom pa'i lhag mthong gtso bor bshad la/ 'grel pa ko sa la'i rgyan las zhi lhag gi mtshan nyid dang bsngags pa rgyas par bshad pas na/ lam thun mong ba lta ba rnam dag la rtsal du 'don cing khyad par snang stong lha skur 'char ba'i sgo nas thabs mkhas khyad par can la slob pa'i gang zag de rdo rje theg pa ba yin gyi/

za chog gcig gnyis re bslabs nas nag chang don du gnyer bzhin du rdo rje theg pa'i sgrub pa po yin no snyam pa'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyis gzhan dam chos 'dul ba'i lag len byed pa rnams la brnyas thabs byed pa ni/ bstan pa la rma 'byin cing*/ rang gi dam tshig dang sdom pa'ang nyams par byed pa yin te/ rgyas par rgyud sde so so'i dam tshig dang sdom pa'i rnam gzhag rnams las shes par bya'o/ /bzhi pa rnal 'byor bla med kyi lam la/ rgyud kyi dbye ba bshad pa dang*/ lam gyi rnam gzhag bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgya bod gnyis kar du mkhas pa thams cad mthun par| dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rtsa bshad kyi rgyud rnams la pha rgyud dang*/ gshin rje gshed skor dang phyag na rdo rje 'khor chen sogs la de'i cha mthun gyi rgyud du byas cing*/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dang*/ rdo rje gdan bzhi dang*/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor sogs la ma rgyud du bzhed cing*/ rje btsun sa skya pa ni| dpal dus kyi 'khor lo yang ma rgyud du byas nas/ dges pa rdo rje gnyis med kyi rgyud du bzhed do/ /bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa sogs ni/ kyai rdo rje ma rgyud du byas nas/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la gnyis med rgyud du mdzad do/ /de dag gi 'jog byed ni/ thabs gtso bor gyur pa dang*/ shes rab gtso bor gyur pa dang*/ thabs shes cha mnyam par ston pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de dang der 'jog par bzhed do/ /mkhas pa phyi ma dag ni/ gnyis su med rgyu'i ya gyal thabs shes la byed par rigs mod kyi/ bla med kyi rgyud sde thams cad thabs shes gnyis med kho na yin te/ thabs bde ba chen po dang shes rab stong pa nyid rtogs pa lam gyi gtso bor mi ston pa'i rgyud sde med pa'i phyir ro| |gal te bde stong gtso bor ston mi ston gyis 'jog na ni/ bde mchog sogs las stong nyid las kyang bde chen rgyas pa cig bstan te/ rtsa rlung thig le la brten pa'i rnal 'byor dang phyag rgya bsten tshul sogs zhib par bstan pa'i phyir ro/

/des na ma rgyud nyid thabs rgyud du thal ba sogs kyi skyon yod pas/ pha rgyud ma rgyud thabs shes kyi sgo nas mi 'jog gi rjaugs rim la gzugs sku'i rgyu'i gtso bo sgyu lus kyi rnam gzhag gtso bor ston pa la pha rgyud dang*/ chos sku'i rgyu'i gtso bo bde chen gtso bor ston pa ma rgyud yin pas| de ltar na dus 'khor dang kyai rdor yang ma rgyud du 'du la/ kun kyang gnyis med kyi rgyud du 'dod do/ /deng sang gi mkhas pa dag ni/ pha rgyud ma rgyud kyi 'jog byed de ltar 'thad du chug kyang*/ gnyis med kyi 'jog byed ni thabs shes gnyis med tsam min gyi/ pha rgyud 'dus pa dang*/ ma rgyud bde mchog gnyis la med pa'i rgyu la 'bras bus rgyas 'debs pa dang 'bras bu la rgyus rgyas 'debs tshul sogs khyad par mang po yod la/ de dag ni dus 'khor dang kyai rdor gnyis ka la tshang bas/ de gnyis ka pha rgyud ma rgyud las lhag pa'i gnyis med kyi rgyud du bzhed do/ /de la pha rgyud ma rgyud kyi 'jog byed rdzogs pa bod snga rabs pa dag lha pho mo mang nyung dang*/ las thams cad pa pho mos byed pa sogs mang du 'dod pa rnams ni mi 'thad pas/ sku gnyis kyi gtso bo'i sgrub byed la byed pa 'thad par mthong zhing*/ de ltar byas na dpal dus kyi 'khor lo ni gnyis med kyi rgyud du grub pa yin te/ gsang 'dus nas rgyas par ma bstan pa'i rtsa rlung thig le/ las dang ye shes dang phyag rgya chen mo sogs kyi sgo nas lhan skyes kyi dga' ba'am mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen sgrub lam de la gces par 'dzin pa'i ched du khams mi 'dzag par bsrung tshul dang*/ /nyams pa'i nyes dmigs sogs bde dges las kyang zhib par gsungs shing*/ bde dges nas rgyas par ma bstan pa'i bden pa gnyis kyi sgyu lus sgrub tshul gsang 'dus dang ming 'dogs 'dra bar ma mdzad kyang*/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs la mchog tu mdzad la/

stong pa de yang bde chen gyi yul du byas nas sgom rgyu'i yul gyi chos nyid lta bu'i stong rkyang yin gyi/ rdul phra rab kyi bsdus pa'i bem po'i gzugs dang bral yang gsang 'dus pa 'dod pa'i rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i 'ja' lus dang*/ mtshungs pa'i ye shes kyis snang gzugs khyad par can snang stong dbye med bde chen dang kha sbyor du bzhugs rgyu'i gzugs sku yin par legs par grub pa'i phyir dang*/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dkyil 'khor rgyas pa dpal ldan sgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor gyi nang du pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis ka'i lha tshang bar bsdus pa'i phyir/ pha rgyud 'dus pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ bcu gsum ma dang*/ bcu dgu ma dang*/ nyer lnga ma dang*/ so gnyis ma dang*/ so bzhi ma ste tshan pa drug dang*/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba zhe gsum dang zhe lnga ma dang*/ zhe dgu ma ste gsum/ ma rgyud mngon brjod 'bum pa lha bdun bcu rtsa gnyis dang bcas pa bsdus pa'i phyir/ 'grel chen las kyang*/ dang po'i sangs rgyas rigs med pa zhes pa'i don 'chad pa na/ 'dir rigs ni shes rab kyi phyogs dang thabs kyi phyogs te phyogs spangs pa gang gi phyir zhes sogs gsungs la/ 'di'i thabs shes kyang*/ bde chen dang*/ stong gzugs snang ba'i shes rab la mdzad par gsal la/ de gnyis phyogs re ba min par gnyis ka'i rnam gzhag dang sgrub tshul cha mnyam par ston pa sgrub byed du byas nas/ rgyal bas gnyis su med par gsungs so/ /zhes gnyis med rgyud du sgrubs la/ gzhan yang*/ bskyed rim gy-i skabs su/ pha rgyud nas gtso cher bshad pa'i 'byung ba rim brtsegs yongs su gyur nas gzhal yas khang bsgom pa dang*/ ma rgyud nas gtso cher bshad pa'i 'byung ba rim rtsegs ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du sgom pa gnyis kyang 'dir gnyis ka byed pa sogs kyi rgyu mtshan mang du yod de/ rang rang gi thad sor bshad par bya'o/

/de ltar na rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud ni/ pha rgyud dang*/ ma rgyud dang*/ gnyis med kyi rgyud gsum du gnas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud don mtha' dag la lam gyi chings byed tshul mi 'dra ba mang du yod de/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma la rten nas/ slob dpon shrardha ka ras rgyu'i rgyud dang thabs kyi rgyud dang 'bras bu'i rgyud gsum du bsdus te/ dang po ni/ sgron gsal nas bshad pa'i gang zag lnga dang de dag gi rgyud kyi sems kyi chos nyid shin tu phra ba'i gzhi dus kyi rlung sems lta bu'o/ gnyis pa ni/ rim gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i lam dang de thos bsam sgom tshul gyis nyams su len pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa ni/ zung 'jug gi mthar thug mngon du gyur pa'i sangs rgyas so/ /slob dpon skal bzang rdo rje'i lam rim las/ ma smin pa smin par byed pa dang*/ smin pa mi nyams par byed pa'i dam tshig bla ma la rgyud nyan nas mtshan nyid shes pa/ byang chub 'grub byed kyi thabs sems sbyang ba/ de mthar phyin pa'i thabs spyod pa ste cho ga lngar bsdus so/ /dgra nag 'grel pa rin chen sgron me las/ gang zag mchog gi dbang du byas nas/ dbang dang*/ dam tshig dang*/ bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ 'bras bu dang*/ las tshogs te drug tu bsdus la/ gang zag phal pa'i dbang du byas nas sgrub pa dang 'bras bu gnyis ma gtogs pa bzhir bsdus so/ /gsang 'dus kyi bshad rgyud ye shes rdo rje kun las btus las/ rgyud dang*/ gleng gzhi dang*/ nges tshig dang*/ rgyu ste bzhir bsdus so/ /de dag gi don ni sgron gsal las/ chags bral nyan thos kyi spyod pas 'dod khams su sangs rgya ba la tshul bzhi dgos pa dper byas nas bla med kyi spyod pas chags can 'tshang rgya ba la yang tshul bzhi yod par gsungs te/ 'di ltar/ chags bral 'tshang rgya ba la/ mir skyes pa dang*/ khyim pa'i cha lugs sna tshogs yod kyang rab byung pa'i tshe cha lugs gcig tu 'gyur ba dang*/

'dul ba'i kun spyod khyad par can la gnas pa dang/ 'tshang rgya ba'i nye rgyu dka' ba spyad cing 'o ma bzhes pa rnams dgos pa bzhin du/ chags can la bskyed rim gyis rang lha'i rnal 'byor shin tu brtan pa dang*/ bskyed rim la rigs lnga dang rigs brgya sogs yod kyang rdzogs rim pas gsang chen rigs gcig tu bsdud pa dang*/ rigs lnga'i dam tshig dang sdom pa khyad par can la gnas pa dang*/ spros bcas spros med sogs spyod pa khyad par can rnams dgos pa'o/ /bzhi po 'di dag ni rgyud don gyi gtso bo bzung ba yin pas/ sngon 'gro dbang gi cho ga dang*/ mthar 'bras bu 'grub pa'i tshul rnams kyang bzhi po'i nang du ci rigs par 'dus so/ /de ltar lam spyi'i chings byed tshul mang du byung yang*/ nyams su blang bde bar bsdu na/ rnal 'byor bla med du ma zad/ rgyud sde bzhi po re re zhing yang*/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'i tshul dang*/ dbang thob nas dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung ba'i tshul dang*/ sdom pa dag pas lam nyams su len pa'i tshul dang*/ nyams su blangs nas dngos grub sgrub pa'i tshul dang bzhir bsdus te/ de re re la yang yan lag dang bcas pa'i rnam gzhag shes shing rgyud la bkar ba'i myong ba skye tshul zhib du rtogs pa la bslab par bya ba yin no/ /'dir ni yi ge mang kyi 'jigs pas rgyas par ma bris te/ blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis rgyud sde rin po che rnams dang*/ de dag gi dgongs 'grel dri ma med pa rnams dang*/ de dag gi snying po bsdus pa bod kyi rje btsun gong ma sa skya pa'i bstan bcos rnam dag rnams dang*/ khyad par snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che dang*/ blau bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi gsang sngags lam rim sogs las shes par bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ rgyud sde so so'i lam gyi rnam gzhag rnams/ /ji bzhin 'byed pa'i blau gros mig bral yang*/

/lag len cho gas dregs pa'i mkhas rlom dang*/ /rnam dag rgyud sde'i lam dang mi mthun yang*/ /rmi lam gter ma sogs la gtsor byed pa'i/ /rtogs ldan sgrub chen ming can mang na yang*/ /rgyud don lam gyi snying por 'brel shes shing*/ /thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor mchog la brtson pa ni/ /gangs can 'di na nyin mo'i skar ma tsam/ /de phyir skal bzang myur lam don gnyer ba'i/ /blo ldan de yis tshul 'dir 'jug par rigs| |dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rim pa dang po'i lam gyi rnam par bzhag pa bskyed rim snang ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba las/ rgyud sde spyi'i lam gyi rnam par bzhag pa ste le'u gnyis pa'o// // bzhi pa khyad par dus kyi 'khor lo'i rnam gzhag la/ rgyud kyi che ba brjod pa dang*/ de la brten pa'i lam gyi rnam gzhag go /dang po ni/ 'grel chen dri ma med pa'i 'od las/ mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas stong phrag bcu gnyis pa/ rigs med pa/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dus kyi 'khor lo/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ye shes kyi sku mngon du gyu pa'i mtshan yang dag par brjod pas 'khyud pa/ rgyud thams cad kyi rdo rje'i tshig mngon du gyur pa| sangs rgyas rin chen za ma tog kha 'byed pa/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bden pa la rten pa/ rdzaugs pa'i byang chub pa rnam pa bzhi dang*/ /rdo rje rnam pa bzhis yongs su dag pa sku bzhi dang*/ rigs drug dang*/ bden pa bcu gnyis dang*/ de kho na nyid bcu drug dang*/ stong pa nyid bcu drug dang*/ snying rje bcu drug gi bdag nyid brjod par bya ba rjod par byed pa| dbang bskur ba 'jig rten pa'i bcu dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bcu gcig pa rab tu gsal bar byed pa/ las kyi phyag rgya dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang phyag rgya chen mo dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub rab tu gsal bar byed pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams dang*/

nang dang*/ mngon par dbang bskur ba dang*/ sgrub thabs dang ye shes te le'u lnga'i bdag nyid dam brtag pa lnga'i bdag nyid ni mi la sogs pa'i sems can mtha' dag gis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid thob par bya ba'i phyir yang dag par bstan to/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'di la brjod bya'i dang*/ gzhung tshad kyi dang*/ ngo bo'i dang*/ mtshan gyi dang*/ brjod tshul gyi dang*/ byed las kyi dang*/ rjod byed kyi khyad par ste/ khyad par bdun dang ldan pa'o/ / dang po ni/ mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas zhes pa ste/ skad cig ma gcig dang*/ rnam pa lnga dang*/ rnam pa nyi shu dang*/ sgyu 'phrul drwa bas byang chub pa ste/ mngon par byang chub pa bzhi yis sangs rgyas pa'i mtshan nyid/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po ni mchog yin la/ bde chen de yis dang por gdod ma nas sangs rgyas pas na mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas te/ 'di yang sgra la mngon par zhen pa dgag pa'i phyir du gsum pa'i don la drug pa sbyar ba'i sgra'o/ /de la dang po'i sangs rgyas dngos ni 'bras bu'i ston pa rdo rje 'chang yin la/ de'i sgrub gzhi sgrub byed la sogs pa'i cha nas rgyu'i rgyud dang thabs kyi rgyud kyang dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi sgras brjod par rigs pas na mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs dang bcas pa khyad gzhi khyad chos su 'brel ba'i rgyud gsum ni brjod bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtsa rgyud kyi gzhung tshad tshig rkang pa re re la yi ge brgyad brgyad de sho lo ka re re la yi ge so gnyis dang ldan pa mtha' dag kyang rjes bsngags kyi sdeb sbyor gyis bcings pa'i sho lo ka stong phrag bcu gnyis yi ge sum 'bum brgyad khri bzhi stong ngo*/ /de las de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis lung bstan pa rjes su gnang ba'i 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis bsdus pa'i bsdus rgyud kyi gzhung tshad ni rkang pa re re la yi ge nyi shu rtsa re yod pa me tog phreng 'dzin gyi sdeb sbyor 'ba' zhig gis bcings pa sho lo ka re la yi ge brgyad cu rtsa bzhi ma'i sho lo ka stong dang sum cu yi ge brgyad khri drug stong lnga brgya dang nyi shu'o|

|de yang rgyud dngos kyi dbang du byas kyi/ mjug gi dpal ldan dpal ni zhes sogs tshigs bcad bcu ni rgyud bsdus tshul sogs kyi rnam gzhag mjug don lta bu yin pas ma bgrangs so/ /de la rtsa ba'i rgyud ni/ dbang mdor bstan sogs kyi dum bu ma gtogs rgya bod gnyis char du tshang bar ma 'gyur par byang shambha la nyid na phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa zla ba bzang pos mdzad pa'i 'grel chen stong phrag drug cu pa dang bcas te bzhugs la/ bsdus rgyud ni spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa padma dkar po'i 'grel chen stong phrag bcu gnyis pa dang bcas te rgya bod gnyis char na nyi zla ltar grags so/ /gsum pa ni/ gong du bshad pa ltar pha rgyud ma rgyud so so ba lta bu'i brjod bya'i gtso bo gnyis rtsal du 'don tshul cha mi snyoms pa'i rigs su chad pa med par gnyis ka shin tu rgyas pa'i tshul gyis cha mnyam du ston pa'i sgo nas rgyud sde mtha' dag gi rtse mo zla med par gyur pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ khyad chos bdun gyi sgo nas mchog tu gyur pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po| dus kyi 'khor lo'i skad dod la kā la tsakra zhes pa la yi ge re re'i bshad pa ni| 'grel chen las/ kā yig las ni rgyu zhi ba/ /la yig 'di la thim pa nyid| |tsa yig gis ni g.yo ba'i sems/ /kra yig rim par bcings pa'o// zhes gsungs pa'i don gnas skabs bzhi'i bag chags skyes par byed pa'i thig le bzhi po 'gyur med du bcings pas sku bzhi'i bdag nyid mngon du gyur pas dus kyi 'khor lo ste/ de yang ka kā ra ṇa shānti zhes pa'i kā ra ṇa rgyu dang shānti zhi ba la 'jug pa'i rgyu ni sems can gyi sad pa'i gnas skabs bskyed par byed pa| dpral bar gnas pa'i lus kyi thig le yin la/

de zhi zhing 'gags pas sad pa'i gnas skabs zad pa sprul pa'i sku'o/ /la la yo tra pai zhes pa ni/ la yig 'di la thim pa ste/ rmi lam gyi gnas skabs bskyed par byed pa mgrin par gnas pa'i ngag gi thig le dang nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i rlung rnams gzhom med kyi nā da 'di la thim zhing 'gags pas rmi lam gyi gnas skabs zad par longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'o/ /tsa tsa la tsitti ces pa ni/ tsa yig g.yo ba'i sems te/ 'og gi bcings ces pa 'dir yang drangs nas/ gnyid 'thug po'i gnas skabs bskyed par byed pa snying khar gnas pa'i sems kyi thig le 'gags shing bcings pas gnyis 'thug gi gnas skabs zad pa chos kyi sku'o| |kra kra ma bandha nā t ces pa ni rim par bcings pa ste/ bzhi pa'i gnas skabs skyed par byed pa lte bar gnas pa'i ye shes kyi theg le mi 'pho bar bcings shing 'gags pas bzhi pa khu ba 'pho ba'i gnas skabs zad pas lhan cig skyes pa'i sku'o/ /ming gnyis su bsdu na/ dus ni 'gyur med bde shes pa| |thabs ni snying rje'i bdag nyid do/ /'khor lo shes bya'i rnam 'gro dpal| |shes rab stong nyid bdag nyid do/ /zhes pa ste/ yul can mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po thabs dmigs med snying rje chen po ni dus yin la/ yul rnam kun mchog ldan shes bya'i rnams pra phab pa'i snang ba lta bu 'gro ba'i dpal du gyur pa dang*/ shes rab dmigs bcas kyi stong pa nyid kyi bdag nyid ni 'khor lo'o/ /lnga pa ni/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ye shes kyi sku mngon du gyur pa'i mtshan yang dag par brjod pas 'khyud pa dang*/ rgyud kyi rgyal po thams cad kyi rdo rje'i tshig mngon du gyur pa ste/ mtshan brjod kyis 'khyud tshul ni/ bstan bya dang po'i sangs rgyas brjod par khyad med pa'i phyir dang*/ ston pa/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar dus gsum char gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs par mtshungs pa'o/

/'o na gsang 'dus sogs las skal bzang gi sangs rgyas gzhan gyi gsang sngags ma gsungs shing mi gsung bar bshad pa ci zhe na/ 'phags pa'i yul du rigs bzhi'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams la de'i dus su ma gsungs pa sogs la dgongs so/ /zhes 'grel chen las bshad do/ /rdo rje'i tshig mngon du gyur tshul ni/ kun rdzob kyi rdo rje'i tshig gsod pa sogs drang don nges don gyi dam tshig dkyil chog tu bshad pa lta bu rnams dang*/ don dam pa'i rdo rje'i tshig bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no/ /zhes shes rab ye shes dang 'dra bar bshad pa'i dbang bzhi pa'i don te/ rdo rje'i tshig 'di gnyis/ rgyud sde gzhan las shin tu sbas pa'i tshul gyis mngon du ma gyur par bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa la ltos pa'i sgo nas bstan la/ 'dir de las ldog ste bstan pa'o/ /drug pa ni/ sangs rgyas rin chen zhes pa nas/ dngos grub rab tu gsal bar byed pa zhes pa'i bar te/ mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba ni/ sangs rgyas rin chen yin la/ de'i za ma tog ni rdo rje dang padma ste/ de gnyis kyang mnyam par sbyor tshul shin tu rgyas pa'i sgo nas kha 'byed pa'o/ /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bden pa la bsten pa ni/ gtso bo 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub sgrub byed rnam par rtog pa'i bsgom pa bskyed rim dang*/'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub sgrub byed rnam rtog dang bral ba du sogs kyi lam rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis ka gsal bar byed pa'o/ /de bzhin du sngar bshad pa'i byang chub bzhi dang*/ sku gsung thugs ye shes te rdo rje bzhis yongs su dag pa| gnas skabs bzhi'i sgrib gnyis bral/ ngo bo nyid dang*/ chos dang*/ longs spyod rdzaugs pa dang*/ sprul pa ste sku bzhi dang*/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba ye shes kyi khams dang*/ rnam shes nam mkha' dang*/ 'du byed rlung dang*/ tshor ba me dang*/

'du shes chu dang*/ gzugs sa'i khams te mngal skyes kyi rigs drug po sgrib pa dang bral ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rigs drug dang*/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis sgrib pa dang bral ba'i bden pa bcu gnyis dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ mchog dga' dang*/ khyad dga' dang*/ lhan skyes kyi dga' ba bzhi po re re la lus ngag sems ye shes kyi dbye bas/ sprul pa dang*/ chos dang*/ longs spyod rdzogs pa dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa re re la sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje bzhi bzhir byas pas de kho na nyid bcu drug dang*/ stong ba nyid stong pa nyid dang*/ chen po stong pa nyid dang*/ don dam pa stong pa nyid de stong nyid gsum po rim pa bzhin du phung po lnga dang khams lnga dang*/ dbang po lnga'i stong nyid kyi rang bzhin mar ngo'i tshes lnga pa phrag gsum dang*/ gnam stong dang tshes gcig gi dbus su bcu drug pa rnam pa thams cad stong pa nyid de stong nyid bcu drug dang*/ sems can dang*/ chos dang*/ dmigs med la dmigs pa'i snying rje gsum ni go rim bzhin du dkar phyogs kyi tshes lnga pa phrag gsum gyi bdag nyid dang*/ nya dang nag po'i tshes gcig gi mtshams su snying rje bcu drug pa ste snying rje bcu drug rnams rjod par byed pa dang*/ chu dang*/ cod pan dang*/dar dpyangs dang*/ rdor dril dang*/ brtul zhugs dang*/ ming dang*/ rjes gnang dang*/ bum pa dang*/ gsang ba dang*/ shes rab ye shes te/ mngal skyes rnams kyi dri ma dag byed 'jig rten pa'i bcu dang*/ bskal pa chen po mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes kyi mtshan nyid 'jig rten las 'das pa ni dbang bzhi pa ste/ dbang bcu gcig rab tu gsal bar byed pa dang*/ 'dod pa na spyod pa'i dngos grub sgrub byed nu ma dang skrar ldan pa'i las kyi phyag rgya dang*/ gzugs kyi srid pa'i dngos grub sgrub byed rang gi sems kyis yongs su btags pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang*/

dngos po dngos med dang bral ba'i rnam kun mchog ldan gyi dngos grub sgrub byed rtog bral pra phab pa'i rang bzhin phyag rgya chen mo dang*/ sku bzhi sogs kyi bsdus pa'i 'jig rten las 'das ma 'das kyi dngos grub rab tu gsal bar byed pa'o/ /bdun pa ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams la sogs pa le'u lnga ste/ rim pa bzhin du phreng 'dzin gyi tshigs bcad brgya re dgu dang*/ brgya don bzhi dang*/ nyis brgya dang gnyis dang*/ nyis brgya so bzhi dang*/ nyis brgya re gcig rnams ni bsdus rgyud la yod do/ /mi la sogs pa'i sems can zhes sogs kyis ni sgrub pa po'i gang zag bstan te/ de yang khams drug ldan gyi mi'i skye ba 'di la sangs rgyas thob kyi 'gro ba lhag ma lnga la ma yin te/ las sa ma yin par skyes pa'i phyir ro| |lha la sogs pas kyang mi'i skye ba brgyud nas sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis sems can mtha' dag gis zhes gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa ba'i rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis pa ni/ phyi'i gnas rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi shrī dhā na ka ṭa ka zhes pa dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten/ 'og tu chos dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor stong nyid rnam par dag pa'i cha bcu drug gi dbye ba can dang*/ de'i steng na rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad rnam par dag pa'i ka ba phyogs rer bdun bdun te nyi shu rtsa brgyad btsugs pas na dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor cha bcu drug gis rnam par dbye ba can te/ de yang shar lho nub byang gi ka ba bdun bdun po rnams rim pa bzhin du khyab 'jug dang*/ karti ka dang*/ tshangs pa dang dbang phyug gis btsugs pa'o/ /de lta bu'i bkod pas mdzes pa'i gnas khyad par can no/ nang ni gnas chos kyi dbyings nam mkha'i mtshan nyid dog pa med pa'i chos 'byung 'jig rten gyi dpe las 'das pa kun tu bzang po'i bde ba chen po'i gnas su/
