shes pa dang shes bya gcig tu 'dres shing bcad du med la dbyer med pa rnam pa thams cad du dbyings kyi mtshan nyid me long gi pra phab pa dang mtshungs pa'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen por/ phyi'i gnas rdo rje seng ge'i khri zla ba dang nyi ma dang me'i dkyil 'khor bcad du med cing dbyer med pa/ nang gi gnas e yig rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid nam mkha'i khams la bzhugs pa'i phyi'i ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sngar sa bcu gnyis kyi dbang phyug tu gyur kyang 'phags pa'i yul lum bi nir shākya'i rigs mi'i dbang po zas gtsang ma'i lha mo sgyu 'phrul chen po'i lhums nas bltams pa gzhon nu don grub ma ga dhar mngon bar byang chub pa'i mkhas pa sgyu 'phrul chen po 'chang zhing sgyu 'phrul chen po'i mig 'phrul dang ldan pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa mchog gi thugs rje can sgyu med par brnyes gshin pa sgrib pa thams cad las nges par grol ba'i rgyal ba sprul pa'i sku shākya thub pa/ nang gi ston pa mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po'i skad cig nyi khri chig stong drug brgyas phung po dang khams la sogs pa 'pho ba'i rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgya sgrib med kyi 'khor lo skyes pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi bdag nyid waṃ yig bde ba chen po'i ngo bo de nyid kyis/ phyi'i zhu ba po ro ldan dur khrod na gnas pa'i gnod sbyin rnams kyi sde dpon gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje'i sprul pa'i sku shambha la'i yul ka lā pa'i grong gi bdag po nyi ma'i 'od kyi lha mo rnam par rgyal ba'i mngal nas byung ba shākya'i rigs kyi rgyal po zla ba bzang po/ nang gi zhu ba po/ ro ldan sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin la gnas pa 'dud dang nyon mongs pa dang shes bya dang snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa'i gnod sbyin gsod par byed pa'i gnod sbyin gyi bdag po/

rdo rje theg pa mtha' dag gi bsdud pa por gyur pas gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes gsol ba btab nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ lha dang klu dang khro bo'i rgyal po dang*/ lha dang lha mo'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba'i 'khor gyi dbus su legs par gsungs shing*/ rgyal po zla ba bzang pos tshig don mtha' dag legs par bsdus nas byang shambha la'i yul du khyer te glegs bam la bris shing rang nyid kyi 'grel chen stong phrag drug cu pa yang sbyar nas grong khyer bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug na gnas pa'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la rdo rje theg pa'i lam gsal bar byas shing shambha la'i lho phyogs ma la ya'i skyed mos tshal du dus kyi 'khor lo'i gzhal yas khang rin po che sna lnga las grub pa yang bzhengs te lo gnyis lon nas chos kyi rgyal srid rang gi sras lha dbang la gtad de/ longs spyod rdzaugs pa'i gzugs kyis rang gi gnas mkha' spyod chos kyi dbyings su gshegs so/ /de nas lha dbang dang*/ gzi brjid can dang*/ zla bas byin dang*/ lha'i dbang phyug dang*/ sna tshogs gzugs dang*/ lha'i dbang ldan te shākya'i rgyal rigs drug pau des lo brgya brgya'i bar du rtsa rgyud 'grel bshad dang bcas pa bstan to/ /de drug ni rim pa ltar| sa snying dang*/ gshin rje gshed dang*/ sgrib sel dang*/ rmugs byed dang*/ khengs byed dang*/ nam mkha'i snying po rnams kyi sprul pa'o/ /chos rgyal lha'i dbang ldan gyi btsun mo sna tshogs yum gyi mngal nas byung ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa mi'i dbang po grags pas kyang de'i rjes su lo brgya'i bar du snga ma bzhin du chos bstan cing*/ de nas ma la ya'i dus kyi 'khor lo'i gzhal med khang du phyi rol pa'i drang srong nyi ma'i shing rta la sogs pa bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi tshar bcad dang rjes 'dzin gyi sgo nas rdo rje theg pa'i lam la bkod de/

rgyal ba nyid kyis lung bstan cing rjes su gnang ba ltar rtsa rgyud las bsdus rgyud phyung zhing bsdus nas rigs bzhi rdo rje'i rigs su mdzad de 'di phyin chad rigs ldan zhes bya'o/ /des rang gi sras padma dkar po la chos kyi rgyal srid gtad cing*| des kyang 'grel chen stong phrag bcu gnyis pa mdzad nas lo brgya'i bar du bsdus rgyud kyi chos bstan to/ /de bzhin du chos kyi rgyal po bzang po dang*/ rnam rgyal dang*/ bshes gnyen bzang po dang*/ phyag dmar dang*/ khyab 'jug sbas pa dang*/ nyi ma grags pa dang*/ shin tu bzang po dang*/ rgya mtsho rnam rgyal dang*/ rgyal dka' dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ sna tshogs gzugs dang*/ zla 'od dang*/ mtha' yas dang*/ sa skyong dang*/ dpal skyong rnams kyis kyang lo brgya brgya'i bar du chos bstan to/ /de ltar shākya'i rgyal rigs bdun dang*/ rigs ldan bcu bdun rnams sngon chad 'das la/ da lta rigs ldan seng ges chos bstan nas 'das lo bco brgyad song ste/ mdor na sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo 'das ma thag pa drag po'i lo phan la nyis stong sum brgya dang bco brgyad lon no| |'di ni rgyal po zla bzang gi lo gnyis po'i bar la/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las ma 'das pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /da phyin chad rigs ldan rnam gnon dang*/ stobs po che dang*/ ma 'gags pa dang*/ mi'i seng ge dang*/ dbang phyug chen po dang*/ mtha' yas dang*/ rnam rgyal dang*/ slar yang 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i sprul pa drag po 'khor lo can te/ rigs ldan nyi shu rtsa lnga po 'di dag thams cad kyang byang sems dang*/ khro bcu'i sprul pa sha stag yin te zhib par gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /de ltar na dus 'khor shaṃ bha la'i yul na bzhugs pa las/ rwa pa ltar na/ paṇḍi ta 'jam dbyangs sprul pas padma dkar po la dngos su gsan cing*/ 'bro pa ltar na/ dpal skyong la dus zhabs pa che bas dngos su gsan nas rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du phebs shing*/

rim gyis paṇḍi ta chen po nā ro pa dang*/ a bha yā ka ra la sogs pa paṇa grub tshad ldan du mas thugs nyams su bzhes te/ rim pas gangs ri'i khrod du yang dar zhing rgyas par gyur to/ /'di ni brjod bya shin tu zab pa dang rgya che ba gnyis ka rgyas par ston cing shes bya ji snyed pa mtha' dag kyang gtan la 'bebs la/ rjod tshul mtha' drug tshul bzhis bcings pa'i steng du/ stod smad thams cad rtsis kyi ri mo rtogs dka' bas bsdams pa shin tu khong du chud dka' ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ bod la la dag rang nyid kyis rdo rje theg pa spyi dgos kyi gsang tshig zab mo ma rtogs par chos la smod pa'i las chen po bsog cing*/ mkhas pa chen po gzhon nu blau gros kyis dwogs pa gcod pa'i ched du rgal brtag byas pa'i rigs pa rnams kyang yang dag pa'i lan gyis mi bzlog par khas bslangs nas rnal 'byor gnyis su med pa'i rgyud sde rin po che 'di la rgyab kyis phyogs par byed do/ /'di dag ni lus de nyid kyis mnar med pa'am/ rdo rje dmyal ba chen por ltung ste/ bskal pa chen po grangs med pa'i bar du sdug bsngal mi zad pa myong zhing*/ gal te de las thar kyang*/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam zab mo rna ba'i yul du mi 'gyur ba'i skal ngan bdud kyi rigs su rtogs par gdon mi za ste/ yang dag pa'i rigs pa cung zad kyang ma mthong bzhin du theg chen shin tu zab pa'i chos la log par zhugs pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang gang zag la mi rton cing chos la rton pa dang*/ chos kyi'ang tshig la mi rton par don la rton pa ni spyir gsung rab spyi dang khyad par lugs 'di'i grub mtha' yin pas/ rigs pa ltar snang rnams kyis mi gnod pa'i tshul ni logs su rgyas par 'chad la/ 'di nas bshad pa'i lam rnams rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar bde blag tu bgrod pa'i zab lam khyad par can yin pa ni 'og nas 'chad pa'i tshul rnams la brtags pas skal bzang rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis 'phral du rtogs par 'gyur ro/

/deng sang gi mkhas rlom phal cher chos la mi rton gang zag la rton pa'i dbang du byas na yang*/ shambha la'i rigs ldan la sogs pa rnams lung gis sgrub dgos su chug kyang*/ rgya bod na tshad ma'i skyes bur grags pa rje btsun nā ro pa ni rgyud 'di nyid rgyud sde kun gyi gtso bor 'dzin te/

des mdzad pa'i dus 'khor gyi skor la 'grel pa mang du yod cing*/ der ma zad/ kyai rdo rje'i nā ro 'grel chen du'ang*/ nges don gyi bshad pa mtha' dag dus 'khor gyi bsdus rgyud rtsa 'grel 'ba' zhig shes byed du byas nas bshad la/ mkhas pa chen po a bha yas kyang phreng ba bskor gsum du 'di nyid gtso bor bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ bod kyi gsung rab la tshad mar gyur pa'i sngon dang phyis kyis mkhas pa mtha' dag 'di kho na la bshad sgrub kyis rtsal du bton cing*/ red mda' bas kyang rang gis bkod pa'i dwogs pa rnams la rang nyid kyis dri ma med pa'i lan byas nas/ lugs 'di'i rgyud gsum gyi bshad pa man ngag gis brgyan pa dang bcas pa mdzad de bsngags pa lhag par mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras sogs kyis ma bshad pa ni/ slar bstan pa'i tshul gyis de'i dus su 'phags yul du rgyud ma byon pas yin gyi/ skyon can du bzhed nas ma bshad pa ma yin te/ gzhan du gshin rje gshed kyi skor dang*/ yo ga'i skor la sogs pa 'phags pa yab sras kyis bshad pa ma mdzad pa'i gsung rab mang po zhig skyon can du 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa la/ spyi 'gro dang mthun par/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'i tshul dang*/ dbang thob nas dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung ba'i tshul dang*/ sdom pa dag pas nyams su len pa'i tshul dang*/ nyams su blangs nas dngos grub sgrub pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la/ sngags kyi 'jug sgo dbang la ltos par bstan pa dang*/dbang bskur thob pa dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa la ltos pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la ltos pa dang*/ slob dpon du 'os pa bsnyen pa dag pa la ltos par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'grel chen gyi mdor bsdus gnyis pa las/ 'dir phra rab 'dus pa mngon du 'gro ba ni 'jig rten gyi khams so/ /'jig rten gyi khams sngon du 'gro ba ni sems can rnams so/

/sems can sngon du 'gro ba ni 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mngon par dbang bskur ba'o/ /mngon par dbang bskur ba sngon du 'gro ba ni/ bsod nams kyi tshogs dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo goms pas 'og min gyi srid pa mtha' thug pa 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa'o/ /'j-ig rten pa'i dngos grub sngon du 'gro ba ni/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs dang skye ba snga ma'i stong pa nyid dang snying rje kun rdzob dang dmigs pa med pa'i bag chags kyi stobs kyis rdul phra rab 'dus pa las 'das shing dkyil 'khor la sogs pa rnam par rtog pa'i bsgom pa dang bral ba phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes kyi dngos grub sgrub pa'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ sgrub le'i sngaun du dbang le 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa yang dbang la ltos par bshad pa sogs kyis bstan cing gzhan yang*/ rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i dbang bskur ba ma thob na rgyud don legs par shes nas 'bad pa shin tu chen pos thun bzhir rnal 'byor bsgoms kyang dngos grub phra mo yang mi 'grub kyi steng du/ dmyal bar 'gro ba sogs kyi nyes dmigs shin tu che ste/ phyag chen thig le'i rgyud las/ gang tshe dang po'i slob ma ni/ /lan gcig dbang rnams kyis ni bskur/ /de tshe gsang chen bshad pa yi/ /nges par snod du gyur pa'o/ /dbang med na ni dngos grub med/ /bye ma btsir la mar med ltar/ /gang zhig rgyud lung nga rgyal gyis/ /dbang bskur med par 'chad byed pa/ /slob dpon slob ma shi ma thag /dngos grub thob kyang dmyal bar 'gro/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ bla ma las ni dbang nod zhu| |zhes dang*/ bshad rgyud rdor phreng las kyang*/ dug ni sngags kyis 'joms pa bzhin/ /sngags kyis dag byed bcud len byed/ /de bzhin slob ma dbang sogs kyis/ /ma dag pa ni dag par 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ yang dag dbang bskur gyis dben na/

/sgrub pos rgyud kyi don shes kyang*/ /slob dpon slob ma mtshungs par ni/ /mi zad dmyal ba chen por 'gro/ /zhes dang*/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud las kyang*/ /dper na bu tsha med pa'i khyim/ /shi ba tsam gyis stong pa nyid| |ces sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ dbang thob pa yang dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa la ltos la| de yang bla med kyi rgyud gzhan las/ bum pa dang*/ gsang ba dang*/ shes rab ye shes dang bzhi pa ste dbang bzhi la dkyil 'khor yang bzhi ste/ rdul tshon nam| ras bris sam/ lus sam/ bsam gtan gyi dkyil 'khor bzhi po gang rung du slob ma dbang po mchog dman gyi sgo nas bum dbang bskur ba dang*/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang dbang dang*/ kun rdzob dang*/ don dam pa'i sems kyi dkyil 'khor gnyis su dbang tha ma gnyis bskur bar rgyud dang tshad ldan gyi gzhung las bshad pa'i dbang gong ma gsum ka'ang bum dbang ma thob bar bskur du mi rung ste/ dkyil 'khor ma mthong zhing der ma zhugs pa rnams la gsang ba sgrog tu mi rung ba'i dam gzhag thams cad kyang phyi'i dkyil 'khor 'ba' zhig gi dbang du byas pa'i phyir ro/ /phyi'i dkyil 'khor yang rdul tshon dang ras bris gang rung du dbang ma thob par lus kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur du mi rung la/ bsam gtan yang dpon slob gnyis ka nus pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'i dbang du byas so/ /rgyud 'di'i lugs kyis ni thog mar gang du 'jug pa'i dkyil 'khor yang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor kho na la yin la/ dbang bcu gcig kyang bsdu na/ chu'i dbang dang*/ bum dbang dang*/ gsang dbang dang*/ shes rab ye shes dang*/ bzhi pa ste lngar byas nas dkyil 'khor yang rim pa ltar rdul tshon dang*/ lus dang*/ bha ga dang*/ byang chub sems la kun rdzob dang don dam gnyis su byas pa rnams so/ /de rnams go rim nges pa can dgos tshul sogs ni dkyil chog tu yang bshad zin la/

'dir yang*/ rdo rje theg pa'i gdul bya dang por dkyil 'khor du nges par 'jug dgos pa dang*/ gang du 'jug pa'i dkyil 'khor yang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor yin pa'i tshul gyi snying po mdor bsdus te bshad na/ rdo rje gur gyi le'u brgyad pa las| dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs dang*/ /dbang bskur med pa'i rnal 'byor pa| |gang gis rab gnas ma mthong zhing*/ /gang zhig sbyin sreg ma byas na| |'jig rten 'di dang gzhan du yang*/ /de la dngos grub mchog nyid med| |ces dang*/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las kyang*/ dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs dang*/ /dam tshig rnams ni spangs pa dang*/ /gsang ba'i de nyid mi shes pas| |bsgrubs kyang ci yang mi 'grub bo/ /zhes sogs dang*/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pas/ dbang bskur dkyil 'khor sngon 'gro bar/ /rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa ste/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pas dbang mi thob par bshad la/ dam tshig dang sdom pa ni rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rmang gzhi yin la/ de yang rgyud gzhan ltar na rdul tshon dang ras bris sam/ 'di pa'i lugs kyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor kho na ru sdom pa thob kyi/ gzhan du mi thob pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gang dag bskyed rim smin byed kyi phyi'i dbang gtan ma thob par dbang gong ma bskur nas rdzogs rim ston pa dang*/ phyi'i chu la sogs pa'i dbang bskur ba'i tshe yang*/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor mi byed cing*/ byas kyang lha ngo legs par ston pa sogs kyi 'jug pa'i skor la sla chos su byed pa rnams ni bdud kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /'o na 'grel chen las/ dbang le'i gsol gtab kyi tshigs bcad 'chad pa'i skabs su/don dam pa'i bden pas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bri ba med de/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bkag pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du dang po'i sangs rgyas las bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa/

rdo rje'i thig rnams gdab pa dang*/ /rdul tshon dag kyang gdab pa ni/ /mi bya sngags kyi de nyid kyis/ /byed na byang chub thob par dka'/ /zhes pa ste/ zhes sogs gsungs pa ci zhe na/ de ni bskyed rim mthar phyin nas rdzogs rim gyi dbang la rdul tshon du byar mi rung bar ston pa yin par de'i 'phro nyid la ltas pa tsam gyis shes te/ 'dir ye shes sgrub pa'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis dkyil 'khor gsum gsungs pa 'di lta ste/ lus kyi dbang po bha ga sems/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yi/ /dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /gzhan la tshon lnga ldan pa min/ /zhes pa ste/ de'i phyir bde ba chen po sgrub pa dang mchog gi dbang bskur ba sbyin pa'i don du rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du mi 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / gsum pa ni/ dkyil 'khor du dang por legs par 'jug pa ni| 'bri ba'i lag len la mkhas shing sgrub pa'i ting nge 'dzin brtan la/ slob ma'i snod brtag pa dang lha ngo legs par sprad de dag pa sbyor shes pa'i slob dpon la ltos pa na/ 'di ltar bshad par bya ste/ bsten bya slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid/ sten byed slob ma'i mtshan nyid| dpon slob kyi 'brel pa brtag dgos par bstan pa'o/ / dang po ni/ dbang le'i tshigs bcad gnyis pa sogs las/ dang por yang dag bsten bya snga ma bla ma dag kyang dam tshig ldan zhing rdo rje theg par gnas| |de nyid bsgom shing ma chags dri ma dag dang rnam par bral zhing bzod pa'i ngang tshul lam la zhugs/ /slob ma rnams la lam ni sbyin byed dmyal ba'i 'jigs pa 'phrog pa de nyid las ni tshangs spyod ldan/ /bdud rnams la ni rdo rje dbyug pa de yang 'dzin ma'i gzhi la rdo rje sems dpar rab grags pa'o| |zhes pa 'dis slob dpon gyi yon tan bstan la/ de yang mkhas pa dag yon tan bcu ru bsdus mod kyi/ dam tshig dang ldan pa nas rdo rje sems dpar grags pa'i bar phye na yon tan bcu gnyis su 'gyur la/

bsdu na| rang smin par byed pa'i dang*/ gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i yon tan gnyis su 'du la/ dang po la lam gyi rtsa ba drang don dang nges don gyi dam tshig rnam par dag pa dang ldan pa dang*/ lam gyi ngo bo la sngon 'gro bu dang chung ma sogs dang rang gi lus la yang ltaus pa med pa'i sgo nas ma chags pa dang*/dngos gzhi rten mu stegs dang nyan rang gis mi phyed pas rdo rje theg pa'i theg chen la lhag par gnas shing sangs rgyas kyi lam la zhugs pa/ ngo bo rim pa gnyis kyi de kho na nyid bsgoms shing*/ dgos kyi khyad chos 'dzag med kyi tshangs spyod dang ldan pa/ spang bya chags sogs kyi dri ma dang bral zhing grogs tshe 'di'i rnyed bkur la mi lta ba'i bzod pa bsgom pa'o/ /mjug la/ byed las phung po la sogs pa'i bdud rnams la rdo rje dbyug pa dang 'dra zhing ming sa'i steng na rdo rje sems dpa' lta bu'i slob dpon du grags pa'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ slob ma la rim pa gnyis kyi lam sbyin pa'i sgo nas dmyal bas mtshon pa'i sdug bsngal gyi 'jigs pa 'phrog pa'o/ /nga rgyal dang ldan khro bas zil mnan dam tshig rnams bral rdzas la brkam zhing thos pa dag kyang med/ /slob ma rnams ni slu ba don du gnyer zhing mchog gi bde ba'i gnas las sems nyams dbang ma bskur/ /longs spyod dag la kun chags bag med rtsub mo'i tshig dang bcas shing dbang po'i don du 'dod ldan pa/ /de ni dmyal ba bzhin du slob ma mkhas pa rnams kyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub rgyur ni spang bar bya/ /zhes pa 'dis slob dpon gyi skyon bstan la/ 'di yang mkhas pa kha cig gis skyon bcu ru bsdus mod kyi/ nga rgyal dang ldan pa sogs bcu gnyis su gsal zhing*/ de yang dang por smin byedakyi dbang ma thob pa dang bar du grol byed lam las gol ba dang*/ mtharaslob ma rjes su 'dzin pa mi mkhas pa gsum du 'dus pa'i dang po ni/ dbang ma bskur zhes pas bstan la/

gnyis pa la/ mthun rkyen ma tshang ba dang*/ 'gal rkyen gnas pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'jig rten gyis smad pa'i gsang spyod kyi dam tshig gsal por spyad pas dam tshig dang bral zhing dam pa'i lam gyi man ngag dang bral bas thos pa med pa dang*/ le lo'i dbang gis mchog gi bde ba'i gnas zab lam sgom pa las brtson 'grus nyams pa'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ rdzas dang*/ dbang phyug dang rigs gzugs dang mkhas pa'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan zhing snying rje med pa'i khro bas non pa/ dge 'dun dang mchod rten gyi rdzas la brkam zhing 'khor ba'i log spyod la chags pa/ chang 'thung bas bag med cing dbang po gnyis sbyor gyi 'dzag bde'i 'dod chags dang ldan pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rdzun gyis slob ma slu zhing tshig rtsub pos yid sun par byed pa'o| |skyon yon de dag padma dkar pos mdzad pa'i don dam bsnyen pa las kyang gsungs te/ ji skad du/ chags med 'dod chags chen po la ni sems bcings pa/ /dbang po gnyis bde sbyor zhing brtul zhugs chen po can/ /phyag rgya dag la sbyor zhing chags pa nyams mi mnga'/ /rnal 'byor gyis ni nyi zla dag gi lam nyams pa/ /shes rab me la rnal 'byor stobs kyis rab tu zhugs/ /dpag med bde ba'i bdud rtsi btung la chags pa ste/ /sdig 'phrog rdo rje 'dzin pa de ni bla ma dam pa dpal/ /zhes sogs yon tan dang*/ lam dag med cing nor la 'dod cing brkam pa yis/ /de bzhin dbang la rgyal ba'i cod pan 'ching bar byed/ /'dod pa lhag zhen chang gi dbang gis bag med cing*/ khro ba'i sems dang bcas shing rdzas la mang du zhen/ /bden pa ma yin smra zhing bu rnams slu 'dod pa/ /bla ma de yis sdug bsngal ster ba ngo mtshar med/ /ces sogs skyon gyi rnam gzhag rgya cher 'byung ba ltar yin la/ slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid mdo rgyud gzhan las kyang mang du gsungs mod kyi 'dir tshig mang du dwogs pas ma bris so/ /

gnyis pa ni/ zab cing rgya che la sems bla ma'i nges pa la dga' gtong ba'i ngang tshul dang ldan yon tan shes/ /rgyud la gus shing thar pa don gnyer bslu ba med pa'i sems ldan de nyid thob pa shin tu sbed/ /gdug pa rnams kyi grogs nyams slob ma gcig pu de ni bla ma mkhas pa rnams kyis bsdu bya ba// shes rab dbang la sogs pa'i rgyur ste slar yang gzhan zhes bya ba 'bring po bsod nams dag gi rgyur/ /zhes pas bstan la/ yon tan rab 'dir bshad pa kun tshang ba ni shes rab ye shes kyis mtshon pa'i dbang gong ma'i snod dang*/yon tan 'bring po ni bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi rgyur dbang bdun gyi snod dang*/yon tan tha ma ni dge bsnyen gyi bslab gzhi lnga'i snod du bzung nas rim gyis blo sbyong du gzhug par gsungs so/ /de yang zab cing rgya che ba la sems pa sogs yon tan dgu po 'di rnams kyang bsdu na/ sbyor ba bsag sbyang sngon du gtong ba dang*/ dngos gzhi nyan pa po'i chos gsum tshang ba dang*/ rjes yon tan mthar phyin pa'i rgyud dang ldan pa'o/ / dang po ni/ lus dang longs spyod la sogs pa ltos med du bla ma la 'bul ba sogs kyi gtong ba'i ngang tshul dang ldan zhing*/ gdug pa'i slob dpon rnams kyi grogs mi dge ba bcu spyod pa las nyams pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gzu bor gnas pa ni/ bla mas ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin du rtsa ltung spong zhing dge bcu spyod pas bla ma'i nges pa la dga' ba dngargyud 'di nas gsungs pa'i dam tshig mtha' dag bsrung bas rgyud la gus pa'o/ /blau gros dang ldan pa ni/ stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can gyi zab pa dang rgya che ba'i theg chen la sems shing dkon mchog gi yon tan legs par shes pa'o| |don du gnyer ba ni/ 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa la ma chags par thar pa 'gyur med kyi bde chen don du gnyer ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ 'jig rten pa'i lam gyis sems mi g.yo zhing lam gyi rtogs pa rang gis nyams su myong ba de nyid shin tu sbed pa'o/
/gsum pa dpon slob kyi 'grel pa brtag dgos pa ni/ spyir yang gzhan gyi skyon la rtog pa mi rigs la/

khyad par sngagasakyi tshul la ni/ ji skad du/ slob dpon yon tan blang bya yi/ /skyon ni nam yang min pa nyid/ /yon tan blangs pas dngos grub 'gyur/ /skyon rjod pa las dngos grub med| |ces dang*/ dbang mchog thob gang rdo rje yi/ /slob dpon la ni de bzhin gshegs/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams bzhugs pas/ /dus gsum byon pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes sogs slob dpon gyi yon tan kho na la rtog pa dang*/ gnas tshod la yon tan ji ltar yod kyang sangs rgyas su lta ba dgos shing*/ de la sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang phyag sogs bkur bsti byed par gsungs pas| snga ma la skyon yod med brtag mi rigs pas skyon gyi khyad par bshad pa rnams don med do zhe na/ de ni ma yin te/ slob dpon du ma gyur pa'i sngon du dpon slob gnyis char gyi skyon yon legs par brtags shing dpyad dgos te/ rgyud gzhan las kyang*/ snying rje med cing khro la gdug khengs shing chags la ma bsdams dang*/ /rang bstod bla mar slob mar ni/ /blau bzang ldan pas mi bya'o| |zhes sogs dang*/ brtan zhing dul la blau gros ldan/ /bzod ldan drang la g.yo rgyu med/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes/ /snying brtser ldan zhing bstan bcos mkhas/ /de nyid bcu ni yongs su shes/ dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i las la mkhas| |gsang sngags 'chad byed slob dpon te/ /dad pa'i bdag nyid dbang po dul/ /zhes sogs phyi rol skyon yon gyi mtshan nyid dang*/ spyir mdo rgyud kun las| dpon slob kyi 'brel pa brtag tshul gsungs shing*/ khyad par bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las/ lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du rtog par gsungs pa'i phyir ro| |slob dpon gyi skyon la mi rtog cing sangs rgyas su lta bar gsungs pa ni/ slob dpon du gyur zin nas mdzad pa thams cad sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa dang 'dra bar chags pa dang sdang bar snang ba thams cad kyang gdul bya 'dul ba'i don can du shes shing*/

rdo rje theg pa'i tshul la ni rdo rje 'chang dang tha mi dad par lta ba dang*/ rang la phan 'dogs pa'i sgo nas sangs rgyas las kyang lhag par mthong ba'i gus pa bskyed pa la blau sbyang bar bya'o/ /der ma zad dang por brtag dpyad byed pa'i tshe yang slob ma'i snod brtag pa'i ched du tha mal pa'i tshul bzung nas dman pa'i spyod pa mdzad pa dang rang la gshe zhing sdig pa la sogs pa dgos pa'i dbang gis mdzad srid pas yun ring du spro srings nas brtag dgos te/ tshe gcig gi khyo shug 'grul gcig gi lam rogs/ zhag gcig gi gnas khang dang bza' btung sogs la'ang 'bad nas rtog cing dpyod pa mthong ba'i phyir ro/ /de yang mdo rgyud gzhan 'ga' zhig dang dbu ma rtog ge 'bar ba la sogs par yon tan gzhan gyi sgo nas lhag pa zhig yin na/ /rten gyi sgo nas rab byung dang*/ khyim pa la khyad par med par bshad pa'ang yod mod kyi/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rab tu byung ba'i phyogs dag ni/ /yon tan tshad med rnams dang ldan/ /de ltas sdom brtson khyim pa yi/ /byang chub sems las khyad par 'phags/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa dang mthun par/ rgyud 'di pa'i lugs kyi| dge bsnyen dang*/ dge tshul dang*/ dge slong dang*/ dge slong gi nang nas kyang gnas brtan rgan po rnams la/ sngar bshad pa'i yon tan gzhan gyi sgo nas ma nyams yin yang*/ rten gyi sgo nas mchog dman shin tu che ba dang*/ der ma zad yon tan gzhan lhag kyang rten dman na rten mchog la bkur bsti byed dgos pa dang*/ rgyal po la sogs pa chen po rnams kyis kyang khyim pa slob dpon sa thob pa ma gtogs pa bla mar mi bkur ba sogs gsungs te/ ji skad du/ rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ de nyid bcu ni yongs shes pa/ /gsum las dge slong mchog yin 'bring*/ /dge tshul zhes bya de dag las/ khyim na gnas pa tha ma'o| |zhes dang*/ gdug pa sdigs par byed pa'i mchog /gang gi ngur smrig mthong ba yis/

/lha min sa yi 'og tu 'bros/ /dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa bya| |zhes dang*/ sa thob ma gtogs khyim pa ni/ /rgyal pos bla mar mi bya ste/ /de la thos pa yongs shes pa/ /gang zhig rtags can bya ba nyid| |sa thob ma gtogs slob dpon ni/ khyim gnas gang tshe mchod byed pa| |de tshe sangs rgyas chos dang ni/ /dge 'dun rnams la gus med 'gyur/ /lha khang sogs kyi rab gnas sogs/ /rtags can gyis ni rtag tu bya/ /gnas gcig na ni gsum yod na/ khyim pa gos dkar ldan pas min/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi rdo rje slob dpon byed pa la ni/ sngar bshad pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa tsam gyis mi chog gi /spyir yi dam gyi lha'i bzlas brjod kyi sgo nas bsnyen pa mthar phyin cing*/ khyad par dkyil 'khor de nyid kyi lha'i bsnyen pa rnams/ rab sngags bzlas pa'i rkyen gyis dngos sam rmi lam sogs kyi tshe rjes su bzung ba'am/ zhi rgyas sogs kyi nus pa mngon gyur du byung ba lta bu mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa'am/ 'bring lo drug dang zla ba drug la sogs par bya ba gzhan spangs nas bzlas brjod byas pa lta bu dus kyi bsnyen pa'am| tha ma rang rang gi rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i gtso 'khor gyi sngags kyi grangs tshad bzhi 'gyur sogs sam/ shin tu tha ma'ang grangs tshad de nyid bsnyen pa'i grangs su bgrang du rung nges kyi sgo nas song ba zhig shin tu gal che ste/ de lta min na/ bsnyen sogs dag par ma byas par/ /dkyil 'khor las la 'jug pa dang*/ /zhes pa'i sbom pos reg par 'gyur zhing*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis byin gyis mi rlob cing 'tshe bar 'gyur ba dang*/ slob ma snod rung du byed pa'i sa bon khyad par rnams bskrun par mi nus shing*/ ye shes mi phebs par 'gyur la/ bsnyen pa ma rdzogs par zhi sogs kyi las la sbyar na yang 'bras bu med cing tshur la gnod pa la sogs pa gsungs pas/

bsnyen pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /de yang rgyud gzhan nas bshad pa'i bzlas pa'i byed tshul ni mang du yod pa ni mang du dwogs pas mi 'chad la/ rgyud 'di nas gsungs pa'i bzlas pa'i tshul yang*/ rgyas par mchod phreng du bshad pa las rtogs par bya zhing*/ sgrub le'i 'grel chen du/ thugs rdo rje ming yig dang po dang*/ gsung rdo rje ming yig rdzaugs pa dang*/ sku rdo rje ming yig gi steng du yan lag gzhan dang bcas pa gsum las rim pa ltar/ bsgom bya dang mchod bya dang bzlas bya'i sngags su gsungs shing*/ grangs tshad rim pa ltar 'bum phrag gcig dang bcu dang brgya dgos par gsungs la/ lha mnyes shing grub pa'i thabs su bsnun pa dang*/ dbab pa dang*/ sreg pa dang*/ bslang ba dang*/ rgyas pa dang mnyes pa ste bzlas pa drug bya zhing*/ de yang rtsa rgyud las/ sngags kyi dang po gsal byed dam/ /dbyangs rnams bsgrub par bya ba'i slad/ /bsnyen dang bzlas pa byed rnams la/ /'di yis las ni rnam drug gsungs/ /dang por bsnun par bya ba ste/ de nas dbab dang sreg pa dang*/ /de nas sngags pas bslang ba dang*/ /de nas rgyas dang mnyes pa'o/ /rnam par dpyad byas stong pa yis/ /sngags kyi sngon 'gro mnan pa ni/ /mtshon gyi rgyal pos bsnun pa ste/ brgyal ba'i gnas skabs 'thob par 'gyur/ /thugs kyi bzlas pa 'bum gyis ni| |brgyal bar gyur pa sngags kyi lha/ /nga rgyal yongs su btang ba ni/ /sgrub pa po yi dbang du 'gyur/ /de bzhin rlung gis mnan na de/ /rnal 'byor pa la phebs par 'gyur/ /me yis gnan na bsregs par 'gyur/ /de bzhin chu yis slang bar 'gyur/ /sa ni spyi bor gnas pa dag /bzlas na lha ni rgyas par 'gyur/ /spyi bor thig le'i chas bsnan na/ /mnyes pa mchog ni ster bar 'gyur/ /de ltar drug 'bum bzlas pa ni/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyud chen las/ /'dod pa grub slad bde gshegs kyis/ /sngon du bsnyen pa dag tu gsungs/

/phaṭa yig de bzhin hūm̐ bau ṣaṭa/ /na maḥswāhā ba ṣaṭa rnams/ /las drug la ni grangs bzhin du/ /mthar sngags brtul zhugs can gyis bya| |dang por rnam snang mdzad byin nas/ /slar yang bzlas pa yang dag rtsal| |zhes sogs gsungs pa'i don/ 'grel chen gyis sgrol ma'i sngags la sbyar nas gzhan la mtshon par gsungs pa/ 'dir dus kyi 'khor lo'i mtshan yig dang po la sbyar na/ oṃ ཿ phaṭa ces pa dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ ces dang*/ oṃ rkāḥbau ṣaṭa ces dang*/ oṃ can maḥces dang*/ oṃ lkāḥswā hā ces dang*/ oṃ kaṃ ba ṣaṭa ces pa rnams/ rim pa ltar bsnun pa nas mnyes pa'i bar gyi bzlas pa drug go /'di rnams re re la bzlas pa 'bum phrag re dang sbyin sreg khri phrag re bya bar rtsa rgyud nas bshad pa'i phan yon 'byung zhing*/ de rnams thugs rdo rje'i bzlas pa yin la/ de grub nas/ oṃ kā la tsakk+ra swāhā/ zhes pa gsung rdo rje'i bzlas pa 'bum phrag bcu dang sbyin sreg 'bum phrag cig de nas oṃ kā la tsakk+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ ces sogs sku rdo rje'i bzlas pa 'bum phrag brgya dang sbyin sreg 'bum phrag bcu bya ste/ de rnams grub nas lha rnams mchog ster bar 'gyur gyi rnam pa gzhan du ma yin no/ /zhes 'grel chen las bshad pa ltar ro| |de yang oṃ yig bor ba'i ming yig dang po dang sgrub pa po'i ming yig dang po gnyis kyi dbyangs gsal rnams phan tshun dgra ru gyur na dngos grub med kyi steng du/ dbyangs dgrar gyur na sgrub pa po 'chi zhing gsal byed dgrar gyur na/ na bar gyur pa sogs kyi skyon skyed la/ grogs su gyur na dngos grub bshad pa bzhin du 'grub cing tha mal du gyur na dngos grub ring bar gsungs la/ dgra grogs kyi rnam gzhag kyang rtsa rgyud kyi don 'grel chen las bshad pa zhib tu shes par bya zhing*/ mdor bsdus cung zad bshad na/ dang por rtsa ba'i dbyangs/ a i ṛ u l̥ lnga ni mas rim gyis sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i yi ge yin la/

de rnams kyi ring po rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /de rnams kyi 'phel ba a e ar o al rnams ring thung dang*/ de rnams yaṇar ha ya ra wa la ring thung rnams kyang mas rim gyis sa chu me rlung nam mkha' ste/ rgyud 'di pa'i lugs kyi dbyangs sum cu po de la 'byung ba rtsi tshul tshar gcig po de las gsal byed bzhin du 'byung chen 'byung chung gnyis gnyis rtsis pa ma mthong ngo*/ /gsal byed la| sa sde/ ka sde/ tsa sde/ ṭa sde/ pa sde/ ta sde rnams mas rim gyis sa chu me rlung nam mkha' ye shes kyi yi ge yin la/ de'i phyir rgyud 'di pas ta sde pa sde'i mjug tu 'don pa yang 'byung ba'i rim pa dang bstun pa'o/ /sde pa re re la lnga lnga yod pa rnams yas rim gyis sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i yi ge ste/ de ltar na rtsi tshul snga ma la 'byung chen dang phyi ma la 'byung chung du grags so/ /de yang*/ ta sde la mtshon na/ ta sa'i sa/ tha sa'i chu/ da sa'i me/ dha sa'i rlung*/ na sa'i nam mkha'o| |de bzhin du gzhan rnams la'ang sbyar ba bya zhing*/ 'byung ba de dag las| rlung dgra sa/ sa dgra me/ me dgra chu/ chu dgra rlung du bshad cing*/ sa chu phan tshun dang*/ me rlung phan tshun grogs yin la/ chung rlung gi dang*/ sa me'i dang*/ me chu'i dang*/ rlung sa'i tha mal par bshad cing*/ dgra grogs de dag dang dbyangs gsal gyi nang nas dbyangs dang*/ 'byung ba che chung gi nang nas 'byung chung la rtsi ba gal che'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /slob dpon mtshan nyid de dag dang ldan pas dbang bskur ba'i cho ga byed tshul dngos ni/ rgyud dang*/ rgya gar mkhas pa'i gzhung gi dkyil chog dang*/ bod kyi dkyil chog khungs thub rnams dang*/ khyad par rgyud 'di'i dkyil 'khor bri sgrub dang 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'i cho ga lag len rgyas pa mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa legs par bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga chen mo pad dkar dgongs gsal du bshad zin pa las rtogs par bya'o/

/gnyis pa ni/ de ltar dbang legs par thob nas/ lha dang bla ma'i spyan sngar khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung ba ni/ sdom pa gsum la nyams len byed pa'i gang zag rnams kyi bya ba mtha' dag gi gtso bo yin te/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtha' dag gi gnad kyang 'khrul pa med pa'i lam gyi nyams len yin la/ lam gyi rtsa ba yang sdom pa nyid yin pa'i phyir ro| |de yang so sor thar pa dang 'gal ba'i nyes byas phra zhing phra ba gcig gis rgyal chen ris bzhi'i tshe tshad kyi bar la dmyal bar skyes pa lta bu'i nyes dmigs dang*| bslab gzhi sna gcig dang bsnyen gnas nyin gcig bsrungs pas lha mi'i bde 'bras yun ring du thob pa lta bu'i phan yon gyis mtshon nas/ sdom pa gsum ka la bsrungs ma bsrungs kyi phan yon dang nyes dmigs gcig las gcig che ba bslab gzhi re re la yod la/ khyad par rdo rje theg pa la dang por slob ma dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga'i gtso bo dam tshig dang sdom pa 'dzin du gzhug pa dang*/ dam la bzhag pa na phan yon dang nyes dmigs chen po rnams nan gyis bshad pa dang*/ don 'di la nyams len gyi gtso bor bstan pa'i ched kho na'o/ /des na ma bsgoms par 'tshang rgya ba la sogs pa'i lam 'ga' zhig gi zab chos lta bur bshad pa rnams kyang dam tshig dang sdom pa shin tu dag par byas pa'i gang zag des/ lam gyi dngos gzhi rim pa gnyis lta bu la 'bad pa'i brtsom pa byas pa tsam gyis/ 'phags pa kun dga' bos dgra bcom thob par 'bad pa brtsams pa bzhin du rtogs pa khyad par can bde blag tu skye ba'i don yin gyi/ de lta ma yin par lam ma bslabs par sangs rgya na 'bad med du grol bar thal ba sus kyang bzlog tu med do/ /de nyid kyi phyir/ rgyud las kyang dam tshig bsrung ba la nan tan du gdams te/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi le'u dang po las/ shin tu mnyam bzhag sgrub pa pos/ /rtag tu dam tshig bskyang bar bya/

/dam tshig nyams pas dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bskur dngos grub thob mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ sdom 'byung las/ ci ste dngos grub mchog 'dod na/ /srog ni yongs su btang yang sla/ /'chi ba'i dus la bab kyang sla| |rtag tu dam tshig bsrung bar bya/ /zhes dang*/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las kyang*| dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs dang*/ /dam tshig rnams kyang spangs pa dang*/ /gsang ba'i de nyid mi shes pas/ /sgrubs kyang ci yang mi 'grub bo| |zhes dang rdo rje rtse mo las/ bskal pa brgya phrag dag tu ni/ /ci ste mngon par brtson byas kyang*/ /gang zag bzhis ni 'jig rten du/ /sgrubs kyang 'grub pa nyid mi 'gyur/ byang chub sems ni ma skyesadang*/ /the tshom dag dang ldan pa dang*/ /bka' bzhin du ni mi spyod dang*/ /dad pa med pa nyid mi 'grub/ /ces te/ bka' bzhin mi spyod pa ni/ bla mas gsungs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la mi spyod pa'o/ /de yang 'dul ba nas/ bsnyen par rdzaugs ma thag pa la gnas rnams mi brjod par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par dbang thob nas dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung ba la nan gyis bkod dgos par/ bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ de nas sngags sogs byin pa yis/ /dam chos snod du byas nas su/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi ni/ /klag dang 'dzin pa nyid du bya/ /zhes dang*/ sgyu drwa las/

de nas dam tshig bstan par bya/ /de ring phan chad bu khyod kyis| |srog dang rus pa la bab kyang*/ /dam pa'i chos dang byang chub sems/ /slob dpon la ni brnyas mi bya/ /rdo rje spun rnams bkur bya zhing*/ /sdang la byang sems dang bral bar/ khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o/ /zhes dang*/ dkyil chog phal cher gyi/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la sogs pa'i skabs su/ rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya ni/ /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /'dir ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /zhes sogs rgyas par 'byung la/ khyad par rgyud 'di nyid las/ slob ma 'jug pa'i skabs su/ 'tshe dang mi bden gzhan gyi bud med spang bya gzhan gyi nor dang chang gi btung ba de bzhin nyid/ 'khor bar rdo rje'i zhags pa dag ste rang gi dge ba 'joms byed sdig pa lnga po 'di dag go |gang zhig gang gi dus su byung ba lha dang mi yi bla ma de yi mtshan gyis rab sbyin bya/ /sna tshogs gtso bo'i bka' de srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms pa dag ste khyod kyis kyang ni bskyang bar bya/ /zhes sogs brtul zhugs nyi shu rtsa lnga po bstan pa gang gi dus su byon pa'i ston pa de'i mtshan gyis sbyin dgos par gsungs shing*/ yo ga'i rdo rje rtse mo sogs kyang rigs lnga'i dam tshig la sogs pa thog mar slob dpon gyis bsgrag cing bshad la/ bzung zhing bsrung nus na dbang bskur bas bzung du gzhug la/ mi nus na dbang mi bskur ba sogs kyi dam gzhag 'bad pa chen pos mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ / de ltar na sdom pa gsum las so thar ni/ sdom pa ma thob pa'i sngon du bslab bya slob tu ma gnang mod kyi/ gong ma gnyis la sdom pa ma blangs pa'i sngon du bla mas dam sdom gyi bcas mtshams bsrungs ma bsrungs kyi phan yon dang nyes dmigs zhib tu bshad dgos kyi/ dang po nyid nas lam gyi rtsa ba dam tshig dang sdom pa la slob tu mi 'jug par/

rdzogs rim gyis sa mtshams mtho sa cig gi sgras zin ji ltar ba bzhin bshad nas las 'bras kyi blang dor yal bar 'dor ba ni bdud kyis byin gyis rlabs pa'o/ /des na dang por bslab bya mi slob na slob dpon la nyes par 'gyur la bslabs nas mi sgrub na slob ma la nyes par 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir/ rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis/ gsang sngags lam gyi 'jug sgo dbang dang*/ rtsa ba dam tshig dang sdom ba bsrung ba la rag las so zhes/ rtsa ltung gi rnam bshad du gdams pa 'di ltar mdzad de/ rdo rje theg la dad kyang ma smin na/ /zab mo bsgoms kyang 'bras bu ngan 'gro las/ /mchog gzhan mi 'grub sangs rgyas gsungs pas na/ /bla ma mchog la dbang bskur nod par mdzod/ /dbang thob man ngag zab mor gzhol ba yis/ /sa steng byas par kun tu brtsal byas kyang*/ /phan pa'i gdams ngag don po dam tshig ste/ /'di med 'gram rtsa zad pa'i khang rul 'dra/ legs par smin pas dam tshig bsrung byas na/ /rim gnyis zab mo'i man ngag ma brten kyang*/ /skye ba bcu drug dag na 'grub bo zhes/ /'gro ba'i rtsa lag phan pa mdzad pas gsungs/ /bdag ni thos chung shes rab mig bral yang*/ dri med rgyud las legs gsungs mthong bas na/ /dbang blang dam tshig bsrung bar mdzod cig ces/ /kun la thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs/ /ces gsungs so/ /dam tshig dag na rim gnyis la brtson pa ma byas kyang 'grub par gsungs pa ni/ bram ze chen po sa ra has/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud kyi 'grel par| rgyud gsang ba mdzod kyi rgyud lung drangs pa/ dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan na/ skye dang skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur/ /de yis skye ba bdun la ni/ /ma bsgoms par yang dngos grub thob/ /gang la bsgom pa dang ldan zhing*/ /gal te dam tshig sdom la gnas/ /skye 'dir las dbang gis ma 'grub/ /skye ba gzhan du dngos grub 'thob/ /re shig dam tshig nyams na ni/

/dngos grub thob pa lta zhog gi /mi yi skye ba'ang rnyed par dka'/ /zhes dang*/ dam tshig lnga pa las kyang*| gal te ltung ba med gyur na/ /skye ba bcu drug dag na 'grub/ /ces dang*/ rnal 'byor zla bas kyang*/ ma bsgoms gyurakyang ltung med na/ /skye ba bcu drug dag na 'grub/ /ces gsungs pa'i ma bsgoms kyang 'grub ces pa'i don ni sngar bshad zin to/ /de ltar na/ rje btsun chen po'i gsung 'di ni sngags kyi lam gyi gnad mthar thug pa legs par dgongs nas brtse bas gzhan la 'dams pa'i gsung*/ gzhan las rtogs sla zhing bskul che ba zhig snang bas/ tshigs bcad 'di rnams gser gyis bris nas mgul du brtags nas nyin re bzhin lan gsum du bklags la rang gi sems dang zhus dag bya'o/ /de la dam tshig dang sdom pa'i khyad par ni/ rgyal bas bcas pa'i mtshams las ma 'das par byed pa dang*/ bya rgyu mi byed cing mi bya rgyu byed pa la bshad pa byung mod kyi| 'da' bar bya ba ma yin pa'i cha nas dam tshig dang*/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i cha nas sdom par byas na rigs so/ /de la'ang rgyud sde spyi'i dam tshig dang sdom pa'i rnam gzhag dang*/ khyad par dus kyi 'khor lo'i dam tshig dang sdom pa bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ / dang po ni/ jo bo rje'i dam tshig thams cad bsdus pa las/ thun mong ba'i rtsa ba'i ltung ba bzhi dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i ltung ba bcu gnyis dang*/ bya ba'i rgyud kyi ltung ba sum cu dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ rnal 'byor dang bla med gsum la rtsa ltung bcu bzhi bcu bzhi dang*/ yang lnga dang yang bzhi dang*/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba bdun cu thams cad pa'o/ /zhes gsung ste/ de la bya ba'i rgyud kyi rtsa ltung sum cu ni| 'di dang 'di'o zhes bgrangs pa med la/ phyis kyi mkhas pa dag legs grub kyi rgyud las/ dngos grub myur du thob 'gyur ba'i/ /gsang sngags bzlos pa'i 'dul ba bshad/ /sgrub pos gsang sngags thams cad dang*/

/lha rnams dag ni thams cad dang*/ bzlos pa bdag nyid chen po la/ /mkhas pas zhe sdang mi bya'o/ /mkhas pas sngags kyi cho ga dang*/ /gsang sngags rang bzo mi bya zhing*/ /rang bzhin ngan pa'i mi dag la/ /brnyas par yang ni mi bya'o/ bla ma dkyil 'khor ston pa dang*/ /spyod pa ngan par gyur na yang*/ /ngag gam yang na yid kyis su/ /nam yang smad par mi bya'o/ /mkhas pas rigs sngags dag la ni/ khro nas mnan dang bcing ba dang*/ /bcad pa dang ni tshar bcad dang*/ /drag spyod de dang de mi bya/ /gzhan gyis rjes su ma gnang bar| |gsang sngags bzung bar mi bya ste/ /bsnyen bkur mi byed pa la'ang*| |cho ga shes pas sngags mi sbyin/ /rgyud shes mkhas pas gsang sngags dang*/ /phyag chen cho ga zhib mo dang*/ /rgyud dang dkyil 'khor bshad pa dag /dkyil 'khor ma zhugs la mi byin/ /mtshon cha 'dra ba thams cad dang*/ /de bzhin sems can 'dra ba dang*/ /phyag rgya sna tshogs 'dra ba rnams| |bza' bar mi bya 'goms mi bya/ /sgrub pa po ni blo can gyis/ /dman rnams smad par mi bya ste/ /mi gtsang bas kyang reg mi bya/ /rkang pas kyang ni mi 'gong ngo*/ /theg pa chen po dag dang ni/ /shes rab can gyis rtsad mi bya/ / byang chub sems dpa'i mthu chen dag /thos nas sun yang mi dbyung ngo*/ /sngags kyi sgrub pa po dag dang*/ /lhan cig nam yang 'gran mi bya/ /nyes pa chung ngu dag la ni/ khros nas drag shul dpyad mi bya/ /bzlos pa'i cho ga la gnas pas/ /glu gar rtsed mo mi bya ste/ /mdzes par bya phyir phreng ba dang*/ kha dog bcang bar mi bya'o| |'gong ba dang ni 'chong ba dang*/ /rgyug pa dang ni tsab hral dang*/ /lus las byung ba'i gnas ngan len/ /thams cad yongs su spang bar bya/ /bden pa'i chos la gnas pa yis/ /log pa ltung dang 'gyur dang rtsub/ /dbyen gyi tshig kyang spang ba dang*/ /don med gtam yang mi bya'o/ /mu stegs can dang gnas pa dang*// rtsod pa dag kyang mi bya zhing*/

/gdol pa la sogs rigs ngan dang*/ /gsang sngags bzlos pa smra mi bya/ /blo ldan bzlas brjod byed pa yis/ /sngags g.yog gcig pu ma gtogs par/ /gzhan dang lhan cig dgos med par/ /'ga' dang yang ni mi gnas bya/ /'bru mar dag gis lus mi bku/ /til yang bza' bar mi bya zhing*/ /la phug sgog pa tshwa dag dang*/ /chang skyur rnam pa tha dad dang*/ /cung ser dang ni sran ril dang*/ /de bzhin ma sha'i sran ma dang*/ /til gyi cung seng la du dag /dngos grub 'dod pas rnam par spang*/ /log 'dren dag gi zas kun dang*/ /gtor ma'i kha zas thams cad dang*/ /kri sa ra dang 'o thug dag/ gsang sngags bzlos pas rnam par spang*/ /shing rta la sogs zhon pa dang*/ /padma la sogs brdzi mi bya/ /rkang pas kyang ni reg mi bya/ kha zas lhag ma bor ba la/ sgeg pa'i cho ga thams cad dang*/ /lham dang gdugs dag 'chang ba dang*/ /lus kyi bya byed thams cad dag /gsang sngags bzlos pas rnam par spang*/ /rkang pas rkang pa mnye pa dang*/ /lag pas lag pa mnye mi bya/ /bshang gci dag ni chur mi dor/ /de dang nye bar dor mi bya/ /snyim pa kho nar mi bza' ste/ /mkhar ba'i snod du bza' mi bya/ /lo ma'i rgyab tu mi bza' zhing*/ /mkhas pas chags pa'i zas mi za/ khri rnams dang ni khri'u dag la/ /sgrub pa blo ldan mi gtsang ba// gzhan dang nyal bar mi bya ste/ /gan rkyal kha sbub tu'ang min/ /yang dang yang du mi bza' ste/ /ha cang chung dang cher mi bza'/ /mi za bar yang mi bya la| |gang dag dwogs pa'ang mi za'o/ /ngo mtshar kun la dga' mi bya/ /lta mo kun la mi lta zhing*/ /bud med kun dang 'jog nyal la/ /zhen pa'i sems kyis chags mi bya/ /sngags bzlos chog la gnas pas/ /lus dang ngag dang yid kyis kyang*/ /zas dang de bzhin spyod pa la/ ma bsdams par yang yong mi bya/ /sngags bzlos khyim pa mkhas pa yis/ kha dog bsgyur ba'i gos mi bgo /de bzhin rnying dang dri ma can/ /gos gcig par ni yong mi bya/

/bdag la smad par mi bya ba'i/ /rang la dga' bar mi bya ste/ /skyo bar yang ni ma gyur dang*/ /nad kyis 'gong bar mi bya'o/ /bka' lan bstsal ba ma gtogs pa/ /bdag gi gsang sngags btang mi bya/ gti mug blos ni mi smad cing*| |sgrim pa glod par mi bya'o/ /yid ni gzhan du ma gyur dang*/ /bsam pa mang po ma yin dang*/ /mi gtsang chags pa'i sems med par/ /bzlos pa pos ni gsang sngags gton/ /gdon gyi las rnams mi bya zhing*/ /bsrung dang bzlog par mi bya'o/ rang gi sngags sam gzhan gyis kyang*/ / bzlos pas dug gi las mi bya/ /sgrub la dgos pa ma gtogs par/ /gsang sngags gzhan du bcad mi bya| |'gran pa dang ni sad phyir yang*/ bdag gis gsang sngags mi sbyar ro| |zhes sogs gsungs pa rnams bya rgyud kyi dam tshig sum cu po yin nam gzhan yin brtag par bya'o/ /zhes gsung mod kyi 'di dag re re nas bgrangs na sum bcu las mang la/ rigs bsdud pa sogs kyi sgo nas 'grel pa'ang dka' bar 'dug pas/ jo bos gzigs pa'i rgyud sde gzhan zhig na bzhugs par gsal lo/ /'on kyang bya rgyud kyi'ang rtsa ba'i dam tshig ni skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang*/ mi dge ba bcu spong yin la/ legs grub nas bshad pa 'di rnams yan lag gi dam tshig yin zhing*/ de'ang 'gro 'chag za nyal gyi rnal 'byor sogs phal cher ni/ sdom pa gsum ldan 'dul ba'i bcas mtshams las mi 'da' ba rnams la 'dir bshad rnams gsar du bshad mi dgos kyang*/ gang dag sngags la gus pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas 'dul ba'i bcas pa la dgrar ltas byed pa de dag la rdo rje 'chang gi 'ja' sa 'di bstan par bya'o/ /'di rnams las 'ga' zhig bya rgyud rkyang pa'i dam tshig yin mod kyi/ phal cher ni sngags gong ma rnams kyi'ang bslab bya thun mong ba yin pas rgyas par bris so/ /spyod rgyud kyi dam tshig dang sdom pa ni/ rnam snang mngon byang las| thabs shes khyad par can gyis zin pas mu stegs nyan rang dang khyad zhugs pa'i sgo nas rdo rje 'dzin pa rang byung gis mi dge ba bcu car dang*/

khyim pas rtsa ba bzhi log lta dang lnga/ thun mong du dam pa'i chos spong ba dang*/ byang chub kyi sems gtong ba dang*/ ser sna byed pa dang*/ sems can la gnod pa ste/ rab byung la rtsa ltung bcu bzhi dang khyim pa la dgur gsungs te/ ltung ba de rnams byung na sdom pa nyams shing rtsa ba nas chad par gsungs so/ /'di dag ni spyod pa'i rgyud du gsal kha gtod nas rtsa ltung du gsungs mod kyi/ sngags gong ma rnams su 'di dag la rtsa ltung gi ming ma btags kyang srog dang brdos nas bsrung dgos par ni khyad par med do/ /gdug pa can 'dul ba sogs kyi tshe srog gcod pa sogs gnang ba ltar bshad pa yang*/ gzhan la de dang der 'gyur ba'i gzhi de khyad par gyi gang zag la gnang ba yin gyi/ mi dge ba yin na ni ma gnang ba kho na ste/ mi dge ba lhag par spyad pas sangs rgyas myur du 'grub bo zhes smra ba ni 'jig rten rgyang 'phen gyi grub pa'i mtha' las tha chad pa yin no| |rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dam tshig dang sdom pa ni/ bshad rgyud rdo rje rtse mo las| sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*/ /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig brtan par gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*/ /blo chen gyis ni bzung bar gyis/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu zhes su bshad/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po la/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum| |dam chos khyod kyis bzung bar bya/ /'di ni padma'i rigs dag pa'i| |dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la| |sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/

/yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyis| |mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bya/ /de las gzhan pa bcu bzhi ni/ / phas pham par ni rab tu bshad/ /spang zhing dor bar mi bya ste/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba zhes bshad do/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum ni/ /nyin re bzhin ni bzla bar bya| |gang tshe nyams gyur rnal 'byor pa/ kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur/ khyod kyis srog chags bsad mi bya/ /ma byin par yang mi blang ngo*/ /'dod pas log par mi spyad cing*/ /rdzun du smra bar mi bya'o/ /phung khrol kun gyi rtsa ba yi/ /chang ni rnam par spang bar bya/ /sems can gdul phyir ma gtogs pa/ /bya ba ma yin thams cad spang*/ /dam pa nye bar bsten bya zhing*/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams bsnyen bkur bya| |lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang*/ /ngag gi rnam pa bzhi rnams dang*/ /yid kyi rnam pa gsum dag ni/ /ci nus par ni rjes su skyongs/ /theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya/ /sems can don la rgyab phyogs min/ 'khor ba dag kyang spang mi bya/ /rtag tu mya ngan 'das mi chags/ /lha dang lha min gsang ba pa/ /khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya zhing*/ /phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang*/ /mtshan ma 'gom par mi bya'o/ /ces gsung pa'i don la/ yo ga ba snga ma kha cig de las gzhan pa zhes pa'i tshig la rten nas/ rigs lnga'i dam tshig de las gzhan pa srog chags gsod pa nas chang gi bar las log pa lnga/ bya ba ma yin spong ba/ dam pa bsten cing rnal 'byor pa bsnyen bkur ba/ dge ba bcu spyod pa/ theg dman mi 'dod pa sogs bzhi/ lha sogs la mi brnyas pa/ mtshan ma mi 'gom pa ste bcu bzhi la phas pham mam rtsa ltung du 'dod pa la/

phyis kyi mkhas pa dag de ni mi 'thad de/ de nyid snang chen las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi tshul khrims ni/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa| |zhes bya ba la sogs pa pham pa bcu bzhi las ldog pa'i mtshan nyid can no zhes dang*/ dpal mchog las/ rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya rnams/ /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /zhes pa'i 'grel par phyag rgya la sogs pa 'di dag gis ci zhig bya zhes pas/ 'di yongs su spangs na pham par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pas/ rigs lnga'i sdom pa'i rigs dang po la dkon mchog gsum/ gnyis pa la/ rdor dril slob dpon gsum/ gsum pa la sbyin pa bzhi bzhi pa la chos gsum/ lnga pa la mchod pa gcig pu ste bcu bzhi po de las nyams pa bcu bzhi rtsa ltung du slob dpon kun snying bzhed pa 'dra zhes gsung pa la| mkhas pa gzhan dag na re/ lung de dag gis rigs lnga'i sdom pa'i dngos kyi log phyogs rtsa ltung du mi 'grub la/ grub na'ang lung snga mas dngos su bstan pa'i sems bskyed kyi log phyogs dang*/ phyi mas dngos su bstan pa'i phyag rgya spangs pa rtsa ltung du mi 'dod pa la gnod pas mi rigs shing*/ der ma zad| dpal rtse sogs yo ga nas 'byung ba'i dam tshig sgrag pa rnams bla med kyi dkyil chog du lung mar drangs pa'i phyir dang*/ sangs rgyas gsang bas/ rgyud gzhan nas 'byung ba'i dam tshig rnams kyang dpal rtse'i dam tshig tu 'dus par bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ dpal mchog 'grel par/ chos spong dang*/ dam tshig gsum spong ba rtsa ltung du gsungs pas byang chub kyi sems btang ba dang phung po gzir ba dang bla ma la brnyas pa yang rtsa ltung du 'grub pa'i phyir dang*/ dza landha ra'i rdo rje slob dpon kā ma dhe nus/ bud med la smod pa rtsa ltung bcu bzhi pa yin par dngos su bshad pas gzhan rnams kyang mtshon par nus pa'i phyir/ yo ga la yang*/ rtsa ltung gi ming 'dogs dang spyi'i ngo bo/

bla med kyi rtsa ltung bcu bzhi pa ji bzhin du byed dgos te/ de lta min par yo ga la bla med dang gtan mi gcig pa'i rtsa ltung gi rnam gzhag zhig yod na/ yo ga la mkhas pa'i slob dpon gsum la sogs pas tha na ming 'dogs tsam zhig gsungs rigs pa'i phyir ro| |zhes gsungs so/ /'di la'ang rtog dpyod zhib tu byas na/ rgyud gnyis kyi rtsa ltung gi rnam gzhag thun mong ba yin/ rgyu mtshan de nyid kyis rgyud sde kun gyi dam tshig dang sdom pa 'dus pa'i dpal rtse nas bla med bzhin gyi ming 'dogs zur tsam zhig 'byung bar rigs la/ thun mong ba yin pas mi dgos na/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung la sgrag bzung gnyis kyi sgo nas de tsam gyi rnam gzhag zhib mo yang mi dgos par 'gyur zhing chos spong dang rdor dril phyag rgya'i dam tshig gsum spong ba dngos su rtsa ltung du bshad pa nyid kyis/ rigs lnga'i sdom pa'i bzlog phyogs rtsa ltung du 'grub kyi/ bla med kyi bcu bzhi mi 'grub ste/ 'grub na rdor dril dang spangs pa zur du bgrang dgos pas bcu bzhi las mang bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /des na yo ga'i rtsa ltung gi ngos 'dzin ni/ lugs bar ma ltar yin la| 'on kyang grangs kyi rts-i tshul rigs thun mong du sems bskyed/ rigs dang po la dkon mchog /gnyis pa la rdor dril dang phyag rgya slob dpon ste bzhi| gsum pa la/ sbyin pa bzhi/ bzhi pa lnga pa snga ma bzhin bgrangs na legs par go ste/ de las gzhan pa zhes pa yang*/ gzhan dag gi ldog phyogs sems bskyed stong pa sogs bcu bzhi zhes pa yin nam snyam mo/ /de ltar na rgyud gnyis kyi rtsa ltung gi grangs mtshungs kyang ming 'dogs ni tha dad la/ phan tshun ci rigs par rigs mtshungs bsdu bya bsdu byed kyi sgo nas dod thub tu 'gyur bas/ 'di'i phyag rgya spong ba dang*/ bla med kyi bud med la smod pa don gcig tu bzhed pa lta bu yin no zhes rtogs par bya'o/

/de ltar na yo ga'i lugs kyi rigs lnga'i sdom pa ni rtsa ba'i dam tshig dang*/ srog chags bsad par mi bya ba man chod la bsrung bya dang bsten byar dbye nas yan lag gi dam tshig tu shes par bya'o/ /rnal 'byor bla med la yang bsrung bya'i gtso bo ni rigs lnga'i dam tshig nyid yin la| de yang rdo rje'i rigs la slob dpon bzung tshul/ rgyud sde 'og ma dang mi 'dra bar rdo rje 'chang dang tha mi thad par bzung dgos shing*/ de ltar bzung na zab lam tshe gcig la 'grub pa'i phan yon dang*/ ma bzung bar brnyas na rdo rje dmyal bar ltung ba'i nyes dmigs sogs yod pas de nyid dam tshig rnams kyi gtso bor bstan pa'i ched du/ de la dmod pa rtsa ltung dang por gsungs pa dang*/ chos rnams kyi tshig don legs par bzung ba'i steng du/ de rnams nas gsungs pa'i nyams len rnams kyang ji lta ba bzhin theg pa mchog dman gyi gsung rab mtha' dag 'gal med du nyams su len dgos la/ de las 'das na rtsa ltung gnyis par 'gyur ba sogs dang*/ slob dpon bzung ba'i shugs bstan nam zhar la mched grogs la'ang gus par bcas pa lta bu rigs lnga'i dam tshig la dgag bya dang dgos pa che chung gi dbang gis dngos shugs la bstan pa rnams 'ga' zhig rtsa ltung du ma bcas la/ la la la phye nas kyang bcas pa sogs su shes par bya'o/ /de ltar bla med kyi rtsa ltung bcu bzhi'i ming dang grangs tshang ba ni/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi le'u bcu gnyis pa dang*/ gshed dmar dang dgra nag gi rgyud las gsungs la/ gur gyi le'u bco lnga pa nas rtsa ltung bcu dngos su gsungs shing*/ rgyud sde gzhan rnams las kyang ming dang grangs ma tshang yang*/ ci rigs pa gsungs pa rnams slob dpon bha wa lhas mdzad pa'i rtsa ltung bcu bzhi par grags pa'i gzhung las rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig rnams gsal bar gsungs shing*/ de rnams kyi don mkhas pa mang pos gtan la phab pa dang*/

rang gis kyang zur du 'chad pa las rtogs par bya'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ bla med gzhan rnams dang rgyud 'di pa'i rigs lnga'i sdom bzung dang rtsa ltung bcu bzhi'i ming 'dogs 'dra bar 'byung mod kyi don mi 'dra ba yod de/ 'di pa'i rigs lnga'i dam tshig la yang*/ rdo rje'i rigs la rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya slob dpon bzung ba rnams gzhan dang 'dra zhing*/ rin po che'i rigs la sbyin pa gtong ba sogs 'dra yang*/ sbyin pa bzhi'i tha snyad mi byed par/ rin chen lcags zangs ba lang rta/ /glang chen bu mo nor 'dzin dang*/ /'dod pa'i chung ma rang gi sha /sbyin pa rnam pa bcu ru 'dod/ /ces sbyin pa bcu yid bzhin gyi nor bu bsgrubs nas ster ba dang*/ 'khor lo'i rigs la dkon mchog gsum bzung ba ma bshad par/ sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa'i drang nges kyi dam tshig bsten pa dang*/ ral gri'i rigs la mchod pa byed pa gzhan dang 'dra zhing*/ padma la 'dzag med kyi tshangs spyod bsten pa dang*/ gzhan la med pa'i rigs drug pa rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rigs la stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par gsungs so/ /rtsa ltung bcu bzhi'i yang*/ bla ma'i bka' las 'das pa la gnyis pa dang*/ kunda byang chub kyi sems dbang po gnyis bde la chags pa kho na'i sems kyis phyi rol du gtong ba la lnga par bshad pas gzhan dang khyad par che zhing gzhan rnams la'ang nang gses kyi yan lag mi 'dra ba cung zad 'grel chen nas kyang gsungs la/ da ri ka pas ni/ bla med gzhan gyi slob dpon rnams dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par mang po bshad de/ rgyas par gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /bla med gzhan nas gsungs pa'i| khyod kyis srog chags bsad par bya/ /zhes sogs kyi dam tshig rnams la| 'dir yang*/ nges par rdo rje'i rigs dag la ni srog gcod bya ste zhes sogs gsungs pa rnams la/ drang don dang nges don gyi dam tshig drug gam bdun gyi rnam gzhag byas te shes dgos pa ni rgyas par dkyil chog tu bris zin cing*|

'di pa rang gi dgos kyi chos skad kyis gsungs pa'i dam tshig srog gcod sogs bzhi dang chang 'thung ba ste sdig pa lnga dang cho lo rtse ba dang*/ phyugs kyi mchod sbyin gyi don nam/ rang don du bsngos nas bsad pa'i sha lta bu kha na ma tho ba'i zas za ba dang*/ tshig ngan mu stegs kyi bstan bcos lta bu klog pa dang*/ mtho ris kyi don du phyugs kyi mchod sbyin byed pa lta bu 'byung po'i chos dang*/ ma bag mar gtong ba sogs lha min kla klo'i chos te nye ba'i sdig pa lnga dang*/ ba lang byis pa bud med skyes pa rnams gsod pa dang*/ lha mi'i bla ma gsod pa ste/ sku gzugs sam mchod rten bshig pa ste gsod pa lnga dang*/ grogs po dang*/ rje bo dang*/ sangs rgyas dang*/ dge 'dun dang yid brtan la 'khu ba ste/ 'khu ba lnga dang*/ gzugs sogs yul lnga la dbang po chags pa ste chags pa lnga rnams spong ba dang*/ brtul zhugs nyi shu rtsa lnga zhes gsungs pa rnams kyang*/ rgyud tshig 'tshe dang mi bden gzhan gyi bud med zhes sogs kyis gsungs te dkyil chog gi 'jug pa'i skabs su bris pa ltar ro/ de ltar na spyi dgos kyi rdo rje theg pa la zhugs shing mos pa rnams kyis/ dang po kho nar thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la gces spras su bya ba'i phyir| de dag gi bcas mtshams shes pa la brtson par bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ gang zhig sngags kyi lag len zhes grags pa/ /gar sogs spros pa'i cho ga kun shes shing*/ /rim gnyis zab mo'i lam la'ang brtson pa can/ /gzhan yang sngags la nan gyis 'jug byed pa/ /de dag gis kyang rdo rje theg pa yi/ /lam gyi rtsa ba gang yin ma btsal na/ /rtsa ba rul ba'i shing sdong ji bzhin du/ /re zhig gzhan ngor mdzes mdzes ltar snang yang*/ /nyam nga'i thang du 'gyel bar gdon mi za/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bskyed rim gyi bshad pa pas/ lam gyi 'jug sgo dang rtsa ba bstan pa ste le'u gsum pa'o//

// gsum pa sdom pa dag pas lam nyams su len tshul la/ dang por thos bsam gyis shes par byed dgos tshul dang*/ shes nas sgom byung gis nyams su blang tshul lo/ /dang po la/ thos bsam gyis gtan la dbab dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ gtan la dbab bya'i lam ngos bzung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug la ltos pa'i bya ba gang byed kyang*| bya rgyu de'i ngo bo/ rgyu 'bras/ phan yon dang*/ nyes dmigs/ de la gzhan gyi log rtog sel tshul/ mthun rkyen sgrub tshul/ 'gal rkyen sel tshul la sogs pa nang chan chud pa gcig mi shes na/ bya ba de sgrub pa'i ched du rtsol ba byas kyang mthar phyin par mi 'gyur la/ khyad par gsung rab kyi don zab mo nyams su len par 'dod pas ni thog mar thos bsam gyis 'bad par bya ba yin te/ chos mngon pa'i mdzod las/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas/ /sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /zhes dang*/ bslab btus las/ bzod bya thos pa btsal bar bya/ /de nas nags su 'gro bar bya/ /zhes sogs dang*/ mdo sde rgyan las| 'di na dang po thos la rten nas yid la byed pa 'byung*/ /tshul bzhin yid la byed las yang dag don yul ye shes 'byung*/ /de las chos 'thob de yod de las blo gros rab tu skye/ /zhes sogs dang*/ ma thos par sgoms pas chog na lung gi bstan pa don med du 'gyur zhing*/ bsgom mi dgos par thos pa tsam gyis chog na/ sgoms nas skye ba'i rtogs pa don med du 'gyur bar yang de las/ gal te ma thos par yang sgom 'jug 'gyur na bstan pa don med 'gyur/ /gal te thos pa tsam gyis don mthong 'gyur na sgom pa don med 'gyur/ /zhes sogs dang*| de bzhin du mdo dang bstan bcos mang po zhig nas rgyas par gsungs so/ /mdo dang bstan bcos las de ltar gsungs pa yang yod mod kyi/ tshe 'di yun thung shes bya'i rnam pa mang*/ /tshe yi tshad kyang ji tsam mi shes pas| |ngang pas chu las 'o ma len par ltar/

/rang gi 'dod pa dang du len par gyis/ /zhes sogs dang*/ ched du brjod pa'i tshoms las/ smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa mang po la sogs pa gsungs shing*/ khyad par sngags kyi tshul la ni| bla ma'i zhal nas 'byung ba'i man ngag tshig nyung ngus bstan pa nyid nyams su blang bar bya zhing*/ de nyid yi ger bris pa'i glegs bam chung ngu re tsam lta ba dang nyan na rung gi thos pa mang po tshol bar ma bshad do zhe na/ 'di ni rgyal ba'i lung gi bstan pa mtha' dag la skur pa 'debs shing*/ khyad par rdo rje 'chang gis/ rgyud sde rim pa mang po dang*/ rgyud sde re re la yang man ngag zab mo rnams gsal bar ma bstan par sbas pa'i rtsa rgyud dang*/ de'i don gtan la 'bebs pa'i bshad rgyud du ma zhig gsungs shing*/ de dag kyang gsal bar byed pa'i sa bcu'i byang sems dang*/ klu sgrub yab sras sogs kyi bstan bcos chen po ji snyed mdzad pa mtha' dag tshig don rnams nub par byed 'dod pa'i 'dud rigs nag phyogs la dga' bas rgyud zil gyis gnan pa'i tshig yin te/ rgyud dang*/ mkhas pa'i gzhung du ma las/ dang por thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs gcod dgos par lan gcig ma yin par gsungs pa'i phyir ro| |ji skad du/ mnyam sbyor gyi rgyud las/ gsang ba'i de nyid mi shes pas| |sgrubs kyang ci yang mi 'grub bo/ /zhes dang rgyan bdun dgrol ba las| dang por nyan pa'i shes rab kyis/ /tshig gi rgyud la thos pa bskyed/ /de nas bsam pa'i shes rab kyis/ /tshig dang don du 'grel ba bslab/ /ces dang*/ gsang 'dus rim lnga las/ gang zhig bla ma la gus dad dang ldan/ /mos pas bsnyen bkur la ni rtag tu brtson/ /thos pa 'dzin gang slob ma dam pa yin/ /zhes sogs dang*/ de'i 'grel par/ thos pa rdzogs par byed pa shes rab te/ /bsam pa dang ni gnyis po yod gyur na/ sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor ba yin/ /de las dngos grub bla na med pa'o/ /blo dang ldan pas 'di ltar bsams nas ni/

/thog mar thos pa'i don la 'bad pa yis/ /rtag tu brtson bar byed pa gang yin pa/ /de yi lag tu dngos grub legs par thob// gang zhig tshig la the tshom za gyur pa/ /de yis don ni ji ltar rtogs par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ kyaie rdor dka' 'grel mi thub zla bas mdzad pa las/ blo gros med la thos med ma thos pa la'ang bsam pa med/ /gnyis bral rnal 'byor med cing rnal 'byor bral la dngos grub med/ /ces sogs mang du gsungs so/ /de yang rgyud sde gzhan la ni/ rtsa rgyud du sbas pa de nyid bshad rgyud la rten nas 'grel shes pa'i bla ma dam pa'i zhal las rtogs dgos par bshad de/ dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa'i rim lnga las/ dpal ldan 'dus pa'i rgyud du ni/ /de nyid 'di dag rgyas btab nas/ bshad pa'i rgyud kyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /bla ma'i kha las rtogs par bya/ /zhes gsungs ba'i phyir/ rgyud gzhan rnams su zab lam sbed pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 'grel chen dri med 'od las/ 'phags pa'i yul 'dir ma 'ongs pa'i dus nas rdo rje slob dpon rdzas la brkam pa dag 'byung bar 'gyur te/ phyug po rdzas kyis mngon par khengs pa rnams kyi khyim du song nas rdzas kyi don du chos 'tshong bar byed par 'gyur ba dang*/ rdzas la chags pas skal ba dang mi ldan pa rnams la 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang ster bar 'gyur ba dang*/ dang po rgyal po la sogs pa'i mngag gzhug pa phyis nas bla mar 'gyur ba dang*/ mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam yongs su btang zhing sems can skal ba dang ldan par gyur pa gzhan rdzas kyis dman pa rnams la 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang mi ster bar 'gyur ba dang de dag rnams la nyon mongs pa skye bar 'gyur ba dang*/ rdzas kyi dbang gis gdug pa'i sems can rnams la rdo rje'i tshig rab tu gsal bar byed par 'gyur ba dang*/ gzhan yang rdo rje'i tshig mi shes pa phan tshun rtsod par 'gyur ba dang*/ mkhas pa'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyis rgyud kyi don mi shes pa rnams kyang rgyud kyi 'grel bshad byed par 'gyur ba dang*/

bdud kyi ris rnams sems can rnams kyi bla mar gyur nas rdo rje'i tshig phyin ci log tu ston par 'gyur ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dbang po gnyis las skyes pa'i bde bar byis pa'i blo can rnams la ston par 'gyur ba dang*/ gsum pa shes rab ye shes de nyid| bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no/ /zhes pa'i sgra rgyu dang 'bras bu dbye ba med pas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so zhes gsum pa'i ye shes su smra bar 'gyur ba dang*/ 'phags pa'i yul gang du mkhas pa'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyis glegs bam mthong nas dbang bskur med par rdo rje theg pa ston pa po byed par 'gyur ba de'i phyir/ de ltar ma 'ongs pa'i dus kyi gdug pa'i slob dpon rnams kyi 'jug pa gzigs nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyud dang rgyud gzhan thams cad du/ bzhi pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gsal por ma mdzad de/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dang bsdus pa'i rgyud rnams su bzhi pa shes rab ye shes dang*/ phyag rgya chen po sgom pa du ba la sogs pa'i lam shin tu sbas shing*/ rtsa ba'i rgyud 'ga' zhig la rab tu gsal lo/

/rtsa ba'i rgyud mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas 'di dang bsdus pa'i rgyud la yang*/ bzhi pa shes rab ye shes rab tu gsal zhing phyag rgya chen po sgom pa du ba la sogs pa'i lam rab tu gsal ba brgyud pa'i rim pas ma 'ongs pa ste/ dper na sngags kyi lha dang phyi rol gyi dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs dang*/ dpa' bo'i rim pa dang rang byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa yang bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pas 'ongs ba ma yin pa bzhin no| |zhes sogs gsungs pa rnams kyis gsal bar bstan to/ /'dir bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pas ma 'ongs pa zhes pa ni/ rgyud bla med pa/ bla ma kho na'i zhal las shes mi dgos ces pa'i don yin gyi/ bla ma la mi ltos par byas na bshad ma thag pa'i 'grel tshig dang 'gal zhing*/ mdor bsdus dang por/ gang zhig sems can rnams la brtse ba yis/ /gzhan don dge la rtag tu brtson pa yis/ /slob ma dag pa rnams la lam dag ni/ /bla ma dam pa'i drin las 'byung ba yin/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa dang 'gal bar 'gyur ro/ /des na rgyud 'di ni bshad rgyud la mi ltos par rtsa rgyud nyid las shin tu gsal bar ston pas kyang rgyud sde gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ ye shes le'u'i rgyud kyi 'jug tu/ rgyud kyi rgyal po thams cad dag tu nges par rdo rje'i tshig ni rdo rje can gyis sbas pa ste/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas su ni srog chags rnams kyi thar pa'i slad du ma lus par yang mngon sum gsungs/ /de phyir 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa dag las mtha' dag ma tshang med pa'i rgyud kyi bla ma ste/ /dpal ldan rgyud ni dang po'i sangs rgyas mtha' dag rgyal ba'i bdag po mngon par brjod pa zla ba bzang*/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na 'dir yang*/ bla ma dam pa la bsten nas rgyud dang sems 'grel gyi don la mkhas par byas te| yid ches gsum dang ldan pa'i sgo nas nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /'jug sgo'i dbang ma thob cing dam tshig ma bsrungs par/

rgyud don cha shas tsam yang mi shes pa'i bla ma zhig la bsten nas/ 'khrid tshul ngo sprod phyin ci log tu ston pa'i man ngag gi dpe chung gis chog par bzung te/ mig dang lus la mu stegs gcer bu'i lugs ltar sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig bskyed pas ni mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub 'grub par dka'o/ /gnyis pa la/ rim gnyis spyi'i rnam gzhag dang*/ so so'i rang bzhin bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ mi 'thad pa'i cha dgag pa dang*/ 'thad pa'i phyogs bshad pa gnyis| dang po la/ sgom tshul la log par rtog pa dang*/ rang bzhin la log par rtog pa dgag pa'o/ /dang po la/ bskyed rim rkyang pa bsgom byar 'dod pa dgag pa dang*/ rdzogs rim rkyang pa bsgom byar 'dod pa dgag pa'o/ / dang po ni/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pa'i snying po rgyan las phyogs sngar bkod pa'i drang srong chen po bi shwa mi tra dang*/ rigs sngags 'chang gi slob dpon gzhon nu'i sde la sogs pa rnams ni/ theg chen gyi sgrub bya gzhan don yin la/ gzhan don yang gzugs skus byed pas gzugs sku'i rgyu bskyed rim nyid bsgoms par bya ba yin gyi/ rdzogs rim 'od gsal sogs pa dang*/ stong nyid kyi lta ba sogs ni rnam rtog gi lta ba ngan pa bzlog pa'i ched tsam yin la/ de ni rang bzhin shes pa tsam gyis bzlog pas goms par byed mi dgos zhes so zer la/ da ltar yang lha'i nga rgyal la mngon par zhen pa dag 'di dang rjes su mthun par smra'o/ /de ni 'thad pa min te/ spyir 'khor ba'i rtsa ba bden 'dzin lhan skyes ma spangs na/ thar pa tsam yang 'thob mi nus na| sangs rgyas kyi gzugs sku lta ci smos la/ bdag 'dzin de yang 'dzin stangs dngos su mi mthun pa'i shes rab kyis spong dgos kyi lam gzhan bskal pa'i bar du goms par byas kyang spong mi nus par sgrub pa la rigs pa'i dpung tshogs mtha' yas pa yod cing*/ shes rab de yang goms rkyen dang ma bral bar yun ring du goms nas gsal snang rab kyi mthar thug pa dgos kyi yin lugs mthong ba tsam gyis grol na/

rten 'brel gyi rtags la brten pa'i rigs shes rjes dpag skyes ma thag tu 'phags par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang gzugs sku de chos sku ma thob par mi 'thob la/ chos sku sems kyi yon tan mthar thug pa de ma bsgoms par 'grub na/ gzugs sku rnam smin gyi yon tan de 'grub phyir du lha'i rnal 'byor la de tsam gyi rtsol ba byed mi rigs shing*/ khyad par sngags kyi tshul la'ang rdzogs rim dang bral ba'i bskyed rim rkyang pa ji tsam bsgoms kyang 'phags pa'i spangs rtogs tsam yang thob par mi nus na/ sangs rgyas kyi gzugs sku ga la 'thob/ des na grub mtha' 'di ni sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo ye shes kyi tshogs la skur pa 'debs pa'i lta ba ngan par gzigs nas 'di la mchog tu 'dzin pa dgag pa'i phyir du rgyud sde rnams dang*/ khyad par dus kyi 'khor lo'i skor rnams su las bskyed rim gyis mchog sgrub pa la mi phan pa lta bur gsungs so/ /de ltar gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ ye shes kyi tshogs ni/ sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo yin cing*/ de bsgoms pas bsod nams kyi tshogs kyang gzhan las lhag pa 'grub par/ rgyal ba'i yum las/ dzambu'i gling na sems can ji snyed ma lus pa/ /de dag byang chub mchog tu sems skyed nas/ /lo stong bye ba mang por sbyin pa byin byas shing*| |kun kyang 'gro ba'i don du byang chub rgyur bsngo yang*/ /gang zhig shes rab pha rol phyin la mngon brtson pa/ /tha na nyi ma gcig gcig rjes su mthun byed na/ /sbyin pa'i phung po de la bsod nams char mi phod/ /de phyir rtag tu g.yel med shes rab 'jug par bya/ /zhes sogs mang du gsungs shing*/ mdo gzhan dang dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos dang*/ rgyud dang rgya gzhung mtha' dag las stong nyid yul du byed pa'i lam kho na la bsngags pa mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la spyir dgag pa dang*/

bye brag tu lugs de dus 'khor gyi dgongs par 'dod pa dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ yang snying po rgyan las/ bram ze stong nyid blo dang*/ kha che'i mkhan po rab snang byed dang*/ ā nanta badzra dang*/ dge bsnyen sitti ka da dang mkhas pa chen po dpal gyi seng ge la sogs pa rnams ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni gnyis su med pa'i ye shes nyid yin la/ de mi mthun pa'i rgyu las mi 'byung bas/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i stong nyid rtogs pa'i lam kho na bsgom bya yin la/ bskyed rim la sogs pa thabs kyi cha rnams gsungs pa ni/ gdul bya stong nyid la skrag pa rnams drang ba'i phyir du dgongs pa las 'bras la skur pa 'debs pa'i chad lta dgag pa dang*/ dgos su bskyed rim gyi dgos pa ni| bzlas sgom la sogs pa'i rten 'brel gyis 'bras bu zhi sogs kyi rten 'brel sgrub pa'i phyir yin no zhes smra ba'i phyogs snga bkod pa rnams ni 'phags yul du byung ba yin la/ rgya nag gi mkhan po hwa shang gis thog drangs nas bod gangs can gyi khrod du yang lugs 'di nyid kyis rang gzhan slus pa mang du byung zhing*/ deng sang yang 'di la mchog tu 'dzin pa mang ngo*/ /'on kyang hwa shang de'i rjes 'brang da lta yang ming gzhan btags nas yod pa rnams kyis ni| stong nyid lta ba yang rgya gar ba de rnams mi 'dod pa'i cang med la dmigs pa'i yid la mi byed pa nyid sangs rgyas kyi rgyur smra ba ni khyad par ro/ /'di rnams kyi 'khrul gzhi rigs pa ltar snang ni sngar bshad pa de nyid dang*/ gzhan yang khyi dkar nag gis rmug pa dang sprin dkar nag gis sgrib pa khyad par med pa sogs yod la/ lung gi 'khrul gzhi/ hwa shang gis mdo sde brgyad cu khungs drangs pa rnams dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi mtshams mthon po'i skabs rnams ston par byed pa'i rgyud do ha skaur la sogs pa'i rgya gzhung rnams te/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i lnga bcu pa las/

gang yang sgra shes bstan bcos rnams/ /drang srong rnams kyis byas pa ltar/ /rang gi sems ni 'jug byed pa'i/ /skyes bu bcos ma'i bya ba rnams/ /rgyud kyi rjes su 'brangs nas ni/ /'bad pas sdug bsngal slong bar byed/ /de phyir dkyil 'khor la sogs pa/ /bya ba'i cho ga la 'bad pa| |thar pa dang bral phyi rol te/ /skyes bu nyon mongs 'ba' zhig byed| |ces dang*/ saṃ bu ṭi'i brtag pa gnyis pa'i rab byed bzhi pa las/ thun mong dngos grub skyes pa yi/ /sgom pa dang ni dam tshig dang*/ /sku gzugs dang ni nga rgyal dang*/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas ci zhig bya/ /rang 'dod lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyi mthar thug pa/ mtshon bya'i mtshan nyid mngon byas nas| |sa gsum nam mkha' lta bur 'gyur/ zhes sogs gsungs pa rnams so/ /gzhan yang rigs pa ltar snang*/ 'di ltar/ rtog pa yin na/ rgyud 'khrug byed yin pas rnam g.yeng gi rang bzhin yin te/ 'khrul shes yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ des na bskyed rim mtha' dag ni rtog pa'i sgom pa yin pas 'khrul shes dang*/ der ma zad de ma yin la der 'dzin pa log shes yin cing*| de bsgoms pas ting nge 'dzin tsam yang mi skye na/ sangs rgyas kyi lam du ga la 'gyur zhes sogs smra'o/ /de dag ni rigs pa ma yin te/ 'di ltar| sangs rgyas pa'i ye shes de rtog med yin pas de'i rgyur rtog med kho na dgos na/ so skye mtha' dag la mi rtog ye shes thog ma med pa nas rang grub tu yod dgos par 'gyur zhing*/ tshogs sbyor mtha' dag dang mthong sgom gyi rjes thob rnas kyang rtog med yin pa'am yang na sangs rgyas kyi lam ma yin par 'gyur zhing*/ so skye'i rgyud la lta ba rnam dag skye ba'i thog ma rigs shes rjes dpag sogs kyang bsgom bya min par 'gyur te/ rtog pa yin pa'i phyir ro// mdor na sems bskyed dang snying rje dang dad pa la sogs pa thabs kyis bsdus pa mtha' dag 'dor na/

sangs rgyas kyi sku gnyis po tshogs gnyis so so'i lag rjes su mdo rgyud bstan bcos kun las gsungs pa dang*/ khyad par khyed rang yang rgyab brten mthar thug tu byed pa'i theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma las/ rgyal po'i gzugs 'dri ba'i ri mo mkhan dper byas nas/ sangs rgyas pa'i rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes de/ sbyin sogs phar phyin mtha' dag gis sgrub dgos par/ 'dir rnams 'bri byed gang dag yin/ sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod la sogs/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /stong pa nyid ni gzugs su brjod/ /zhes sogs kyis gsungs shing*/ stong nyid kyi ye shes kho na la bsngags pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo bstan bcos kun las kyang*/thabs dang bral ba'i shes rab rkyang pas ni rkyen dang bral ba'i sa bon bzhin du rab kyi mthar phyin par mi 'gyur ba dang*/ rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum sogs thabs kyi cha dor nas bsgoms te yang dag mtha' mngon du byas na chad pa'i mthar ltung bas thabs shes phan tshul grogs su nges par dgos pa'i tshul mang du gsungs pa rnams rang lta mchog 'dzin gyi rab rib 'thug po cung zad phyis nas bltas na khong du chud par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du dus kyi 'khor lo'i cha lag 'jam dpal gyi rang gi lta ba'i 'dod pa mdor bstan pa las/thabs dang bral ba'i stong nyid rkyang pa dgag pa'i phyir du/ phung po rnam bcad stong pa nyid*/ /chu shing bzhin du snying po med/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i| |stong nyid de ltar 'gyur ma yin/ zhes sogs gsungs so/ /gzhan yang*/ rtog pa sgoms pas rtog bral du 'gro mi srid na/ bsgom bya'i don la gsal snang yang 'byung mi srid dgos te/ rigs pa'i dbang phyug gis/ rnam par rtog dang rjes 'brel ni/ /don gsal snang ba can ma yin/ zhes gsung pa'i phyir ro/ /de 'dod na ni/ mi gtsang zad par sa la sogs/ /yang dag min pa'ang sgoms pa yis/

/stobs kyis sprul pas rtog med dang*/ /gsal bar snang ba can du mthong*/ /zhes/ mi sdug pa bsgoms nas sa phyogs keng rus sogs su dang*/ /'dod 'jigs mya ngan gyis brlam dang*/ /rkun po rmi sogs kyis bslad pas/ /yang dag min pa'ang rtag tu ni/ /mdun na gnas pa bzhin du mthong*/ /zhes chags can la chags yul dngos su med kyang mdun na gnas pa bzhin du goms pa'i dbang gis mthong bar gsungs shing rigs pas grub pa rnams dang 'gal la/ phyi rol pa dbang shes rtog bcas su 'dod pa'i ngor rtog bral du sgrub byed dang*/ rnal 'byor mngon sum med par 'dod pa'i ngor de sgrub pa'i mthun dpe med par 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir rten 'brel gyi rtags las rang rgyud kyi phung po bden med du rtogs pa'i rjes dpag rtog pa 'di nyid| snying rje la sogasapa 'i goms rkyen dang ma bral bar yun ring du goms par byas na gsal snang rab kyi mthar thug pa 'byung bar bsgrubs pa'i mthar| de phyir yang dag yang dag min/ /gang gang shin tu goms gyur pa| |goms pa yongs su rdzogs pas na/ /de gsal mi rtog blo 'bras can| |zhes rnam 'grel mdzad pas gsungs so/ /de lta mod kyi/ de dag ni rigs pa shes pa dag gi lugs yin pas/ kho bo cag ni/ spyir theg pa gzhan nas bshad pa'i rnam gzhag dang*/ khyad par rigs pa khas mi len no zhe na/ de lta na/ yin min dang blang dor 'byed pa'i thabs mi shes so zhes smra ba yin pas de lta bu dang su zhig rgal lan byed/ 'on kyang rgyud kyi lung yang yod de/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod las/ dngos po gang dang gang gis na/ /mi rnams yid ni yang dag sbyor/ /de ni de yi dngos 'gyur te/ /sna tshogs gzugs can nor bu 'dra/ /zhes dngos po gang la yid shes rtog pa yun ring du sbyar zhing goms par byas na/ de nyid mthar dngos po de'i rang bzhin du 'gyur ba tshon gyis bsgyur ba'i dpes gsungs shing*/

rgyud sde gzhan las kyang mang du bshad pa rnams ltos shig de dag gis ni 'khrul shes yin kyang lam du 'gyur ba dang zad par la sogs pa'i log shes rnams kyang lam du bsgrubs so/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang kha sbyor la sogs pa'i rgyud las/ bskyed rim dang sngags kyi bzlas brjod sogs mi dgos zhes gsungs pa rnams ni/ de rnams sngon du btang ste mthar phyin nas/ rdzogs rim gyi ye shes la rtsal du 'don pa'i tshe mi dgos so zhes pa dang*/ de rnams kyis mchog mi 'grub cing 'bad pa don med pa ltar gsungs pa ni/ rdzogs rim dang*/ lta ba rnam dag gi grogs dang bral ba'i de rnams rkyang pa la dgongs par spyir gsung rab gung bsgrigs na legs par rtogs shing*/ khyad par lung de dag nyid las kyang shes te/ khyed kyis drangs pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i lung de'i snga rol de ma thag na/ rnal ma'i sbyor ba rtogs bya'i phyir/ /bcos ma'i bsgom pa dag dang ni/ bcos ma yi ni bzlas pa bya/ /rnal ma'i sbyor ba rtogs gyur nas/ /bcos ma'i sbyor ba phyi rol bas/ /rnal ma'i sbyor ba rtogs gyur pas/ /bcos ma dag ni mi bya'o| |dper na gzings la 'jus nas ni/ /chu yi pha rol 'gro bar byed/ /pha rol phyin nas 'dor ba ltar/ /bcos ma dag kyang de bzhin no/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs las gang ni/ /bcos ma'i sems kyis gang byed pa/ /phyi rol las rnams gsal byed pas/

/dang po'i las can rnams la bsngags/ /dngos grub de kun 'dir gnas pas/ /rgyal ba'i dngos nyid rigs las min| |zhes sogs so/ /'dis ni khyed cag gi grub mtha' legs par bkag ste/ dngos grub mtha' dag tshogs pas mchog sgrub dgos kyi/ rgyal ba'i dngos po ye shes kyi gnas lugs nyid kho na rigs pa'i lam phyogs re bas 'grub pa min ces so/ /gzhan yang khyed cag chu'i pha rol rgal tshar na ni lam sgrub don med la/ rgal ma tshar ba nas gzings 'dor na ni blun po'i ngang tshul kho nar 'gyur ro/ /gal te las dang po pas de ltar dgos kyang*/ skye ba snga ma mang por bskyed rim sogs la goms pa'i gang zag la tshe 'dir mi dgos so zhe na/ de la ni rdzogs rim kyang cher mi dgos pa yod mod kyi/ des ni bskyed rim sangs rgyas kyi rgyu min par sgrub pa la ci yang mi phan te/ skye ba snga ma la tshogs sbyor mthong sgom sogs sngon du song ba'i gang zag gis tshe 'dir de rnams sgom mi dgos pas tshogs sbyor sogs sangs rgyas kyi lam ma yin par sgrub mi nus pa dang 'dra'o/ /des na 'di lta bu'i log rtog ni shin tu tha chad par gzigs nas/ dbu ma'i gzhung lugs rnams las kyang*/ stong nyid la mngon par zhen na gsor mi rung du gsungs shing*/ rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam gyi go rim las nyams par gzigs nas/ 'phags pa lha'i spyod bsdus sgron mer/ dwogs spyod kyi sgo nas dmigs phug pa'i dgag pa mdzad do/ /kyai'i rdo rje'i rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa las kyang*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor 'di/ /de yi bde ba bde chen brjod/ /rdzogs pa sgom pa med par ni/ /bskyed ba yis kyang ci zhig 'tshal/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' bstsal pa/ /e ma bya chub sems dpa' che/ /dad pa'i shugs kyis rab tu nyams/ /lus kyi dngos med ga la bde| |bde ba smra bar mi nus so/ khyab dang khyab byed tshul gyis ni/

/bde bas 'gro ba khyab pa nyid/ /ji ltar me tog la gnas dri/ /me tog dngos med shes mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin gzugs sogs dngos med par/ /bde ba nyidakyang dmigs mi 'gyur/ /ces rdo rje snying pos las dang po pas rdzogs rim med par bskyed rim sgom pa don med de/ bde chen lhan skyes ni rdzogs rim gyis sgrub dgos pas so/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ khyod rdzogs rim la dad pa'i shugs kyis bskyed rim las nyams te/ de gnyis me tog dang de'i dri bzhin du rten dang brten pa yin te/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas pa'i chos sku dang gzugs sku gnyis rten dang brten par grub la/ de sgrub byed kyi lam gnyis po yang gcig med na gcig shos mi 'grub par gsungs so/ /de ltar rigs pas brtag na ni/ rim gnyis gcig sgom pa'i tshe gcig shos gtso bor mi byed pa ma gtogs sangs rgyas kyi rgyur khyad par med par legs par grub la/ lung tsam la rten na ni| kha sbyor las kyang*/ de ltar rnal 'byor pas bsgoms na/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mnyam par 'gyur/ /zhes sogs dang*/ gur gyi le'u gnyis pa sogs dang*/ lha so so'i sgrub thabs ston pa'i rgyud dang*/ rgya gzhung mtha' dag nas/ lha de nyid bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i sgrub tshub dang*/ bsgrubs pas lha de'i go 'phang mngon du byed par 'gyur ro zhes pa sha stag yod pas log par rtog pa'i gnas med do/ / gnyis pa la/ 'dod pa brjod pa dang*/ de dgag pa'o/ / dang po ni/ dus kyi 'khor lo la sgrub pa snying por byed par rlom pa kha cig na re/ bskyed rim mchog sgrub byed kyi lam ma yin pas dor byar bzhed pa ni| sems 'grel skor gsum dang*/ khyad par dus 'khor 'grel chen gyi dgongs pa yin te/ 'di ltar/ mdor bsdus dang po las/ sna tshogs rnam rtog la sogs lam gyis ni/ /de nyid de bzhin gshegs pas gang gsungs pa| |bcu drug bzhi yi rab tu dbye ba can/
