/des na phyag rgya lnga dang drug pa sogs khros ma khros kyis rgyud tha dad du 'byed pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs dang 'jigs byed/ spyan ras gzigs dang phyag drug pa sogs kyis ma nges pa shin tu che bas blun po la yang dwogs pa'i gnas med do/ /gzhan yang*/ bgegs dang ye shes pa sogs rdo rje shugs kyi rdo rje lcags kyus bkug /ces pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ badzra bhai ra wa ya ā karṣa ya dzaḥ ces pa'i sngags gnyis sbrel bas kyang gcig tu 'grub bo/ /de ltar na bsrung 'khor ni bsrung bzlog khyad par can khro bo'i phrin las gtso bor gyur pa'i phyir/ phyag rgya dang phyag mtshan sbrul rgyan thams cad sngags kyis 'god pa'i rgyas pa 'di gtso bor bya zhing long med pa sogs la/ rdo rje'i rna rgyan la sogs pa'i phyag rgya dang phyag mtshan dang sbrul rgyan dang rdo rje'i tshogs kyis legs par brgyan par gyur/ oṃ hūm̐ kro dhent+ra sogs man chad sbyar ba'ang rung ngo*/ /de la phyag rgya drug ni/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa/ /rna cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med/ /mgul gyi phreng ba rin chen bdag /lag pa rnam par snang mdzad de/ /ske rags la ni don yod gnas/ /zhes dang*/ thal chen rdo rje sems dpar brjod/ /ces sbyar te/ rdo rje snying 'grel du de dag sbyar ba'i tshigs bcad 'byung ba bzhin dkyil chog tu bkod pa ltar ro/ /'khor lo ni/ shi ro ma ṇi zhes pa spyi bo'i nor bu ste/ de yang lag gdub dang rkang gdub gnyis ka gcig tu bgrangs nas rnam snang sa khams dang sbyar bas/ sngar dpral bar 'od dpag med nas gsang bar rdo rje sems kyi bar rigs drug bkod pa'i rim pa dang mthun par gnas so/ /de rjes zla phyed dar dpyangs dang*/ mchod phyir thogs ni spyi bo'i phyag rgya'i 'khor du bshad pas na zur du mi bgrang bas phar phyin drug dag pa'i phyag rgya drug po de'i steng du/ stag lpags/ mgo phreng*|

thod skam/ glang lpags te bzhi po phar phyin gzhan bzhi dag pa ste bsdoms pas phar phyin bcu'i rang bzhin phyag rgya bcur bshad do/ /de yang brtag gnyis su/ bla ma slob dpon 'dod lha la/ /phyag 'tshal don du 'khor lo 'dzin/ /zhes drang don du phyag 'tshal ba'i don du lus kyi drug cha mgo bo bla ma la 'bul ba mtshon zhing nges don du spyi bo'i byams sems la 'dud pas sbyin pa'o| |bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la/ /dmod tshig mi nyan pa yi phyir/ /rna ba dag la rna cha bzang*/ /zhes drang don du 'khor lo 'dzin/ zhes drang don du bla ma la dmod pa'i tshig la rna ba mi gtod pa dang*/ nges don du skye bo ma rungs pa drang zhing rang nyid las mi nyams par byed pas rna cha ni bzod pa'o/ /sngags kyi bzlas pas mgul rgyan nyid/ /ces drang don bzlas brjod dang*/ nges don srog mi shigs pa bsdud pas mgul rgyan ni brtson 'grus so/ /gdub bu srog chags gsod pa spangs| |zhes pa drang don 'tshe ba spang*/ nges don kunda byams sems kyi srog mi gcod pas gdub bu tshul khrims so/ /phyag rgya bsten pa ska rags nyid/ /ces pa drang don du phyag rgya mo bsten/ nges don du bde ba'i rten lte bar mi nyams par byed pas ska rags bsam gtan no/ /chos thams cad la bdag med kyi rgyas gdab par mtshon pas thal chen shes rab bo/ /gzhung gzhan nas mgul rgyan sbyin pa/ ska rags brtson 'grus/ 'khor lo bsam gtan du bshad do/ /stag lpags ni thabs te/ thabs kyis mngon pa'i nga rgyal zad par byed pa'o| |mgo phreng stobs te/ stobs kyi bdud 'joms shing bdud brgya'i phreng ba yin pas so/ /thod pa kha dog lnga'i phreng ba ni smon lam ste/ ye shes lnga mthar phyin pa'i tshe smon lam rdzogs pas so/ /glang lpags ye shes te/ ma rig pa'i glang po bsad pa mtshon pas so/ /de dag la gnas kyi dbye bas stong nyid bcu drug tu bshad pas ni/

rna rgyan la gnyis dang*/ gdub bu la bzhi yod pas/ re re sngar bgrangs pa'i lhag po bzhi dang zla phyed dang tshangs skud bsnan gsungs yang*| gdub bu la lag pa'i bzhi dang rkang pa'i gnyis te drug tu phye nas bgrangs na snga ma rnams la gnas kyi dbye bar 'gro'i/ gzhan du na dar dpyangs kyang yod do/ /'di dag ni haṃ haḥsogs kyi thig le yod pa rnams dang thung ngu rnams g.yon pa'i dang*/ tsheg drag can dang ring po rnams g.yas pa ste/ thig le'i rang bzhin dkar cha g.yon na gnas pa thabs dang*/ tsheg drag gi rang bzhin dmar cha g.yas na gnas pa shes rab yin pas so/ /des na skabs gzhan du yab rnams kyi sa bon thung ngu dang thig le yum gyi ring po dang rnam bcad byed pa sogs kyang de bzhin no/ /'di dag la yang*/ karṇa yor ces sogs rnam dbye bdun pa'i gnyis tshig os kyi rjes te/ karṇa'i srog gi a yig 'di/ dhu ṭa mang po nyid la ni e'o/ os la'ang ngo zhes pas e dang e a yar bsgyur ba'i ya la es kyi o bcug sa rnam bcad dang de rar gyur pa'i rjes yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na 'di dag la yang rna ba g.yon g.yas la zhes sogs kyi bod skad kyang sbyor ba ni rna ba g.yon g.yas la rna ba g.yon g.yas la zhes sogs lan gnyis gnyis brjod pas sngags kyi don mi shes so/ /zhes gsal bar sgrogs pa kho nar zad do/ /sngags kyi don rnams ni mchan du bris pas 'dir mi brjod do/ /phyag mtshan la ni/ gnas kyi sgra gsal bar med pas mtshams sbyar gyi tshig mngon rtogs rgyas par bris pa tsam dgos shing*| de tsam gyis sngags kyi don rnams ni 'grub la/ sa bon ni/ ha dang kṣa/ wa dang ra thig le dang rnam bcad rnams g.yon dang g.yas sam thabs dang shes rab kyi rang bzhin du legs par gnas pas g.yon g.yas kyi sa bon du bkod la| re re yang thabs shes ya mi 'bral ba'i phyir du/ dbyangs a yig thung ngu g.yon dang ring po g.yas la bkod do/

/glang lpags 'dzin pa'i phyag gnyis phyag thams cad kyi ye shes kyi cha yin pas ha dang kṣa gnyis la dbyangs bcu gnyis pos 'khyud par gsungs so/ /klu'i rgyan 'god pa'i tshe rdo rje'i phyag rgya 'cha' bar snga rabs pa 'dod kyang klu'i phyag rgya nyid 'god pa legs so/ /'dir yang lus la rdo rje 'god dgos te/ sngar bkod pa dus 'khor lhan skyes kyi sku yin la/ de yongs su gyur nas rdo rje shugs su gsar du bsgoms pa'i phyir ro| |de ltar snang ba gsal ba'i steng du nga rgyal shin tu brtan pa dgos pas/ oṃ hūm̐ kro dhent+ra sogs kyis bsrung ma rnams 'byin pa po dang khro bo la bka' bsgo ba por nga rgyal bskyed par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ bcu tshan drug gi dang po khro bo la/ steng dang phyogs bzhi'i khro bo zhal gsum phyag drug pa dang*/ 'og dang mtshams bzhi'i khro bo zhal gcig phyag bzhi par mdzad pa shin tu mang zhing*/ slob dpon a bha yas thams cad zhal gsum phyag drug par bshad pa la'ang*/ 'dir 'chad par 'gyur ba'i phyag dang mtshon cha dang zhal dang ldan pa zhes 'grel chen du gsungs pa sgrub le la snyeg dgos la der mtshams 'og zhal gcig phyag bzhi par bshad pa'i phyir ro| |zhes dgag pa dang bcas nas 'chad do/ /de yang 'thad pa min te/ lung de ni ha yig las grub pa kha dog ljang khur 'chad par 'gyur ba'i zhes gtsug tor kho na la sbyar zhing*/ gzhan rnams la'ang kha dog sogs gcig pa dgos par dgongs pa kho na yin gyi/ mtshams 'og sgrub le'i mngon rtogs ji bzhin dgos par bzhed na/ 'grel chen nyid la nang 'gal 'byung ste/ sgrub le'i lha min dbang po'i sgrub thabs kyi skabs dang mtshungs pa byas na 'gal pa spong mi thub pa'i phyir te/ der/ phyi rol re khā gsum la phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor du ni de bzhin khro bo'i mtshan ma rnams ces pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi ji lta ba bzhin du phyogs rnams su'o/

/lha mo rnams kyi ji lta ba bzhin du phyogs bral rnams su'o/ /steng du gtsug tor gyi rdo rje'o/ 'og tu gnod mdzes kyi dgra st+wa ste ra ba gsum po rnams bsrung ba'i slad du'o/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ mtshams kyi khro bo sku 'khor nas gsungs pa la yum bzhi'i mtshan ma 'ong don dang steng 'og tu rdo rje dang dgra st+wa 'ong don med pa'i phyir ro| |spyir khro bo rnams thugs sku rim pa tha dad du byed na sgrub thabs ltar dgos kyang*/ der ra ba gsum pa bsrung ba la rim pa tha dad med pas gshegs pa gshegs ma bzhin sa bon yang ring thung dang phyag mtshan yang gcig pa dang zhal phyag kyang phyogs dang phyogs mtshams 'dra bar byed pa yin no zhes gsungs pa na/ 'dir yang de ltar mtshungs so/ /gzhan yang sgrub ler gtsug tor gcig nyid thugs dkyil du zhal gsum phyag drug pa dang*/ sku dkyil du zhal gcig phyag bzhi par mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/ thugs dkyil snying po'i dkyil 'khor yin pas zhal gsum phyag drug pa las nyung ba mi rung la/ gsung dang sku la zhal gcig phyag bzhi las mang ba mi rung bas yin no zhe na| 'dir yang der thal te/ snying po'i dkyil 'khor yin pa'i phyir te/ khro bo bcu ka bkod pa'i mjug tu snying po'i dkyil 'khor bkod pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du khang brtsegs yid bsrung byed dang sbyong byed yin pas kyang thugs dkyil du grub pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du/ rdo rje snying 'grel du yang bsrung 'khor gyi khro bo bcu ka zhal gsum phyag drug par gsungs pas grub bo| |lung rigs 'di dag gis ni/ sbyin sreg gi thab bsrung ba'i dkyil 'khor khro bo bcu ka yang zhal gsum phyag drug dgos la/ de la ni yum yang bshad pas dgos shing*/ 'dod phyir 'dod rnams kyang rang rang gi bskyed byed dang sku mdog rtsa phyag mtshungs pa ma gtogs zhal gsum phyag drug byed pa'ang khegs so/

/des na gang dag tshes lha steng 'og pa phyogs su bkod pa rnams steng 'og gi mdog can du ye ler gsal bar gsungs pa la dgongs nas| a bha yas 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir du phyogs mdog tu bshad pa'i rjes su nan gyis 'brangs te/rwa 'bro la dgag pa mang du mdzad cing*/ skabs 'di'i khro bo a bha ya dang bstun pa'ang nor pa chen po'o/ /'di ni sa bon brtseg lugs la/ bod snga ma kha cig sogs ring ring po dang*/ kha cig thung ngu brtsegs par 'dod pa'i snga ma mi mthad phyi ma bi bhā ti dang mthun pas 'thad ces gsungs yang*/ gnyis ka min te/ ngang 'don la ha ya ra ba la brtsegs zhes pa las ma thon kyang bsgom don/ ha hā/ yi yī sogs dbyangs dang bcas pa dgos la de yang thung ngu rnams phyogs gcig tu dang ring po rnams phyogs gcig tu brtsegs pa yin la| de yang ring po lugs ldog tu 'god pa dang 'byin pa ni 'dir pha rgyud sgo bstun yin pas ma gsungs so/ des na yaṃ yāḥdang yi yī gang yin/ sngon sa skyar gzhi thog pa dang u rgyan pa rgyal byas pas u rgyan pas thob pa la rong pa sher seng gis dgag pa byas nas bka' bsgo'i sngags kyi mgo na gang 'dug ltos zer ba ni/ skabs kyi 'grel pa dang 'gal bas/ 'dir gsal byed sum cu la dbyangs ring thung bcu bcu zhugs pa rnams sa bon du byas pa yin la/ skabs gzhan du sngags kyi mgo rnams kyang rung ngo*/ khro bo'i gdan la khro bo bcu gcig nyi rkang bcu gcig ste/ gtso bo dang phyogs kyi bzhi dang*/ gzhan drug go /de la nyi ma'i nor bu lon gyi dbye bas thams cad nyi ma dang*/ tshes kyi de'i dbye bas zla ba/ sa me dang chu rlung gi yon tan las lho dang nub nyi ma/ byang dang shar zla ba/ lus kyi dbye bas phyogs su zla ba/ mtshams su nyi ma bsam pa'i dbye bas de las ldog pa rnams gang byas kyang rung bar gsungs so/ /'di dag gi 'og gi sa bon nam mkha'i khams yin kyang khams lngar bsdud pa'i tshe/

mkha' ye gcig tu byed pas skyon med ces gsungs yang*/ a yig ring thung gnyis byung ba'i tshe thung ba nam mkha' dang ring ba ye shes yin pas 'gal spong 'ong don med do/ /spro ba'i lus kyi gnas/ gzhan rnams dwogs pa chung la| rdo rje'i gtsug tor nam mkha'i khams nas sa khams spro ba ci zhe na/ nam mkha' thams cad la khyab pa dang gtso bor chu dang rlung du bsdud cing*/ sa rlung lus bsam yin pas so zhes brjod par bya'o/ /zad par la/ snga rabs pa kha cig gzugs dang gzugs med kyi lha yin pas mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can du byed la/ bu ston rin po che nas| dbang le'i brgya so bdun par/ tshangs pa'i yul sar dpal ldan bzhi ste rab mchog zhi ba'i grong du khams gsum dag gi yum gcig ma/ /zhes pas yum lnga'i sku mdog phyag mtshan mdzad pa gnyis ni/ snga ma cung zad bzang ste/ zad par lnga bsgom pa rnams der skye bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /phyi ma ni/ yum lnga po gzugs dang gzugs med na lhag par spyod pas de dag gi gnas su gsungs pa tsam yin la/ de lta na/ sa 'og rnams su gtum mo brgyad de mi yi 'jig rten phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor du ni khro skyes rnams/ /yi dwags zhes bya yi dwags 'jig rten du ste lha mchog nang du sgra yi rdo rje la sogs drug ces gsungs pas dmyal ba pa rnams rab gtum mo'i gzugs dang mi rnams khro mo yi dwags rnams tsartsi ka sogs rnal 'byor ma brgyad/ 'dod lha drug sems ma drug gi gzugs su sgom dgos par gsal lo/ /phyogs skyong 'di dang sgrub le'i sku mdog mi mthun pa la 'gal spong mang du mdzad mod/ 'dir rang rang gi phyogs skyong yin pas phyogs mdog dang*/ sgrub le'i sbyang bya dang dag bya'i zla ba so so'i khams dang bstun pa'o/ /gza'i sku mdog phyag mtshan kyang*/ sngon bo dong rin chen rtse mos ma shes par rong pa sher seng la dri ba bskur bas me lha gzar dag gi skabs la gzigs byas pas rigs ldan du 'dug ces mnyes par grags mod|
de la'ang phyogs dang kha dog mi mthun pa sogs ni yod/

'on kyang*/yugs sa mo dang mi 'grogs su/ /yul na mgo gtsang med pas so/ /zhes pa'i 'jig rten kha bsngags dang bstun zhes gsungs so/ kha cig ni/ zad par rnams ni nam mkha' dang gza' rnams me khams pa yin pa la bsams nas ljang khu dang dmar po gzhi gcig tu bsgom pa sogs dang*/ gza' la nyi zla sogs kyi dkyil 'khor ltar zlum por bsgom pa sogs kyang byung ngo*/ /de dag la ni/ 'og sgrub le'i sa bon dang phyag mtshan bshad pa'i skabs nas khams 'di la sa bon 'di dang sa bon 'di la phyag mtshan 'di zhes gsal bar gsungs pa rnams dngos su mi gsal ba kun la sbyar dgos pa ma dran pa'i nyes pas reg pa kho na ste/ sgrub le'i bdun cu par/ sa las 'khor lo rab tu skye bar 'gyur te chu las padma dang ni me las nor bu'o/ /rlung las ral gri dang ni stong pa dag las rdo rje 'gyur te 'gyur med las ni gri gug go /zhes dang*/dbang le'i re dgu par/ zhes pa de ltar dbyangs ldan rnams ni rigs kyi dbang gis dkyil 'khor dag la sngags kyi dbye bar 'gyur/ /phyag rgya mtshan ma rnams kyi kha dog mtha' dag rdo rje can gyi zhal gyi dbye bas 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ gya gcig par/ rlung me chu dang sa yi lha rnams dag ni skye ba'i gnas ni mi bdag i ṛ u l̥'o/ /zhes phyogs mdog zhal drug gi dbye ba dang*/ phyag mtshan sa bon gyi khams las grub la/ sa bon ni/ gsal byed zad par la nam mkha' dang gza' la me khams yin kyang dbyangs a i ṛ u l̥ rnams nam mkha' rlung me chu sa yin pas de dag gi dbang gis sku mdog dang phyag mtshan gnyis ka grub la/ zhal phyag gi grangs mi gsal ba la zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa las lhag pa byed thabs med pa'i phyir na ji skad bshad pa rnams skyon med pa yin no/ /klu dang 'byung po ni dwogs pa chung la/ phyi ma la rgya dper mo rtags yod pas rab gtum ma nyid du 'dod pa mi 'thad do/

/ye shes dgug gzhug dbang bskur rgyas btab ni ji ltar byed pa'i rgyas pa'ang legs la/ ma grub na bsdus pa'ang rung ngo*/ /'di dag yang dag par sbyar bas sbyor zhes pa'i 'grel tshig la rten nas nang gi rnams zhal phyir bstan dang phyi'i rnams nang bstan byas nas ra ba dang khang brtsegs sogs rang rang gi bsrung bya'i rten rnams bar du bcug ste rtsig pa la kha sbyar ba dgos par bu ston bzhed pa dang*/ bla ma dam pas de ltar dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan du nang ma rnams yab dang phyi ma rnams de dang de'i yum gyi rang bzhin yin pas so zhes gsung mod kyi/ bsrung bya ni gtso 'khor rnal 'byor pa yin la de gtso bo'i nga rgyal du gnas pas de la bsrung bzlog gi las bya dgos shing bsrung ba la zhal nang bstan dang bzlog pa la phyir bstan byed par rje btsun sa skya pa rnams bzhed pas 'di la gnyis ka tshang ba'i don du nang ma rnams nang bstan dang phyi ma rnams phyir bstan rgyab yang dag par thad kar sbyar bas sbyor ba bya'o/ /shar dang shar lho sogs kyi klu phyogs sa dang mtshams pa go zlog tu gtor sngags sogs nas 'byung ba ni/ spyir phyogs pa thabs dang mtshams pa shes rab yin kyang re re la yang thabs shes kyi cha gnyis gnyis yod pas phan tshun gdams kha'i tshul du bsnol nas gsungs pas mi 'gal lo/ / gnyis pa ni/ sngar gtso bor bdag la 'tshe ba'i bgegs bsregs shing 'dir yang gtso bor gnas la 'tshe ba'i bgegs rnams sngar ltar bsregs te| me lha'i rigs lta bu ma tshig pa dang re shig bros pa rnams rdo rje shugs kyis ra ba'i phyi rol tu bkug mi g.yo bas rkang lag bsdams shing bcings/ stobs po ches phur bu 'dzugs pa la/ thog mar phur bu sgrub pa ni ha hā las steng 'og gi phur bu sogs yi ge bcu las bskyed pa dang*/ ngo bo khro bo bcu nyid yin cing*/ mdog dang phyag mtshan yang gcig pa la/ ṣaṇmu kha zhal drug dang*/

ṣa dza phyag drug dang*/ ṣa ra ṇa zhabs drug yin pas zhal sngo dmar dkar ba gnyis brtsegs sogs dang*/ zhabs drug ka zhu nas lte ba man chad phur bu'i dbyibs can| yang na/ bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan bgegs gan rgyal du 'gyel ba'i 'khor lo drug la zhabs re re'i rtse mo zug pa byed dam zhes gsungs yang*/ bla ma 'phags 'od pas/ zhabs gnyis dbus drang por gshibs te mthil sbyar ba'i rtse snyung la/ gnyis g.yas brkyang dang gnyis g.yon brkyang gi gar stabs byas pa'i gnyis kar rtse sprad pa sbyar bas rtse mo dang*/ bskum pa gnyis dbal ltar byed gsung pa 'di 'thad par bzhed mod/ lhag ma bzhi ka bskum pa'i gar stabs byas na phur bu zur bzhi pa 'byung bas legs par mngon no/ /zur bzhi pa ni shānti bas gsang 'dus 'grel par bshad la/ zur gsum pa la na pa'i dkyil chog sogs su bshad do/ /de ltar grub pa'i phur bu bcu po shar gyi bgegs kyi spyi bor/ shar gyi phur bu phyogs ma 'chol bar 'dzugs mkhan stobs po che'am/ ming gi rnam grangs mtha' yas brtson 'grus kyis byed pa'o| |dbyug sngon can gyis ll̥̄ las grub pa'i rdo rje tho bas brdungs pas 'khor lo drug ka phug ste gsang gnas gser gyi sa gzhi la sbrags pa yin la/ lugs gzhan du rkang mthil gyi bar zhes 'byung ba yang*/ phyed skyil dkrungs byas pa'i rkang mthil gnyis bshang lam gyi sgor bsnol ba la phug nas bsgrog dgos so//de ltar bkod pa'i phur bu dang bcas pa'i phyogs thams cad khro bo bcus bsrungs ces pa ni/ sprul pa'i khro bcu ra ba'i phyi rol phur bu'i steng gi nam mkha' la zhal phyir bstan bkod pa la/ sngags bcus bka' bsgos te bsrung du 'jug pa'o/ /'o na phur bus gdab bya'i bgegs kyi gtso bo gang yin zhe na/ phyogs skyong bcu'o/ /'o na de rnams bsrungs ma'i nang du 'god pa ci zhe na| 'di la bsrungs ma 'chol ba ni 'jig rten las 'das pa dang phur bus gdab bya ni 'jig rten pa yin pas rgyud tha dad do zhes sogs mi mthun pa mang du smra mod kyang*/

spyir phyi rol gyi phan byed gnod byed thams cad kyang nang gi byed pa la rten pa'i las snang yin la/ bgegs kyang rang gi sems yin zhes sogs kun gyis 'don pa ltar/ snying kha'i rtsa bcu la gnas pa'i glo bur gyi dri mas bsdus pa'i las rlung bcu po rnam rtog dang bcas pa ni nang gi phur bus gdab bya'i phyogs skyong bcu yin zhing*/ de dag gi steng gi rang bzhin rnam dag gi ye shes kyi rlung gzhi'i 'od gsal dang bcas pa ni bsrungs ma'i phyogs skyong bcu yin pas de dag gtso bo'i cha shas su 'jog dgos sau/ de ltar na gtso bor ni| nang gi bgegs rnams 'od gsal du bsdus shing las dang po pa'i blo dang bstun pa'i phyir du bgegs kyi rnam par bkod pa la phur bus gdab cing de'i rnam rtog 'od gsal du 'jug pa sogs rnal 'byor gyi nus pas nang gi bgegs rnams zhi ba'i rkyen gyis phyi'i bgegs kyang zhi bar 'gyur la rgyud tha dad 'dul ba la ltos te/ sprul sku'i sa bon bzhag cing nus pa sgrub dgos pas na rtog ngor ye shes kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa'i 'byung lus rags pa ltar bsgoms pas phyi? rol gyi bgegs 'ga' zhig kyang bsrung bya mi mthong bar sa phyogs me phung du mthong ba la sogs pa 'byung ba lam dus su de ltar legs par sbyangs pas sangs rgyas nas 'bad rtsol med par rang gi ngang gis de ltar 'byung ba yin no/ /zlas ba la/ bzlas bya'i phreng sngags gnyis kyi don cung zad bshad na/ spyir sngags rnams dag pa gsum ldan du bya ste/ dag par 'don/ dag par bsgyur/ dag par bshad pa'o/ /dang po gnyis ni/ legs sbyar gyi gzhung la legs par sbyangs nas bya la/ ma mtha'ang legs sbyar la sdang smras mi byed cing legs par mkhyen pa'i drung du 'don lugs skad dod bslabs nas byed dgos la| gsum pa ni/ de tsam gyis kyang mi 'grub kyi/ sngags rnams kyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug la ltos pa'i nges don mkhyen pa dang*/

'dir phyi nang gzhan gsum legs par sbyor shes pa la gtug dgos so/ /de yang mdor bsdus tsam brjod na/ spyir dus kyi 'khor lo'i brjod bya e waṃ du bsdu la| de yang waṃ yig stong chen yig lnga'i rang bzhin/ rdo rje zla ba dri med 'od kyi chos/ de nyid rnam pa bcu drug dang*/ e yig stong pa yig drug gi rang bzhin/ rdo rje nyi ma snang ba'i chos bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis su phyi nang gzhan gsum thams cad sbyar dgos pas/ 'dir yang rkang pa bcu drug pa ni dang po dang*/don gnyis pa ni gnyis pa ste/ drug tshan bcu gnyis su gnas pa'i phyir ro| |de yang*/ phyi'i zla nyi la/ zla ba ni/ de nyid bcu drug pa ste/ dkar cha 'phel ba dang nag cha 'grib pa gnyis ka cha bcu drug par gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /nyi ma ni/ bden don bcu gnyis pa ste/ nyin zhag re la'ang skar khyim bcu gnyis rdzogs par 'char ba'i phyir dang*/ lo re la nyi mas skar khyim bcu gnyis po rdzogs par spyod pa'i phyir ro/ /nang la phra rags gnyis las/ phra ba khams thig le la sbyar na dkar cha ni bcu drug pa ste/ gtsug tor nas dpral ba dang*/ de nas mgrin pa dang*/ de nas snying kha dang*/ de nas lte ba dang*/ de nas gsang ba'i rtse mo nor bu'i bar rnams la/ dga' ba/ mchog dga'/ khyad dga'/ lhan skyes sam thugs gsung sku ye shes te re re la bzhi bzhir dbye bas so/ /dmar cha ni bcu gnyis pa ste/ nor bu'i rtse nas gsang ba'i bar dang*/ de nas lte snying 'grin dpral gtsug tor te drug la cha gnyis gnyis su gnas pa ste 'pho ba'i gnas skabs kyis bzhag la/ dmar cha lte ba'i khyim bcu gnyis dang*/dkar cha dpral ba'i rtsa 'dab bcu drug la gtso bor spyod pa ni rten gyis bzhag pa ste de gnyis nang gi thabs shes phra bar gnas la/ rags pa ni skyais pa lo bcu drug pa dang*/ bud med lo bcu gnyis pa thabs shes so/ /nang gi thig le cha bcu drug dang*/

rlung 'pho ba cha bcu gnyis kyang rags pa'i nang gi thabs shes so/ /gzhan bskyed rim la rten dkyil 'khor cha bcu drug pa dang brten pa lha tshogs yan lag bcu gnyis po thabs shes/ rdzogs rim la/ thig le bcu drug sgrib bral du byed pa dang*/ rlung 'pho ba bcu gnyis 'gog pa thabs shes/ bskyed rdzogs thun mong du bsnyen sgrub bzhi la dga' ba bzhi'am rdo rje bzhi bzhir phye bas bcu drug dang*/ 'pho ba bcu gnyis bkag nas sa bcu gnyis sgrub par byed pa thabs shes/ gzhan yi ge la dbyangs thung ngu bcu drug dkar cha dang*/ ring po bcu drug nag cha*/ gsal byed so drug thabs shes kyis phye bas don gnyis ni drug tshan bcu gnyis su gnas pa rnams/ de nyid bcu drug dang bden don bcu gnyis su gnas pas/ phreng ba'i sngags kyang rkang pa bcu drug pa dang don gnyis par bzhugs so/ /zhes shes par bya'o/ /de yang gzhi lam 'bras bu la sbyor tshul rags pa ni bcu drug dang bcu gnyis kyi grangs kyis rtogs par nus la/ lam dang 'bras bu la cung zad zhib par sbyar na/ bcu drug pa'i dang po la sngags tshan bdun gyi dang po gsum gsum ni yab yum gyi sgo gsum sku gsum rdo rje gsum po dang sbyar nas bdun pas de rnams dbyer med ston pa ni lhan skyes kyi lhan skyes/ rkang pa gnyis pa lhan skyes kyi khyad dga' sogs te/ dang po bzhi lhan skyes las phye ba'i dga' ba bzhi'am rdo rje bzhi'am sku bzhi/ de nas bzhi khyad dga'am chos sku'am thugs rdo rje'i bzhi| de nas bzhi gsung*/ de nas bzhi sku las phye ba ste lam rim pa gnyis ka'i bsnyen sogs bzhi dang sbyar bar bya'o/ /rkang pa don gnyis pa bskyed rim dang sbyar ba ni rdo rje shugs la bstod nas bdud rigs dang bgegs dang log 'dren dang mi'am ci la sogs pa sems can spyi la 'tshe bar dga' ba/ phyogs bcur dkyil 'khor lnga khams gsum sgo gsum phung khams skye mched la gnas pa rnams bkug

rkang lag bcings/ dur khrod kyi sa gzhi me 'bar ba la bsdabs nas phyag gi mtshon cha'i tshogs kyis phye mar byas te/ dum bu byi ba phrag phyed dang bzhir btang*/ dur khrod kyi 'byung po dang mkha' 'gro thams cad cang te'u'i sgras drangs pa la gtor ma byin nas sems can thams cad la zhi rgyas skyob sbed sogs kyi las 'chol ba ste/ bsnyen sgrub bzhi rdzogs la bla ma snga mas ma sbyar zhing*/ rdzogs rim gyi bsnyen sgrub la gang sbyar rnams bskyed rim la'ang sbyor bar grub pa ni rang lugs yin no/ /rdzogs rim la sbyar na/ rkang pa dang pos ting nge 'dzin spyir bstan/ de nas nyer gsum pa yan sor bsam| de nas nga gsum pa yan gyis las rlung dbu mar 'gugs pa'i srog rtsol gtso bor bstan pas 'dzin pa zhar byung*/ de nas nga bzhi pa dur khrod kyi me la brdabs pas rjes dran/ de nas rkang lag 'ching ba gnyis 'dzin pa/ nga bdun pa man chad ting nge 'dzin la sbyar ro/ /de yang 'di ltar/ yi ge drug ni rigs drug gi sa bon yin pas sbyor drug rgyal ba drug tu bshad pa bzhin sbyar/ rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi yan lag re re'ang bcu bcur bstan te/ srog yig gi a dang lnga las rim bzhin sor bsdud kyi du sogs mtshan ma dang po lnga/ bsam gtan gyi yul can lnga/ srog rtsol gyi g.yas pa'i rlung lnga 'jug pa/ 'dzin pa'i 'khor lo lnga'i rlung 'gro ba 'dzin pa lnga/ rjes dran gy-i gnas skabs dang po lnga dang des mtshon pa'i rtags lnga/ ting nge 'dzin g.yas pa'i rlung lnga'i sa bon 'gog pa'o/ / yi thig le dang zla phyed dang ha dang kṣa dang ma rnams mas rim gyis/ sor bsdud kyi nyin rtags lnga/ bsam gtan gyi yul lnga/ srog rtsol gyi g.yon pa'i rlung lnga gzhug pa/ 'dzin pa'i rlung 'ong ba lnga 'dzin pa/ rjes dran gyi gnas skabs phyi ma lnga/ ting nge 'dzin gyis g.yon pa'i rlung 'gog pa lnga rnams bstan pas so/ /'jig rten pa dang lam 'og ma gang gis kyang 'dul ma nus pa'i rlung dang rtog pa gdul dka' ba 'dul ba sogs te/

rnal 'byor gyi che ba yin la| rdo rje ni stong pa dang sku dang lus ni stong gzugs snang ba ste/ skra spu glu gar sogs gang du'ang snang ba'i stong gzugs kyi rnam pa can sor bsam/ rnal 'byor thams cad kyi mnga' bdag 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /de nas srog rtsol gyis las rlung bkug nas bum pa can bsgoms pa la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bka' yis ces pa bla ma'i man ngag gis so/ /de yang phyogs bcu dkyil 'khor lnga khams gsum rnams ni lus spyi'i phyogs bcu sogs sam/ phyogs bcu ni snying kha'i rtsa/ dkyil 'khor lnga rtsa 'khor lnga/ khams gsum g.yon g.yas dbu ma'i rtsa/ sgo gsum yang de gsum mam lte gsang nor bu'i rtsa gsum/ phung khams dbang yul rang ming ste/ lus kyi cha gang ci yang rung ba na gnas pa thams cad srog rtsol gyis 'gugs pa'o/ /steng rlung lag pa dang 'og rlung rkang par byas pa g.yo med du bcings pa 'dzin pa/ lte ba'i me la spyi bo'i byang sems 'bebs pa ni dur khrod kyi me'i sa gzhi la rdebs pa ste/ byang sems skye ba'i gnas grogs dang 'dra ba ni spyi bo yin la/ de shi ba'i ro'i gnas ni lte ba ste thabs kyis ma zin na lte ba las 'das nas nyams par 'gyur bas so/ /nga bdun pa man chad kyis ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyis phung khams thams cad sgrib bral du byed pa ston pa ste/ ye shes lnga'i rdo rje la sogs te/ nges don ye shes kyi ral gri nas dgra st+wa'i bar gyis sgrib pa'i sa bon rtsad nas gcod pa yin la tha na ba spu bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi yang sgrib bral du byed cing rlung gzhom med nā da'i ḍa ma rus rtsa'i mkha' la 'gro ba'i ye shes kyi rlung bkug ste bdud bzhi'i sa bon gyi khrag gsol du bcug pas phung khams skye mched kyi sems can thams cad la zhi sogs mtha' dag legs par stsol ba'o/ /'bras bu la sbyar na/

gzhu dang rga shi 'gag pa nas rtsams te rten 'brel rags rim nas 'gag pa la sbyar te/ sa dang po nas lugs 'byung du rtsi ba dang*/ ma rig pa chu srin 'gag pa nas brtsams te phra rim nas 'gag pa la sbyar te/ sa bcu gnyis pa nas lugs ldog tu rtsi ba gnyis las sngags kyi go rim phyi ma ltar bshad de/ rkang pa dang po bcu gnyis 'pho mtshams ye shes kyi rlung bcu gnyis/ rkang pa bcu gsum pa man chad kyi lnga tshan re re sbyar na chu srin nas gzhu'i bar du 'gags pa dang sbyar ro/ /de yang ye shes kyi khams la phra rags gnyis su byas pa'i phra ba ni sbyang gzhi tsam yin pas gnyen pos sbyong mi dgos la/ rags pa ni sa khams las kyang sbyong sla bas sa dang po gnyis kyi spang bya 'pho ba'i bag chags ni/ rga shi dang skye ba'i rang bzhin ye shes khams pa/ de nas gnyis ni len srid kyi rang bzhin sa khams pa sogs te/ gnyen po phra rim nas skyes pas spar bya rags rim nas 'gog pas spang bya'i rim pa lugs ldog dang gnyen po sbyor drug gi khams kyi rim pa lugs 'byung du gsungs par kho bos rtogs so/ /gsang 'dus sogs las/ sngags 'chad pa la don bzhi ste/ sngags kyi ming*/ don spel ba/ rdo rje'i tshig sgra spangs pa'o/ /dang po la/ sbrul/ btus pa/ mgo med/ mjug med/ ming med ces pa/ las sngags 'di gnyis mjug med do/ /don la/ bstod sngags/ bod sngags/ bskul sngags gsum las/ rkang pa bcu drug pa ni bstod pa ste/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi mngon rtogs dang yon tan la rnam dbye bzhi pa byin nas 'dud pa'o/ /don gnyis pa la gsum ka tshang ngo*| |spel ba ni las so so'i spel tshig sbyar ba'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ rdor bzlas te rim gnyis la de so so'o/ /yang sngags la gsang sngags gzungs sngags rigs sngags te/ pho rtags mo rtags gnyis ka yod pa rnams las/ 'di gnyis snga ma dang 'jug go /mchod bstod dang gtor ma ni rgyud sde 'og ma gsum las gtor ma'i rdzas dang 'bul chog sogs rgyas par bshad mod kyi cha gsum gtor ma'i yul la sogs pa 'jig rten pa la 'bul ba sha stag tu snang bas 'das pa'am dkyil 'khor pa la 'bul ba ma bshad cing*/

'dir yang grong bdag la 'bul ba dang*/ 'dir bsrung ma drug cu la 'bul ba'i gtor sngags sogs rgyas par gsungs kyang dkyil 'khor pa la 'bul ba ma bshad la saṃ bu ṭi dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang gdan bzhi sogs nas gtor ma la le'u re re rgyas par gsungs pa rnams na'ang dkyil 'khor pa la 'bul ba mi gsal mod kyi/ rdo rje snying 'grel las| dkyil 'khor pa la 'bul tshul shin tu 'jug pa bde bar gsungs shing*/ phreng ba dang kṛ ya sa mutstshar saṃ bu ṭi sogs kyi don du byas nas gsang 'dus dang bde dgyes rnams la dngos su sbyar nas bla med gzhan yang rtogs nus pa'i gtor chog rgyas par gsungs pa ltar rgya gar mkhas pa gzhan gyis kyang bshad pas legs par 'thob bo/ /de la gtor ma'i rdzas ni/ bya rgyud legs grub dang dpung bzangs su gtor rdzas khyad par ba drug dang gzhan dkar gtor dmar gtor sogs 'byung po rang rang gi dam tshig gi rdzas bshad cing cha gsum gtor ma ni dpung bzangs su rgyas par 'byung ba slob dpon kun snying sogs kyis rnal 'byor rgyud la'ang sbyar la/ bla med la 'bras chan dang zan dang khur ba dang 'bras khur dang la du dang dzambu ṭi la sogs nya dang sha dang tsong dang sgog skya dang chang dang chu dang zho dang 'o ma la sogs pa me tog la sogs pa dang ldan pa bla bre la sogs pas brgyan pa zhes sogs bshad pas bzang zhing gya nom pa ci 'byor pa'am/ chu dang zan tsam yang rung bar bshad do/ /shin tu 'byor na ni ji ltar bshad pa'i sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa'ang legs par dgos te ma 'byor na gtor rdzas gang 'byor de nyid de dang der bsam dgos par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang ye shes zhabs lugs kyi skor du bdud rtsi lnga nyid 'byung la sambu ṭir ni sha lnga nyid bshad cing*/ 'dir ni gtor ma nyid kyi thad du mi gsal yang*/ chang dang sgron ma sangs rgyas rnams dang zhes sogs kyis gnyis ka bstan no/

/de bzhin du/ bdud rtsi lnga la sogs dang chu gter rdo rje zhes pa rtsa 'grel dang*/ dbang le'i dam tshig bzhi dang brgyad kyi thad du yang sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas tshogs kyi 'khor lo mchod par bya'o/ /zhes sogs kyis gsungs so/ /gtor snod ni kṛ ya sa mutstshar sa ḍa dang sha ṭ-i ka la sogs pa'i gtor snod ces pa gtor gzhong ka tor rar grags pa la sogs pa ste/ rin po che mchog dman nam shing dang*/ sa las byas pa'am/ shing lo'am/ rdo leb bam/ ma 'byor na lag mthil yang bshad la/ bla med la thod pa byung na'ang bzang ngo*/ /byin gyis rlob tshul ni/ bla med spyi las sbyangs rtogs sbar gsum dang 'dir de'i steng du bdud rtsir bya ba dang bzhir gsungs te/ rdo rje gsum dang bzhi'i khyad par gyis so/ /de yang gang du bya ba'i snod ni/ dngos su ma 'byor na'ang sgom dus mi thod du mi byed pa'i bla med ma mthong bas de nyid de/ de yang kaṃ dang a dang oṃ las skyed pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba dum bu gcig par bshad pa mang ngo*/ /de'i nang du padma dmar po'i gdan yod med kyang ci rigs so/ /sbyangs rtogs sogs gang la bya ba'i rdzas ni/ gtso bor bdud rtsi lnga dang sha lnga yang ste phal cher rdzas bcu pa'o/ /de gnyis rim pa ltar/ gshegs ma lnga dang gshegs pa lngar byas pa dang*/ zlog pa'i tshul gnyis spyir bshad kyang*| 'dir ni/ sgron ma sangs rgyas rnams dang zhes sogs kyi sgron ma'am stobs sam sha rnams ming gi rnam grangs yin la/ bdud rtsi la sangs rgyas ces mang du bshad pas sha lnga zhes ma nges par byed pa ni 'di pa'i lugs te/ nang gi bdud rtsi lnga yul can dbang po lnga la byed par gsungs pas kyang ngo*/ /de rnams kyi gnas kyang phyogs bzhi dbus dang lngar brtsegs pa dang der bdud rtsi bkod nas sha lnga mtshams bzhi dbus dang lngar 'god pa dang de las ldog par bshad kyang 'dir snga ma kho na ste/ gshegs ma phyogs su 'god pa med pas so/

/sa bon yang rang rang gi ming yig dang pos de dag la btags nas tha snyad brjod dgos par rgyud sde mang por gsungs pa ltar mang du bshad mod kyi rigs lnga'i sa bon sogs gtso bor bya la/ de yang bhruṃ aṃ sogs gzhan du 'byung yang 'dir dbyangs lnga thung ring la khams mi 'chol ba sogs kyi rgyu mtshan khyad par ba yong bas de rnams te des na rigs lnga'i gnas kyang rang lugs nyid bya'o| |de yang dri chu la mi bskyod pa'i tha snyad 'dir yang byed mod kyi khams lnga'i nang nas chu khams pa yin pas 'od dpag med dang sbyar zhing dkar cha mkha' khams pa mi bskyod pa dang sbyar ba'o/ /de yang byis pa skyes ma thag dri chu dang 'du shes rdzogs par yod kyang khu ba dang rnam shes rdzogs pa ni lo bco lnga'i bar du mi 'byung bas de ltar sbyar ro/ /sbyang sogs gang gis byed pa'i lha sngags ni/ phal cher yi ge 'bru gsum gyis byed par bshad la/ de yang hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ rnams kyis rim pa bzhin sbyangs rtogs sbar gsum byed pa dang*/ de dag kyang rim pa bzhin rdo rje padma zla ba rnams dang snga ma gsum sbyar ba mang ngo*/ /ma rgyud rnams la/ ha ho hri gsum mam/ de gsum gyur pa'i mi bskyod pa rnam snang snang mtha' rnams bar snang du bkod pa'am/ dbyangs gsal rgyas pa bkod nas de dag byed pa'ang bshad la/ gshin rje gshed skor sogs su bar snang la rigs lnga bkod pa gzhu ste bstim nas byed pa'ang yod cing rdzas rnams ga zhu ba'i rkyen yang 'bru gsum maṃ hūm̐ yig las 'od 'phros nas byed pa'ang yod mod kyi| 'dir ni rnal 'byor pa'i snying kha'i hūm̐ yig gis rkyen byed do/ /de yang ga zhu byed me dang de sbaur byed rlung ni kun la yod la/ de dag gis sbor tshul 'jig rten dang mthun par bya ba'i ched du thod pa sgyed bu la gnas pa dgos pa'i sgyed bu ni phal cher du mi mgo skam rlon bshad kyang*/ 'dir sā dhu pu tras bum pa bshad pa bzhin no/

/de dag gis rdzas rnams gzhu zhing bkol ba'i steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje skya ba'i dod du bsams te des kyang dkrugs nas de yang zhu bas zla ba zhu ba'i gzugs su bsgom pa ni 'dir sbyang rtogs gang la bya ba'i gzhir byed do/ /'dir ni oṃ yig gis dri ma sbyang ba dang*/ ā yig gis dag pa'i bdud rtsir rtogs pa dang*/ hūm̐ yig gis mang por sbar ba dang*/ ho yig gis zag med kyi bdud rtsir byed de/ de dag kyang zla nyi sgra gcan dus me'i rang bzhin lag pa g.yon g.yas kyi mthil dang*/ gnyis ka'i mthil dang rgyab rnams bstan pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ de bzhi la rdo rje re re bsgoms nas 'od kyis phyi nang gi rdo rje bzhi'i bdud rtsi bkug nas dam tshig gis rdzas la bstim pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang sbyongs shig rtogs shig sbor zhig bdud rtsir mdzod cig ces pa'i sngags dang bcas pa rgyas par byed pas gtor ma dang bdud rtsi'i bskyed chog kyang shin tu ngo mtshar ba'o/ /de ltar na 'di'i rdo rje bzhi yang dus 'khor rang gi rdo rje bzhi po la byed dgos par gsal bas/ oṃ dang padma las skyes pa'i sku rdo rje 'od dpag med sogs dgos mod kyi/ bla ma gong ma'i phyag len oṃ dang 'khor lo la skyes pa'i rnam snang sogs rgyud sde gzhan gyi rgya bkab mdzad pa rnams mngon rtogs su bris pa yin no/ /gtor 'gron ni/ rgyud sde gong 'og kun tu rang bzhin gyi gnas na bzhugs pa'i ye shes pa bkug nas mdun du bzhugs pa la 'bul ba sha stag yin la/ bla med la 'gron 'jig rten pa yin na nang gi bdud rtsi khyad par can 'bul ba na 'das pa'i rnam par bsgyur dgos pas phur bus gdab pa'am skad cig gis 'od gsal du bcug nas bsgyur chog bshad pa mang mod kyi/ 'dir ni/ rdo rje shugs kyis sprul pa'i ye shes kyi sku dang ngo bo dbyer med du byas zin pas bsgyur chog mi dgos so|

|spyan 'dren pa'i phyag rgya ni/ lag pas yi ge de dang de las rdo rje sogs su bskyed pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang bstun nas lha sde tshan so so'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya 'gugs pa yin la/ 'bul ba'i gtor sngags la/ dri spos me tog mar me zhal zas te nyer spyod lnga tshang bar yod cing gtor ma nyid bdud rtsi yin pas mjug tu nyer spyod dang nang mchod sogs ma sbyar na chad pa bzhin du byed pa ni sngags don mi shes pa'i skyon no/ /de ltar na bla ma snga rabs pa mang pos gtor 'gron la cho ga gsum bskyed la sogs pa'i skyed chog rgyas pa mang po mdzad pa rnams la'ang khungs yod par ma mthong zhing*/ gtor mgron la lha sku bzhin lag gi rnam pa can dgos par bsams nas bum skyed gzhu tshar ba'i rjes su gtor ma 'bul bar rgya gar ba'i gzhung khungs thub mang po nas bshad pa go rim dkrugs nas byed pa rnams la'ang skabs de rang du mi rung ba cher mi snang na'ang*/ rgyu mtshan de ni shin tu ma nges te/ dang por lha skur bskyed pa srid na'ang rjes su bsgyur tshar ba'i thig skud dang bris pa'i thig nyid la gtor ma 'bul ba'i phyir ro/ /spyir yang rdzogs rim kyi rnal 'byor par ma zad/ bskyed rim pas kyang gang snang bde stong gi ye shes su ྄'char ba dgos la khyad par gtor ma'i sngags khyad par can gtor ma 'di bzhes shig ces sogs kyi sngags don med par/ a kā ro zhes sogs kyi don/ a zhes bya ba ni gdod ma nas ma skyes pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /zhes sogs 'ba' zhig tu yod pas mchod bya mchod byed mchod rdzas thams cad ye shes kyi ngo bo 'od gsal bar mos pa kho na rgya cher gsungs pa go dgos so/ /'dir gtor 'gron spyan 'dren rgyu ra ba khang brtsegs la bkod zin pa'i bsrungs ma rnams las mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du gtor ma'i steng gi bar snang la bkod pa rnams la phul zhing dgyes nas bsrung ma dngos rnams dang dbyer med du gyur pa rnams gtso bo'i 'khor lo drug gi yi ge la bsdu zhing*/

rten gsum yang sgo gsum la bsdus nas rdo rje shugs yongs rdzogs kyang gtso bo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yum dang bcas par bsdus nas thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug pa'am| thun sbrel nas mngon rtogs dngos gzhi la 'jug pa yin te/ de dag ngag 'don la dngos su ma thon pa rnams kyang de ltar mos par bya ste bsrung 'khor la dwogs pa'i gnas cung zad mang bas rgyas par bshad pa'o// gnyis pa mthun rkyen tshogs gnyis bsags pa la/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs so/ de yang*/ mdo rgyud gzhan kun tu tshogs gnyis kho na 'byung yang*/ 'dir/ tshogs gsum don du sgrub par bgyi/ /zhes gnyis po'i steng du tshul khrims kyi tshogs zhes zur du 'chad pa ni/ lam gyi gtso bo 'gyur med kyi bde chen yin la/ de'i rten gyi gtso bo khams byang chub kyi sems yin pas de mi nyams pa la rtsal du 'don pa'i don du gnyen po la tshul khrims kyi tshogs dang*/ spang bya la rtsa ltung lnga pa de nyams pa la 'chad pa yin no/ /de ni rgyud sde spyi dang khyad par bla med kun gyis blang dor byed dgos mod kyi chu skyes 'od dpag med kyi rigs la 'di'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa ma blangs pas rtsa ltung du mi 'gyur la/ 'dir blangs pas rtsa ltung du 'gyur zhing*/ gzhan nas bshad pa'i rtsa ltung lnga pa ni 'dir rten de la brten pa'i ye shes yin pas bden gnyis kyi sems blo rdzas gcig la 'dus pa'i bde chen byang chub kyi sems btang ba la rtsa ltung du ni kun gyis byed dgos pa thun mong ba yin no| |de ltar tshogs gsum yang bsdu na gnyis su'ang 'du ste/ tshul khrims bsod nams kyi tshogs su 'dus pas so/ /de ltar na/ bsod nams kyi tshogs la zhing ni bla ma kho na yin te/ skyabs gnas dang mchod yul thams cad lhag pa'i lha'i dkyil 'khor dang de nyid bla ma dang dbyer med kho nar ma shar na/ gang gis bla ma rdo rje 'dzin/

/tha dad nyid du mthong gyur pa/ /de yis de nyid dngos grub ni/ /tshogs pa'i mtshan nyid can mi 'thob/ /ces sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /mchod pa yang de kho na la 'bul dgos te/ mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas/ /bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsam/ /zhes dang*/ lha dang 'byung po la sogs kyi/ /mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas/ /bla ma mchod par bya'o zhes/ /rab 'byams zhing na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis mthun par gsungs/ /zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /skyabs 'gro'i skyabs yul yang*/ de kho na la bsten te/ sangs rgyas slob dpon dbang mchog thob/ /ces sogs te/ de ltar na/ phar phyin theg pa'i theg dman ltar na sangs rgyas bdun khri bdun stong sogs grangs kyis bcad pa'am/ theg chen ltar na grangs med re re la'ang sangs rgyas dpag med grangs med la bsnyen bkur byed dgos par bshad pas tshogs sogs pa'i yul mtha' yod du bshad cing*| skyabs kyi gtso bo sangs rgyas yin kyang da lta don dngos su mi bzhugs/ chos rgyun ting nge 'dzin ma thob bar du sangs rgyas kyi zhing du bgrod par mi nus pas tshogs bsog pa'i yul dkon pa dang dus 'gyang ba dang nus pa chung la| sngags bla med ltar na gsum ka dngos su bzhugs pa dang*/

bla mar ma 'dus pa'i sangs rgyas gcig kyang med pas nus pa che ba'i phyir dus myur ba yin pa la nges pa brtan po rnyed nas/ sngon 'gro tshogs bsog gi nyams len thams cad kyang bshes gnyen bsten tshul gyi chos skor mchog tu shes na dngos grub myur du 'grub kyi/ bla ma la zla gcig gi rgyags ster mkhan tsam du yang mi rtsi bar sbyor ba tshogs bsog gi sgo nas lha mnyes su re ba ni/ gal te lha ni mnyes 'dod na/ /'bad pas bla ma mnyes par bya/ /zhes rdo rje 'chang gis nan tan gyis gsungs pa ma tshor zhing tshor kyang mi rtsi bar zad do/ /tshogs kyi ngo bo ni/ phyag mchod sdig bshags yi rang dang*/ /bskul gsol skyabs 'gro lus 'bul bsngo/ /lam la rgya cher sten pa'o/ /'di la bsam pa sems bskyed dang*/ /sbyor ba nyams su len pa'o/ /'di la bsten bya sten pa dang*/ /spang bya spong ba'i dang po la/ /don gnyis phyin drug bsdu bzhi'o// gnyis par mi dge bcu spong dang*/ sgrib pa lnga dang nyon mongs bzhi/ /zag bzhi lta ba'i skyon bzhi spong*/ /zhes bya'o/ /de ltar na/ rdo rje gur nas gsungs pa'i rgyun bshags sogs bla med kyi rgyun bshags mang po nas chos 'khor bskor bar bskul ba dang mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs pa mi 'byung ba la| gsang sngags gsungs ba po yin na longs sku yin pas khyab la/ de la de gnyis ka mi dgos pas yin no zhes sogs smra ba ni longs sprul gyi rang bzhin la rmongs shing*/ rang nyid mthong rgya chung ba gsal bar byed pa ste/ 'di dang da ri ka pa'i rgyun bshags sogs na yod pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir sgrib pa lnga la| 'dod pa la 'dun pa dang gnod sems ma bgrangs pa ni/ rgyu'i kun slong la snying rje dang sems bskyed khyad par can gyis zin pa dgos kyang dus kyi kun slong la chags sems dang khro ba cung zad bskyed nas de nyid gnyen po'i ngo bor bsgyur dgos pas yin par gsal lo/

/'o na rgyun bshags rgyas pa 'di tsam la sngags kyi sdom bzung med pa ci zhe na/ bden gnyis dbyer med kyi byang chub kyi sems dang*/ tshogs gsum ka 'dus pa'i phan phyin drug ni/ phar phyin gyi theg chen la yang med par ma zad rgyud sde 'og ma la yang med pas 'di dag tu legs par 'dus pa'i phyir sdom bzung gi don gyi shin tu tshang bar yod do/ /gzhan yang sgrub thabs kun bzang sogs bla med dang*/ rdo rje 'byung ba sogs yo ga'i sgrub thabs kyi rgyun bshags rnams la'ang sngags kyi sdom bzung gi don yod pa la dgongs nas rigs lnga'i sdom bzung med pa yin no/ /ye shes kyi tshogs ni/ sangs rgyas pa'i chos sku'i thun mong min pa'i rgyu yin te/ bsod nams kyi tshogs gzugs sku'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ de yang*/ mkhas pa dag chos sku'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu tshogs tshang la yongs su rdzogs pa ni phar phyin theg pa la yang yod de/ chos sku dang rnam pa mthun par bsgoms pa yod pa'i phyir/ des na ye shes kyi tshogs sog pa'i sngags kyi gnas skabs kun tu yang*/ spyir phar phyin theg pa dang khyad par sher phyin gyi mdo dang dbu ma rigs tshogs nas bshad pa'i stong nyid sgom tshul ji lta ba bzhin las khyad par 'thon rgyu gang yang med do zhes gsungs la/ gzhan dag ni/ de lta bu phung po rnam dpyad kyi stong pa nyid ces bya ba chad stong dang bem stong yin pas gsang sngags lam gyi gol sa yin te/ 'jam dpal gyi rang gi lta ba'i 'dod pa mdor bstan par/ phung po rnam dpyad stong pa nyid/ /chu shing bzhin du snying po med/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /stong nyid de ltar 'gyur ma yin/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na sngags kyi lta ba ni rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs srid gsum pra phab pa'i rnam pa can 'od gsal bde ba chen po yin pas/ mdo sngags lta bas khyad par du 'byed pas/

don dam pa'i bden pa yang rtag brtan ther zug gi dngos po sgrub pa rang dbang ba yin la/ yul 'di ni sngags su ma zad/ mdo'i 'khor lo tha mar yang zag pa med pa'i shes pa sbrang ma'i rtsi dang 'dra/ /zhes sogs kyi gsal bar ston pa 'di nyid nges pa'i don yin gyi/ 'khor lo bar pa'i dngos bstan dbu ma rigs tshogs kyis bkral ba'i don dam bden pa ni med dgag ci med byar med kyi chad stong yin pas 'khor lo de ni drang don yin nam zhes sogs zer ro/ /lugs snga ma ni/ rgya gar gyi mkhas pa ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa'i lam rim gnyis pa las/ sngags la rab tu mi gnas las/ /don dam lha med lha yod na/ /don dam skyon can slob dpon rmongs/ /kun rdzob bden pas khyad par che/ /zhes sogs dang*/ sdom gsum rab dbye las/ pha rol phyin dang gsang sngags la/ /lta ba'i dbye ba bshad pa med/ /pha rol phyin pa'i spros bral las/ /lhag pa'i lta ba yod na ni/ /lta de spros pa can du 'gyur/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa dang mthun mod/ 'di yang lta ba'i yul gyi gtso bo 'dzin stangs kyi yul la dgongs pas lugs phyi ma la shin tu gnod cing don la zhugs mod kyi/ yul can lta ba'i ngo bo ni khyad par shin tu che ste/ phar phyin theg pa las ni/ yul don dam pa'i bden pa gcig pu de nyid shes rab khyad par can gcig gi 'dzin stangs kyi yul du byas te legs par rtogs pa de nyid thabs kyi khyad par grogs su gyur pa mchog dman ci rigs pa dang sbyar te bskyangs pas byang chub gsum la sogs pa 'grub kyi yul can bde bas stong nyid rtogs pa mi srid de/ bde ba ni tshor ba yin pas shes rab tu 'gal la| stong nyid rtogs pa'i sems byung yin na shes rab khyad par can yin dgos pas so/ /des na thabs shes dbyer med dang zung 'brel ces pa'ang gcig la gcig gis rtsis zin pa tsam ma gtogs rnam shes gcig gi 'khor du cig car 'byung ba tsam yang slob pa'i gnas skabs su mi srid pa'i phyir dang*/

sngags la ni/ yul stong nyid yul can bde bas rtogs dgos so/ /zhes sngags 'chad pa po kun gyis mgrin gcig tu smra ba ni shin tu 'thad la/ bde ba ni tshor ba yin zhing de yang lus tshor sems tshor gnyis las/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i bde ba ni rdzogs rim pa'i lhan skyes kyi bde ba 'bras bu dang bcas par nges la/ de yang lam sgom stobs kyi zhu bde lhan skyes yin pas nang reg khyad par can la rten pa'i lus bde dbang shes kho na yin pa'i phyir phar phyin theg pa ba phal cher gyi blor mi shong ba'i mnyam gzhag ye shes dbang shes su 'dod pa ni sngags kyi grub mthar byed dgos so zhes kho bos smras so/ /de ltar rdzogs rim gyi tshe tshor ba shes rab khyad par can du dngos su bsgyur thub pa la ni/ bskyed rim gyis snga mo nas mos ngor goms su 'jug pa nges par dgos pas gnas skabs 'di dag gi tshe yang lhan skyes kyi bde bas stong nyid rtogs par mos pa nyid la nan tan mchog tu bya bar rigs so/ /de ltar rtogs bya'i 'dzin stangs kyi yul 'khor lo bar pa'i dngos bstan dpal mgon klu sgrub kyis bkral ba'i stong nyid las lhag pa rtogs rgyu cung zad med mod/ snang ba'i dmigs yul ni khyad par che ste/ lugs de la ni/ chos can ma dag pa'i kun rdzob 'di dag la rigs pas dpyad pa'i mthar cung zad kyang ma rnyed pa de nyid kyang gnas lugs kyi don rnyed pa'i rigs shes rjes dpag de'i ngor gang zhig snang na bden snang skye bar nges pa'i bem chos las snang gi chos can mtha' dag 'gags pa'i snang med 'ba' zhig ma gtogs/ blo de'i ngor dag pa'i snang ba 'char bar ma bshad pa bzhin du mnyam gzhag snang med kho na slob pa'i gnas skabs su khas len la/ sngags la ni/ yul can bde bas byas pa'i nus pas du sogs kyi mtshan ma nas brtsams te/ bem chos dang bral ba'i stong gzugs dag pa'i chos can dmigs pa'i yul du 'byung bar ni sngags las rgya cher gsungs shing*/

rnal 'byor pa phal cher gyis myong bas grub pa'i mngon sum dang*/ gsang sngags pa 'bras bu lam du byed cing*/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la snang bcas su mi 'dod pa med pas na/ bskyed rim mos pa yid byed la yang de ltar byed dgos pa ni rigs pa de dag gis legs par grub cing*/ 'jam dpal zhal lung sogs kyi lung yang yod de/ de nas sems can thams cad la/ /tshangs spyod chen po bzhis dmigs te/ /de la sogs pas rang rgyud kyi/ /las kyi sgrib pa dag byas nas/ /sems tsam la ni dmigs byas te| |phyi rol rang bzhin stong par bya/ /sems tsam de yang stong byas nas/ /rang rig tsam du gnas par bya/ /rang rig de yang zla ba sogs/ /mdun du brtags nas yi ge'o/ /snyug gus bsnun byas mtshan ma'o/ /de nas rang nyid lhar bskyed la| |lha yi nga rgyal dang ldan par/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis rgyas btab ste/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo sprul bar bya/ /de mnyes de la goms byas pas/ /phyi rol lus ni bzlog par bya/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi spyod yul ba/ /mtha' yi de nyid bsgoms par bya/ /rang snying dam tshig phyag rgya yis/ /thugs kar mtshan ma la gnas pa/ /de bzhin gshegs kun ye shes mchog/rim pa dang po pa rnams la/ /yi ge'i gzugs su rab tu snang*/ /zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na/ spyod mjug las/ gang tshe dngos dang dngos med dag /blo yi mdun na mi gnas pa/ /de tshe rnam pa gzhan med pas/ /dmigs pa med pas rab tu zhi/ /zhes sogs dang*/ 'jug pa las/ gang tshe skye med de nyid yin zhing blo yang skye ba dang bral ba/ /sogs dang*/ byang chub sems 'grel las| dmigs pa dang ni bral ba'i sems/ /nam mkha'i mtshan nyid la gnas te| |nam mkha' bsgom par byed pa 'di/ /stong pa nyid ni bsgoms par bshad| |ces sogs dang*/ mdo las/ nam mkha' mthong zhes sems can tshig tu rab brjod pa/ /nam mkha' ji ltar mthong zhes don 'di brtag par gyis/

sogs dang*/ rgyud las/ spros pa rmi lam ltar byas nas/ /spros pa nyid ni spros med byed/ /ces sogs dang*/ dngos po med la bsgom pa med/ /ces sogs mang du gsungs pa rnams kyis mnyam gzhag snang med du bstan pa ma yin nam zhe na/ de dag ni dag snang mi 'gog gi mtshan ma'am spros pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig la dgongs la/ de yang bden pa'i dang*/ snang ba'i mtshan ma ste/ dang po ni/ rjes thob tu 'byung yang rigs shes dran pas mngon gyur 'gog nus la/ gnyis pa ni/ slob pa'i rjes thob tu 'byung ba rjes thob der mi khegs kyang*/ rnyed don la mnyam par bzhag pas mnyam gzhag tu 'gag par 'gyur zhing*/ sangs rgyas nas kyang mtshan ma'i dri ma can gyi snang ba mtha' dag 'gags nas dag pa'i snang ba mtha' med du sangs rgyas par 'gyur bar nges don gyi mdo rgyud kun tu gsungs pa'i don/ lo chen thams cad mkhyen pas bsdus te/ kun rtog 'khrul pa'i mun pa ma lus sangs/ /'od gsal dag pa'i snang ba rab 'byams rgyas| |shes dang shes bya'i yul kun gcig tu 'dres/ /ces sogs gsungs pa ni| nges don 'thon po'i gsung rab spyi dang*/ khyad par dbang bzhi pa'i lam gtso bor ston pa byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel pa skor gsum gyi dgongs pa yin gyi/ gang dgadrang nges kyi don la don dam bden pa brjod bya'i gtso bor byed pa kho na nges don gyi gsung rab yin no zhes mthar thug don dam la ltos pa'i drang nges nyid khas blangs nas/ 'khor lo tha ma dang rgyud sde nas rgya cher gsungs pa'i 'od gsal bde gshegs snying po la sdang smras byas te/ tha snyad gnas skabs la ltos pa'i drang nges mi 'dod par shing rta gnyis las thogs med la rgyab kyi phyogs pa dang*/ da ltar gyi bem chos las snang thams cad phyi don tshad grub tu khas blangs shing*/ 'jig rten las las skyes pa dang sangs rgyas las sgrib las grol ba dang*/ sangs rgyas la las snang yod par 'dod pa dang*/

mnyam gzhag snang bcas la sdang smras byed cing slob pa'i zung 'jug gi sku thugs gnyis ka mnyam gzhag der mngon du 'gyur bar 'dod pa dag gis ni sems 'grel gsum la sogs pa'i nges don mi rtogs par ma zad/ rang gi nang 'gal rnams spong bar mi nus la/ lugs gnyis pas ni don dam rigs pas dpyad bzod du khas blangs pa'i phyir/ dbu ma rang rgyud pa tsam yang min zhing*| rtag pa dang dngos po'i gzhi mthun 'dod par rang sde gnas ma bu pa las kyang dman te/ gzhan dag gis rgyas par bkag pa bzhin no/ /de ltar na/ rdo rje theg pa'i ye shes kyi tshogs ni/ 'dzin stangs sher phyin gyi mdo dang dbu ma rigs tshogs nas gsungs pa'i stong nyid las lhag pa'i don dam bden pa yul du mi byed pas don dam gyi gnas lugs chos nyid stong pa nyid la chu la chu bzhag gi rnam pa can yin la/ snang ba'i dmigs yul 'khor lo tha ma dang rgyud sde rnams su gsungs pa'i zag pa med pa'i shes pa dang*/ 'od gsal dang*/ shin tu phra ba'i rlung dang*/ tho rangs slod byed kyi skyon gsum dang bral ba'i nam mkha'i rang mdog dang*/ stong gzugs pra phab pa'i rnam pa can gyi phyag rgya chen mo stong nyid don dam pa'i bden pa dang ngo bo dbyer med kyi gzugs snang gi rnam pa thams cad pa zhes bya ba tha snyad kyi gnas lugs chos can rlung sems phra mo la dmigs pa ni/ sangs rgyas pa dang rdzogs rim 'thon po nas dngos su 'byung ba rdzogs rim dman par rjes mthun pa dang mtshan ma tsam 'byung ba bzhin du bskyed rim nas mos ngor bsgom dgos so zhes bya ba ni kho bo'i legs bshad do/ / gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ gong du bshad pa ltar/ bzhi las/ dang po sku rdo rje bsnyen pa'i yan lag dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog la gsum las/ dang po 'chi ba chos skur 'khyer ba la/ bsdud rim khyad par can dang mthun par dang*/ 'dzin stangs khyad par can dang mthun par sgom pa gnyis las/

dang po ni/ nang gi khams phra ba zla nyi sgra dus bzhi'i thim rim khyad par can mdo sngags gzhan gang nas kyang ma gsungs pa dang mthun zhing*/ de sbyong ba'i thabs su gsungs pa ste sngar bshad pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngags tshan bzhi'i don bsgom pa ste/ de lta bas na phar phyin theg pa rkyang pa'i lta ba skyong lugs kyis mi chog pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ sngags don khyad par can gyi sgo nas nga rgyal 'dzin pa ni bya rgyud nas kyang yod la| de yang rgyud sde gong 'og gi khyad kyis 'og ma rnams la swa bhā wa tsam shas che zhing*| bla med la shū n+ya tā dang khyad par 'di la sngags tshan bzhi'i sgo nas nga rgyal 'dzin tshul rgyas par gsungs so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ swa bhā wa la ni/ chos thams cad rang bzhin rnam par dag pas bdag kyang rang bzhin rnam par dag par gyur pa nga'o snyam pa las med la/ shū n+ya tā la ni/ yul stong pa nyid yul can ye shes bde chen gnyis dbyer med pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i bdag nyid ni nga'o/ /zhes pas khyad che la/ dbyer med tshul yang*/ gcig gis gcig rtsis zin zhing rgyas thebs pa tsam min par/ thabs kyi gtso bo bde chen nyid gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can du skyes la de yang don dam gnas lugs spros pa nyer zhi'i dbyings dang tha snyad gnas lugs bde gshegs snying po'i rlung sems gnyis ka rtogs par gyur pa ste sngar bshad pa bzhin no/ /de yang dpal ldan 'dus pa sogs rdo rje gsum gyi rgyud la/ ngo bo rgyu 'bras gsum stong par rtogs pa'i rnam thar sgo gsum las med la/ 'dir de gsum gyi steng du yul can ye shes nyid kyang rkyen gyis mngon par 'dus ma byas par rtogs pa bsnan pas bzhi'o/ /gnyis pa bar do longs skur 'khyer ba la/ mi 'thad pa dgag pa dang*/ nyams su len tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/

dus 'khor la bar do sbyong byed med par 'dod pa dgag pa dang*/ yod pa rnams la cha gnyis mi 'thad par 'dod pa dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sngar brjod pa ltar kha cig na re/ 'di la de med de/ bar dor 'tshang rgya ba med pa'i phyir dang*/ sgrub le'i mdor bsdus gnyis pa'i mtshams sbyor du/ da ni sngon gyi smon lam rdzogs par bya ba dang chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i don du mngal 'jug pa'i tshul gyis zhes sogs gsungs pas/ lugs 'di la sku bzhi dang rdo rje bzhi sogs 'bras bu la sbyor ba gtso che yis sbyang gzhi la sbyor ba mi rgyas pas so zhes smra'o/ /de ni shin tu mi rigs te/ tshe 'di nyid la 'tshang rgya bar nges pa des skye shi bar do gsum ka sku gsum du 'khyer mi dgos par 'gyur te/ gnas skabs gsum ka la 'tshang rgya ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /de bar dor mtshang mi rgya yang de'i lam 'khyer ma byas na longs sku'i sgrub thabs khyad par can nyams par 'gyur bas bsgom mo zhe na 'dir yang mtshungs so/ /sbyang gzhi la sbyor ba mi rgyas par smra ba ni ches 'khrul te| dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog mngal gyi zla grangs dang rtsa 'chags tshul dang legs par sbyar ba dang*/ las rgyal mchog mngal sgor rlung rgyu tshul dang*/ rnal 'byor gnyis po lo bcu drug gi mtshams su bde ba 'grub tshul dang sbyar ba 'di tsam gyi rgyas pa gsang 'dus 'phags lugs la yang med pa'i phyir ro| |der ma zad/ bde gsang sogs las bar dor 'tshang rgya bar grags mod kyi| legs par btugs na tshad mas grub par dka' ste/ de la lam gyi bogs 'byin spyod pa dgos la de la yul rten gnyis ka khams drug ldan med pas bde chen mi 'dren pa'i phyir ro/ /ci ste/ de bar do nyid ma dag pa'i sgyu lus su langs pa kho nas byed la/ de nam mkha' mdzod la dbang thob pas de 'dra'i yul dang rten sgrub par shin tu sla'o zhe na/ sgrubs pa'i lus de bar do'i yid lus yin nam min soms shigayin na ni gsar du sgrub don med la/

ma yin na ni/ don de nyid gyis bar do'i rten la 'tshang mi rgya bar grub bo| |des na de ltar gsungs pa ni de sgyu lus su ldang bar nus pa tsam la dgongs pa yin gyi/ sgrub gzhi dang lam gyi khyad par gyis yin no zhes smra ba rnams kyis ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad lam bgrod pa gcig pa dang*/ rtogs bya'i gnas lugs la dbye ba med pa dang*/ gang zag la dbang po mchog dman dang*| de la ltos pa'i gsung rab rnams kyi dngos bstan la drang nges dang mchog dman gsungs pa rnams ma go bar zad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ mkhas rlom 'ga' zhigakyai rdor la gzhal yas khang gi rgyur bar do'i rnam shes mtshon byed rnams gtong ba 'gog par byed cing*/ rigs pa ni gur du/ nam mkhar dri za gnas pa ni/ /lhung nas zhu ba rjes dran bya| |zhes pa ltar ye shes zhabs lugs kun la gsungs pas de dgos pa gang zhig bar do la cha gnyis bzo thabs sbyang gzhi la med pa'i phyir dang*/ shes pa bem po'i nyer len du 'gro mi srid pa'i phyir zhes sogs brjod par byed do/ /'o na ni/ bar do yi ger bsgom pa mi 'thad par 'gyur te/ gzhi'i bar do yi ge'i gzugs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /de ni yi ge'i ngo bo gdangs yin la de yang rlung yin pas/ bar do rlung sems tsam gyi yid lus yin pas de dang ngo bo mtshungs par bsgoms pas sbyong byed khyad par can du 'gro ba yin gyi/ gzhi'i khyad chos ji bzhin bsgom pa min te/ yin na 'khrul snang sna tshogs kyang bsgom dgos par 'gyur ro zhe na/ de ni bden gyi/ 'dir yang de ltar sbyor zhigades na sbyang gzhi'i steng gi yon tan gyi cha dang chos mthun par bsgoms nas skyon sbyong ba yin pas/ gzhi la bar do cha gnyis mi srid pa dang*/ rang gi khang pa'i rgyur mi 'gro ba sogs ni skyon yin pas de dang mi bstun pa nyid bzang la/ gzhal yas khang gtso bo'i ye shes su khas blangs nas rnal 'byor pa'i rlung sems de'i rgyur gtong ba la sdang smras byed pa dag rigs pa smra ba'i khyu mchog tu 'dzin pa ni bstan pa nyams pas nongs so/

/de bzhin du gzhal yas khang me long ye shes rnam snang gi ngo bor gsungs shing 'dod la/ de rnal 'byor pa rang gi ye shes las gzhan du bsgoms pas dgos pa mi 'grub cing*/ nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i sngags don la/ bdag nyid nga'o zhes pa'i tshig kha ton du byas kyang don la go bar zad do/ /de dag ni rigs pa yin la/ lung ni/ brtag gnyis las/ ji ltar sgom pa po 'byung ba'ang zhes dang*/ de'i 'grel pa ku mu ti las| dkyil 'khor 'ba' zhig bsgoms par bya ba ni min gyi/ sgom pa po bdag nyid kyang der bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes sogs dang*/ gur las/ bhruṃ las 'khor lo'i steng du bzhag /srid pa bar ma'i bsam gtan bya/ /zhes dang*/ mi thub zla ba'i yan lag drug par/ bhruṃ las byung ba'i 'khor lo ste/ /de steng bdag nyid bar ma'i skye/ /zhes dang*/ rin chen 'bar bar/ bhruṃ las 'khor lo de steng du/ /srid pa bar ma'i bag chags bsam/ /zhes sogs dang*/ rje btsun rtse mos/ de nas rkyen gyi yan lag gi /'byung bzhir rnam shes zhugs bsgoms te/ /zhes dang*/ rje btsun chen pos/ bar do'i rnam par shes pa 'byung bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa la zhugs pas gzhal yas khang zhes sogs mang du gsungs so/ /de dag ni kyai rdor la gzhal yas khang rnam snang gi yan lag la nga rgyal 'jog dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin pas/ zhabs lugs gzhan la ni/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa la bar do cha gcig 'jug par/ sgrub thabs kun tu bzang mo dang*/ bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa dang*/ dman zhabs pa'i sgrub thabs dngos grub gter mdzod sogs na shin tu gsal la/ kun bzang dang*/ rin chen rdo rje dang*/ jo bo sogs kyis dngos su ma thon mod kyi/ gzhi'i bar do de kho rang gi pha ma'i rgyur mi 'gro yang 'bras bu la skyed bya skyed byed rgyud gcig pa ltar lam dus su yang bsgom dgos pas cha gnyis nges par dgos so/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'chi ba chos skur 'khyer ba'i de ma thag tu bar do mtshon byed kyi yi ge nā da dang*/

sgo gsum 'grub tshul sogs ni/ 'dus pa zhabs lugs dang*/ bde mchog dang*/ 'phags lugs sogs la yod kyang*/ zhabs lugs kyi yang lam 'khyer bsdus pa kun la med pa bzhin du 'dir yang ngo*// lu hi pa'i dpal mngon par rtogs pa na nā da 'jog pa dang*/ sgrub thabs kun bzang na 'bru gsum 'jog pa 'chi srid sbyong ba'i lam gyi de ma thag na med kyang gzhung rgyas pa rnams kyis kha 'gengs pa ltar byed na ni 'di la'ang mi rung ba med pas/ 'jog na/ rnam thar sgo bzhi'i sngags kyi 'jug tu/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i khams mtha' yas pa'i chos 'byung gi nang du bar do'i rnam shes hūm̐ yig sngon po nam mkhar 'khod pa'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi sogs bya'o/ /hūm̐ yig rkyang pa ni mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor yang 'byung la/ 'dir yang 'og tu/ zla ba'i dbus su hūm̐ yig dri za'i rnam shes su gsal bar gsungs pas rigs so/ /de ltar na/ yi ge la lnga dang gsum dang gcig rnams rgyas 'bring bsdus pa ste/ nā da phra mo ni mtshan ma'i yi ge tsam yin pas de rnams ni rlung sems phra mo mtshon byed du zad pas bar do'i ngo bo tsam dang*/ 'phags lugs kyi mngon byang lnga bskyed ni bar do'i sems snang 'grub tshul dang bstun pas bar do'i rnam pa dang mthun par sgom pa zhes bya'o/ /'on kyang rgyud 'grel gyi dngos bstan la med pa ltar mtshon byed nam mkhar ma bzhag na'ang rung ste/ rnal 'byor pa rang nyid bar do yid lus phra mo longs sku'i ngang nas gzhal yas khang bskyed pa sogs 'byung lus rags pa dang bral ba'i ngang nas bya'o/ /gang ltar byed kyang rung ste/ 'di la gnyis/ mngal sbyor ba dang mthun par/ bzung ba dang mthun par sgom pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ rgya che rol pa sogs su/ lhums su 'jug pa'i thog mar mngal sbyong ba'i tshul gsungs pa dang mthun par gzhal yas khang gdan bcas bskyed cing rnam dag bsgom pa ste/

chos phung gi rnam dag gi 'jug tu/ de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis mngal sbyang ba'i nges pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / 'di la/ gzhal yas khang gi rten dang brten pa gzhal yas khang dngos dang*/ de'i rnam dag sgom pa'o/ / dang po ni/ phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi rnam bcu dbang ldan te/ gzhan yi ge ni/ gsal byed bdun dang*/ dbyangs a yig dang*/ tsheg drag gi rang bzhin zla tshes dang thig le rnams yin la/ a yig gi mtshon byed ni nā da'o/ /phyi nang gnyis ka'i a yig gi rang bzhin ni nam mkha'i khams so/ /phyi'i rlung sogs dgu ni rang ming gis bstan pa bzhin dang*/ nang gi dgu ni/ mngal bzung sa'i ma'i dpral mgrin snying lte'i rtsa 'khor bzhi dang*/ lto ba zlum po dang*/ gsang gnas kyi padma dang*/ de'i dbus kyi rtsa gsum mo/ /'di la sngon dang dus phyis kyi mkhas pa'i grags pa dang*/ 'khor bsdu ba'i las kyi bgo skal lhag pa mang po dag ni/ skabs 'di'i ri rab kyi steng gi padma zla nyi sgra gcan rnams dang*/ gzhal yas khang gi nang gi lte ba'i gtso bo'i gdan rnams gcig tu 'dod cing*/ sgrub byed ni/ 'og tu gzhal yas khang gi rnam dag sbyor bar bzhed nas/ de ltar thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dpag tshad 'bum phrag cig go /gsung gi dkyil 'khor 'bum phrag gnyis so zhes sogs gsungs pa rnams lung du 'dren cing*/ sku'i rtsa thig 'jig rten spyi'i rlung gi phyi mtha' dang tshad mnyam du 'dod la/ 'og nas gtso bo'i gdan gyi padma oṃ yig las skye bar rgyud 'grel gnyis kas gsungs pa dang 'gal ba spong ba ni/ kṣa yig dang 'dam kha yin no zhes zer la/ kha cig de dag gi steng du gtso bo la dus me'i gdan yang a bha ya dang sā dhu pu tras bshad pa bzhin nan gyis 'dod do/ /de ni shin tu mi 'thad de/ phyi nang gzhan gsum ka dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /phyi dang 'gal te/ khams ler/ ri rab kyi ra zur la phyogs skyong bcu po gnas nas dus 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor bsrung zhing de dag gi dbus na dus 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gnas par gsungs pa dang 'gal ba dang*/

'jig rten gyi rgya la dkyil 'khor gyi 'dod snam phan chod rta babs khor yug rdor ra me ri sogs lta zhogasku'i rtsa thig gi zur rnams kyang ma shong bar 'gyur ba dang*/ ri rab dang 'dzam gling chen po sogs ji ltar gnas pa ltar dkyil 'khor gyi nang yang de ltar du 'dod na/ ye shes 'khor lo dang*/ thugs 'khor lha snam gyi bar 'gyangs mtho dman la dpag tshad 'bum phrag gcig dang*/ gzhan thams cad ngos mnyam du 'gyur zhing*/ ci ste ri rab kyi steng du rdo rje'i sa gzhi'i khyon 'jig rten las che ba zhig bkal te| 'og gi sa chu rlung gsum gyi drang thad du thugs sogs dkyil 'khor gsum po yong bar byas nas sgom na'ang*/ 'jag ma slang ba'i steng du phub chen bkal ba ltar 'gyur bas/ tha snyad rnam gzhag las shin tu 'gal bar 'gyur ro| |nang dang 'gal te/ ma'i gsang gnas kyi padma dang rgya khyon mnyam pa'i pha'i nor bu ni rdo rje'i gur du gsungs shing*/ gur gyi nang du gzhal yas khang mtha' dag tshud pa dgos la/ khyed ltar na gur mtshon pa'i nor bus ma'i lus ril po yang bcu drug lhag pa non par 'gyur ba'am/ yang na rdo rje gur gyi nang du ye shes 'khor lo yang mi tshud par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan dang yang 'gal te/ padma oṃ yig las skye pa'i tshe/ rnam bcu dbang ldan 'jig pa'i phyir te/ ha oṃ ma la wa ra yaṃ zhes par 'gyur ba'i phyir dang*/ dus me yang 'dod na/ rnam pa bcu gcig dbang ldan du yang 'gyur bas dus kyi 'khor lo la legs par ma sbyangs bzhin du de'i rnam gzhag 'jog pa la rings pa kho nar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro| |des na ri rab steng gi padma dang rgya mnyam rdo rje'i sa gzhi sa 'bum bang rim nyis brtseg gi rnam pa zhig gis pad sogs bzhi ka non par byas te/ rnam bcu dbang ldan mtha' dag gzhal yas khang gi rten du go ba byas nas rdo rje'i sa gzhi de dang mnyam pa'i rdo rje'i gur gyi nang du khor yug bzhi dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum ka tshud pa dang*/

gur gyi phyi la me ri 'phro bar bya'o| |zhes bya ba ni kho bo'i grub pa'i mtha'o/ /'o na/ thugs 'khor dpag tshad 'bum phrag gcig par bshad pa sogs kyi 'grel pa ji ltar 'chad ce na/ de ni rnam dag sbyar ba yin te/ de lta ma yin na de ma thag tu lus la rnam dag sbyar ba'i tshe/ thugs kyi 'khor lo ni/ snying kha nas phrag pa'i bar dang gsung ni gru mo'i bar dang sbyar ba sogs yod pas thugs 'khor gyi tshad khru gang pa bsgom dgos par 'gyur ro/ /'di dag gis ni/ rgya bod kyi bde mchog smra ba mtha' dag rtog dpyod cung zad tsam yang ma bcug par mgrin gcig tu/ ri rab kyi steng du paṃ dang hūm̐ las skyes pa'i sna tshogs pad rdor de nyid/ phyis rdor ra me ri dur khrod kyi gzhal yas khang yan lag dang bcas pa thams cad mngon byang lnga'am bhruṃ las bskyed pa de'i nang gi yan lag gi sna tshogs pad rdor dang*/ khyad par sna tshogs padma chung ngu de gtso bo snying po'i rnal 'byor ma dang bcas pa'i gdan gyi sna tshogs padma de nyid yin no| |zhes smra ba yang legs par bkag ste/ mngon byang lnga las rdo rje'i ra ba skyes pa'i tshe 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi zhig skyes sam ma skyes/ skyes na de sngar gyi sna tshogs padma dang ri rab kyi bar du ji ltar 'jug ma skyes na ra ba de 'og gzhi gang dang sbrel ba legs par soms shig gzhan yang rdor ra me ri dur khrod dang bcas pa mngon byang lnga las gsar du skye na de dag gi nang du tshud pa'i sna tshogs padma dang rdo rje yang gsar du mi skye bar grub zin mdun sgyur su ji ltar 'dod legs par gzigs la grub pa'i mtha' zhog cig de yang dpyad pas legs par dag pa'i khas len drag po gzhan phyogs la sdang smras dang bcas te smra ba dag gis legs par dpyad rgyu gzhan yang mang ste/ gzhan du bstan par bya'o| | gnyis pa ni/ spyir dgos kyi thig la mkhas par byas nas bsgom don blos longs kyi don spyi legs par 'char ba dgos pas/

phreng ba dang shradhā'i thig rtsa sogs la sbyang bar bya zhing*/ spyir bsgom bya dang blos longs kyi log rtog rags pa rnams ni/ 'di'i cha lag rten gsum bzhengs tshul dpal 'byor rgya mtshor bkag cing*/ dus 'khor dgos kyi thig la rten pa'i log rtog ni| 'di'i thig rtsa nyid du bkag zin pas de dag tu lta bar bya'o/ khyad par dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor bsgom bzhengs byed na/ rgyud 'grel las dngos su gsal bar ma gsungs mod kyi/ 'os med kyi rigs pa dang*/ chos dbyings gsung dbang sogs kyi rigs pa sbyar na/ bzhi pa rigs bsdus rdo rje'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor ram/ mgron thabs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes pa bzhi pa cig byed dgos pas sku 'khor nyis 'gyur gyi dkyil 'khor bzhi pa/ sgo dang rta babs sogs kyi mtshan nyid thams cad dus 'khor rang lugs ji bzhin pa cig gi nang du lha snam gyi sgo bzhi'i g.yas g.yon dang mtshams bzhir 'dus pa drug dang dra ba gsum/ mngon brjod de dkyil 'khor bcu po gru bzhi sgo bzhi phyogs mdog sogs dus 'khor ji bzhin la rta babs med pa dang*/

klu dang gtum mo'i padma 'dab brgyad re re ste/ bcu gnyis po bkod pa mdzes par bya ste/ mngon rtogs zur na gsal ba bzhin no/ /de ltar 'byung bzhi ri rab gzhal yas khang sogs thams cad kyang*/ spyir ye shes kyi snang ba gru bzhi sgo bzhi sogs kyi rnam par snang ba yin pas ngo bo ye shes yin par ni bsgom dgos mod kyi/ 'on kyang longs skus mi 'dul bar sprul sku khyad par can gyis 'dul dgos pa'i gdul bya'i snang ngo la 'char ba'i mchog gi sprul sku khyad par ba'i gnas dang*/ khyad par skye ba sprul skur 'khyer ba'i lam khyer gyi sprul sku'i gnas yin pas 'byung lus phra mo'i gzugs snang du bsgom par bya ba yin no| |de yang spyir thog 'bub kyi rnam gzhag rgyud dang rgya gzhung kun na mi gsal zhing*| khyad par sgo sbrag gi thog 'bubs la/ bod snga phyi dag 'og gzhi mnyam po la rang rang gi rgya phyed dpangs sogs byas pas skya dang thog gnyis ka bre nang bcug 'dod pa dang*/ phyi ma phyi ma g.yas bskor ltar byas pa'i nang du nang ma rnams bcug pa'i dbus ma thog rdzogs pa la tog gis spras pa'i skya bre nang bre bcug tu 'dod pa dang*/ phyi ma rnams thog rdzogs par stel mor phub pa'i steng du nang ma rnams brtsegs par 'dod pa dang*/ nang ma rnams rdo rje'i sa gzhi 'bur du dod pa'i steng du slong bar 'dod pa rnams las phyi ma shin tu legs te/ bde mchog gi 'khor lo bzhi po je mthor rgya gzhung mang po bshad pa'i rigs pa 'gre ba'i phyir dang*/ rdor dbyings dkyil 'khor nang ma la 'og gzhi 'dab ma bzhi brtseg kun snying gi 'grel par bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ sgo rkyang sbrag yin kyang*/ skya la rgya'i phyed dang*/ thog dbus ma'i tog gi rtsa ba'i bar gyi dpangs la rgya dang mnyam po las ma 'das pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang nang ma nang ma'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi'i 'bur po rnams phyi ma phyi ma'i mda' yab dang mnyam pa byas nas slang na 'chug med du yong bas thob thang de ltar bya la/

dkyil 'khor khang pa'i thog dpangs la ma tshud pa sogs la bzo thig cung zad byed pa sogs ni skabs dang sbyar bar bya'o/ khyad par/ deng sang lag len phran tshegs su snang ba'i gnad 'chug tshabs shin tu che ba cig la/ thugs 'khor gyi rtsig pa nang nas bsdud rim du byed pa ni bu ston rin po che'i gsung sgros zin bris su/ mngal du lus thog mar 'grub cing de nas ngag gi rang bzhin rlung dang de nas sems gsal ba dang mthun gsungs pa'i rigs pa dang*/ bi bhu ti'i sna 'chan sogs la yod gsung ba'i lugs la rten par snang na'ang shin tu mi rigs te/ rgyud 'grel gyi dbang le'i de rang gi thad na mi gsal yang*/ gsung sku gnyis kyi skabs na sor mo lnga dang dag pa sbyar te/ las 'jam po rnams la nang nas spro rim nges par dgos pa dang*/ drag po la nang nas bsdud rim byed par shin tu gsal bar gsungs zhing*/ nag dmar dkar gsum rlung me chu'i khams sam rdul mun snying stobs sam/ yid ngag lus gsum mam/ theg pa gsum gyis ra ba gsum/ /zhes pa dang sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'du ches/ /thugs gsung sku yi dkyil 'khor ro/ /zhes pa dang 'dra bar/ theg chen theg 'bring theg dman rnams nang nas rim bzhin las 'os med pa rnams kyi phyir ro/ /de ltar na lag len nor ba 'di dang*/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo sogs kyi gnam 'khor la lha rnams zhal phyir bstan du byed pa 'di drag las la bya bar gsungs pa kho na yin pas| 'di dag gis ni bod na dmag 'khrug shin tu dar ba 'd-i'i rkyen yang byas par nges so/ /der ma zad bu ston rin po ches gnam 'khor rnams la'ang yig mgo lha'i dbu sogs phyi la ston kyang lho byang go ldog pa man ngag yin gsung ba'i tshig zur la rten nas/ de ltar byed pa rnams kyis gnod sbyin mo 'khor 'og tu ma chug par rang sa 'dzin du bcug nas pho 'khor steng du shar nub las gzhan du go ldog byed pa'i lag len dar ba 'di yang mo rnams ngan dbang che zhing pho rnams brtan yang mi thob pa'i rten 'brel yang byed la/

kagṇi sogs la lho byang go slog pas 'jig rten spyi'i phyogs dang mthun pa ltar snang yang*/ lha gtso bo'i g.yas g.yon go log pa'i skyon 'byung bas/ 'ga' zhig gis skyon de spang ba'i phyir du gtso bo'i dbu shar lta byas pa mang du snang ba rnams ni gtso bo'i rgyab mdun log cing zhal nub bstan du btang bas shin tu ma rungs par gyur to| |de ltar na thams cad la da ltar gyi mngon sum la gros dris na skyon gcig rjes su gcig ldang bar nges pas rdo rje 'chang gi gsungs pa la bcos ka mi bya'o| |ci ste gsal kha gsungs pa rnams de ltar yin pa bden kyang mi gsal ba rnams blos dpyad nas ma bcos na nyes dmigasashin tu che'o snyam na/ de tsam gyi nyes dmigs yod na gsal por mi gsungs mi srid pas ma gsungs pa nyid kyis skyon yon chung bar 'grub pa yin no/ /de bzhin du lha snam 'dod snam sogs dkar por byas pa na dkar shas che ba ltar snang yang*/ zhi rgyas la de nyid yon tan yin pas mdzes chos su ma song ba dgos te/ dbang dgug la de dag dmar po dang*/ rmongs rengs la ser po dang*/ bsad skrad la nag por btang dgos pas de dag la'ang dmar shas ches pa sogs 'byung yang nan gyis sgrub dgos pa bzhin no/ /'on kyang mtshan ma gsum po gang 'god kyang lha khyim dmar po sogs tshon ris mi mthun gyis ma chung pa byas pa'i nang du gdan rnams kyang ma chad pa byas te bkod na rgyal bas ma bkag pa'i mdzes tshon du 'gro bas de ltar bya'i/ ri mo za zi sogs kyi mdzes chos rnams bdud kyi mtshan mar gsungs pas mngon sum ltar snang dang bstun par mi bya'o/ /rgyas par dkyil chog gi tshon pa sogs su bshad zin pas de rnams su lta'o/ /de bzhin du ye shes 'khor lo yan gyi rgyan tog dang rgyan sogs chad par byed pa mang du 'dug pa rnams kyang shin tu mi rung ngo*/ /gsum pa ni/ da lta grags che ba'i dus 'khor lag len rnams la 'di'i thad du/

rten gzhal yas khang gi rnam dag sgom pa mi byed pa rnams ni chad pa'i skyon du 'gyur te/ 'og tu brten pa lha la rnam dag sgom pa rgyas par byed pa'i phyir dang*/ 'di'i thad kyi 'grel chen du/ khams kyi rnam dag ye le la zhal 'phangs shing*/ chos phung gi rnam dag rtsa rgyud drangs nas gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na de gnyis ni nges par dgos la/ sngar bshad pa'i rgya khyon gyi 'khrul gzhi rnams kyang skabs 'di nyid du gsungs pas/ dbus nas sgo yi dang po'i mtshams ni/ /zhes sogs dbang ler gsungs pa'i dkyil chog tu bris pa rnams kyang spro zhing nus na dgos so/ /de yang nang lus kyi khru re dang phyi 'jig rten gyi dpag tshad 'bum phrag re sbyar nas gsungs pa bzhin du/ dkyil 'khor yang slob dpon gyi khrus 'jal bar gsungs pa'i thugs la khru gang dang*/ gsung la do dang*/ sku la bzhi yin pas/ phyi'i 'jig rten rgya dpangs gnyis ka'ang 'bum phrag bzhi pa yin pa dang*/ nang lus kyi rgya dpangs khru bzhi yin pa rnams dang rnam dag tshar re dang*/ sku'i rtsa thig nas rta babs kyi myos srung gong ma'i bar la phyogs rer sku'i sgo tshad bzhi bzhi ste/ sgo tshad de ni slob dpon gyi mtho gang yin pas phyogs gnyis sdoms na khru bzhir 'gyur ba rnam dag tshar gcig dang*/ de nas rdor ra'i mtha'i bar la de dang 'dra bar tshar gcig ste rnam dag tshar gsum sbyar zhing*/ me ri la bri bya rags pa la sgo tshad re tsam byed kyang mtha' med par 'phro bas mtha' la re kha mi bya bar gsungs pa'i phyir na tshad med pas rnam dag mi sbyor bar shes par bya'o/ khams kyi rnam dag ni/ gtso bor rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la sbyor ba'i kha dog sogs kyi rnam dag yin pas/ 'di la rten nas bod re re tsam gyis lus dkyil byas mod kyi rnam dag sbyar tshad lus dkyil du gtong na/ 'dus pa zhabs lugs sogs phal cher la lus dkyil dgos par 'gyur bas blo bzor 'gro'o/

/chos phung gi rnam dag dang dbang le'i rgyud dang 'grel pa'i thig rnams kyis ni dkyil 'khor gyi zhib cha mtha' dag bstan par shes par bya la| de yang grangs dang dbyibs la sogs pa de dang mtshungs pa tsam la rnam dag gi don du bzung na mi rung bas/ chos kyi phung po ni spyir sangs rgyas mtha' dag dang*/ khyad par rnam snang gi thugs rgyud kyi rtogs pa khyad par can yin pas de dang de gzhal yas khang gi cha shas de dang der shar ba'i rnam par go ba dang*/ phyi nang gi lus dang khams la sbyar ba rnams ni/ rnal 'byor pa rang rang gi snod bcud kyi snang ba'i steng gi ma dag pa'i dri ma rnams dag nas de dang der snang ba yin par da lta mos pa tsam byas pa yan chad kyang de dag gi dri ma sbyong byed du 'gro ba'i thabs yin la/ gtso bor gzhal yas khang gi mdog dbyibs thams cad bem chos su 'dzin pa'i lhan skyes 'khrul pa 'di legs par gzhom pa'i ched du shes par bya'o/ / gnyis pa la/ pha ma'i dkar dmar sbyong ba'i dang*/ bar do'i rlung sems dngos sbyong ba'i lam mo/ / dang po ni/ gdan dbus ma'i steng gi zla nyi'i rnal 'byor te/ 'di la spyir kyai rdor gyi cha shas 'ga' re dang 'khor chen sogs su/ lha gtso 'khor thams cad rang rang gi gdan so so'i steng du zla nyi kha sbyor sa bon dang bcas pa las skyed pa'ang 'byung mod kyi/ gdan dbus ma'i steng kho nar bsgom pa mang zhing lam gyi gnad la'ang 'chun che la/ de yang brtag gnyis rtsa rgyud du nyi zla kha sbyar gsungs pa la mi mnyam sbyor dang*/ bshad rgyud sambu ṭir zla ba kha sbyor gsungs pa la mnyam sbyor du grags shing*/ phyi ma la yang dbyangs gsal las so sor bskyed pas dbyangs gsal thabs shes kyi rang bzhin so sor ni byed do/ /de lta bu yang na mngon byang gi me long dang mnyam nyid ye shes su byed pa dang*/ /zla nyi gnyis der byed pa gnyis kyi nang nas 'di phyi ma dang mthun pas kyai rdor rtsa rgyud dam bsdus rgyud dang mthun shas che zhing*/

zhabs lugs rgyas pa rnams su zla ba gnyis dbyangs gsal las skyes shing mtshan pa thabs shes so so ba gnyis ka me long ye shes dang*/ de gnyis dbyer med du 'dres pa mnyam nyid ye shes su gsungs la/ bde mchog skor du zla ba gcig nyid dbyangs gsal gnyis ka las skyes shing dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa dbyangs gsal gnyis kas mtshan par byas pa'i dbyangs dang dkar cha me long dang*/ gsal byed dang dmar cha mnyam nyid du'ang gsungs te/ 'di dag ni ma rgyud cha mthun dang bcas pa nas 'byung ba'i mngon byang zhes bya la/ yo ga'i rtsa rgyud du sems so sor rtog pa dang byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ brtan pa'i rdo rje dang*/ rdo rje'i bdag nyid dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ji lta ba bzhin las byang chub pa ste lnga dang*/ 'dus pa 'phags lugs sogs su/ de bzhin nyid dang zla ba dang sa bon dang phyag mtshan dang sku rdzogs pa las byang chub pa ste lnga gsungs pa rnams ni pha rgyud cha mthun dang bcas pa nas 'byung ba'i mngon byang ngo*/ /'di snga ma dang mthun shas che mod kyi/ ma rgyud ji bzhin rang ni ma yin no/ /de dag la zla ba 'og dang nyi ma steng du byas nas kha sbyar gyi bar du sa bon 'jug pa sogs gang dran lta bus chog pa'i rnam gzhag rags pa las med la/ 'dir ni phyi nang gnyis ka'i sgra gcan dang nyi ma'i bar du zla bas chod dgos pa bzhin du/ 'dir yang nyi ma 'og tu nges par dgos pa dang*/ dri za'i rang bzhin hūm̐ yig kyang zla ba'i steng gi dbus su zhugs nas gcig tu 'dres pa'i rnam gzhag zhib mo khyad par can mdzad do/ /dbyangs gsal gyi bshad pa rgyas pa ni/ sgra ka lā pa'i spyi don du bshad pa ltar yin la/ gsang sngags spyi dang sgra mdo gnyis nas 'byung ba'i dbyangs gsal gyi grangs dang*/ yi ge'i bsdu ba sogs ni phyi rol pa la'ang grags pa'i kun rdzob 'jig rten dang bstun pa'i brda chad dang*/ dus 'khor 'grel chen sogs sems 'grel gsum las 'byung ba rnams ni rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dang spyan ras gzigs kyis mdzad pa'i sgra mdo nas 'byung ba don dam nges don gyi rnam gzhag tu dbyangs 'char gyi mdor bsdus kyi mgo dang tshe 'khor gyi thad du gsal bar gsungs so|

|de yang dbyangs la stong chen yig lnga'i rang bzhin rtsa ba rang byung gi yi ge lnga dang*/ de'i ring po lnga dang*/ yon tan lnga dang*/ 'phel ba lnga dang*/ yaṇr bsgyur ba ring thung gnyis te phye na sum cu las/ rtsa ba dang yon tan dang yaṇa thung ngu lnga rnams la thung ngu bco lnga/ lhag ma la ring po bco lngar gsungs shing*/ thung ngu'i mthar thig les brgyan pa ni dkar phyogs kyi rang bzhin thabs dang*/ ring po'i mthar tsheg drag gis brgyan pa ni nag phyogs shes rab tu gsungs la/ de ltar na thung ngu g.yon skor dang ring po g.yas skor du bkod pas kha tshur ltas kyi g.yon du thung ngu dang g.yas su ring po 'byung bas dkar cha g.yon thabs dang*/dmar cha g.yas shes rab tu 'byung bas gsang sngags gzhan dang mi mthun par 'byung zhing ma mthun pa nyid nang gi g.yas g.yon dang 'grig par 'ong ba yin la/ gsal byed la yang*/ gzhan la grags pa'i sde pa lnga po yang ta sde sa khams pa yin pas pa sde chu khams pa'i mjug tu bton na khams mi 'khrug pa sogs yin la/ gzhan du 'byung ba'i mthar gnas dang dro ba'i rnam gzhag mi byed par/ sa sde/ ha sde gnyis zur du phye ba'i sa sde'i sa ṣa sha gsum ni dro ba'i nang tshan gsum po yin zhing*/ de gsum gyi steng du ྈྐ lce rtsa can dang ྉྤ mchu can gnyis bsnan pa dang*/ ha sde'i ha ni/ dro ba bzhi pa dang*/ gzhan bzhi mthar gnas bzhi ste/ lnga po 'di la dbyangs yaṇr bsgyur ba lnga ni dbyangs su dang*/dbyangs kyi lus 'gyur ma yin par dang po nas gsal byed nyid du gnas pa lnga ni gsal byed du bgrangs par shes dgos so/ khyad par skabs 'dir/ bzhi bcu phrag gnyis dgos pa byung ba na/ lugs gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin ḍa ḍha gnyis dang*/ ya wa la rnams lhag po re bgrangs pa la/ la sde zhes btags nas de ltar bzhi bcu po thung ngu g.yon skor dang ring po g.yas skor byas pas snga ma bzhin 'byung ba'i zla ba dbyangs bcas gzugs sku'i mtshan dang chos sku'i me long*|
