nyi ma gsal byed dpe byad brgyad cu dang mnyam nyid de/ gzhi la pha ma'i dkar dmar yin pas lam dus su'ang phyi nang gi zla nyi/ gzhan gyi yi ge dang sku gnyis kyi yon tan thams cad dbyer med kyi ngo bo dang rnam pa zla nyi yi ge rnams shin tu gsal bar bsgom dgos pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngar nam mkhar bkod pa'am ma bkod kyang rung ste/ zla ba'i dbus su zhugs pa'i hūm̐ yig 'di nyid phyi'i sgra gcan nang gi kun gzhi'i rnam shes cha dang ye shes cha gnyis kyi phyi ma gzhi'i dus 'khor mkha' khyab mkha'i rdo rje can 'khor ba bsdud pa'am ldog pa la gtso bor zhugs pa dang snga ma skye ba len byed dam/ 'khor ba 'dzin byed du nang ler gsungs pas 'dir yang rnal 'byor pa'i kun gzhi'i rnam shes cha srid pa bar do'am/ dri za'i rnam shes/ gzhan sor rtaug ye shes/ longs skus sprul sku'i skye ba 'dzin par mdzad pa'i ye shes rnams dbyer med kyi nga rgyal dang rnam pa gnyis ka shin tu gsal bar bya ba ni|

mngal 'dzin pa dang mthun par bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor khyad par can du yid ches pa'i gnas so/ /gsum pa skye ba sprul skur 'khyer ba'i rnal 'byor la/ mngal gyi gnas skabs sbyong ba dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog btsas ma thag pa nas lo bco lnga'i bar sbyong ba las rgyal mchog lo bcu drug pa'i bde ba sbyong ba thig phra'i rnal 'byor ces pa'i chings byas kyang rung mod kyi/ rdo rje bzhi'i rgyud yin pas/ bsnyen sgrub bzhi'am rdo rje bzhir thog mar phye nas/ sku rdo rje bsnyen pa'i yan lag lus gtso bor gyur pa mngal gyi gnas skabs gtso bor sbyong byed dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog la/ 'chi ba chos sku/ bar do longs sku/ skye ba sprul sku'i rnal 'byor gsum du phyai na'ang legs par 'ong ngo*/ /gang ltar na'ang*/ 'di man chad kyi dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog la/ gtso bo yab yum mtshan ma dang bcas pa mngon byang las bskyed pa/ yum gyi mngal du dkyil 'khor rgyas par bskyed nas spro ba/ gzhan don sems can la snying rje'i dbang bskur sbyin pa/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i nga rgyal bzung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ kha cig 'dir nus ma mtshan ma rnams mngon byang las mi bskyed par bskyed chog zur du byed pa ni mi 'thad de/ de rnams gtso bo yab yum gyi mngon byang lnga bskyed dang*/ lha gzhan gyi mngal 'byin khyad par can gnyis la ma the bas mgron btsun bzhin du 'gyur ba'i phyir dang*/ de dag bde mchog gi mkha' 'gro ma sogs bzhi po dang 'dra bar gtso bo nyid kyi rjes su spyod pa'i yum yin pa'i phyir dang*/ phyi la gza' gzhan rnams nyi zla dang de gnyis sgra gcan du 'dus tshul dang*/ nang gi rlung bcu steng 'og gi srog thur gnyis su 'dus tshul dang*/ gzhan la phar phyin bcu ka shes rab dang ye shes su 'dus tshul sogs ma shes pas/ nus ma brgyad ka sna tshogs yum dang rdo rje dbyings phyug mar 'dus tshul ma shes shing*/

las rgyal mchog tu yang*/ de dag gi bskyed chog gtso bo yab yum dngos dang mtshungs par mdzad pa yang ma rtogs par zad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rdor phreng nag po tshun gyi lha dang mtshan ma thams cad mngon byang las gcig car du grub pa rnams rim gyis gsal 'debs par shes par bya'o/ /de dag kyang rten 'brel dang po gsum gyi rang bzhin mngal zla dang po gsum gyi skyon sbyong zhing*/ snying kha'i rtsa rlung phra mo bcu po sbyong byed du gsal bar gsungs pas de'i snang zhen brtan pa gal che'o/ /de la yang mngon byang tha ma gnyis las/ dang po bya grub ni/ snga ma'i dkar dmar rnam shes gsum gcig tu 'dres pa las rnam shes kyi bzhon pa srog rlung nag po mtshon byed haṃ yig nag po bya grub bam don grub kyi phrin las kyi rang bzhin rlung khams pa'i ngo bor legs par bsgom dgos so/ /'dis kyang dus 'khor ma rgyud kho na yin pa bkag ste/ ma rgyud las bya grub ye shes rlung du sgom pa ma bshad cing*/ 'di pha rgyud dang bstun pa'i phyir te/ pha rgyud du ni rgyal ba'i sgrub gzhi'am lam gyi sbyang gzhi phra mo la rlung gi tha snyad gtso bor mdzad pa'i phyir ro| |de yang rnam shes gtan med kyi bzhon pa rkyang pa ma yin gyi rlung sems phra mo 'dus pa yin kyang gtso bor rlung shas che ba tsam gyi dbang las de'i ldog pa nas bsgom pa yin no/ /ye shes tha ma chos dbyings ni/ thig le dang rnam bcad dang ha srog med dang*/ srog gi a yig rnams ni/ dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi rtsa ba dang*/ de gnyis kyi srog gdangs su ma thon pa'i nā da dang*/ thon pa'i rlung rnams yin la/ de rnams phyi'i zla nyi sgra dus/ nang gi dkar dmar sems rlung*/ gzhan me long la sogs ye shes bzhi yin pas de rnams gcig tu 'dus pa'i yi ge ni haṃ yig ste/ de yang ngo bo mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen mtshon byed dang*/ de nyid gtso bor thugs yin la thugs nyid skur snang ba ni stong gzugs ye shes kyi sku yab yum zhal sbyor sogs su snang bas na/

sku'i cha shas yongs su rdzogs shing dag pa'i rnam shes ham̐ yig dang ldan pa ste/ mngon byang gi bskyed 'bras la sku thugs kyi mtshon byed gnyis ka gsal bar yod pa 'dis kyang dus 'khor ni bskyed rim kyang gzhan las mchog tu grub bo/ /sku'i phyag tshad dang cha shas phra mo rnams kyi rnam gzhag ni dpal 'byor rgya mtsho na gsal la/ phyag gi 'gyed tshul blo yul du 'char dka' bar byed mod kyi/ 'di la ni/ rtsa ba phrag pa phyogs rer gsum gsum la bar lhu drug drug dang de re re la phyag ngar gnyis gnyis gyes pa 'bro pa'i lugs ltar byed la/ bde dgyes sogs la ni phrag pa gcig la bar lhu'i rtsa ba nas du yod gyes pa yin pas rtsa ba dpungs mgo nas dgyes par 'dra la/ yas 'gyed mas 'gyed ni/ rtsa phyag gnyis thugs ka man gyi smad phyogs na yod na mas 'gyed dang*/ spyi bor bsnol ba sogs stod phyogs na yod na yas 'gyed bya zhing*/ de yang phyag mgo rnams rim gyis je mtho dang je dmar song ba'i don du shes par byas nas bsgom pa dang 'bri ba dang 'bur ma bzhengs pa sogs bya'o/ /phyag mtshan rdor dril kha ṭwāṃ dga dang ral gri sogs kyi tshad dbyibs kyang dpal 'byor rgya mtshor blta'o/ /yab kyi phyag mgo rnams cung zad thur du 'phyang ba dang yum gyi phyag mgo rnams gyen du phyogs pa byas na/ yab kyi phrag pa'i thad kyi bar stong yum gyi phyag mgo rnams son pa'i sgo nas shin tu mdzes par 'byung gi yab kyi phyag ngar rnams kyi nang la yum gyi phyag mgo yod par byas pa mi mdzes shing*/ yum gyi zhabs bde dgyes bzhin du yab kyi brla la 'khril ba'ang 'di la mi rung ste/ yab g.yas rkyang gi stabs la yum g.yon rkyang gi stabs kyis 'khyud pa yin pa'i phyir ro| |yum gyi smad g.yogs ring po 'jol thabs su byas pa dang*/ gcer mo sked rgyan gyi za ra tshags thung ngur byas pa gnyis ka mi mdzes pas smad g.yogs med pa'i gcer mo la za ra tshags 'jol thabs shin tu mdzes par bsgom zhing bzhengs par bya'o/

/me'i mda' dang*/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo la padmas mtshan ma mtshan sogs ni phran tshegs yin la/ gdan gyi dus me ni/ ro mnyam gyi skabs kyi 'grel par dang gis phye nas bsgyur mod kyi/ rtsa bar me zhes 'byung ba'i 'grel pa yin pas dus kyi me ste sgra gcan zhes bsgyur bar bya ba yin pa'i phyir dang*/ gzhan stod smad kun tu gsum las mi 'byung zhing*/ dag pa yang rtsa gsum dang sbyar gyi bzhi dang ma sbyar ba'i phyir dang*/ sa bon yang gsum las ma gsungs shing*/ phyi la'ang gsum brtsegs pa dang nang du'ang rtsa gsum 'dus pa yong gi bzhi ka brtsegs pa dang 'dus pa mi srid pa'i phyir dang*/ me dang mun pa zhes pa'ang sgra dus gnyis ka'i spyi ming yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ci ste/ dbang mdor bstan du/ lte ba'i steng du kun 'dar ma/ /gang de yid bzang mun pa can/ /'og tu khu ba 'bab gang de/ /mkha' 'gro gdong dang dung can ma| |zhes dbu ma'i lte ba yan la sgra gcan dang*/ man la dung can ma/ zhes so sor gsungs pas gzhi la rtsa'i gtso mo bzhi yod pas de dag sbyong ba yang bzhi dgos so zhe na/ de lta na/ steng du zla nyi sgra gcan gyi rtsa gsum/ 'og tu bshang gci khu ba'i rtsa gsum ste/ rtsa'i gtso mo drug tu bshad pa mang mod kyi/ bzhir bshad pa med pas drug brtsegs kyang dgos par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'dod chags chen pos gdul bar bya ba'i sems can zhes sogs 'grel tshig sor bzhag lta bu ste/ ye shes zhabs lugs su snying rje'i dbang bskur gyi bshad pa bzhin te/ spyir sngags lam thams cad la chags lam zhes grags pa ltar bde chen gtso bor dgos shing*/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud las| ting nge 'dzin gyi thog ma rang 'dod chags chen po'i tshul gyi ting nge 'dzin gsungs pa ltar byed pa'o/ /de yang gtso bor bsgrub par bya ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams dam tshig pa rkyang pa min gyi ye shes pa phyi rol nas spyan drangs pa rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i dkyil 'khor par bya ba'i ched dang*/

de yang da lta rnal 'byor pa rang dang rgyud tha dad du snang ba'i phyi rol gyi ye shes pa spyan drangs nas rang yab yum la bstim pas phung khams sogs byin gyis rlob par yang 'gyur mod kyi/ de ni rgyud sde 'og ma dag dang bstun pa'i byis pa'i skye bo drang ba'i don tsam yin la/ nges pa'i don la nang lus kyi phung khams skyai mched lha'i rang bzhin du gnas pa rnams 'dod chags chen po'i rnal 'byor gyis legs par zhu ste yas babs mas brtan la sogs pa'i sbyor bas mnyes par byas pa'i byang chub kyi sems dang phyi rol gyi lha yang ro gcig tu gyur pa las dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i don du yin no/ /de ltar sgrubs pa'i dkyil 'khor du mtha' med pa'i sems can bkug pa rnams la/ phyi nas spyan drangs pa dang*/ lus la gnas pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad zhu ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyis nang dbang rgyas par bskur bas de thams cad sprul sku sna tshogs su sangs rgyas pa'i phung sogs so gnyis po thams cad mtshan so gnyis su gyur pa'i lha so gnyis kyis brgyan par byas nas rang rang gi zhing du gshegs par mos pa ni dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi rnal 'byor gyi ngo bo yin la/ de yang gzhi la med pa gcig lam gyis gsar du sgrub pa gtso bo min gyi/ gzhi la yod pa'i rang bzhin gyi dag pa'i phung khams skye mchaid rnams sngar grub zin gyi 'bras bu'i sangs rgyas dang ngo bo gcig par gnas pa bzhin du yid ngor yang de dag gis byin gyis rlabs shing dri ma sbyangs pas gnas skabs yang gcig tu song bar mos pa'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa ni/ su bi shuddha dharma dhā tu zhes pa shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin du nga rgyal byed pa ste/ de yang 'khor 'das thams cad mthar thug gi chos dbyings de bzhin nyid ngo bo gcig par ma zad| gnas skabs kyi chos dbyings stong gzugs sam/

gzhom med kyi stong gzugs kyang ngo bo gcig par don la gnas kyang*/ thabs mkhas khyad par can 'di lta bu ma shes kyi bar du de ltar ma rtogs pa de rtogs par byas nas yid ches pa'i nges pa brtan po 'dzin pa ni nga rgyal gyi don no/ /de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog mtha' dag spyir lus ngag yid ye shes bzhi'i nang nas lus sbyong byed dang*/ mngal btsas gnyis kyi nang nas gtso bor mngal sbyong byed du gsal bar gsungs la/ de yang mngal zla dgu la/ sngar gyi gtso bo yab yum mtshan ma dang bcas pa rnams/ rten 'brel dang po gsum gyi rang bzhin mngal zla dang po gsum sbyong ba sku rdo rje'i gnas skabs dang po/ 'di nas thugs dkyil rdzogs par spro ba ni/ rten 'brel de 'og gsum gyi rang bzhin mngal zla bar pa gsum sbyong ba/ sku rdo rje'i gnas skabs gnyis pa/ de nas 'dod phyir 'dod rdzaugs par spro ba'i bar ni/ rten 'brel de 'og gsum gyi rang bzhin mngal zla tha ma gsum sbyong ba sku rdo rje'i gnas skabs gsum pa'o| |thugs dkyil la yang*/ gshegs pa gshegs ma spro ba mngal zla bzhi pa| sems dpa' spro ba mngal zla lnga pa/ sems ma spro ba mngal zla drug pa dang sbyar nas gsungs shing*/ de ltar thugs 'khor thams cad mngal du snying kha'i rtsa bcu 'grub pa dang sbyar ro/ /'o na nang ler/ mngal du zla ba gnyis pa nas snying kha'i rtsa skyai bar bshad pa ci zhe na/ de ni phra mo tsam 'grub pa la dgongs la| 'dir rtsa nang gi rlung dang bcas pa la sbyor ba yin no/ /de ltar na mdun bskyed bum bskyed bstod ring sogs la ni sbyang gzhi'i rim pa sogs dang sbyar mi dgos shing*/ las rgyal mchog mngal sgor 'thon ma thag gi rlung dang sbyor ba la'ang 'di 'dra'i rim pa med pas/ khro bo dang sems dpa'i go rim sogs nang nas rim bzhin byar rung yang*/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog la ni de lta bu'i gang bde bde mi rung zhing*/

sems dpa' sems ma gcig car spro ba yang phyag len rags pa yin mod kyi/ sems dpa' rdzogs nas sems ma spro ba ngag 'don la'ang dgos la/ ye ma grub na'ang yid kyis mos pa nges par bya dgos te zla ba snga phyi yod pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang snying kha'i rtsa brgyad kyi nang tshan snga phyir grub tshul dang*/ lha'i gshegs pa dang sems dpa'i snga phyi sogs sbyor ba ma yin gyi/ phung khams dang*/ de rjes kha dang rkang lag bshang lam/ de rjes mig sogs dbang po/ de rjes gzugs sogs yul rnams rdzogs par 'grub pa bzhin du lha spro bar gsungs so/ /gsung 'khor man la yang zla ba bdun par tshor ba'i chos/ lte ba dang mgrin pa'i rtsa 'grub pa bzhin du gsung gi rnal 'byor ma/ brgyad par sred pa'i chos dpral ba dang gsang gnas kyi rtsa 'grub pa ltar tshes lha spro zhing*/ tshangs bug dang bshang lam gyi bu ga dang rkang lag gi mthil 'grub pa ltar khro bo| de nas dgu pa la lag pa dang rkang pa'i sor mo 'grub pa ltar klu dang rab gtum ma/ de nas skra ba spu ltar khor yug gi lha/ /de nas bcu pa la snying kha'i rtsa bcu las rlung phyir mi 'pho yang nang du rgyu ba ltar gzungs ma 'dod phyir 'dod rnams spro bar gsungs so/ /snying rje'i dbang bskur ni/ zla ba bcu pa'i mthar mngal sgor 'thon du nye ba'i skabs su phung khams so drug rdzogs par 'grub cing bde sdug gi tshor ba mtha' dag mngon du 'gyur la/ rlung mtha' dag rtsa nang du rdzogs nas sna sgor 'byung 'jug mi byed pas mngal du mngon shes 'byung bar sems 'grel skor gsum nas gsungs pas/ de dag dang tshul mthun zhing*| de'i dri ma sbyong ba'i bsgom rim khyad par can yin pas/ 'phags lugs kyi lhag mos kyis mdzad pa dang*/ zhabs lugs kyi snying rje'i dbang bskur dngos dang tshul mtshungs kyang gnas skabs sogs kyi sgo nas sbyang gzhi dang sbyor tshul ni 'di nyid khyad du 'phags so/

/mngal zla rnams su rtsa khams 'grub tshul sogs ni nang le'i tshigs bcad brgyad pa sogs su gsungs pa spyi don du legs par blta bar bya zhing*/ mngal zla rten 'brel bcu gnyis dang sbyar nas skabs 'dir gsungs pa la chos mthun sogs kyi rgyu mtshan sbyar ba ni rgyud 'grel du ma gsungs sha.ing*/ mkhas pa dag gis kyang ma bshad mod kyi mngal zla dang po gsum khyab 'jug gi 'jug pa bcu'i nang nas nya dang rus sbal phag pa'i gnas skabs yin pas/ lus sems gnyis ka mi gsal ba dang*/ cung zad gsal bar 'du byed pa dang*/ rnam par shes pa cung zad rags su song bas rim pa bzhin ma rig pa dang 'du byed dang rnam par shes pa'o/ /zla ba bzhi par lus kyi ming bzhi'i phung po dang gzugs phung rnams gsal du song zhig lnga par dbang po drug dang*/ drug par yul dbang rnam shes gsum 'dus te reg pa'i reg pa thog mar 'grub pas/ rim pa bzhin/ ming gzugs dang*/ skye mched drug dang*/ reg pa'o/ /bdun par bde sdug so sor rig pa'i tshor ba dang*/ brgyad par yul yid 'ong la sred pa dang*/ dgu par yan lag skyed de/ sred yul len pa la 'jug pas de gsum rim pa bzhin no/ /bcu par srid pa 'grub byed kyi las mngon 'gyur pa dang 'dra ba'i mngal sgor 'byung bar 'dod pa'i sems pa 'byung bas srid pa'o/

/'di dag ni/ nang ler/ mngal skyes rnams mngal 'dzin pa'i dus sbyor la chu srin dang*/ zla ba bdun pa la rlung mngon 'gyur ba 'byung ba la srog skye bzhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad nas nang gi nyi ma rlung yin pas de karka ṭa'i khyim du skye ba bzhin du phyi'i nyi ma'i skyes khyim karka ṭar bshad la/ khyim de gnyis la ma rig pa dang tshor ba'i rten 'brel gyi tha snyad ni/ khams ler/ khyim bcu gnyis dang rten 'brel bcu gnyis sbyar nas gsungs pa'i thad du/ zla ba bcu gnyis par grags pa rgyal gyi zla ba la chu srin gyi khyim dang rten 'brel ma rig par byas te rim pa bzhin du sbyar ba dang shin tu mthun la/ de dag phyi rol gyi zla ba spyi 'gro la sbyar ba bzhin du nang gi mngal skyes rnams kyi mngal bzung ba chu srin dang*/ srog skye ba karka ṭar gsungs pa 'di yang*/ bod kha cig phyi'i zla ba la 'dod pa ni/ mngal bzung tshad rgyal zla dang srog skye tshad chu stod zla bar 'dod dgos pas shin tu mi 'thad la/ phyi'i zhag re la 'char ba'i dus sbyor la sbyor ba'ang de dang 'dra bas/ rang lugs phyi rol gyi lo'am zhag gi dus sbyor dang mi bsgrig cing*/ mngal du skyes tshad kyi rang rang gi zla ba dang po chu srin dang*/ bdun pa karka ṭa sogs su byas nas rten 'brel dang sbyar ba rnams sbyang gzhir byas nas sbyong byed rim gnyis kyi lam phra rags rnams kyis sbyong bar shes par byas te/ gsang sngags spyi dang khyad par 'di pa'i lugs kyi 'khor ba'i nyon mongs gsum gyis bsdus pa'i yan lag bcu gnyis kyi gtso bo ni/ las rlung gi 'pho chen bcu gnyis phra rags su bzhed pa'i phyir ro/ /de dag gi rags pa rnams bskyed rim gyis sbyong la| de yang dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi mngal zla dgu la gsal bar sbyar zhing bcu pa yang sngar bshad pa rnams kyis shugs kyis thon par gsungs la/ skye rga gnyis gang la sbyor mi gsal yang*/

mngal sgor mthon ma thag pa la 'jig rten pa rnams skyes so zhes tha snyad byed pas de la skye ba dang*/ de nas bzung ste spyir khams rnams rim gyis 'gyur zhing*/ khyad par rlung 'byung 'jug gi 'pho ba bcu gnyis po rnams rim gyis 'gyur ba ni rga ba dang*/ mthar rgyun 'chad pa la shi bar byed dgos pas yan lag de gnyis gtso bor las rgyal mchog dang*/ phra mor na rnal 'byor gnyis kyis sbyong zhing*/ 'bring po rnams rdzaugs rim gyis spong tshul yang*/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang smin grol sbyor rgyu'i sor bsam gyis yan lag dang po bcu dang*/ srog 'dzin rjes dran gsum gyis tha ma gnyis po dang/ yan lag bcu gnyis po phra ba rnams kyi sa bon ni ting nge 'dzin gyis spong ngo*/ /de ltar na/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ni gtso bor mngal dang sbyar bas lus rdzogs pa sku rdo rje dang*/ lus kyi sdig pa sbyong ba dang*/ skye gnas bzhi'i nang nas mngal sbyong ba'i rnal 'byor du gsungs pa rnams legs par bshad pa yin la/ byang chub bzhi las rnam pa lngas byang chub par gsungs pa ni gtso bo'i bskyed chog mngon byang lnga'am ye shes lnga las bskyed pa la gtso bo dgongs la/ chos mngon pa dang*/ gsang 'dus rnam gzhag rim pa sogs su/ nur nur po dang/ nar nar po dang*/ 'khrang 'gyur dang*/ rkang lag 'gyus pa dang*/ skra spu sen mo chags pa ste mngal gyi gnas skabs lnga gsungs pa rnams sbyong bas sbyang bya la ltos te yang rnam pa lngas byang chub par gsal lo/ /rgyal mchog dang po 'di ni rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa zhes bya ste/ bskyed rim gyi lam 'gros gzhan kun tu yang mngon byang lnga bskyed rnams rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa la gtso bor sbyar zhing 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams cho ga gsum bskyed shas che ba'i phyir dang*/ rnam shes rgyu dang ye shes 'bras bur spyi dgos kun la grags shing*/ rgyu la 'bras bus rgyas 'debs pa'i dbang du byas nas rgyal mchog 'di'i gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpas rgyas btab gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/

mngon byang lnga bskyed rdzogs pa'i mjug tu mi skyod pa rab tu zhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa gtso bo mi bskyod pa'i ngo bor bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /des na kha cig gtso bo'i sku mdog sngon por yod pa tsam la bsams nas rdo rje sems dpar 'dod pa rnams kyis ni rgyu mtshan de dag ma go bar zad do/ /rang rigs kyi rgyas 'debs dang phyag rgya 'dod pa ni gsang sngags gzhan gyi rnam gzhag dang sgo bstun yin gyi lugs 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor du mi 'gro'o/ /thugs dkyil las 'phros pa'i lha nyer lnga ma ni/ gtso bo mi bskyod pa'am rdor sems zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ dpal 'dus pa lta bu bzhugs pa la gshegs pa gshegs ma bzhi bzhi dang*/ sems pa sems ma drug drug dang*/ sgo skyong bzhi po dang bcas pa bsgom par gsal te/ nus ma bum pa dang bcas pa spangs pa'i phyir ro| |des na de'i tshe gtso bo yang dpal 'dus pa lta bur 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi rang gzhung la bi bhu ti sogs kyi zhe na zhes pa sbyar nas phyogs sngar byed pa mi 'thad de/ /nus ma sogs bor ba'i tshe/ gtso bo yab yum zhal gsum phyag drug pa 'os pa'i phyir ro/ /des na dus 'khor la gtso bo zhal gsum phyag drug pa bzhugs pa mi rigs so zhe na/ zhes pa'i phyogs snga khong na gnas pa bsu nas/ lan du nyes pa med de/ rgyud 'di la bde mchog gi bzhugs stabs dang 'dus pa'i bzhugs stabs gnyis ka rung ste/ pha ma so sor rigs nges pa med pa'i phyir zhes pa'o/ /'dir thugs dkyil rkyang pa la rten nas dbang rdzogs par bskur tu rung bar gsungs pa la/ kha cig dbang rdzogs par bskur ba la dkyil 'khor phyi ma gnyis bkag par 'dod pa dang*/ kha cig nyer lnga ma la rten nas dbang rdzogs par bskur du rung bar yang 'dod cing*| de la gzhan gyis nus ma dang steng 'og gi khro bo ma tshang bas mi 'thad zer ba la/ nang le nas/

lha bcu gsum ma dang dgu ma la rten nas kyang dbang bskur bar gsungs pa'i skyon spong byed pa rnams 'thad par ma mthong ste/ phyi ma gnyis dbang la 'gog na nyams len la yang 'gog dgos shing dbang la dgos pa'i lha rnams ma tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor du de'i dbang bskur ba mi 'thad pas dbang bdun rdzogs par bskur na thugs dkyil nyid rgyas pa dgos shing*/ spyir rig pa'i dbang lnga'am/ 'di pa'i chu dbang tsam bskur ba la ni lha dgu sogs kyi kyang 'grub par khas blang par bya'o/ /bde mchog la rigs lnga med kyang rig pa'i dbang lnga yod do snyam na/ rigs lnga nyid mkha' 'gro ma sogs rnal 'byaur ma'i cha byad 'dzin pa'i sgo nas ma rgyud du byed pa yin no/ /des na nang ler/ ma mos bzung ba gso ba'i skabs su lha dgu dang bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du chu la sogs pa'i dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /zhes pa'i sogs khongs nas nad pa gang byung la dbang mtha' dag bskur bar 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/ /dbang ler/ slob ma mchog la dbang tshang ba dang*/ 'bring la dbang bdun dang*/ tha ma la dbang mi bskur bar dge bsnyen gyi bslab pa sogs kyis rjes su bzung bar gsungs shing*/ kun slong nad zhi ba tsam gyi bsam pa can ni tha mar yang mi rung ba'i phyir ro/ /des na nad pa rab sngar nas dbang rdzogs par thob pa sogs la dbang mtha' dag bskur du rung mod kyi| de la ni bris pa'i dkyil 'khor la lha dgu la sogs las med kyang dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs ting nge 'dzin gyis sprul nas der bskur bas chog cing*/ 'bṛng la dbang bdun yang de dang 'dra ba dang*/ tha ma la ni/ byab srungs spyir dgos kyi mjug tu chu dbang du tha snyad gdags su rung ba'i khrus chog rgyas pa dang*/ yid ches pa'i thabs su cod pan sbyin pa tsam bya bar rigs so/ rgyal mchog 'di la mngal du rten brten pa gnyis ka bskyed gsungs pas| rten gzhal yas khang yang dag tu gsal bar ma thon yang sngon du yid ngor grub pa dang*/

brten pa spros tshar ba'i mjug tu rten yang spros nas phyi dkyil la thim par mos pa ni nges par dgos la grub na ngag tu yang 'don par bya'o| |lha rnams kyi zhal phyag dang sku mdog sa bon sogs la dwogs pa dpyad pa ni 'og tu lhan cig tu bshad par bya'o/ /rgyal mchog dang po la sku rdo rje bsnyen pa'i yan lag ces bya ste/ sbyang bya lus sbyangs pa'i 'bras bu sprul sku'i sgrub byed dngos ni rdzaugs rim gyi sor bsam yin la/ de'i smin byed khyad par can ni rgyal mchog dang po 'di yin la/ 'di dag spang bya dang 'bras bu rags kyang*| gnyen po phra rim nas skyes te spang bya rags rim nas spong ba gzhung lugs spyi tshul yin pas 'di yang spong byed kyi lam ni phra ba'i phyir/ sor bsam ye shes dang nam mkha'i khams su gsungs pa ltar 'dir yang lam gyi ngo bo'i khams ni ye shes dang nam mkhar nges par 'grub pas/ lam gyi khams rnams skye rim spro rim du 'byung ba yin no/ /bsnyen pa zhes pa ni/ thob bya rdo rje 'chang la/ thun mong min pa'i lam gyi dbang du byas nas sngar mi nye ba las 'dir sleb nas nye bar gyur pas na bsnyen pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ces pa ni/ gzhi 'bras gnyis pa'i mngal gyi skabs na btsas pa'i dus kyi yul 'dzin tshul dang don byed tshul tsam med pas 'di la dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang phyi ma la las rgyal mchog ces bya'o/ /gnyis pa gsung rdo rje nyer sgrub kyi yan lag las rgyal mchog rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa ni sbyang gzhi'i gtso bo rlung yin la/ sbyang 'bras longs sku dang sbyong byed dam longs sku sgrub byed kyi gtso bo rdzogs rim srog 'dzin yin la de'i smin byed khyad par can te/ lam gyi ngo bo don grub dang rin 'byung gi rang bzhin rlung me'i khams pa yin zhing*| thob bya la snga ma las kyang nye bas nyer sgrub bo/ /'dir rnam pa nyi shu la/

rgya gar gyi gzhung las gsal kha ma mthong zhing*/ bod dag mi mthun pa mang du smra ste/ rong pa sher seng*/ glus bskul la/ lha mo bzhi/ ma sring sogs phyag rgya bzhi| tshad med bzhi/ 'bras bu bzhi/ sa sogs bzhi rnams bsdoms pas nyi shu zhes zer ro/ /bu ston rin po ches/ de glus bskul rkyang par song 'dug pas rgyal mchog spyi'i rnal 'byor mi 'thus pas na/ bskul ba lnga/ de las bzhengs pa lnga/ dgug gzhug bcing mnyes ro mnyam ste lnga/ dbang dang rgyas gdab bzhi ste nyi shu'am/ yang na snga ma bcu'i steng du/ rgyas btab bzhi dang dbang bskur drug ste nyi shu'o zhes gsungs*/ bla ma dam pa/ sbyang bya phung po lnga/ khams lnga| las dbang lnga/ bya ba lnga ste nyi shu sbyong bas rnam pa nyi shu'o/ /zhes gsungs*/ kha cigalus kyi sor mo nyi shu sbyong bas so zhes dang*/ kha cigagayas g.yon rlung dkyil 'khor bcu dang*/ de'i gnas bcu'o/ /zhes sogs smra mod kyi| 'dir bskul tshul gsum gsungs te/ rmi lam gyi shes pa gsal yang yul 'dzin tshul zhan pas/ gnyid sad pa'i ched du bskul ba dang*/ mngal du rlung thams cad rdzogs kyang sna sgor 'byung 'jug gi 'pho ba med pas de tshang ba srog rdzogs pa'i phyir du bskul ba dang*/ lo bcu drug gi mtshams su bde ba'i rten khu ba rdzogs kyang*/ bde ba ma rdzogs pas de rdzogs pa'i slad du bskul pa'o| |dang po ni/ skabs de bzhin du zhes pa'i dper gsungs nas/ phyi ma gnyis la/ 'dir bskul ba gnyis te zhes gsungs mod kyi/ bar pa ni/ skabs kyi bskul bya la ltos pa'i bskul ba dngos yin kyang*/ tha ma ni/ bskul mkhan lha mos byed pa'i rgyu mtshan dpe tsam du 'gyur ro/ /des na 'dir bskul ba gnyis te zhes pas 'khrul nas/ glus bskul bsdus rgyud rtsa rgyud kyi tshigs bcad so sos lan gnyis byed pa mi 'thad cing*/ mdor bsdus snga ma'i mjug tu phyi ma dang mtshams sbyor gyi tshul du gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan du byed pa'ang*/

sa chog gi mdor bsdus kyi mjug tu thig 'debs tshul zhib par gsungs shing*/ de ma thag pa'i thig gi mdor bsdus nyid du don de rgyas par bshad pas bsher thig 'debs thengs gnyis dgos par yang 'gyur bas mi rigs so/ /des na bskul tshul bar pa nyid 'dir gco bor bzung dgos te/ las rgyal mchog gi sbyang bya'i gtso bo rlung gi dkyil 'khor lnga dang sbyang 'bras kyi gtso bo de dag sgrib bral gyi dkyil 'khor pa yin pa'i phyir dang*/ bskul ba'i tshig la yang*/ spyan las/ bdag gi dkyil 'khor zhes pa sa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ mā ma kis/ chu'i dkyil 'khor sogs dang*/ thun mong du/ stong pa'i dkyil 'khor yang*/ sna bug gnyis kyi dbus nas rgyu ba'i nam mkha'am ye shes la bskul zhing*/ drang don dkyil 'khor gyi lha yang*/ sa khams pa dang chu khams pa sogs bzhengs pa'i slad du bskul ba yin pas/ rgyal mchog 'di ni gtso bor glus bskul dang sbyar dgos pas na/ 'dod pa snga ma nyid 'thad par mthong la/ sbyang bya la ltos na phyi ma'ang nye mod kyi/ rlung gi gnas dang sbyor ba mi 'thad pas/ g.yas g.yon gyi dkyil 'khor bcu po 'byung 'jug gis phye bas rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa'o/ /de ltar na rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa'i sgrub thabs kyi gtso bo rdzogs rim srog 'dzin gnyis yin la/ de gnyis kyis sbyang bya ni/ g.yas g.yon nyi zla'am bdud dang nyon mongs kyi rgyu ba nyid yin pas/ de gnyis kyang 'pho chung dkyil 'khor lnga lnga'i bdag nyid 'byung ba dang 'jug pa kho nar nges pas na gtso bor sbyang bya la ltos nas bzhag pa 'di nyid legs par bshad pa yin zhing*/ de bskul mkhan dang sbyar na snga ma legs pa yin no/ /de ltar na/ las rgyal mchog la lnga/ dam tshig pa bskyed/ ye shes pa gzhug /dbang bskur/ rgyas gdab/ rnam dag sgom pa'o/ /dang po la/ zhu ba glus bskul te 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin par bzhengs/

des dkyil 'khor lnga'i lha tshogs spros nas gnas su 'god pa'o/ /dngapo ni/ 'dir bskul bya gtso bo yab yum rjes chags kyis zhu ba'i theg le yin par mthun mod kyi/ snga phyi'i mkhas par grags pa kha cig nus ma mtshan ma dang bcas pa ma zhu bar 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ de gtso bo nyid kyi dgos kyi yum dang rdo rje bzhi yin pa'i phyir dang*/ 'dir spro ba'i 'grel tshig las kyang ye shes 'khor lo phan chad spro bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na zhal lung pa'i phyag bzhes ltar de dag kyang zhu ba bya'o/ /zhu ba'i rkyen 'di dang 'dus pa 'phags lugs la yab yum rjes chags kyi mes zhu bar dngos su bshad la/ zhabs lugs la bar srid yab kyi zhal nas zhugs pa yum gyi padmar babs kyi bar du ma zhu ba/ chos 'byung la reg pa'i rkyen gyis zhu zhing*/ de'i rkyen gyis yab yum gnyis kyang zhu bar byed pa'i bar srid ho dmar po gnyis kyi bar du chud pa'i 'bru gsum du yod pa dang*/'dir de dang rjes su mthun par bstan pa'i don du gtsug tor dang ltai ba'i a ba dhū ti'i nang du ho yig 'od zer dang bcas pa dang*/ de gnyis kyi bar du 'bru gsum bgod pa la dmigs pas lte ba'i ho yig gtum mo 'bar ba'i rkyen gyis zhu ba mdzad do/ /bskul mkhan gyi lha mo ni/ sngar gyi dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi lha rnams/ ra pas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ la bsdus zin par 'dod pa bus/ de ltar na glus bskul mkhan med pa'i skyon yong bas mi 'thad cing*/

kha cig sngar gyi rnams ma bsdus par gnas pa la las rgyal mchog gi mngal skyes rnams spros nas dam tshig pa la ye shes pa 'jug pa ltar byed pa yang mi legs pas/ rang gtso bo yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas dkyil 'khor lnga'i rang bzhin gyi sangs rgyas nam mkhar bzhugs pa rnams zhes pa'i skabs su bsdus nas ye shes 'khor lo phan gyi gdan stong par gnas pa la gsar pa rnams spro gsungs pa ltar byed na/ snying rje'i dbang bskur gyi skabs su/ rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams rang gi snying khar zhugs zhes pa/ phyi nas spyan 'dren pa yin la/ de dag dkyil 'khor la bkod pa rnams spyan drangs de zhu bas sems can la dbang bskur bar byed na/ bde chen 'khor lo ma bsdus pa 'dir chags pas zhu ba dang*/ glus bskul gyi lha mo zhabs lugs pa ltar rang gi tshad med bzhi po lha mor sprul nas bskul ba dang*/ sprul pa bsdus na'ang 'gal ba med pas/ de ltar na/ steng du nam mkhar bzhugs pa zhes pa drang don phyi rol gyi nam mkha' dang nges don rtsa nang gi nam mkha' la bya'o| |'dir rgyal mchog gnyis kyi khyad par la/ rwa pas/ dang po la lha thig le tsam las bskyed cing*/ gnyis pa la thig le las sa bon/ de las phyag mtshan| de las sku rdzogs par bskyed pa dang*/ dang po la sems dpa'i sngon du khro bo spros yang/ gnyis pa la mjug tu nges par spro ba dang*/ 'bro pas/ dang po la 'khor mi bskyed pa dang*/ ra pas snga ma ni/ phyi ma la lha rgyas par mi spro zhing rgyas par mi bsgom pa rnams ni 'dir sngon bzhin zhes rtsa 'grel las gsungs pa dang 'gal bas mi rigs mod kyi 'dir gtso bo mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can du gsungs pas ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa' yin zhing*/ rgyal mchog dang por de las ldog pas/ mngal skyes kyi gtso bo mi bskyod par gsus pas na/ 'dir rdor sems yab yum du byed dgos pas mngon rtogs su tshig ris ma thon kyang lag len la yod pa ltar bya'o/

/'di la kha cigagong du mngon byang lnga bskyed kyi nus ma rdzogs mtshams su/ de ltar rang gi phyag rgya dang bcas pa ste rdo rje sems dpa' rdzaugs pa'o/ /zhes sogs kyi dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi gtso bo rdor sems su bstan pas mi bskyod pa byed pa ni mi 'thad do zhes zer ba ni| spyir gsang sngags la rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa dang 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rnam gzhag dang*/ lugs 'di la rnam shes dang ye shes rgyu 'bras su bshad cing khyad par gzhan rigs kyi phyag rgya dang rgyas 'debs byed kyi/ rang rigs kyi phyag rgya rgyas 'debs byas na gzhan dang sgo bstun du 'gro yi/ rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam gzhag nyams par gsung pa rnams las gal che sa rang du 'gongs par 'gyur te/ rgyal mchog dang po'i gtso bo rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can du lan gcig min par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na mi bskyod pa rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas zhugs pa dang rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs bdag gi sgo nas rdzogs pa'o zhes sam/ yang na 'dus pa dang sgo bstun gyi gtso bo mi bskyod pa la phyag rgya'am yum du ma med kyang*/ gtso bo'i bzhugs tshul dang yum ma rgyud sgo bstun gyi rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag rgya'am yum du ma yod pas nus ma brgyad dang bcas pas phyag rgya'i sgo nas rdor sems rdzaugs pa'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /'dir rgyal mchog gnyis po la/ rnam pa lngas byang chub pas sku rdzaugs pa bsnyen pa'i yan lag dang*/ rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa ngag rdzogs pa nye bar sgrub pa'i yan lag tu gsungs pas/ sbyang gzhi lus ngagasbyong byed bsnyen pa nyer sgrub/ mngon byang dang sbyang 'bras sprul sku longs sku rnams la rtsod pa med cing*/ de ltar bskyed rim gnyis las gcig ni mngal skyes dang gcig ni sgong skyes zhes gsungs pas/ rgyal mchog de gnyis kyis skye gnas de gnyis so sor sbyong ba yang shin tu gsal mod kyang*/

bu ston rin po ches/ rgyud gzhan du/ sgong skyes glu ni med pa ste/ /sgra dang sgra min spangs pa'o/ /zhes sgong skyes la glus bskul med par gsungs la/ 'dir las rgyal mchog la/ glus bskul byung bas sgong skyes sbyong ba mi 'grig pas na/ sgong skyes sbyong byed kyi bskyed rim ni gzhal yas khang bskyed par la byed dgos te/ tshangs pa'i sgong nga zhes pa'i tshig zur gyis bstan no zhes gsungs zhing*/ bla ma dam pas kyang de ltar gsungs mod kyi/ sgong skyes rlung gi skye gnas can du yang yang gsungs shing*/ rgyal mchog gnyis pa 'di/ rlung gtso bor sbyong bas sgong skyes sbyong ba'i bskyed rim du dgongs par mngon zhing*| de bzhin du lha skad cig gis bskyed pa dkrongs bskyed du grags pa rdzus skyes sbyong bar dngos su gsungs pa 'dis/ cho ga gsum bskyed dang*/ sa bon rkyang pa las bskyed pa rnams drod bsher skyes sbyong byed du shugs la bstan par blta'o| |sgong skyes glu ni med pa ste/ /zhes sogs ni bskyed rim gyi lam 'gros ril po la glus bskul yod med la byed pas mi 'gal lo/ /'dir dam tshig pa bskyed pa la log rtog bdun te/ grangs dang*/ ngo bo dang*/ mdog dang*/dbyibs dang*/ gnas dang*/ gdan dang*/ thabs shes la log par rtog pa'o| |dang po ni/ kha cig thugs 'khor steng 'og tu mi bskyod pa yab yum dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum dang*/ yang nus ma'i cha dang thig le ma gnyis rnams spro zhing*/ kha cig 'og tu gnod mdzes yang spro ba ni mi 'thad de/ rgyud 'grel las mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /ci ste/ dbang bskur la rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi dbang yod cing*/ sgrub pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum las mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du spyan drangs nas slob ma'i lus kyi rdor sems la gzhug dgos pa'i phyir zhe na/ de ni gtso bo yab yum nyid las spyan 'dren pa yin te/

rdor sems mi bskyod pa gang yin dang por spro ba'i dus su yum gyi padma nas spros te/ bdag nyid la gzhug par 'dod chags chen pos 'dul bar zhes sogs kyi mjug gi 'grel par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ khyed ltar na de dag spros nas steng 'og tu bkod pas/ gtso bo yab yum bdag nyid la gzhug par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i 'grel tshig sub dgos par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du/ nus ma bcu yang sna tshogs yum gyi dngos bstan sher phyin ma'i rang bzhin thig le ma dang*/ sbas yum rdo rje dbyings phyug ma ste cha ma yin pas/ gzhan brgyad dang bcur byed pa yin gyi/ khyed la nus ma bcu gcig tu 'gyur bas| gtso bo la phar phyin bcu'i phyag rgya gsungs pa dang 'gal lo/ /gnod mdzes kyang thugs 'khor rkyang par dbang rdzogs par bskur ba la bya rung yang yongs rdzogs la mi gsal lo/ /byed pa'i tshe yang gtsug tor ltar zhal gsum phyag drug par byed dgos la/ 'dis kyang bsrung 'khor du gnod mdzes zhal gsum phyag drug pa mi rung ba la gnod cing*/ der ma zad/ yongs rdzogs la dbang len pa'i tshe yang*/ mchog gi dbang po dang gdub bu gnod mdzes su skyed pa'i tshe yang zhal gsum phyag drug par byed pa'i phyag len gyis kyang gnod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ snga rabs pa mang po thugs dkyil dang sku'i khro bo rnams ye shes pa'am 'jig rten pa las 'das pa yin gyi gzhan gsung 'khor phan gyi lha ni 'jig rten pa yin no zhes zer la phyis kyi mkhas pa dag kyang*/ rab gtum ma tshun gyi lha drug brgya sum cu so drug mtshan ma dang bcas pa ni gtso bo'i ye shes kyi cha shas yin pas lha chen bcu gnyis sogs 'jig rten pa'i mtshan yod pa rnams kyang 'jig rten las 'das pa yin mod kyi khor yug gi gza' bcu la sogs pa thams cad 'jig rten pa kho na'o/ /zhes zer mod/ rigs pa de 'di la yang mtshungs te/ khor yug gi lha rnams kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi ye shes kyi cha shas las gzhan du mi 'thad pa'i phyir te/

rten dang brten pa mtha' dag gtso bo nyid kyi cha shas yin pa'i phyir dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyi skra dang ba spu'i rang bzhin 'byung po phyed dang bcas pa'i bye ba phrag ces sogs mang du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang*/ phyi'i lha chen dang gza' dang klu sogs rang rgyud par grags pa rnams la'ang*/ 'dul ba lung sogs nas bden pa mthong ba dang*/ theg chen gyi mdo sde 'ga' zhig las sa brgyad pa dang bcu par bshad pa dang*/ gsang sngags las rgyud sde so so'i dkyil 'khor du bcug nas dbang bskur gsang mtshan btags par bshad pas/ de dag gi 'bras bu'i skabs kyi ye shes pa dang gtso bor gzhi'i skabs kyi rang bzhin lhan skyes sam shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems ye shes kyi sku rnams dang por bkug nas sgrub gzhir gtong ba dang ye shes dgug gzhug gi tshe yang de dag 'jug pa'i go rgyu 'char ba gal che'o/ / gsum pa ni/ slob dpon a bha yas/ lha chen bcu gnyis po thams cad phyogs bzhi so so'i mdog tu mdzad pa la bod snga mas lha lug khyu tsam gyi sku mdog nor zhes dgag pa byas pa la/ phyi rabs pas dgag pa phyir slog ste sdang smras mang po dang bcas nas a bha ya'i lugs bsrang ba ni/ ye ler/ gtso bo'i steng zhal nas spros pa'i gshin rje dang khyab 'jug sogs sku mdog ljang khu dang 'og zhal nas spros pa'i drag po dang gnod sbyin sogs thams cad sngon por gsungs pa dang 'gal zhing*/ de dag ni khams drug tu phye ba'i spros pa yin gyi| mkhas mchog a bha ya'i bzhed pa ni gtso bo'i dngos bstan gyi zhal bzhi dang bstun nas khams bzhir bsdus pa'i phyogs mdog yin no zhes kyang bshad par dkag ste/ de dag dang spro pa'i zhal gcig ba'i steng 'og gi sems dpa' sems ma rnams ljang khu dang sngon por mkhas pa de nyid kyis bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na paṇa chen de ni rgyud pha ma phyogs re ba'i rtsa bshad kyi dngos bstan la thugs zhen cung zhig ches pas gnyis med kyi rgyud dang sems 'grel la gtso bor mi byed pas nongs so/

/bzhi pa ni/ rwa pas/ tshangs ma dang gzhon nu ma sogs thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis par bzhed pa bzhin phyi rabs pa 'ga' re yang 'dod pa ni/ gdong bzhi ma dang gdong drug mar dngos su bshad pa dang 'gal bas bsgom par ma zad bzhengs pa la yang zhal bzhi dang drug la sogs pa nges par dgos shing*| rab gtum ma rnams dang 'byung po rnams khyi dang bya rog gdong can sogs su bshad pa ni/ sngags rnying ma ba'i lugs ltar 'grin pa yan chad srog chags de dang de'i mgo bor byed pa mi 'thad kyi/ lha'i zhal la de dang de'i sna dang mchu yod pa tsam du bya'o/ /lnga pa ni/ steng zhal 'og zhal nas spros pa'i phyag rdor kun bzang sogs la steng du 'og tu zhes pa'i 'grel tshig la rten nas/ kha cig lha ljang khu thams cad steng dang sngon po thams cad 'og tu 'god par byed pa ni/ 'grel tshig gi de ma thag tu lho sgo'i g.yon du bya'o/ /zhes sogs gsal bar gsungs pa la dngos su 'gongs pa'i mkhas khyad do/ /de bzhin du sgo skyong la 'or zer can sogs kyi ming gsungs pas 'khrul nas khro mo rnams gtso bor byed pa yang rtsa ba'i tshig la gtso bor byas pas 'grel pa dang 'gal zhing*/ rtsa ba'i yang ro mnyam sogs kyi skabs su khro bo sgo skyong gi gtso bor bshad pa dang 'gal bas sngon gyi mkhas pa gsung rab spyi dgos la legs par 'dris par mdzad pa rnams kyi rjes su 'brang bar bya'i/ legs par ma sbyangs bzhin du mkhas khyad 'don pa la rings par mi bya'o/ /drug pa ni/ gtso bo'i gdan gyi dus me ni gong du bkag zin la/ gsung sku'i srog chags rnams zla nyi'i tshab ma yin pa dang*/ gtso bo gtso mo'i bzhon par gsungs pas so zhes padma'i lte bar 'god pa mang mod kyi/ mkhas mchog bu ston la sogs pas padma'i gdan du bzhed pa ches legs te/ dbang le'i gdan gyi thad kyi rgya dper/ pre taṃ ta du pā ri ka ma laṃ aṣta da laṃ zhes/

tata ces pa de dang*/ u pā ri zhes pa steng gi skad dod yin pas/ yi dwags de'i steng du padma 'dab ma brgyad pa ces dang*/ sgrub ler yang de bzhin du 'byung ba'i lung dang*/ rab gtum ma'i 'khor lo 'degs byed dang*/ sgo skyong gi shing rta 'dren pa'i phyugs dang mtshungs pa'i phyir zhes pa'i rigs pas 'grub pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gtso bo gtso mo'i dgos kyi bzhon par gsung pa ni ma grub la| spyi tsam nas gsungs pa ni 'gal ba yin te/ khyab 'jug gi bzhon pa yin na 'khor rnams kyi yang yin dgos pa'i phyir te/ /dgos kyi 'khor rnams kyang rang rang gi gtso bo dang ngo bo gcig pa'i phyir/ des na padma zla nyi sgra gcan ni gtso bo bcom ldan 'das kyi gdan la dgos pa bzhin du rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor spyi'i gdan du yang dgos pa yin no/ /zla nyi'i tshab tu dgos pa'ang ma nges te/ sgo skyong dang klu dang rab gtum ma rnams la med pa'i phyir ro| |de bzhin du padma'i lte bar srog chags byas na mdzes kyi/ 'og tu byas na mi mdzes te/ glang gi steng du phub bkal ba lta bu 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa'ang rab gtum ma'i 'khor los gnod do/ /'khor yod med kyis mi mtshungs so zhes zer ba ni/ khyab pa la dngos skyon byung bzhin du chos can mi gcig go ces smra ba dang mtshungs so/ /bdun pa ni/ sngon dang da lta'i mkhas rlom dag tshes lha'i yum rnams ni rang rigs sku mdog phyag mtshan gcig pa nyid rigs kyi/ gzhan rigs la shes byed med de/ sbyang gzhi zla ba gcig pa'i phyir dang*/ sgrub gzhi rtsa 'khor gcig pa'i phyir dang*/ rgyu sa bon gyi sde pa gcig pa'i phyir dang*/ phyag mtshan ral gri nag po sum cu zhes sogs bshad pa'i phyir ro zhes zer ro/ /'di ni mi 'thad de/ sgrub byed phyi ma ma grub pa'i phyir dang snga ma gsum po ma nges pa'i phyir ro/ /phyi ma ma grub te/

bden bral gyi ral gri dang rlung gi dpag bsam gyi shing dang zhes sogs gsungs kyi grangs nges ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /snga ma gsum ma nges te/ nus ma brgyad kyi sbyang gzhi dang sgrub gzhi snying kha'i rtsa dang rlung yin pas sku mdog phyag mtshan gcig tu byed dgos par 'gyur ro/ /de la phyogs kyi nges pa sogs kyis khams tha dad do zhe na/ 'dir yang nya dang stong gi nges pas tha dad do/ /de bzhin du gshegs pa gshegs ma'i sbyang gzhi dpral ba'i rtsa 'khor dang*/ 'jigs ma sogs re bzhi'i lte ba'i rtsa 'khor ram/ dbyug gu re bzhi dang*/ lha chen bcu gnyis kyi lo gcig gi zla ba dang*/ 'khor rnams kyi chu tshod gcig gi dbugs sum brgya drug cu sogs sbyang gzhir gsungs pas sku mdog phyag mtshan gcig tu byed dgos par 'gyur la/ de dag la so sor 'byed byed gang yod 'dir yang mtshungs pas/ rigs pa'i gnod byed kyis mtha' 'khor ba'i dbus na rang nyid rigs pa smra ba'i gad rgyangs sgrogs pa ni/ smra ba po nyid sgrin po ma yin par gsal bar byed pa'o/ khyad par rgyud 'dir/ gzhan gyi rigs kyi dbang las bde ba dam pa'i don du 'gyur/ /zhes stod smad kun tu gsungs shing*/ ye le'i zhe bdun pa'i 'grel par rang rigs la gnod byed kyi bka' skyon mang du gsungs pa las 'gongs pas gnyis med dus 'khor gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i tshul las nyams shing*/ a ma ra ko ṣa'i 'grel par/ lha chen 'di dag ming rjes sring rjes su bshad pa dang ma bstun pas 'jig rten gyi tha snyad las rgal ba'o/ /des na dpal mo ni nor sbyin gyi sring mo dang*/ nor dbang ma ni khyab 'jug gi sring mo yin pa sogs su rig par bya la/ 'on kyang sa bon sde pa rigs gcig pa ni 'jug pa bde ba'i ched du gsungs pa'am/ rnam pa gcig tu na/ 'jig rten na'ang gzhan rigs kyi bud med blangs nas rang gi lha'i ming rigs dang mthun par byed pa bzhin mdzad pa'o|
|gzhan yang dbang bsgrub gnyis su lha dang padma'i sa bon mi gcig pa 'ga' re gsungs pa ni/

bdag bskyed dang mdun bskyed kyi khyad par ram| 'ga' zhig gnyis ka rung ba'i 'dam kha can yin pas/ slob dpon a bha yas sgrub le'i thugs 'khor gyi pad ma'ang dbang ler gsungs pa'i sa bon gyis bskyed par bya'i/ gzhan du na gzhung gong 'og 'gal bar 'gyur ro zhes zer ba ni/ sgrub le nyid du pad ma rnams oṃ las bskyed pa dang*/ oṃ gyi yi ge phral nas padma'i rtsa ba sdong bu sogs so sor bskyed par gsungs pa dang 'gal bas gnyis med kyi rgyud dang sems 'grel la ma sbyangs pa'i skyon no/ /de bzhin du sgrub ler gzungs ma bcu gnyis kyi rol gar byang dang*/ bdud rtsi ma dang 'bras bu ma 'og dang*/ glu 'dod steng du bkod pa ni/ snying kha'i rtsa bcu las steng 'og gi rtsa gnyis la lha mo gnyis gnyis dang gzhan rnams la re re sbyar bas/ 'og gi rtsa nas bshang gci 'dzag pas bdud rtsi dang 'bras bu ma| steng nas rlung dang khrag 'bab pas glu 'dod/ byang dang byang shar rol gar dag pas de gnyis bzhag pa nang lus dang sbyar ba gtso che la/ dbang ler mdun bskyed phyi rol yi ge'i khams gtso bor byas nas da lta grags pa ltar gsungs pa yang gnyis ka rung ngo*/ /'dod phyir 'dod/ dbang ler phyogs gzhan gsum gyi g.yas g.yon gnyis ka dang nub kyi g.yas su lnga lnga/ nub kyi g.yon du kṣa gcig pu las ma gsungs shing*/ sgrub ler skye mched sde tshan gyi sgo nas gsungs mod kyi/ g.yon phyogs rnams su bzhi bzhi ste phyogs rer dgu dgu byas na bkod pa snyoms shing mdzes pas/ la dang sa dang kaṃ ste sde pa sa khams pa gsum po nub tu blangs nas rgya bod mang pos mdzad pa ltar legs so/ / 'di dag kyang ngo bo ni/ bskyod pa dang lus la 'phrug pa la sogs pa lus kyi bya ba de dang de'i bsam pa'i sgo nas mtshan btags la/ phyir 'dod pa ni/ rwa 'gyur dang 'gyur mang ltar na 'dod pa las ldog pa ste mi 'dod mar bshad kyang*|

shong 'gyur ltar na 'dod pa phyi phyir 'phel bas chen por song ba la bshad du rung zhing*/ rdo rje snying 'grel du/ sa dang chu ni rnam 'dres pas/ /lus can kun gyis rgyas par 'gyur/ /zhes sogs dang sbyar na/ rlung gi sa tsa yig las skyes pa ni/ rlung dgra sa yin pas dbye bar 'dod par 'gyur zhes sogs su 'chad dgos shing bshad pa de nyid tsheg drag sbyar na 'dod pa dang thig le sbyar na mi 'dod par 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan med pas 'dod pa cher 'phel ba la bshad par bya'o/ /'on kyang sa bon gyi khyad chos ni rnam dpyad nyi ma'i chos yin pas gsung dang thig le zla ba'i chos yin pas sku la sbyar ba yin no/ /'di dag gi sku mdog ni bskyed byed so so dang 'dra la/ zhal phyag yang bskyed byed ji bzhin mdzad pa yod mod kyi/ 'di dag gzungs mar bshad pas mchod lha yin pa'i phyir dang*/ a bha ya/ bi bhū ti/ sā dhū pu tra/ bla ma dam pa sogs bod kyi mkhas pa 'ga' dang bcas pas zhal gcig phyag gnyis mar bshad pa ltar yin la/ phyag mtshan ni bskyed byed so so'i rtsa phyag gnyis sam/ yang na g.yas rnal 'byor ma so drug mchod pa'i tshogs 'khor gyi mtshan ma dang*/ g.yon thod pa'i nang du nang gi rdzas dang phyi'i rdzas so drug gi bdud rtsis bkang bar bya'o/ /klu rnams rta babs ka ba'i 'og tu 'god par gsungs pa'ang sgra ji bzhin du byas te/ bri bya la kha khyer steng dang sgom don blos longs la ka ba gar btsugs kyi 'og tu 'god par bya'o/ /mkha' lding a n-i la ni/ mkha' la lding ba gzhal med ces pa bya khyung yin la de yang khra'o ste/ chos dbyings gsung dbang sogs su cung zad mi 'dra ba gzhan bshad kyang sgrub le'i khyung khra'i sgrub thabs su 'byung ba ltar/ rkang pa nas lte snying mgrin dpral gtsug tor gyi bar rnams sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i mdog go seng ge rkang brgyad pa ni/ sha ra bhar grags pa ste/

gcan gzan ri dwags kyi yan lag can rkang lag re re la rje ngar dang rkang thung gnyis gnyis te brgyad yod pa yin gyi rkang pa dngos brgyad pa ni min no/ /bse ni ri dwags nag po spyi gtsug na rwa sbom po gcig yod pa yin la/ bya bhe runḍani bya ser po/ bshang gdong ni pha wang*/ mig sngon ni 'dre bya mo'o/ /rab gtum ma rnams kyi sa bon dbang ler ka sde lugs ldog dang rtsa sogs gzhan rnams lugs mthun du rtsa bar gsungs kyang 'grel par lugs ldog tu mdzad pa ni drag las sam rdzogs rim dang sbyar ba yin la/ sgrub ler lugs mthun du gsungs pa ni las 'jam po'am bskyed rim dang sbyar bar bya ba yin zhing*/ gshegs pa gshegs ma bzhin du steng dang phyogs ma spro rim dang mtshams dang 'og rnams bsdu rim yang rung bar sems so/ /'di rnams me rlung 'khor yug gi mtshams su 'god par gsal bar gsungs shing*/ nye 'khor du dur khrod kyi mtshan ma keng rus dang gcan gzan sogs kyang cung zad rung ngo*/ khor yug gi lha rnams kyang me rlung gi mtshams nyid du kha cig gi 'god pa ni/ bri bya la lañdza sogs kyi sa bon bkod pa'i tshe mi gsal zhing mi mdzes pa'i steng du dbang le'i re brgyad pa'i 'grel par/ yang na rlung gi dkyil 'khor la mtshan ma sna tshogs pa bya ste/ zhes pa'i 'grel tshig dang 'gal ba'o/ /yang na zhes pas khor yug gnyis kyi mtshams sam yang na rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes bstan no snyam na/ 'dam ngar gong bzhin du nges pa can byed pa'ang mi rigs la/ 'di ni de'i 'dam kha yang min tai/ gong du sa bon sngags rnams zhes rtsa bas bshad pa las yang na zhes yin pa'i phyir ro| |de'i rtsa bar dur khrod sa gzhi la gnas 'byung po'i tshogs zhes bshad do zhe na/ nye ba la dgongs pa ste/ gzhan du na sgrub le'i so dgu par/ 'byung po'i skyes gnas las skyes rlung gi mthar zhes kyang bshad pas/ de gtso bor byed na/

rlung gi dang nam mkha'i khor yug gi mtshams su 'god dgos par 'gyur ro| |des na khor yug gi lha'i 'god pa ni dur khrod kyi phyi rol rlung gi khor yug yin la/ dgod bya ni/ bsdus rgyud du/ dur khrod sa gzhi la gnas 'byung po'i tshogs zhes pa tsam dang*/ 'grel chen du yang*/ skra dang ba spu rnam par dag pa'i 'byung po bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi zhes sogs las mi 'byung yang*/ rtsa rgyud kyi na maḥ'i mchod pa'i skabs nas/ gza' bcu dang brtan pa dang*/ ri byi dang*/ rgyu skar thams cad dang*/ khyim bcu gnyis dang*/ cha bcu drug dang*/ phyogs skyong bcu dang*/ dga' byed dbang phyug sogs 'byung bas grub pa dang 'byung po la gnyis gnyis dang*/ 'phrog ma'u gnyis rnams su byas nas bgrang na khor yug la bgod bya brgyad cu gya brgyad yod la/ 'god tshul mkhas pa dag gis byang shar gyi rab gtum ma rnams nas brtsams te/ rdul tshon dkyil 'khor la 'god pa'i rim pa ji ltar mdzad pa de nyid sgom don dang ngag 'don la'ang byed mod kyi/ sde tshan rnams 'dres pas tshig gzung dka' zhing steng 'og dang phyogs mtshams kyi lha 'byed dka' ba dang yig tshogs kyang shin tu che bar snang bas rang lugs kyi ngag 'don ji skad bshad pa ltar byas na skyon de dang bral ba'i yon tan phun sum tshogs par 'byung ba yin no/ /'di dag gi zhal phyag kyang gza' bcu ni bsrung 'khor du bshad zin la/ brtan pa ri byi gnyis byang skar dang lho skar du grags shing*/ byang gi ri thag 'gyangs sar dpyid sos dang*/ lho'i ri thag 'gyangs sar dgun smad mthong ba'i skar chen gnyis yin pas/ byang steng dang lho 'og gi chos yin pa ltar sbyar ba'o/ /rgyu skar ni| gling chung 'di'i mig skar la/ dbo nas rgyal smad kyi bar byang skar dang*/ dbo nas mchu'i bar lho skar te bcu bzhi bcu bzhir gnas pa tsam las mi snang yang*/ smin drug nas bgrangs pa'i bdun tshan bzhi shar lho nub byang gi skar mar/

rma bya chen mor gsal bar bshad cing*/ de rang lugs kyi phyogs kyi khams dang sbyar na rlung khams pa bdun la sogs par gsal ba dang*/ mgo lag rgyal gsum lhag pa che bar 'jig rten na grags pa dang yang mthun gyi| deng sang rtsis pa phal cher gyi lag na gza' skar gyi khams dang de'i 'phrod sbyor bshad pa sogs la snying po mi snang ngo*/ /des na rang rang gi phyogs mdog kyang rung mod kyi chos dbyings gsung dbang sogs nas bshad pa'i mdog dbyibs su phyag len la yod pa bzhin byas pa'o/ khyim bcu gnyis la rgyud 'grel 'dir mi 'dra ba mang du gsungs te/ nang le rtsa chad kyi skabs khams me dbyangs 'char gyi skabs/ dbang sgrub tshes lha'i skabs rnams mthun par*| nag pa sa ga rlung*/ snron/ mchu stod me sogs dang*/ khams le'i tshes kyi dbyangs kyi skabs nas/ karka ṭa sogs lho bgrod drug nam mkha' nas skye rim dang*/ chu srin sogs byang bgrod drug ye shes nas bsdud rim du bshad/ ye le'i bzhi bcu zhe bzhi par chu srin gsum tshan bzhi/ thugs gsung sku/ ye shes rdo rje rnams kyi zhal gsum gsum ste/ nag dmar dkar/ dmar dkar nagadakar nag dmar/ ser dkar nag par bshad/ ye le'i gya dgu bcu par/ chu srin nas 'khrig pa'i bar nam mkha' nas lugs 'byung dang*/ gzhu nas karka ṭa'i bar lugs ldog tu bshad pa rnams las 'dir lag len la yod pa ni tha ma ste/ nyi ma lug khyim du zhugs pa'i nam langs khar nam mkha' la ji ltar 'khod pa dang mthun pa'o/ /des na khams le'i 'grel chen du/ shar gyi phyed phyi ma la lugadabang ldan du glang*/ byang gi phyed phyi ma la 'khrig pa zhes sogs kyis/ dus bzhi g.yon du 'khor bar bstan par smra ba dag kyang 'dis bsal te/ 'dis khyim rnams gnas tshul g.yon skor du gnas shing 'khor tshul g.yas su 'khor bar bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar khyim la bshad tshul bzhi byung ba'i tha ma'i rgyu mtshan ni de ltar yin la/

dang po ni dus kyi khyad par/ dpyid zla gnyis rlung*/ so ga zla gnyis me/ dbyar ston zla gnyis chu| dgun stod zla gnyis nam mkha' shin tu dwangs pas ye shes/ dgun smad zla gnyis 'thibs pas nam mkha'i khams te gling chung 'di nyid kyi dbang du mdzad par mngon la/ rgyu mtshan gzhan yang phyi ru lo gcig la dus druganang du 'pho ba drug gam tshigs chen drugagazhan rigs drug rnams la thabs shes kyis phye bas gnyis gnyis so/ /gnyis pa la rgyu mtshan gzhan gsung mod kyi| rdo rje zla ba'i chos mtshan mo 'phel 'grib kyi dbang gis bzhag go /gsum pa ni/ gtso bor nyin zhag gcig gi dus sbyor bcu gnyis po rdo rje bzhir bsdus shing*| de re re la yon tan gsum gsum po bsdus pas rdul mun snying stobs gsum rim bzhin dmar nag dkar ba'i mdog rnams zhal gsum la sbyar ba ste/ dbus g.yas g.yon gsum rim bzhin no/ /'di dang dbang le'i zhe drug par| ma rig pa sogs rten 'brel gsum tshan bzhi rim pa bzhin ye shes sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje bzhir bshad pa gnyis 'gal te/ khams ler chu srin sogs khyim bcu gnyis ma rig pa sogs rten 'brel bcu gnyis su gsungs pas so zhe na/ skyon med de/ de mngal zla dgu/ btsas pa'i gsum tshan rnams kyi gsum tshan la sems kun gzhi tsam las med pa dang*/ lus skyed mched rdzogs pa dang*/ ngag gi rtsa ba rlung rdzogs pa dang*/ sems kyi yul gsal bar 'dzin pa rnams dang sbyar ba yin la/ 'di zhag gcig gi dus sbyor bcu gnyis rdo rje bzhir bsdu ste spro rim du 'byung ba sbyar ba'i phyir ro/ cha bcu drug ni/ zla ba'i cha bcu drug gi lha ste skyed mched de dbyangs bcu drug gi khams so so las mdog kyang de ltar sbyar ba'o/ /phyogs skyong bcu ni/ mdo sngags spyi 'gro dang mtshungs par/ khams le ye le gnyis ka nas 'byung la/ 'on kyang sku mdog ni rang lugs kyi phyogs mdog tu byas shing*/

phyag mtshan spyi la grags pa bzhin no| 'di la'ang sa lha'i sa bon spyi 'gro bzhin phyag mtshan la yod pas byas mod kyi| dus 'khor rang lugs khyab 'jug nyid do/ /dga' byed dbang phyug sogs bzhi'i mdog phyag kyang chos dbyings gsung dbang sogs gzhung gzhan nas 'byung ba bkod la/ zhing skyong pho nya 'phrog ma rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /ye shes dgug gzhug la/ dngos dang ro mnyam rgyas par bya ba'o/ /dang po ni| dgug gzhug bcing mnyes ro mnyam ste lnga'o/ /dgug pa ni/ yi ge dzaḥdang phyag rgya rdo rje'i lcags kyu'o/ /de bzhin du gzhug sogs bzhi la/ hūm̐ rdo rje/ baṃ dang zhags pa/ ho dang dril bu/ hi dang dbyug pa'o/ /dang po bzhi ni rgyud sde gong ma gnyis ka'i spyi dang mthun la/ lnga pa ni/ yo ga las phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas gdab shin tu rgyas par 'byung ba sgo bstun zhing*/ drang don bskyed rim la ye dam ngo bo tha dad du 'dzin pa'i snang zhen phra mo tsam yang 'gog cing*/ nges don rdzogs rim la gsang sngags gzhan gyi bde chen mthar thug rnams kyang g.yo bder yod la| 'di bde chen mthar thug rnams kyang mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen du gyur pa sgrub pa'i phyir du'o/ /de yang skabs 'dir mngal skyes btsas ma thag gi byis pa'i dbang po yul la la sad par byed pa dang chos mthun zhing de'i dri ma sbyong ba bskyed rim drang don gtso che/ ye le'i brgya dang brgyad par/ yas babs rjes dran la dgug gzhug dang*/ mas brtan ting nge 'dzin la glus bskul gyi nges don sbyar bas rdzogs rim nges don gtso che la/ de gnyis bskyed rim gy-i phra thig la'ang sbyar dgos pas rdzogs rim kho nar ma zad do/ /'di'i khro bo lnga po/ rlung la sbyar na/ byis pa btsas ma thag tu rgyu ba'i dbu ma ye shes kyi rlung dang*/ de rjes mig gzugs la 'jug pa'i mig gi rlung*/ de nas lus dbang gi dang*/ de nas lce dbang gi dang*/

de nas sna'i dbang po'i rlung rnams te/ de ltar dbang po gzugs can bzhi dngos su byung ba'i zlas drangs pas dang po rna ba'i dbang po dang sbyar dgos te/ rna ba'i dbang po ye shes khams pa yin par dang*/ phyir ltas kyi shes pas yul 'dzin pa la sbyor ba'i skabs yin pa'i phyir ro/ de dag gi dbang po rnams ni/ khro bo lnga'i skye mched sems dpa' lnga po yin la/ des skyed pa'i khro bo lnga po rnam shes dang sbyar na/ dang po la 'gyur la lar kun gzhi'i rnam shes zhes 'byung yang*/ rna ba'i rnam shes sogs lngar byed dgos par gsal lo| |de ltar na byis pa mngal sgor mthon nas yul gsar pa 'dzin pa'i rnam shes sgo lnga po thog mar rna ba'i dang*/ de nas mig dang*/ de nas lus dang*/ de nas lce dang*/ de nas sna'i rnam shes skyes nas yul gzugs sogs lnga rdzogs par longs spyod pa bzhin du/ ye me sa chu rlung gi rang bzhin rna mig lus lce sna'i rnam shes kyi khro bo lngas rim pa bzhin du dgug sogs lnga byed par gsungs so/ /'dir rdo rje shugs la sbrul zhags med pas sbrul zhags kyis 'ching ba mi rigs so zhes pa'i dwogs pa bsu nas/ 'ching ba la sbrul zhags sngags pas zhags pa nyid la sbrul zhags su brjod do zhes pa'i lan mdzad pa ni/ shes rab mthar byed kyi rdo rjes dam tshig pa la ye shes pa bcug ces sogs la'ang dogs pa mtshungs la/ lan de ltar gdab rgyu med pas/ gsar du sprul nas byed par gsal lo/ /'o na 'di dang ye le'i dgug gzhug gi khro bo thog mtha' rjes pa ci zhe na/ ye le'i dgug bya'i ye shes pa ni/ spyi bo'i dkar cha yin la/ de 'gugs byed sogs kyi rlung lnga ni rim pa bzhin/ dhu ti'i steng gi srog rlung dang*/

ro ma'i nyi ma'i rlung dang*/ 'og dung can ma'i thur sel dang*/ g.yon rkyang ma'i zla ba'i rlung dang*/ mtha' dag dbu mar thim pa'i ye shes kyi rlung phra mo rnams yin la/ de rnams kyi spyi bo nas dgug pa dang*/ 'khor lo lnga la gzhug pa dang*/ phyir mi 'pho bar bcing pa dang*/ lus la bsil bas mnyes pa dang*/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde bas ro mnyam du byed pas na/ rdo rje shugs dang bgegs mthar byed rjes pa'o/ /de ltar na dgug pa ni/ yas bab yin la/ lte snying mgrin dpral du rgyu mthun sogs kyi thig le dang gtsug tor du thun mong gis rdzogs par bskul bas glus bskul ni mas brtan dang sbyar nas de gnyis kyi nges pa'i don gyis rdzogs byang sgrub dgos kyi/ bskyed rim rkyang pa'i de gnyis kyis mi 'grub par gsungs te shin tu ngo mtshar ro/ /gnyis po ni spyir sngags kyi tshul la/ rang nyid lhar bsgoms te/ tha mal gyi snang zhen lha'i snang zhen du bsgyur ro zhes yang yang sgrogs kyang kha cigarang la lha'i sgrub gzhi yang med par smra zhing*/ yod par 'dod pa dag gis kyang*/ swa bhā wa la sogs pa'i sngags don bsgoms nas nga'i 'dogs gzhi dang lha'i sgrub gzhi la sogs pa'i dag ma dag gi chos can mtha' dag mi snang bar byas nas nam mkha' stong pa la rang dang 'brel med kyi lha sku blos btags 'ba' zhig pa re bsgom pa shin tu mang la/ de la rang nyid kyi nga rgyal 'jog tu phyin pa'i tshe na/ nga dri ma can gyi rnam ldan du 'char bas/ dam tshig pa la dri ma can dang*/ ye shes pa dri ma med par grags shing blo lhan skyes la yang 'char bas na/ blo mchog dman gyi rim pas rang dam tshig pa tsam du yang bsgom mi nus pa dang*/ de nus kyang de la ye shes pa 'jug mi nus pa dang*/ nus kyang nan tan ches chen por bsre dgos la bsres kyang thun mtshams su de'i nga rgyal 'dzin mi nus pa la rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gsungs shing*|

bla med pas rtag tu dbyer med bsgom par gsungs kyang de ltar ma go ba dang*/ go yang rgyud sde 'og ma'i cho ga 'chugs pa dang*/ ma 'chugs kyang*/ gzhi'i sku bzhi rdo rje bzhi dang 'bras bu'i bzhi po ngo bo dbyer med rang chas su yod pa blor ma shong ba'i skyon gyis/ ye shes dgug gzhug ji snyed byas kyang gzhi dang 'bras bu'i nga gnyis ngo bo shin tu 'thad par 'dzin pa'i lhan skyes 'khrul pa la ltos te ro mnyam shin tu rgyas par gsungs mod kyi/ skabs kyi gnad ma rtogs pa rnams la ni/ rgyas par lan mang du byas kyang phan chung la/ gnad kyi don la thal ba dang thung ba'i skyon dang bral nas rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub gzhi dang sgrub tshul gong du brjod pa la nges pa brtan po rnyed pas ni ngag 'don du brjod pa tsam gyis 'grub par bsams so/ /dbang bskur la/ pha rgyud sgo bstun rdo rje gsum gyi dbang dang*/ thun mong min pa dbang bcu gcig go /dang po ni/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud kyi le'u bdun pa dang bcu gnyis pa nas gsungs pa'i gsol gdab dang nga rgyal 'dzin tshul sogs 'grel chen gyi kha skong ba yin pas lha'i zhal phyag kyang gsang 'dus bzhin du dgos kyi dus 'khor gyi rgya mi bkab ste/ 'gebs na ye shes rdo rje yang dgos par 'gyur ro| |de yang zhabs lugs la gtso 'khor thams cad la byed pa dang thugs nas mgo brtsam pa sogs yod kyang*/ 'di ni 'phags lugs sgo bstun te/ 'on kyang yum la'ang sbyar ro/ /gnyis pa la/ bskyed rim smin byed dbang bdun dang rdzogs rim smin byed dbang bzhi'o/ /dang po la lus ngag yid/ ye shes dag byed bzhi'o/ /dang po la khams dag byed chu dang*/ phung po dag byed cod pan no/ /gnyis pa la rlung dang rtsa dag byed dar dpyangs rdor dril lo/ /gsum pa la/ dbang po yul dang bcas pa dang las dbang bya ba dang bcas pa dag byed brtul zhugs dang ming ngo*/

/bzhi pa la phung po drug pa ye shes kyi phung po dang*/ khams drug pa rnam shes kyi khams te/ 'di yang sa chu me rlung nam mkha' rnam shes kyi khams zhes nam mkha'i zlas drangs pa'i rnam shes yin pas rnam ye shes gnyis kyi nang nas ming rnam shes su btags kyang ngo bo ye shes kyi khams te de gnyis rdor sems dang sher phyin mar bskyed nas rang rang gi yum dang yab kyis 'khyud pa'i dbang bskur byas nas rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum kyi rjes gnang 'dogs bcas kyi dbang bskur bas ye shes dag par byed pa la rgyud sde gzhan la bsgrub gzhi de ma grags pas khyad par gyi sgo nas thun mong ba yin zhing snga ma drug kyang lus kyi phung khams rtsa rlung sogs so so nas lhar bskyed pa la bskur bas kyang de bzhin te/ bdun po 'di'i spyi tsam nas rgyud sde kun dang mthun no| |de yang kha cig rigs pa'i dbang lnga'i dod tsam du smra ba ni ches 'khrul te/ bskyed rim yongs su rdzogs pa'i smin byed yin pas bla med gzhan gyi bum dbang mtha' dag lhag dang bcas pa tshang la/ rigs drug pa'i sdom gzung dang thun mong min pa'i bskyed chog dang dbang bskur tshul sogs kyi dod med pas/ bla med gzhan gyi bum dbang ji tsam rgyas kyang 'di'i dod mi thub pas gzhan gyi rnal 'byor rkyang pa la 'di pa'i thun mong min pa'i rtsa ltung mi 'byung ba yin no/ /dbang 'di'i lam ni bskyed rim yongs su rdzogs pa cha lag las chen bcu gnyis dang las phran re bzhi la sogs pa nas 'og min gyi mthar thug pa nas 'jig rten gyi dngos grub dang*/ /phar phyin theg pa'i 'das lam sa bdun pa ring du song ba'i spang rtogs mtha' dag rdzogs par byed pa yin mod kyi sngags lam gyi tshogs lam chung ngu sgom byung gi rtog med rnal 'byor ma skyes pa nyid du zad do/ kha cig lam sna zin pa'i thog ma rdzogs rim du sogs kyi mtshan ma mthong ba'i rtog med la byed dgos pas bskyed rim lam min no/

/zhes zer ba snga phyi mang yang*/ sa bdun pa rdzogs par byed pa'i rnal 'byor gyi lam gyi go mi chod pa ni ches mun sprul yin te/ theg pa rang rang gi 'jug sdom nam skyes pa nas de dang de'i tshogs lam 'dod dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /'di dang bskyed rim rdzogs rim gyi smin byed ma yin no zhes dang*/ bskyed rim la bsnyen bsgrub bzhi ma tshang ngo zhes zer ba rnams ni lam 'di'i gol sa chen po'o/ /des na/ dbang bdun lam mchog sa bdun spang rtogs bsgrub/ /sngags kyi tshogs lam chung ngu rtog sgom lam/ /rdzogs rim smin byed sgo gsum ye shes sbyong*/ /bsnyen sgrub bzhi ldan bskyed rim mthar phyin shog /ces bya'o/ /spyir rgya bod kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis dbang gi dbye ba mang du gsungs mod| bsdu na/ smin byed rgyu'i dbang*/ grol byed lam gyi dbang*/ thob bya 'bras bu'i dbang du 'dus pa las/ bdun po de yi dang po ni/ de dang de'i dbang rdzas gtad pa sogs kyi byed pa la rten nas slob ma'i rgyud la nus pa khyad par ba re gsar du skyes pa yin la/ gnyis pa ni bskyed rim yan lag dang bcas pa yin zhing*| gsum pa ni rdzogs rim kyi bsnyen bsgrub bzhi'o/ /rdzogs rim smin byed la bum gsang*/ sher ye/ bzhi pa'o/ /de dag kyang las ye gang rung gi phyag rgya'i nu ma la reg pa dang*/ gsang rdzas myangs shing gsang gnas ltas pa dang*/ de dang snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde stong gi ye shes dang*/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen dang stong gzugs kyi mthar thug thugs sku zung gi don go ba rnams ni smin byed dang*/ sor bsams/ srog 'dzin/ rjes dran/ ting nge 'dzin rnams kyis grol byed dang*/ sangs rgyas pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes bzhi ni thugs kyi 'bras bu'i dbang yin la/ lam gyi lag rjes ni/ phar phyin theg pa'i sa brgyad pa/ dgu pa/ bcu pa/ sangs rgyas sa'i dri ma rnams sbyong ba ste/

ting nge 'dzin yan lag myur ba'i bde chen stong brgyad brgya pa phrag bcu gnyis kyis 'pho ba'i bag chags stong brgyad brgya pa phrag bcu gnyis kyi sa bon bcom ste/ kun tu 'od ma mthar byas pa'i sngags kyi thun mong min pa'i sa bcu gnyis kyi spangs rtogs yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ rgyas par rdzogs rim kyi bshad par blta ba'o/ / de dag kyang snga ma bzhin smon lam du bsdus pa zur na yod cing dbang gi sngags don ni mngon rtogs kyi sngags kyi mchan bu na gsal lo/ / rgyas gdab la/ sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi rgyas gdab bzhi'o/ /dang po la so so ba dang thun mong ba'o/ / dang po la/ rigs drug gi dang*/ lha gzhan rnams kyi'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir rgyas gdab kyi don ro mnyam du byed pa yin zhes bla ma gsungs yang*/ phyag rgya chen pos rgyas gdab tshul dang*/ phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas gdab sogs ni de ltar yin mod/ 'di ni/ 'jig rten phal pa'i dmag rtags la sogs pa ltar sde ris so sor 'byed pa'i mtshan ma yin te/ /'dul ba las/ khyim pa sogs dang 'byed pa'i phyir du snam sbyar dras shing drub pa'am de'i rnam pa can dang*/ de'i nang tshan so so mi nor ba'i ched du mtshan ma so so dang*/ phyi rol pa'i drang srong so so'i mtshan ma ral pa'i khyad par dang dbyug gu dang tshangs skud la sogs pas sde ris so sor 'byed pa dang tshul mtshungs so/ /de yang rigs bdag dang de'i rigs can gnyis su gnas pa'i 'khor ram rigs can rnams ni| rang rang gis rigs bdag gtso bos rgyas 'debs la/ rigs bdag drug po las/ rang nyid la rang nyid kyis rgyas 'debs ba ni rgyud gzhan nas bshad kyang 'dir mi bzhed de/ ngo bo nyid la ngo bo nyid kyi rgya ni bkag ste zhes sogs rgyu mtshan dang bcas nas gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ ye ler/ rigs gzhan la mi bskyod pa'i rgyas 'debs gsungs pa ni/ dgos pa rgyas 'debs so sor nges pa mi nus pa'i gang zag gi ngo bor ram/

'jug pa bde ba'i ched du/ dgongs gzhi mthar thug lha kun la mi bskyod pas rgyas gdab par 'gyur ba la dgongs pa ste/ mi bskyod pas rnam snang*/ des snang mtha'/ des rin 'byung*/ des don grub la rgyas btab pa'i phyir dang*/ 'dir rgyas gdab bya dang 'debs byed kyi don ni gtso bo bskyed bya dang bskyed byed yin pas mi bskyod pa ni rigs lhag ma'i bskyed byed yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na mi bskyod pa la rdor sems kyis rgyas 'debs pa ma yin nam zhe na/ yin mod kyi de la'ang 'dis 'debs pas gnyis ka'ang rgyal ba thams cad kyi skyed mdzad du rig par bya'o/ /de ltar na 'dir/ gdab bya/ 'debs byed/ 'debs tshul gsum gyis bshad par bya ba las| dang po ni/ ye dam dbyer med pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs te/ de yang rigs drug ni mu stegs rjes su bzung ba'i phyir du/ dbang phyug gi zhal lam sgo drug gi yon tan gyi dbang gis te/ rgyab tu tshangs pa/ g.yon du g.yon gyi lha/ g.yas su mi 'jigs pa/ mdun du de'i skyes bu/ steng du dbang po/ 'og tu dus kyi me zhes pa ral pa'i thor tshugs can gyi lha drug tu 'dod la/ de drug rim pa bzhin du rnam snang*/ snang mtha'/ rin 'byung*/ don grub/ mi bskyod pa/ rdor sems rnams kyi dod du 'dod pas/ 'dir yang ral pa'i cod pan dang*/ lha dang lha mo lhag ma rnams rin po che sna tshogs pa'i cod pan 'dzin pas gnas pa'o| |'dir rigs drug la rgyan med par 'dod pa yod kyang*/ dbu rgyan mgul rgyan la sogs pa'i rgyan yod med kyi khyad par med kyi/ rigs drug la ral pa phyi nas mngon par yod pa la dbu rgyan gyis spras pa dang*/ lha lhag ma la ral pa nang du tshud nas mi mngon par byas pa'i rin po che'i prog zhu can no| |'debs byed ni/ mi bskyod pa dang rdo sems phan tshun du rgyas 'debs pa yang sngo ljang so sor bya la/ don grub la rin 'byung sogs gzhan rigs kyis rgyas 'debs shing lha lhag ma rnams la rang rigs kyis rgyas 'debs pa'o|

|'debs tshul ni/ mi bskyod pa dang rdo rje sems dpa' gnyis phan tshun rgyu la 'bras bu dang 'bras bu la rgyu'i rgya ste/ rnam shes lam gyis sbyangs pa'i 'bras bu'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir dang*/ ye shes rang don chos kyi sku las rnam shes gzhon gzugs kyi sku 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /rnam snang la mi bskyod pa ni lus la sems sam rten la brten pa'i rgya ste/ rnam snang gzugs phung dang yum gyi sku/ mi bskyod pa rnam shes phung po dang*/ yab kyi thugs yin pa'i phyir ro| |rnam snang gis snang mtha' la rgyas btab pa ni/ ngag la lus kyi rgya ste/ spyi 'gro dang bstun na snang mtha' gsung yin la/ lus kyi mgrin pa la sogs pa'i gnas lnga nas 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /rin 'byung la snang mtha' ni grogs la grogs can te/ phung po'i tshor 'du dang rtsa'i ro rkyang grogs yin pa'i phyir ro/ /don grub la rin 'byung ni 'bras bu la rgyu'i rgya ste/ khrag smin pa las sha 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ khams dang sbyar na ni rlung me chu sa rnams phyi ma phyi mas snga ma snga ma la rgyas btab pa'i kun kyang rgyu la 'bras bu rgyas gdab pa'o// lha gzhan rnams ni/ rigs so so la rang rang gi rigs bdag gam skyed byed kyis rgyas btab pa'o/ /gzhan yang nang gi rtsa dang bstun na/ rin 'byung la 'od dpag med ni ro rkyang phan tshun grogs yin la/ don grub la rin 'byung ni/ gci ba'i rtsa dang ro ma rgyun gcig pas dang*/ snang mtha' la rnam snang yang rkyang ma dang gshang ba'i rtsa rgyun gcig pa'i phyir dang*/ rnam snang la mi bskyod pa ni/ bshang ba'i rtsa 'og gi dbus na gnas shing de mi bskyod pa'i gnas yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes kyang brjod par bya'o/ sku'i rgyas gdab thun mong ba ni/ gtsug tor du thig le la a las mi bskyod pa zhes sogs rigs drug dgod pa'o| |gsung ni/ lte bar sa'i dkyil 'khor la l̥ zhes sogs yi ge lnga'o|

|thugs ni/ dpral bar zla ba la oṃ zhes sogs bzhi'o/ /ye shes ni/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor oṃ zhes sogs gsung rgyun la 'byung yang*/ a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchoga.a ka ro'i don can a thun mong ngo*/ /'di rnams sku sogs bzhir gang gis bzhag ce na/ mkhas pa dag rigs drug phung po phye bas lus dang*/ yi ge lnga ngag gi gnas lngas phye bas ngag dang*/ thig le bzhi gnas skabs bzhi'i rnam rtog gis phye bas sems dang*/ gsang gnas chags pa'i gnas yin pas ye shes sogs zhes gsung mod/ sku dang*/ yi ge dang*/ thig le dang*/ gzhom med kyi mtshon byed nā da yin pa de gzhir bzhag pa'o| |rnam dag la/ rten gyi rnam dag ni bshad zin/ thun mong gi rnam dag ni/ ye le'i lnga pas rdo rje bzhi dang sbyar zhing*/ sgrub le'i go lnga pa sogs kyis/ nang le'i mngal dang bcas pa so so dang thun mong la sbyar ba'i sku bzhi dang rnam dag sbyar ba rnams kyang lugs gzhan gyis skabs 'dir sbyar mod kyi rgyud 'grel nyid nas 'dir bstan gyi rgyud tshig rnam dag nyid du gsungs pas na/ tshig mang yang sgrub thabs rgyas pa'i rnam dag ni 'di nyid la rten par rigs so/ /'di la gsum/ phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi sgo nas lha'i dang*/ gnas skabs bzhi'i bya bas sku'i dang*/ g.yas g.yon rlung gi rgyu bas stabs kyi rnam dag go /dang po la nang rtsa'i 'khor los 'khor gyi lha'i dang*/ phyi dus kyi sbyor ba gtso bo yab yum kyi dang*/ gzhan phung khams sogs kyi gtso 'khor thun mong gi rnam dag go /spyir rnam dag la yar dag mar dag phar dag tshur dag sogs kyi bshad tshul gzhan yang yod mod kyi/

bya spyod la rnam dag mi gsal zhing*/ yo ga 'bras bu ye shes sogs dang sbyor bas yar dgabla med phung khams sogs dang sbyor bas mar dag ces bshad na rung zhing*/ de gnyis kyi don ni/ ye shes la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas pa'i spang rtogs kyi yon tan nyid rten dang brten par bshad pa yin zhes pa la khyad par med kyang*/ snga mas thob bya'i 'bras bu khyad par de dang de thob pa'i phyir du rten dang brten pa 'di ltar bsgom zhes dang*/ phyi mas thob bya de dang de thob pa la ngo skal gyi dri ma'i khyad par 'di dang 'di sbyong dgos pas de sbyang ba'i phyir du 'di dang 'di sgom zhes pas 'bras bu la dmigs par 'dra yang dri ma ngos zin ma zin gyi khyad par gyis bla med zab pa yin no| |des na/ bum pa rnams dang du ba la sogs brgyad pa rnams kyis snying khar chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu 'gyur/ zhes pa'ang lam dus su bum sogs bsgoms pas snying kha chos kyi rtsa 'khor dri ma dag nas chos skur 'gyur zhes pa'am/ yang na snying kha'i rtsa 'khor dri ma rnam par dag nas bum sogs kyi rnam par 'char bar 'gyur zer rgyu/ dag bya'i byed tshig dag byed la sbyar ba ste/ dus kyi dag pas dpal ldan rdo rje can 'gyur zhes sogs ni byed tshig thob thang bzhin du sbyar ba'o/ /tshig rnams kyi 'bru non ngos 'dzin ni 'grel chen du gsal lo/ gnas skabs bzhi'i bya ba dang sku bzhi rnam dag tu sbyar ba yang grangs 'grig pa tsam ma yin gyi/ dpral mgrin snying lter sprul longs chos dag gam/ sku gsung thugs ye'i thig le gzhom med bzhi'i rang gi ngo bo sku bzhi rdo rje bzhi'i sgrub gzhi khyad par can nyer len gyi rgyu nyid du gnas kyang*/ 'khor ba'i sad rmi gnyid bde bzhi'i nus pa rnams 'bral rung glo bur ba'i tshul du gnas pa las de bzhi'i bya ba mngon 'gyur ba mngal btsas nyin mtshan kun tu 'byung ba rnams kyi dri ma rags pa mngon gyur ba dang*/

phra ba nus pa dang*/ sa bon du gnas pa rnams lam rim pa gnyis kyi bsnyen sgrub bzhi bzhis rim pa bzhin legs par sbyangs pas sku bzhi rdo rje bzhir 'gyur ba'i phyir na/ sbyang gzhi dang sbyang bya dang sbyong byed dang sbyang 'bras rnams la nges pa brtan po rnyed pa ni rnam dag gsungs pa'i dgos pa dang por shes par bya'o/ /de bzhin du rlung gi rgyu ba rkang stabs dang sbyar ba yang g.yon 'pho g.yas 'pho snyam rgyu rnams g.yon brkyang g.yas brkyang mnyam pa'i stabs rnams dang*/ g.yas g.yon re re'i 'pho chung lnga po nam mkha' nas sa'i bar rim pa bzhin/ sa ga dang*/ zlum po dang*/ rol pa dang*/ pad ma dang*/ rdo rje'i gdan du 'gyur zhes pa ste/ 'pho ba che chung de rnams las rgyal mchog dang srog rtsol gyis sbyangs pas/ mthar dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i stang stabs de rnams su 'char zhing*/ lam dus sa chog la sogs pa'i skabs su lha'i nga rgyal brtan po dang bcas tai stang stabs de rnams byas pas las rlung gi 'pho ba de rnams 'gag par go bar bya'i/ rnam pa 'dra ba tsam rnam dag gi don du mi bzung ngo*/ /de ltar na/ rgyal mchog gnyis pa 'di la las rgyal mchog tu brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ btsas nas srog rlung rdzogs pa ni 'di'i sbyang gzhi yin la/ srog rdzogs pa na las dbang bya ba la 'jug pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes 'di'i mdor bsdus gyi 'jug tu gsungs so/ /de bzhin du mngal tu lus rdzogs pas dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang*/ lo bcu drug tshun la thig le rdzogs pas dang*/ de nas 'khrig pa spyod pa'i bde ba rdzogs shing de la dmigs pas thig le dang phra mo'i rnal 'byor du gsungs kyi/ 'di gnyis kyi gtso bo rdzogs rim yin pa la dgongs nas/ 'di'i 'grel tshig dang rtsa rgyud kyi tshig la rdzogs rim ston pa yang yod la/ des 'khrul nas bla ma mang pos 'di gnyis rdzogs rim kho na la sbyar ba ni rgyas par gong du bkag zin la|

'di gnyis rdzogs mtshams kyi 'grel par/ dkyil 'khor ba'i lha rnams kyis rdo rje bzhi rnams ni bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi rdo rje bzhi ni rnam par thar pa bzhi'i stobs kyis te kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pas ces gsungs pas kyang bkag ste/ bsgoms stobs kun rdzob bskyed rim dang rnam thar bzhi rlung stobs rdzogs rim don dam zhes dgongs pa'i phyir zhes kho bo smra la/ chos rje bla ma dam pas kyang 'di mthun gsungs so/ /gzhan yang mkha' gsang rdo rje dang padma'i bskyed chog yi ge'i sgo nas rgyas par mdzad pa'i phyir yang ste/ rdzogs rim la yi ge phyag mtshan gyi bskyed chog 'gog pa'i phyir dang*/ zhal lung las kyang*/ rim pa dang po pa rnams la/ /yi ge'i gzugs su rab snang ba/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor gsum pa thugs rdo rje sgrub pa'i yan lag thig le'i sems rdzogs pa thig le'i rnal 'byor bshad pa la/ phyag rgya rten dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ bstan bya phyag rgya'i dbye ba/ ji ltar sten pa'i tshul/ rnal 'byor 'di rjes dran gyi smin byed du 'gro tshul lo// dang po ni/ spyir rdo rje theg pa la chags lam zhes bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gdul bya gsum la ltos nas tshul lam spyod pa gsum gsungs pa'i phyir te/ dman pa la mos pa la chags bral gyi dang*/ rgya chen po la mos pa la sa dang phar phyin dang*/ zab mo la lhag par mos pa la 'dod chags kyi spyod pa'am tshul bstan no zhes tshul gsum sgron me sogs las rgya cher bshad pa ltar yin pa'i phyir dang nyan thos pas 'dod chags mi sdug pa bsgoms pas spong la| phar phyin pas 'dod chags kyi rang bzhin stong par shes pas ngo bo bkag nas spong yang*/ sngags las 'dod chags nyid thabs mkhas kyi sman chen po/ sgrib pa mtha' dag gi nad sel ba dang*/ skal bzang skye bos gang snang thams cad bde chen gyi bdud rtsir 'char ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo yin par shes nas mngon gyur rgya cher spel te nyams su myong ba'i bde chen sngags lam gyi rang bzhin ni yin pa'i phyir ro/

/mchog dman mtha' dag gnas lugs stong pa nyid dang legs par sbyar zhing de ltar mi sgom pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems la'ang snying rje chen po bde chen gyi ngo bor lhag par 'bar bas nyams su len pa ni des na| 'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ khams gsum na ni sdig med de/ /zhes sogs dang*/ rig pa 'di ni dor byas na/ /thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs mi brgya| zhes sogs du ma dang*/ khyad par rtsa rgyud las/ chags bral las gzhan sdig pa med/ /bde ba las gzhan bsod nams med/ /ces dang*/ 'phos pa las ni chags bral 'gyur/ /chags bral las ni sdug bsngal 'byung*/ /zhes sogs nas/ de phyir sems can ji srid pa/ /chags bral las 'byung gzhan du min| |zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs so/ de yang dper na/ me de thabs dang bral na dngul chu 'bros rkyen gyi gtso bo byed kyang dngul chu legs par 'ching ba ni me kho na la rag las pa bzhin du phyag rgya bde chen gyi brten la dngul chu ji lta ba bzhin du gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ zhal lung du/ gsal zhing rab dga' mkha' 'dra ba/ gzhan gyis rig par mi nus te/ /bud med phyag rgya sgyu ma ni/ /sgyu ma kun las khyad par 'phags/ /ces gzhi'i rang bzhin lhan skyes zab gsal gnyis med kyi ye shes de 'khor 'das kun gyi rtsa bar sgrubs nas de rdzogs par mngon du 'gyur ba ni phyag rgya kho na la rag las par gsungs shing*/ rim lngar yang de dang 'dra ba dang*/ brtag gnyis su yang*/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes/ /gang du yang ni mi rnyed de/ /bla ma'i dus thabs sten pa dang*/ /bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya/ /zhes gsungs zhing*/ bla ma yang phyi'i bla ma kho nar ma zad kyi/ nang gtum mo dang gsang ba'i rig ma yang bla ma nyid du zhal lung las rgyas par gsungs so/ /de ltar na phar phyin theg pa'i lam ji tsam bsgoms kyang*/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi 'dzin stangs kyi yul don dam gnas lugs kyi chos nyid la gnyis snang nub par nus kyi|

dmigs pa'i snang yul tha snyad gnas lugs bde gshegs snying po'i rlung sems mngon du 'gyur bar mi nus pas spyir sngags lam mtha' dag dang*/ khyad par phyag rgya ni 'di'i thabs kyi gtso bo yin pa'i phyir na rten dgos pa yin no| | gnyis pa ni/ spyir rgyud 'grel gyi stod smad kun tu/ las kyi phyag rgya dang*/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang*/ phyag rgya chen mo'i dngos grub ces phyag rgya gsum nyid du bsdus pa mang*/ de gsum ni rim pa bzhin/ skra dang lan bu sogs dang ldan pa'i phyi rol gyi bu mo dang*/ de'i don spyi yid ngor shar ba lha mor bsgom pa dang*/ stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo/ /shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems lha mo dngos su bzhengs pa 'di gsum las rim pa bzhin 'dod pa dang khams gong dang mchog gi dngos grub gter bar gsungs la/ bsdus rgyud pa gzhan dag phyag rgya gsum pa chos nyid don dam bden pa kho na la 'chad pa ni sems 'grel gsum du rgya cher bkag go /'di'i skabs la lar phyag rgya bzhir mang gsungs te/ sgrub le'i brgya dang bdun par/ las dang dam tshig dag dang*/ chos dang*/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya zhes gsungs pa/ rgyu so so la sbyar na/ smad 'tshong dang gzhan dbang gi bud med dang rang dbang gi bu mo dang rang gi chung ma rnams so/ /rgyud gcig la gtso bor sbyar na/ lo bcu gnyis ma/ bcu drug ma/ nyi shu ma/ sum cu ma rnams te/ 'di dag ni gtso bor las kyi nyid la dbye ba'o/ /ye le'i don gsum par/ las ye dam chen bzhi gsungs pa'i dang po gnyis spyi 'gro bzhin/ gsum pa nang gi gtum mo/ bzhi pa chos dbyings stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo'o/ /'di gnyis bla ma dam pas rnam snang mngon byang dang nā ro 'grel chen gyi lung la brten nas go log pa ni gzhung gi tshig don la ma zhugs so/ /gzhan yang*/ las rgya'i dbye ba rgyas pa ni/ rnal 'byor ma so drug 'jig rten na rigs dang las so drug spyod pa'i mi mo'i tshul 'dzin tshul rgyas par gsungs zhing*/

khyad par dbang le'i brgya bco brgyad par gshegs ma bzhi dang sems ma drug tsha mo bu mo la sogs pa bcu'am/dmang rigs mo sogs bcu dang sbyar ba lo bcu gcig ma nas nyi shu ma'i bar rnams dbang bskur ba'i dus kyi rig ma dang*/ de nas khro mo bcu lo nyer gcig nas sum cu'i bar dang*/ de nas gsung 'khor gyi brgyad/ de nas rab gtum ma brgyad de lo zhe drug gi bar gyi rig ma rnams lam sgom dus kyi phyag rgyar gsungs so/ /phyag rgya re re la yang 'khrig spyod pa'i gnas skabs la btags pa'i ming 'dogs/ sems pa dang reg pa dang rdo rje zhugs pa dang bsrub pa dang thig le lhung ba dang*/ chags pa nyams pa la/ ma dang sring mo dang bu mo dang tsha mo dang chung ma dang mdza' mo'i ming dang*/ dpral mgrin snying gsum gyi thig le la sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya gsum ste phyag rgya dgur bshad pa dang*/ yang pho mo 'dus pa skyes pa dang bud med dang*/ tsumbha na sogs dang*/ bde ba rgyas pa rnams la mchog dang gsang ba dang las dang chos kyi phyag rgyar bshad la/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dang*/ sgron ma dang*/ gos dkar mo dang*/ mā ma kī dang*/ spyan ma'i rigs can ky-i rig ma lnga la ming 'dogs dpal ldan bzang mo dang*/ pad ma can dang*/ dung can ma dang*/ sna tshogs ma dang*/ sna chen ma rnams su bshad cing*/ chos dbyings rdo rje ma sogs sems ma drug rigs skad phug ron lta bu rnams dang*/ byin pa sbom zhing sna cung zad yo ba| mdzes ma dang*/ lha mo dang*/ sha za mo dang*/ mi mo dang*/ srin mo dang*/ klu mo rnams kyi ming 'dogs dang*/ de thams cad kyi lus dbyibs dang dri'i sgo nas brtag thabs la sogs pa gsungs so/ /'di dag gi rnam gzhag ni spyir ma rgyud rgyas pa bde mchog rtsa bshad kyi rgyud nas rgya cher 'byung zhing*/ bshad rgyud rdor phreng dang*/ brtag gnyis sogs nas kyang*/ las brgya rigs lngar gsungs pa mang mod kyi/
