'jam dpal zhal lung las ni gshegs ma bzhi dang sbyar ba'i pad ma can dang*/ dung can ma dang*/ ri mo can dang*/ glang chen ma bzhi'i mtshan nyid gsal zhing rgyas par gsungs so/ /de yang de bzhi rim pa bzhin/ mā ma ki dang gos dkar mo dang*/ sgrol ma dang spyan ma'i rigs/ mdog dmar po dang dkar ser dang sngo sangs dang smug mo/ nu ma til 'bras dang*/ na ra ga dang*/ shing thog pa la 'dra ba dang*/ g.yas g.yon du dgye ba/ dri padma dang*/ ba tshwa dang sha rlon dang chang gi dri/ dbyibs/ sna lce til 'dra ba la rgyab rgur zhing*/ brang mdzes pa/ spu 'khyil zhing gsus gnyer gsum yod pa/ sen mo dmar zhing ring pa rnams dang*/ skra ring zhing sna yang ring ba dang*/ lus chung zhing brla shin tu mdzes pa/ 'chu 'phyang zhing rje ngar bya rog 'dra ba/ skad phug ron lta bu rnams dang*/ byin pa sbom zhing sna cung zad yo ba/ lus sbom zhing dri nga la rdul mang ba rnams so/ /rakta'i dri ni skyur ba dang*/ mngar ba dang*/ tsha ba dang*/ nga ba rnams so/ /spyod pa ni/ glang chen gyi 'gros 'dra ba dang*/ 'o ma dang zho la sred pa dang*/ ngo tsha med cing khro 'dod la 'thab mos dga' zhing gan rkyal du nyal ba dang*/ spyod pa shin tu rtsing ba rnams so/ de dag la thun mong gi skyon/ rol tshe rgyab kyis phyogs pa dang*/ khong du dga' zhing tshig mang dang*/ /bgo ba bzhin du bka' yang bcog /'o byas kha ni 'phyid byed dang*/ /bla ma'i yon tan shes gyur kyang*/ /gzhan du de la cung zad 'chad/ /bla ma ma mthong ltar byed cing*/ 'ongs kyang de la phyag mi 'tshal/ /rje btsun de dang mi mthun pa'i/ /mi gzhan de dang brtse bar byed/ /des sogs rab dbye mi rung ste/ /mkhas pas rab tu spang bar bya| |zhes gsungs la/ yon tan ni/ mig gi rtsa dang mig rtsa rgod/ /slang zhing skad cig bsam pa dang*/ /skad cig rgod pa'i 'phro bzhag nas/ /bsam zhing smra'am yang na 'dzum/ /rje btsun bla ma mthong gyur na/

/dga' zhing mdzes blta 'dzum par byed/ /de yis bka' stsal nyan zhing mgo /steg pa'i tshul gyis zhe sar ldan/ /gzhan du de la snyan par brjod/ /de mthong 'grogs la 'khyud cing brten/ /phyag la 'khri zhing sor tshigs stod/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa rnams so/ /de bzhin du gsang gnas kyi mtshan nyid kyang rgyas par gzhung der gsungs so/ / gsum pa ni/ de ltar brtag pa'i phyag rgya dang por longs spyod sbyin pa la sogs pas kyang dbang du byas te/ thog mar bslab pa'i gzhi dang sems bskyed la sogs pa sbyin zhing theg pa la lhag par mos su bcug nas/ 'dod pa'i bstan bcos las bshad pa'i sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhi pa legs par sbyong du gzhug cing*/ byang nas sgo gsum las su rung ba na/ dbang bskur nas dam tshig dang sdom pa la legs legs par bkod de/ dus khyad par can la bab pa na tshogs 'khor dang bcas pas bla ma la phul nas gsang dbang blangs la de rjes phan tshun rjes chags kyi sbyor ba rnams dang phan tshunagasol gdab byed tshul zhal lung las gsungs pa lta bu sngon du gtang ste/ lus dang mkha' gsang byin gyis rlob tshul skabs 'di'i 'grel chen du rtsa rgyud drangs pa rnams kyi don mngon rtogs su bkod pa ji ltar ba bzhin du bya ste/ de yang dung can ma'i rtsa'i rtse mo legs par btsal ba sngon du btang nas lus lha dang ngag sngags dang sems chos kyi 'du shes te 'du shes gsum ldan gyi snyoms 'jugabade ba phal pa la sred pa'i sred pa cung zad kyang ma 'dres par 'gyur med bde chen gyi rten byang chub kyi sems 'phel bzhin pa'i thabs 'dzag med tshangs spyod kyi brtul zhugs lhur len pa'i bsam pas spyad par bya ba kho na yin la/ de yang bskyed rdzogs kyi nus pa mi brtan pa'am brtan yang so thar gyi bstan pa gtso bor gsungs dgos na| 'di dag yid kyis mos par byed pa'i ye rgya la brten par bya ba yin no/

/ bzhi pa ni/ rnal 'byor 'di bskyed rim gyi bsnyen bsgrub gsum pa'i yan lag yin pa bzhin du rdzogs rim gyi rjes dran yang gsum pa yin pa'i phyir dang*/ ye le'i don gsum par/ rgyal ba'i lhan skyes bde ba 'di ni 'phel ba'i don slad dang por las kyi phyag rgya bsten par bya/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gsum gyis bskyed rdzogs thun mong gi thig le dang phra mo'i rnal 'byor gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang*/ rgyal mtshan rtse la 'gog pa gang*| de ni shes rab ye shes skad cig gal te thig le'i phreng ba g.yo ba med pas bde na'o/ /zhes pas rjes dran gyi skad cig tha ma ni/ slob lam gyi yas babs mthar thug nor bu'i rtse mor/ mas brtan 'gyur med kyi skad cig dang po de ma thag tu 'dren nges cha bcu drug par gsungs kyang*/ bskyed rim gyi yas babs 'di la zla ba'i cha bco lnga gang ba'i tshul du byon par bshad pa ni/ mos ngo tsam la nor bu'i rtser brtan pa yang rung mod kyi/ dngos gnas la bskyed rim pas gsang gnas kyi rtsa 'khor las sma bar gzung mi nus pa la dgongs pa yin no| | bzhi pa ye shes rdo rje sgrub chen gyi yan lag bde ba la dmigs pa phra mo'i rnal 'byor ni/ rdzogs rim mas brtan gyi mthar thug mthong sgom gyi bsdus pa ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag 'gyur med bde chen nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i stong brgyad brgya pa phrag re res ngo skal gyi 'pho ba'i bag chags stong brgyad brgya pa phrag re re'i sa bon rtsa ba nas drungs phyung ste kun tu 'od la sogs pa'i sa bcu gnyis po re re bgrod cing*/ de nas nor bu'i rtse nas gsang ba dang*/ de nas lte ba dang*/ snying kha dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ dpral ba dang*/ gtsug tor rnams su sa gnyis gnyis bgrod par byed pa'i lam/ sgrub chen gyi mthar thug de'i smin byed kyi lam khyad par can du bya ba'i phyir du rdo rje bzhi'i thig le 'khor lo bzhi 'bras bu bzhi'i tshul du de bzhin gshegs pa'i sgra bshad kyi sgo nas steng du gshegs pa ste/

rim pa dang por yang mos pa tsam du ma zad bde ba rjes mthun pa 'dren par nges pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de yang 'di'i rgyud tshig las/ shes rab chos 'byung dag la gnas pa zhes pa/ 'grel par/ chos 'byung dngos kyi nang du byang sems phab nas bsgom par bla med gzhan nas 'byung ba lta bu min gyi/ 'grel par chos 'byung na gnas pa'i a ba dhū tī'i mas sna nyid la der btags par gsungs pas kyang 'dzag med kyi tshangs spyod ni lugs 'di'i lam gyi gtso bor bstan la/ bla med gzhan gyi dngos bstan rnams g.yo ba de dang 'dzag bder shugs la bstan pas mthar dbang bzhi pa'i lam gyi mthar thug 'di legs par gnon dgos shing*/ 'gyur med kyi bde chen las gzhan gyi 'gyur ba'i bag chags 'joms mi nus so zhes go bar byas nas lam gyi mthar thug ston pa'i rgyud 'di la shin du gus par byos shig de ltar na bskyed rim bsnyen bsgrub bzhi po 'di byang chub bzhi dang sbyor ba na rim pa bzhin rnam pa lnga dang rnam pa nyi shu dang skad cig ma gcig dang rnam pa sna tshogs pa'am sgyu 'phrul drwa bas byang chub pa yin pas thig le'i rnal 'byor ram rjes dran gyi ngo bo ni bskyed rdzaugs so so'am yas babs kyi bde chen mthar thug pa'i skad cig ma yin pas skad cig ma gcig dang*/ phra mo'i rnal 'byor ram ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag ni bskyed rdzogs so so'i mas brtan gyi thig le tha ma ye shes kyi thig le las dang zhing gsal ba'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo spros pas rnal 'byor pa rang snang gi khams gsum po mthar thug gi las snang bem chos kyi dri ma phra rags rnams legs par sbyong bas sgyu 'phrul drwa bas byang chub pa'o/ /de ltar sgo gsum ye shes dang bcas pa'i dri ma rags pa sbyong ba bskyed rim gyi dngos gzhi bsnyen sgrub bzhi'i rnam par bzhag pa rnams rgya cher bshad zin la/ zhib cha phra mo rnams ni rgyud 'grel dang ngag rgyun mthong rgyud dang bcas pa rnams las shes par bya'o/

/ bskyed rim gyi 'jug gi rnal 'byor ni/ gzhung lugs gzhan las thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor bcu bzhi la sogs par phye nas gsungs mod kyi| 'di ni/ rgyud las/ phra mo'i de ma thag nas rdzogs rim rgyas par gsungs te| de'i mthar bskyed rim gyi nyer bsdu gsungs pas bzlas pa mchod bstod/ mdun bskyed maṇḍal mchod pa dang bcas pa byas nas stan thog de nyid du/ rnal 'byor pa yongs rdzogs yin na rdzogs rim long skabs dang bstun pa yang bsgoms nas nyer bsdu bya dgos pas na/ yongs rdzogs la ltos te rdzogs rim yang bskyed rim dang 'brel ba'i thun gyi dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor yin zhing bskyed rim rkyang pa bas ni rdzogs rim sgom don med pas bzlas mchod kyi mthar nyer bsdu bya'o/ /gang ltar yang 'jug la/ thun dngos kyis bsdus pa dang*/ thun mtshams kyis bsdus pa gnyis su byas nas dang po la bzlas pa'i rnam gzhag rgyas pa dang*/ mchod pa rgyas pa ni mchod phreng du bshad zin cing*/ nyer bsdu ni/ brten pa lha rnams lus kyi rtsa'i 'khor lo so so la bsdu la de yang gtsug tor du bde chen 'khor lo'i gtso bo yab yum zhal phyag yongs rdzogs bsdus nas zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gnas pa'i rtsa 'khor lhag ma la gzhan rnams bsdu bar go don du bya la rten bsdu ba mi gsal yang*/ ka ba rnams dang rdo rje'i phraing bar lus phyi dkyil 'khor rtsig pa nyid ni rgyud pa rnams kyi mdzad do// ces sogs khams kyi rnam gzhag gi don dran nas dag bya de dang de dag tu gzhal yas khang gi cha de dang de dag bsdu bar mos par bya'o/ /bsdus nas thun mtshams bya ba ni/ 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug kun tu lha'i snang zhen brtan la bde stong gi rgyas thebs pa ni gtso bo yin la/ khyad par zas kyi rnal 'byor la sogs pa phyi nang gi sbyin sreg dang*/ ras bris la sogs pa'i mdun bskyed rgyas par sgrub mchod dang*/

dam tshig gso ba'i dbang khrus kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ /nyal ba dang ldang ba'i rnal 'byor dang*/ mtshan ma rnyed nas zhi rgyas la saugs pa'i las rab 'byams sgrub pa rnams te/ nyams len bsdus pa lag len du gsal la/ rab gnas sbyin bsreg tshogs 'khor gson gshin rjes 'dzin gyi cho ga rnams dkyil chog cha lag dang bcas pa rnams su rnam gzhag rgal brtag dang bcas pa dang*/ lag len mthong brgyud dang bcas pa bris zin cing*| |las rab 'byams kyi spros pa rnams dbang gi spyi don du bshad pa las shes par bya'o/ /'di ni sdus rgyud gtso bor gyur pa chos dbyings gsung dbang gi dkyil 'khor la gtso bor sbyar ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnal 'byor bshad pa yin la/ rtsa rgyud gtso bor gyur pa dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor stong drug brgya nyi shu'i rnam gzhag la pad ma gdan can gyi lha brgya dang nga drug /'dab ma'i lha mo bzhi brgya dang nyer bzhi thabs dang bcas pa ste dus 'khor rtsa ba'i lha grangs stong dang bzhi/ mngon brjod bde mchog gi dpal mo so drug thabs dang bcas pa'i steng du phyag rgya drug gi lha mo bsnan pas stong dang gya gnyis las gtso bo yab yum ma gtogs pa'i stong dang brgyad cu po rnams lo gsum nyi ma'i lha/ gsang ba 'dus pa lha dgu ma/ bcu gsum/ bcu dgu/ nyer lnga/ so gnyis/ so bzhi ma rnams sdoms pas brgya dang so gnyis thabs shes dang bcas pa dang*/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba zhe gsum/ zhe lnga/ zhe dgu ma rnams dril bas brgya dang so bdun thabs shes kyis phye ba ste/ /kun gril lnga brgya dang bzhi bcur gnyis kyis chad pa la sngar gyi gtso bor yab yum bsnan pa ni/ phyogs gsum gyi zhag zhe lnga po nyi khyim gyis bsgyur ba'i grangs yin pas phyogs gsum zla ba'i lha zhes gsungs zhing*/ /ye ler 'dus pa dang drwa ba'i dgos kyi dkyil 'khor bkod pa yang mdor bsdus mod kyi/ dkyil 'khor chen po gcig la 'god tshul gyi bkod pa mi gsal zhing rgya bod sus kyang ma gsungs pa/

kho bos rigs pa'i gtso bo mtha' gzhan khegs pa'am/ /'os med kyi rigs pa la bsten nas bsnyen bsgrub rnam bzhi sku gsum lam mkhyer dang bcas pa'i sgrub thabs zur na byas pa las rtogs par bya'o/ /'di'i mngon brjod/ bod snga ma kun gyis sdom chen la bshad pa ni/ de'i rnal 'byor ma don gnyis po la thabs sbyar na lha grangs mang zhing ma sbyar na dkyil 'khor gzhan kun la 'dab ma'i lha mo yang thabs shes sbyar nas 'di la mi sbyor ba mi rigs shing*/ sdom pa chung ba 'khor lo gsum pa'i dkyil 'khor la dus 'khor rang lugs kyi bkod pa zur pa ye ler gsungs pa yang don med du 'gyur bas mi 'thad pa'i phyir sdom pa chung ba'i dpa' mo so drug la sbyar dgos so/ /des na bde mchog lha don gnyis ma'i dkyil 'khor zhig gsungs pa 'di'i dgos kyi mngon rtogs zur pa yang thob cing*/ phyag rdor bstod 'grel la rten pa'i lha re gnyis ma gnyis med lugs kyi rim gnyis zur pa zhig kyang gzhan du brjod par bya'o/ /sdom pa che ba'i sgrub thabs ni bkod zin cing*/ dus 'khor lugs kyi gsang 'dus bskyed rdzogs kyang sngon chad rgya bod du ma byung mod kyi/ kho bos brjod par bya'o| |dkyil 'khor de dag gtso bo'i zhal gang las spros tshul dang*/ spyir rgyud sde so drug rnam dag dang*/ de dag gi sgrub gzhi rang chas su yod pas dri ma sbyangs nas 'thob tshul ye le'i stod du gsungs pa rnams kyang*/ sgrub le'i cha lag yin pas skabs 'dir bshadapar bya ba yin mod kyi rgyud 'grel na shin tu gsal ba dang*/ 'dir yi ge mang kyi dwaugs pas ma bris mod kyi/ rgya cher rgyud 'grel nyid las shes par bya'o/ 'dir smras pa/ dus 'khor bskyed rim lam du mi 'dod dang*/ /'dod kyang bsnyen bsgrub tshang bar mi 'dod cing*/ /sku gsum sku bzhi'i lam 'khyer mi 'tshol bar/ /lag len phra mo'i brgal brtag byed pa rnams/

/rnam 'byed mkhas la rten na zab lam gyis/ /pad mtshor yid kyi dang pa legs bshad kyi// dril chen sgrogs pa'i dpal ni 'byung bas na/ khengs pa dor nas 'bad pas lhur len mdzod/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i bskyed rim rnam par bshad pa bskyed rim snang ba'i nyin byed las dus 'khor dgos kyi bskyed rim bshad pa ste le'u lnga pa'o/ / bzhi pa lam nyams su blangs pas 'bras bu 'grub tshul la sbyor ba las chen bzhi bcu dang las phran re bzhi thun mong min pa mchog 'grub tshul rnams rgyud na'ang gsal zhing spyi don dang rol mtsho bdun na gsal lo/ /gang gi drin gyis bdag blo dbyar dus kyi/ /rlabs chen 'phel ba'i chu gter ji bzhin du/ /rgyas mdzad 'jam mgon bla ma'i zhabs pad la/ /snying nas bka' drin dran pas phyag bgyid do/ /mdo sngags chu klung stong phrag legs par bsdus// zab dang rgya che'i gting mtha' dpag par dka'/ /blo gsal klu dbang kun gyi bsten bya ba/ /bskyed rim rnam gzhag legs bshad chu gter yin/ /'on kyang rgyal ba'i dgongs zab dpag yas shing*/ /byis blo legs sbyangs mig sman mthu chung bas/ /ji bzhin ma mthong nyes par bshad srid na/ /mkhyen ldan mkhas pas rtsod dus dka' thub mdzod/ /dam pas bskyangs dang skye thob me long la// brtson pa'i byi dor cung zad sbyar ba las/ /mdo sngags rig gnas gzugs brnyan phal mo che/ /legs par legs bshad byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ /'di dang 'dir 'dra'i legs bshad dga' ston la/ /nyin dang mtshan tu rol ba'i skal bzang gis/ /phyogs kun gang bas thub bstan 'phel rgyas pa/ /mi pham mngon gyur de srid gnas gyur cig/ces dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub le'i kha skong dang bcas pa'i spyi don bskyed rim snang ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis kar dgos pa'i rgyun mtshan yan chad snga mo nas sbyar tshar ba bar skabs su yun ring du 'gyangs/
